# cloudscape_flutter

> Unofficial Flutter port of AWS Cloudscape Design System: every visual-refresh token in light, dark and compact density, 148 Cloudscape icons, and accessible, touch-ready components. Not affiliated with AWS.

Import `package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart`, wrap the app in `CsThemeProvider`, read the theme with `context.cs`. Widgets are prefixed `Cs`; props follow Cloudscape names (`variant`, `value`/`onChange`, `visible`/`onDismiss`, `items`); colors are `CsColor` tokens (`context.cs.colors.textBodyDefault`); spacing is `CsSpace` (fixed) and `context.cs.space` (density-aware); content text is body-m, 14px on 20px.

## Guides

- [Accessibility](doc/guides/accessibility.md): - **Semantics.** Every control exposes its role, label and state (button, link, checked, toggled, selected, expanded, slider value, text field). Icon-only buttons require a `semanticLabel` (an assert enforces it for `CsButton`).
- [For AI agents](doc/guides/for-ai-agents.md): This page is for coding agents that build Flutter apps with cloudscape_flutter.
- [Getting started](doc/guides/getting-started.md): Install the package, wrap your app in `CsThemeProvider`, and build with `Cs*` widgets.
- [Mobile](doc/guides/mobile.md): Cloudscape is designed for wide consoles. cloudscape_flutter keeps Cloudscape's look and switches to Cloudscape's own mobile behavior at its mobile breakpoint, 688px (`context.csIsNarrow`).
- [Motion](doc/guides/motion.md): Motion answers touch. Feedback on press, springs that start from where things are, sheets that follow the finger. Nothing loops forever.
- [Theming](doc/guides/theming.md): `CsThemeProvider(mode: ...)` takes `CsThemeMode.system` (default, follows the platform), `.light` or `.dark`. Mode changes cross-fade every token over 250ms (`CsDurations.complex`), instantly when motion is off.
- [Tokens](doc/guides/tokens.md): All tokens are generated by `tool/generate_theme.dart` from the visual refresh theme preset that ships inside `@cloudscape-design/components` (1,173 tokens, about twice what the public `@cloudscape-design/design-tokens` package exposes), so every component can use exactly the value Cloudscape uses.

## Components

- [CsActionCard](doc/components/CsActionCard.md): Cloudscape's `ActionCard`: a card that is one button or link, for choosing between a few actions or destinations.
- [CsAlert](doc/components/CsAlert.md): Cloudscape's `Alert`: a short, important message in the context of a page or form, such as a warning before a destructive action or a constraint the user should know about.
- [CsAnchorNavigation](doc/components/CsAnchorNavigation.md): A table of contents for a long page that jumps to sections and highlights the one in view.
- [CsAnchoredOverlay](doc/components/CsAnchoredOverlay.md): The positioning primitive behind every popover, tooltip, menu, select and combobox: it places a popup next to its trigger, flips and shifts it to stay on screen, follows the trigger and animates it in and out from the trigger.
- [CsAnnotationContext](doc/components/CsAnnotationContext.md): Runs a tutorial over the app: wrap the page in it so `CsHotspot`s below open the current step's annotation popover and a `CsTutorialPanel` shows progress.
- [CsAppLayout](doc/components/CsAppLayout.md): Cloudscape's `AppLayout`: the frame of a console page with navigation, breadcrumbs, notifications, content, a split panel and the tools panel or drawers.
- [CsAppLayoutToolbar](doc/components/CsAppLayoutToolbar.md): Cloudscape's `AppLayoutToolbar`: the app layout with a 42px toolbar row holding the navigation trigger, breadcrumbs and the tools and drawer triggers. Same API as `CsAppLayout`.
- [CsAreaChart](doc/components/CsAreaChart.md): An area chart that stacks series to show how parts add up to a total over time; the popover ends with the total.
- [CsAttributeEditor](doc/components/CsAttributeEditor.md): Cloudscape's `AttributeEditor`: rows of form fields with add and remove buttons, for key-value pairs, environment variables, headers and other repeated attributes.
- [CsAutosuggest](doc/components/CsAutosuggest.md): Cloudscape's `Autosuggest`: a text input that suggests options while the user types. Any text is a valid value; suggestions only help.
- [CsAvatar](doc/components/CsAvatar.md): A round picture of a person or a generative AI assistant in a chat, with initials, an icon, an image or a loading state.
- [CsBadge](doc/components/CsBadge.md): A small colored label for a count, a category or a severity, such as "New", "3" or "Critical".
- [CsBarChart](doc/components/CsBarChart.md): A bar chart that compares values across categories, grouped or stacked, vertical or horizontal.
- [CsBoard](doc/components/CsBoard.md): A configurable dashboard grid whose items people rearrange by dragging, resize from the corner, add from a palette and remove.
- [CsBoardItem](doc/components/CsBoardItem.md): The container for one item on a `CsBoard` or in a `CsItemsPalette`, with a drag handle, header, settings slot, content, footer and resize handle.
- [CsBox](doc/components/CsBox.md): Cloudscape's `Box`: the text and spacing primitive. A `variant` gives semantic text styles (headings, paragraph, small, code, key label, large value), with overrides for size, weight and color, and token-based padding and margin. `CsVisualAccent` is Box's `visualAccent`.
- [CsBreadcrumbGroup](doc/components/CsBreadcrumbGroup.md): Shows the path from the top of a service's hierarchy to the current page, so people can see where they are and move up.
- [CsButton](doc/components/CsButton.md): Cloudscape's `Button`: the control for actions, in normal, primary, link and icon variants, with icons, a loading state and a disabled reason.
- [CsButtonDropdown](doc/components/CsButtonDropdown.md): Cloudscape's `ButtonDropdown`: a button that opens a menu of actions, with groups, checkbox items, expandable groups, disabled reasons, external links and a split-button main action.
- [CsButtonGroup](doc/components/CsButtonGroup.md): Cloudscape's `ButtonGroup`: a compact row of icon actions (icon buttons, icon toggles, copy and an overflow menu), with tooltips and click feedback.
- [CsCalendar](doc/components/CsCalendar.md): An inline month grid (or a year of months) for picking one date; reach for it when the calendar should stay on the page, and for `CsDatePicker` when it belongs behind a field.
- [CsCards](doc/components/CsCards.md): Cloudscape's `Cards`: a collection shown as a grid of cards, with the header, filter, pagination and preferences slots of a collection and optional selection.
- [CsChartSeries](doc/components/CsChartSeries.md): The data types shared by `CsLineChart`, `CsBarChart`, `CsMixedLineBarChart` and `CsAreaChart`: series, data points, popover details, palette and copy.
- [CsChatBubble](doc/components/CsChatBubble.md): One message in a conversation with a person or a generative AI assistant, paired with an avatar and optional actions.
- [CsCheckbox](doc/components/CsCheckbox.md): A box with a label for a single on or off choice that is submitted with a form, or the "select all" control above a list.
- [CsCodeEditor](doc/components/CsCodeEditor.md): Cloudscape's `CodeEditor`, rebuilt in Flutter without Ace: a monospace editor with line numbers, syntax highlighting, an active line marker, validation and Cloudscape's status bar.
- [CsCodeView](doc/components/CsCodeView.md): A read-only code snippet with optional line numbers, line wrapping, syntax highlighting and a copy button.
- [CsCollection](doc/components/CsCollection.md): A pure-Dart port of Cloudscape's `useCollection` hook (`@cloudscape-design/collection-hooks`): text and property filtering, sorting, pagination and selection over an in-memory list, with the values `CsTable`, `CsCards`, a text filter and a pagination control need.
- [CsCollectionPreferences](doc/components/CsCollectionPreferences.md): Cloudscape's `CollectionPreferences`: a settings button for a table or cards that opens a modal with page size, line wrapping, striped rows, density, sticky columns, column order and visibility, and custom preferences.
- [CsColumnLayout](doc/components/CsColumnLayout.md): Cloudscape's `ColumnLayout`: lays content out in 1 to 4 equal columns (more with a minimum column width) that collapse on narrow widths.
- [CsContainer](doc/components/CsContainer.md): Cloudscape's `Container`: the standard panel for a block of related content, with an optional header, footer and media.
- [CsContentLayout](doc/components/CsContentLayout.md): Cloudscape's `ContentLayout`: the page frame inside the app layout content, with notifications, breadcrumbs, a page header and the content.
- [CsControlGroup](doc/components/CsControlGroup.md): Cloudscape's `ControlGroup` (`src/control-group`): joins form controls, such as an input and a select, or an input and an icon button, into one visual control with shared borders.
- [CsCopyToClipboard](doc/components/CsCopyToClipboard.md): Cloudscape's `CopyToClipboard`: copies a value (an ID, an ARN, a command) to the clipboard and confirms in a small popover.
- [CsDateInput](doc/components/CsDateInput.md): A masked text field for typing a date as `YYYY/MM/DD`; reach for it when users know the date and a calendar would slow them down.
- [CsDatePicker](doc/components/CsDatePicker.md): A date field with a calendar button that opens a `CsCalendar` in a dropdown, or a bottom sheet on phones; the default way to ask for one date.
- [CsDateRangePicker](doc/components/CsDateRangePicker.md): A trigger that opens a dropdown for picking an absolute range on a calendar, with optional times, or a relative range such as "Last 5 minutes"; the standard filter for time-based data.
- [CsDialog](doc/components/CsDialog.md): Cloudscape's `Dialog`: a small panel that opens in place, next to the content it is about (a quick rename inside a card, a confirmation in a side panel), without a backdrop and without blocking the rest of the page.
- [CsDialogRoute](doc/components/CsDialogRoute.md): A navigator route that draws the Cloudscape backdrop (`CsScrim`) and runs dialog motion around a custom widget; Escape, a backdrop tap and the back gesture pop it.
- [CsDivider](doc/components/CsDivider.md): Cloudscape's `Divider` (`src/divider`): a 1px line that separates content, horizontal (optionally labelled) or vertical.
- [CsDrawer](doc/components/CsDrawer.md): Cloudscape's `Drawer`: a panel with a header, scrolling content and a sticky footer, used in the app layout or over the screen.
- [CsDropdown](doc/components/CsDropdown.md): The floating container behind selects, multiselects, autosuggests and button dropdowns: Cloudscape's dropdown, anchored under its trigger on wide screens and a bottom sheet on phones.
- [CsEditable](doc/components/CsEditable.md): The bare text-editing core shared by every Cloudscape field: styled text, caret, selection color and placeholder, with no box or label.
- [CsErrorBoundary](doc/components/CsErrorBoundary.md): Cloudscape's `ErrorBoundary` (`src/error-boundary`): shows an error fallback in place of content that failed to build, so one broken section does not take down the screen.
- [CsExpandableSection](doc/components/CsExpandableSection.md): Cloudscape's `ExpandableSection`: a header that shows and hides its content, in six variants.
- [CsFieldBox](doc/components/CsFieldBox.md): The chrome of every Cloudscape text field: background, border, radius, focus ring and validation states, around any content.
- [CsFileDropzone](doc/components/CsFileDropzone.md): Cloudscape's `FileDropzone`: the dashed area files are dropped onto, with Cloudscape's hovered state.
- [CsFileInput](doc/components/CsFileInput.md): Cloudscape's `FileInput`: a button (or icon button) that opens a file picker, for custom upload flows.
- [CsFileTokenGroup](doc/components/CsFileTokenGroup.md): Cloudscape's `FileTokenGroup`: chosen files as tokens with name, size, date and image thumbnail, a dismiss button, and loading, error and warning states.
- [CsFileUpload](doc/components/CsFileUpload.md): Cloudscape's `FileUpload`: a "Choose file" button with constraint and validation text, and the chosen files as tokens.
- [CsFlashbar](doc/components/CsFlashbar.md): Cloudscape's `Flashbar`: page-level messages about the result of an action (an instance launched, a deletion failed) or an ongoing process, shown at the top of the page, optionally collapsed into a stack with a notification bar.
- [CsFocusRing](doc/components/CsFocusRing.md): Cloudscape's keyboard focus ring: 2px of `color-border-item-focused`, drawn outside a control so layout never shifts. `CsPressable` draws it for you; use `CsFocusRing` around focusable widgets that are not built on it.
- [CsFocusTrap](doc/components/CsFocusTrap.md): Keeps keyboard focus inside a subtree while it is on screen and hands focus back to whatever had it before when the subtree goes away. Cloudscape's `FocusLock`, used by modals, sheets and popovers with controls.
- [CsForm](doc/components/CsForm.md): The frame of a create or edit flow: header, form content, a form-level error and the action row.
- [CsFormField](doc/components/CsFormField.md): Wraps a form control with its label, description, constraint text, character count and validation message.
- [CsGrid](doc/components/CsGrid.md): Cloudscape's `Grid`: a 12-column responsive grid where each child sets its span, offset, push and pull per breakpoint.
- [CsHeader](doc/components/CsHeader.md): Cloudscape's `Header`: the title of a page, container or section, with a counter, info link, description, secondary content and actions.
- [CsHelpPanel](doc/components/CsHelpPanel.md): Cloudscape's `HelpPanel`: help content for the app layout's tools panel, with a header, body and a footer of related links.
- [CsHotspot](doc/components/CsHotspot.md): A marked place in the app that a tutorial step points to; while a tutorial runs it shows a marker that opens the step's annotation popover.
- [CsIcon](doc/components/CsIcon.md): Cloudscape's `Icon`: one of the 148 built-in `CsIcons`, drawn as a vector outline in the current text color, with Cloudscape's stroke width for each size.
- [CsIconProvider](doc/components/CsIconProvider.md): Cloudscape's `IconProvider` (`src/icon-provider`): replaces built-in icons by name for everything below it, including the icons inside components.
- [CsInput](doc/components/CsInput.md): A single-line text field for names, IDs, numbers, passwords and search queries.
- [CsItemCard](doc/components/CsItemCard.md): Cloudscape's `ItemCard`: a bordered card for one item, with an icon, title, description and actions in the header, content and a footer.
- [CsItemsPalette](doc/components/CsItemsPalette.md): A catalog of items people drag onto a `CsBoard`, with an add button as the keyboard and screen reader alternative.
- [CsKeyValuePairs](doc/components/CsKeyValuePairs.md): Labeled values of a resource in up to four responsive columns, such as the details section of an instance or a distribution.
- [CsLineChart](doc/components/CsLineChart.md): A line chart that shows how one or more values change over a continuous range, usually time, with optional thresholds.
- [CsLink](doc/components/CsLink.md): A text link that navigates somewhere or opens related content, such as the help panel.
- [CsList](doc/components/CsList.md): A vertical list of structured items (icon, content, secondary content, actions) separated by dividers, with an optional sortable mode for drag and keyboard reordering.
- [CsLiveRegion](doc/components/CsLiveRegion.md): Cloudscape's `LiveRegion`: announces content to screen readers whenever it changes, without moving focus, for results of filtering, saved states and other updates the user cannot see happen.
- [CsLoadingBar](doc/components/CsLoadingBar.md): A 2px animated gradient bar that shows a generative AI process is running.
- [CsMenuPanel](doc/components/CsMenuPanel.md): The surface and rows of dropdown menus: `CsMenuPanel` (the container), `CsMenuRow` (an option), `CsMenuGroupLabel` (a group heading), `CsMenuSeparator` (a divider) and `CsMenuKeyboard` (arrow-key movement).
- [CsMixedLineBarChart](doc/components/CsMixedLineBarChart.md): A chart that combines bars and lines on one categorical x axis, such as monthly costs with their running average and a budget threshold.
- [CsModal](doc/components/CsModal.md): Cloudscape's `Modal`: a dialog over a dimmed page that collects a decision or a short task (confirm a deletion, edit a setting) before the user goes on, with a header, scrollable content and a footer of actions.
- [CsMultiselect](doc/components/CsMultiselect.md): Cloudscape's `Multiselect`: pick any number of options from a dropdown list; the choice shows as dismissible tokens under the trigger.
- [CsNavigableGroup](doc/components/CsNavigableGroup.md): Cloudscape's `NavigableGroup` (`src/navigable-group`): makes a set of buttons, toggle buttons, button dropdowns or links a single Tab stop, with the arrow keys moving focus between them.
- [CsOptionList](doc/components/CsOptionList.md): Cloudscape's `OptionList` (`src/option-list`): an always visible list of options to pick one or several from, without a trigger or dropdown.
- [CsPagination](doc/components/CsPagination.md): Moves through pages of a table, cards or list, with page numbers, arrows and an optional jump-to-page field.
- [CsPanelLayout](doc/components/CsPanelLayout.md): Cloudscape's `PanelLayout`: a side panel next to main content with a draggable divider.
- [CsPieChart](doc/components/CsPieChart.md): A pie or donut chart that shows how parts make up a single whole, with segment labels, a legend, a segment filter and a detail popover.
- [CsPopover](doc/components/CsPopover.md): Cloudscape's `Popover`: a small panel of extra detail that opens from a trigger on tap, such as the full status of a resource, the definition of a term or a confirmation after copying a value.
- [CsPopupSurface](doc/components/CsPopupSurface.md): The floating surface of popovers, tooltips and dropdowns: Cloudscape's popover container (`color-background-popover`, a 2px `color-border-popover` border, 8px radius, `shadow-popover`) with an optional arrow that points at the anchor.
- [CsPressable](doc/components/CsPressable.md): The interaction primitive under every tappable Cloudscape component. Use it for custom rows, tiles and cards that need press feedback, hover, keyboard focus, a 44px touch target and semantics.
- [CsProgressBar](doc/components/CsProgressBar.md): Cloudscape's `ProgressBar`: how far an operation of known length has got, with a label, a percentage and, when it ends, a success or error result.
- [CsPromptInput](doc/components/CsPromptInput.md): Cloudscape's `PromptInput`: the multi-line field of a chat or generative AI experience, with a send button, actions under the text and content above it.
- [CsPropertyFilter](doc/components/CsPropertyFilter.md): Cloudscape's `PropertyFilter`: builds a query of `property operator value` tokens and free-text tokens for filtering a collection.
- [CsRadioButton](doc/components/CsRadioButton.md): A single radio button with a label, for building custom single-choice layouts; also exports the `CsRadioIcon` glyph and the `CsControlRow` layout.
- [CsRadioGroup](doc/components/CsRadioGroup.md): A list of mutually exclusive options where all choices stay visible.
- [CsS3ResourceSelector](doc/components/CsS3ResourceSelector.md): Cloudscape's `S3ResourceSelector`: an S3 URI input with a Browse button that opens a modal to pick a bucket, object or object version, plus a version picker and a View button.
- [CsScrim](doc/components/CsScrim.md): The backdrop behind modals and sheets: Cloudscape's `color-background-modal-overlay`, so the page behind recedes, and a full-screen tap target that closes the overlay.
- [CsSegmentedControl](doc/components/CsSegmentedControl.md): A row of 2 to 6 buttons in a pill where exactly one is active, for switching between views of the same content.
- [CsSelect](doc/components/CsSelect.md): Cloudscape's `Select`: pick one option from a dropdown list, with optional filtering, option groups, rich options and asynchronous loading states.
- [CsSheet](doc/components/CsSheet.md): A sheet attached to a screen edge that follows the finger, snaps by release velocity and dismisses with a flick, usually opened with `showCsSheet`. Cloudscape components use it on phones in place of anchored menus and panels.
- [CsSideNavigation](doc/components/CsSideNavigation.md): The list of pages of a service, with sections and groups, shown in the navigation drawer of the app layout.
- [CsSkeleton](doc/components/CsSkeleton.md): Cloudscape's `Skeleton`: a placeholder shaped like the content that is loading, so the layout does not jump when the content arrives.
- [CsSlider](doc/components/CsSlider.md): Picks a number from a range by dragging a handle along a track.
- [CsSpaceBetween](doc/components/CsSpaceBetween.md): Cloudscape's `SpaceBetween`: a vertical stack or a wrapping horizontal row with a token-sized gap between its children.
- [CsSpinner](doc/components/CsSpinner.md): Cloudscape's `Spinner`: shows that a short, unknown amount of work is in progress.
- [CsSplitPanel](doc/components/CsSplitPanel.md): Cloudscape's `SplitPanel`: a secondary panel, usually details of the selected item, under or beside the content of an app layout.
- [CsStatusIndicator](doc/components/CsStatusIndicator.md): An icon and short text for the state of a resource or process, such as "Running", "Stopped" or "3 errors".
- [CsSteps](doc/components/CsSteps.md): Shows the progress of a multi-step process, such as a deployment or a series of checks, with a status for each step.
- [CsStrings](doc/components/CsStrings.md): Shared built-in copy (Close, Cancel, Loading, status names, month and weekday names, pagination text) in one place, provided by `CsLocale` and read with `context.csStrings`. Component-specific copy is passed per component as `i18nStrings`, as in Cloudscape.
- [CsSupportPromptGroup](doc/components/CsSupportPromptGroup.md): Suggested prompts a user can send to a generative AI assistant with one tap.
- [CsTable](doc/components/CsTable.md): Cloudscape's `Table`: a collection of items in rows and columns, with sorting, selection, inline editing, expandable rows, resizable and sticky columns, and the header, filter, pagination and preferences slots of a collection.
- [CsTableBody](doc/components/CsTableBody.md): Cloudscape's `TableBody` (`src/table-body`): the rows of a `CsTableRoot`. It tells each `CsTableRow` its position, so striping, row dividers and joined selection outlines match `CsTable`.
- [CsTableBodyCell](doc/components/CsTableBodyCell.md): Cloudscape's `TableBodyCell` (`src/table-body-cell`): a data cell, or the header of its row, styled as `CsTable`'s cells.
- [CsTableHead](doc/components/CsTableHead.md): Cloudscape's `TableHead` (`src/table-head`): the header section of a `CsTableRoot`, holding one `CsTableRow` of `CsTableHeaderCell`s.
- [CsTableHeaderCell](doc/components/CsTableHeaderCell.md): Cloudscape's `TableHeaderCell` (`src/table-header-cell`): a column header with the label, the sorting caret, the divider to the next column and an optional resize handle, styled as `CsTable`'s headers.
- [CsTableRoot](doc/components/CsTableRoot.md): Cloudscape's `TableRoot` (`src/table-root`): the frame of a composable table. You build the head and rows from `CsTableHead`, `CsTableBody`, `CsTableRow`, `CsTableHeaderCell` and `CsTableBodyCell`; the root sizes the columns and draws the table the way `CsTable` does.
- [CsTableRow](doc/components/CsTableRow.md): Cloudscape's `TableRow` (`src/table-row`): one row of cells in a `CsTableHead` or `CsTableBody`.
- [CsTabs](doc/components/CsTabs.md): Cloudscape's `Tabs`: switches between panels of related content.
- [CsTagEditor](doc/components/CsTagEditor.md): Cloudscape's `TagEditor`: an attribute editor for resource tags with key and value suggestions, tag validation, a tag limit and undo for removing tags the resource already has.
- [CsTextContent](doc/components/CsTextContent.md): Long-form text with Cloudscape's typography and spacing: headings, paragraphs, small print, inline code, code blocks, links and lists, for help panels and "How it works" sections.
- [CsTextFieldState](doc/components/CsTextFieldState.md): A `State` mixin for controlled text fields: it owns a `TextEditingController` kept in sync with the widget's `value` and a `FocusNode` whose focus is mirrored in `focused`.
- [CsTextFilter](doc/components/CsTextFilter.md): Cloudscape's `TextFilter`: a search input that filters a collection by text, with the match count next to it.
- [CsTextarea](doc/components/CsTextarea.md): A multi-line text field for free-form text such as a description, a note or a policy document.
- [CsThemeProvider](doc/components/CsThemeProvider.md): The root of a Cloudscape app: resolves light or dark mode and density, applies color overrides and typography, provides `context.cs`, and cross-fades mode changes. `CsTheme` forces a theme for a subtree, `CsDensityScope` switches density for a subtree.
- [CsTiles](doc/components/CsTiles.md): A single choice shown as bordered cards, for options that need a description or an image to be compared.
- [CsTimeInput](doc/components/CsTimeInput.md): A masked text field for typing a time of day as `hh:mm:ss`, `hh:mm` or `hh`.
- [CsToggle](doc/components/CsToggle.md): An on/off switch for a setting that takes effect immediately.
- [CsToggleButton](doc/components/CsToggleButton.md): Cloudscape's `ToggleButton`: a button that stays pressed until pressed again.
- [CsToken](doc/components/CsToken.md): Cloudscape's `Token`: a compact, optionally dismissible representation of a chosen item, such as a selected option or an applied filter.
- [CsTokenGroup](doc/components/CsTokenGroup.md): Cloudscape's `TokenGroup`: a list of dismissible tokens with an optional limit and "Show more" toggle.
- [CsTooltip](doc/components/CsTooltip.md): Cloudscape's `Tooltip`: a short text label for a control, shown on hover after a delay, at once on keyboard focus, and on long press with touch. Drawn as Cloudscape's popover container with its arrow.
- [CsTopNavigation](doc/components/CsTopNavigation.md): The global bar above the app layout with the product identity, a search field and utilities such as notifications, settings and the user menu.
- [CsTreeView](doc/components/CsTreeView.md): Shows hierarchical items, such as folders and objects in a bucket or nested resources, that people can expand and collapse.
- [CsTruncatedText](doc/components/CsTruncatedText.md): Text that ends with an ellipsis when it does not fit and shows the full text in a tooltip on hover, keyboard focus or tap.
- [CsTutorialPanel](doc/components/CsTutorialPanel.md): Lists the available tutorials and, while one runs, its tasks, steps and progress; place it in the help or tools panel under a `CsAnnotationContext`.
- [CsVisualContext](doc/components/CsVisualContext.md): Recolors a subtree the way Cloudscape's `awsui-context-*` classes do: the always-dark top navigation and high-contrast header, and the inside of flash messages and alerts.
- [CsWizard](doc/components/CsWizard.md): A multi-page form that walks people through a complex task, such as launching an instance, one step at a time.

# Accessibility

- **Semantics.** Every control exposes its role, label and state (button, link, checked, toggled, selected, expanded, slider value, text field). Icon-only buttons require a `semanticLabel` (an assert enforces it for `CsButton`).
- **Keyboard.** Tab order follows visual order. Enter and Space activate. Arrow keys move within groups (radio groups, tabs, segmented controls, menus, option lists, calendars, tree views). Escape closes popovers, dropdowns, sheets and modals. Modals trap focus and return it to the trigger on close.
- **Focus ring.** Keyboard focus shows Cloudscape's 2px `color-border-item-focused` ring, drawn outside the control so layout never shifts. Fields show their focused border and a 1px ring.
- **Disabled with a reason.** Buttons and menu items with `disabledReason` stay focusable and explain themselves in a tooltip.
- **Contrast.** Cloudscape's text tokens pass WCAG AA on the surfaces Cloudscape puts them on. Check custom pairs with `CsColorUtils.contrastRatio`.
- **Status is never color alone.** Status indicators, flash messages, alerts and form errors carry an icon and text.
- **Announcements.** Flash messages, form errors, table selection and "Copied" confirmations are live regions; `CsLiveRegion` announces anything else.
- **Text scale** up to 2x, RTL layouts (directional icons mirror), and disabled or reduced motion are supported and tested.
- **Headings.** `CsHeader` and heading `CsBox` variants are marked as headings for screen reader navigation.

---
source: doc/guides/for-ai-agents.md

# For AI agents

This page is for coding agents that build Flutter apps with cloudscape_flutter.

## Install the skills

```sh
dart run cloudscape_flutter:install_skill            # into .claude/skills
dart run cloudscape_flutter:install_skill --agents   # also add a pointer to AGENTS.md
```

This installs two skills: `cloudscape-flutter` (components, tokens, recipes) and `cloudscape-flutter-craft` (the design, accessibility, motion and copy standard, with a delivery checklist). Read both before UI work.

## Where to look

- `llms.txt`: an index of every guide and component page. `llms-full.txt`: all of them in one file.
- `doc/components/<Name>.md`: one page per component with parameters, defaults, examples and the Cloudscape React mapping.
- The Cloudscape docs at https://cloudscape.design describe the same components for React; prop names carry over (`variant`, `value`/`onChange`, `visible`/`onDismiss`, `items`, `selectedItems`).

## Rules that keep output on-brand

1. Wrap the app in `CsThemeProvider`; read colors from `context.cs`, never hardcode hex values.
2. Content text is body-m (14/20); headings use `CsHeader` (page `h1`, container `h2`); labels and buttons are bold.
3. One `primary` `CsButton` per view, `normal` by default, `link` for Cancel, `icon` in toolbars.
4. Controls are controlled: hold the value in your state and pass it back in `onChange`.
5. Pages are `CsAppLayout` + `CsContentLayout`; blocks of content are `CsContainer` with a `CsHeader`; collections are `CsTable` or `CsCards` with `CsCollection` for filtering, sorting and pagination.
6. Every collection has `loading` + `loadingText`, an `empty` state and an error state.

---
source: doc/guides/getting-started.md
---

# Getting started

Install the package, wrap your app in `CsThemeProvider`, and build with `Cs*` widgets.

## Install

```sh
flutter pub add cloudscape_flutter
```

Flutter 3.38 or newer. Open Sans is bundled and the 148 Cloudscape icons are drawn as vectors; there is nothing else to set up.

## Wrap the app

`CsThemeProvider` resolves light or dark mode and density, provides `context.cs` and sets the default text style. Put it above `MaterialApp` and use `csMaterialTheme` so the Material widgets you still use (Scaffold, scroll bars, text selection) match Cloudscape.

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

void main() => runApp(const App());

class App extends StatelessWidget {
  const App({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return CsThemeProvider(
      mode: CsThemeMode.system,
      density: CsDensity.comfortable,
      child: Builder(
        builder: (context) => MaterialApp(
          theme: csMaterialTheme(context.cs),
          home: const InstancesPage(),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class InstancesPage extends StatelessWidget {
  const InstancesPage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: SafeArea(
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(CsSpace.l),
          child: CsSpaceBetween(
            size: CsSpacingSize.l,
            children: [
              CsHeader(
                variant: CsHeaderVariant.h1,
                title: 'Instances',
                actions: CsButton(text: 'Launch instance', variant: CsButtonVariant.primary, onPress: () {}),
              ),
              const CsContainer(
                header: CsHeader(title: 'Details'),
                child: CsStatusIndicator(type: CsStatusType.success, text: 'Running'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

## Read the theme

```dart
final cs = context.cs;
final surface = cs.colors.backgroundContainerContent; // a token as a field
final error = cs.color(CsColor.textStatusError);     // a token by enum
final body = cs.body;                                 // 14px Open Sans, color-text-body-default
final small = cs.text(CsTypeScale.bodyS, color: CsColor.textBodySecondary);
final gap = cs.space.scaledM;                         // 16px comfortable, 12px compact
```

- [Theming](theming.md): modes, density, visual contexts, brand overrides, fonts.
- [Tokens](tokens.md): colors, spacing, density, radii, borders, shadows, breakpoints.
- [Motion](motion.md): Cloudscape motion tokens, springs, gestures, disabled motion.
- [Mobile](mobile.md): how a console design system adapts to phones.
- [Accessibility](accessibility.md).
- [For AI agents](for-ai-agents.md): how to build screens with this package from an agent.

source: doc/guides/mobile.md

# Mobile

Cloudscape is designed for wide consoles. cloudscape_flutter keeps Cloudscape's look and switches to Cloudscape's own mobile behavior at its mobile breakpoint, 688px (`context.csIsNarrow`).

- **Hit areas.** On touch platforms every control's hit area is at least 44x44 (`CsTapTargetSize.padded`) while the visual keeps Cloudscape's 32px height.
- **App layout.** Navigation, tools and drawers open as full-screen overlays from the app layout's toolbar; the split panel docks at the bottom.
- **Dropdowns become sheets.** Selects, multiselects, autosuggest, button dropdowns and date pickers open in a bottom sheet that follows the finger. Components take `presentation: CsPresentation.auto | popover | sheet`.
- **Modals** take the full width minus gutters; long content scrolls between a sticky header and footer.
- **Tables** scroll horizontally with a sticky first column, or render rows as cards.
- **Breadcrumbs, top navigation and tabs** collapse their overflow into menus and scrollable rows.
- **Forms.** Form fields stretch to the full width; secondary controls move under the control.
- **Text scale.** Components use minimum heights, never fixed heights around text, and are tested at 2x.
- **Safe areas.** Sheets and overlays respect the system insets.

---
source: doc/guides/motion.md
---

# Motion

Motion answers touch. Feedback on press, springs that start from where things are, sheets that follow the finger. Nothing loops forever.

## Cloudscape's motion tokens

Fixed transitions use the motion tokens of Cloudscape's visual refresh theme:

| Token | Value | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CsDurations.responsive` + `CsCurves.responsive` | 115ms, `cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0, 1)` | Tooltips, popovers, small state changes |
| `CsDurations.expressive` + `CsCurves.expressive` | 165ms, `cubic-bezier(0.84, 0, 0.16, 1)` | Check marks, toggles, indicators |
| `CsDurations.complex` | 250ms | Panels, theme cross-fade |
| `CsDurations.showPaced` + `CsCurves.showPaced` | 180ms, ease-out | Expandable sections |
| `CsDurations.moderate` + `CsCurves.easeOutQuart` | 135ms | Caret rotation |

Wrap durations in `CsMotion.duration(context, d)` so disabled motion collapses them.

## Press feedback

Every tappable surface is a `CsPressable`. Its state changes on pointer-down: the surface scales to 0.98 with a spring, and hover and active colors switch instantly (hover colors are never animated).

## Springs

Anything a finger touches moves on a spring that starts from the current value and carries velocity, so it can be grabbed and reversed mid-flight.

| Spring | Damping | Response | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CsSprings.standard` | 1.0 | 0.35s | Things that move on their own |
| `CsSprings.press` | 1.0 | 0.2s | Press down and release |
| `CsSprings.popup` | 1.0 | 0.2s | Popovers and dropdowns scaling from their trigger |
| `CsSprings.sheet` | 0.86 | 0.32s | Sheets, drawers and panels settling after a drag |
| `CsSprings.momentum` | 0.8 | 0.35s | Only after a flick that carried momentum |

## Gestures

Drags follow the finger 1:1. On release the velocity goes into the spring, `CsMotion.project(velocity)` predicts where the gesture was heading, and `CsMotion.rubberband` resists past the bounds. Sheets, split panels, sliders and toggles work this way.

## Loops

A repeating animation runs only while a real state is true (a spinner or loading bar while loading, hotspots while a tutorial runs) and stops when hidden.

## Disabled and reduced motion

`CsMotion.reduceMotion(context)` is true when the platform asks for reduced motion or the theme has `disableMotion` (Cloudscape's `disableMotion`). Slides, scales and springs become instant changes. The spinner keeps turning, as in Cloudscape, so loading never looks stuck.

---
source: doc/guides/theming.md
---

# Theming

## Modes

`CsThemeProvider(mode: ...)` takes `CsThemeMode.system` (default, follows the platform), `.light` or `.dark`. Mode changes cross-fade every token over 250ms (`CsDurations.complex`), instantly when motion is off.

Force a mode for one subtree:

```dart
CsTheme(
  data: CsThemeData.dark(),
  child: const CsBox(text: 'Always dark'),
)
```

## Density

Cloudscape has two content densities. Comfortable is the default; compact tightens vertical spacing and makes controls 28px instead of 32px, for data-heavy pages.

```dart
CsThemeProvider(density: CsDensity.compact, child: const SizedBox())
```

Switch density for a subtree with `CsDensityScope`. Components read density-dependent spacing from `context.cs.space`, so they adapt on their own.

## Visual contexts

Cloudscape recolors parts of the page with `awsui-context-*` classes: the top navigation and the high-contrast page header are always dark, and flash messages and alerts recolor the controls inside them. `CsVisualContext` does the same for a subtree:

```dart
const CsVisualContext(
  context: CsVisualContextName.header,
  child: CsHeader(variant: CsHeaderVariant.h1, title: 'Amazon S3'),
)
```

Components that need a context (top navigation, flash messages, alerts, content layout's high-contrast header) apply it themselves.

## Brand overrides

Every color is a `CsColor` token, Cloudscape's `applyTheme` equivalent is a map of overrides per mode:

```dart
CsThemeProvider(
  lightColorOverrides: const {
    CsColor.backgroundButtonPrimaryDefault: Color(0xFF7B2FBE),
    CsColor.borderButtonPrimaryDefault: Color(0xFF7B2FBE),
  },
  darkColorOverrides: const {
    CsColor.backgroundButtonPrimaryDefault: Color(0xFFC08BF0),
    CsColor.borderButtonPrimaryDefault: Color(0xFFC08BF0),
  },
  child: const SizedBox(),
)
```

Check new pairings with `CsColorUtils.contrastRatio`: 4.5 for text, 3 for control boundaries. For full control, pass complete themes with `light:` and `dark:` (`CsThemeData.light().copyWith(...)`).

## Fonts

Open Sans (300, 400, 700) is bundled under the SIL OFL; it is the first family in Cloudscape's font stack. Monospace text uses Cloudscape's system stack (Monaco, Menlo, Consolas). To use your own faces, declare them in your app's pubspec and pass their family names with `package: null`:

```dart
CsThemeProvider(
  typography: const CsTypography(sans: 'BrandSans', package: null, mono: 'BrandMono'),
  child: const SizedBox(),
)
```

The OFL and Apache license texts are registered with Flutter's license page by the provider (`registerCsLicenses`).

## Motion

`CsThemeProvider(disableMotion: true)` is Cloudscape's `disableMotion`: transitions become instant everywhere. The platform's reduce-motion setting has the same effect.

## Tap targets

Cloudscape's controls are 32px tall. On touch platforms the provider pads hit areas to 44x44 without changing the visuals (`CsTapTargetSize.padded`); with a mouse they match the visual (`shrinkWrap`). Override with `tapTargetSize:`.

## Material bridge

`csMaterialTheme(context.cs)` builds a `ThemeData` from the Cloudscape theme (colors, text theme, no ink splashes). `CsMaterialTheme` does the same as a widget for a subtree.

## Copy and locale

Shared strings ("Close", "Loading", month names) come from `CsStrings`; provide your own with `CsLocale`. Component-specific copy is passed per component as `i18nStrings`, the way Cloudscape does.

```dart
CsLocale(
  strings: const CsStrings(close: 'Tutup', cancel: 'Batal', loading: 'Memuat'),
  child: const SizedBox(),
)
```

---
source: doc/guides/tokens.md
---

# Tokens

All tokens are generated by `tool/generate_theme.dart` from the visual refresh theme preset that ships inside `@cloudscape-design/components` (1,173 tokens, about twice what the public `@cloudscape-design/design-tokens` package exposes), so every component can use exactly the value Cloudscape uses.

## Colors

`CsColor` has 807 tokens: the palette (`grey500`, `blue600`), the data visualization palette (`chartsRed300`, `chartsPaletteCategorical1`...), and the semantic tokens components use (`textBodyDefault`, `backgroundButtonPrimaryDefault`, `borderInputFocused`). The Cloudscape name minus its `color` prefix is the Dart name.

```dart
Container(
  color: context.cs.colors.backgroundContainerContent,
  child: Text('Error', style: TextStyle(color: context.cs.colors.textStatusError)),
)
```

`CsColorSchemes.light` and `.dark` hold the values; `CsColorSchemes.contextOverrides(context, brightness)` holds what each visual context recolors.

## Spacing

| Token | Value | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CsSpace.xxxs` | 2 | Hairline gaps |
| `CsSpace.xxs` | 4 | Icon to text, label to control |
| `CsSpace.xs` | 8 | Between buttons |
| `CsSpace.s` | 12 | Field horizontal padding |
| `CsSpace.m` | 16 | |
| `CsSpace.l` | 20 | Container horizontal padding |
| `CsSpace.xl` | 24 | |
| `CsSpace.xxl` | 32 | Between page sections |
| `CsSpace.xxxl` | 40 | |

`CsSpace` also has the named fixed tokens (`fieldHorizontal`, `containerHorizontal`, `buttonFocusOutlineGutter`...). Spacing that changes with density lives on the theme: `context.cs.space.scaledM` is 16px comfortable and 12px compact; so are `sizeVerticalInput` (32/28), `buttonVertical`, `fieldVertical`, `containerContentVertical` and the rest of `CsDensityTokens`. `CsDensityTokens.compactTable` holds what tables use in compact content density.

## Type

`CsTypeScale` pairs each font size with its line height, weight and letter spacing:

| Step | Size / line | Weight |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bodyS` | 12 / 16 | 400 |
| `bodyM` | 14 / 20 | 400 |
| `headingXs` | 14 / 18 | 700 |
| `headingS` | 16 / 20 | 700 |
| `headingM` | 18 / 22 | 700 |
| `headingL` | 20 / 24 | 700 |
| `headingXl` | 24 / 30 | 700 |
| `displayL` | 42 / 48 | 700 |
| `displayXl` | 64 / 72 | 400 |

Use `context.cs.text(CsTypeScale.headingM)` or, for semantic text, `CsBox(variant: CsBoxVariant.h3)`. Raw values are in `CsFontTokens`.

## Borders and radii

`CsBorderRadius` (`button` 20, `container` 16, `input` 8, `dropdown` 8, `badge` 4...), `CsBorderWidth` (`button` 2, `field` 1, `popover` 2, `fieldStatusInlineStart` 8...) and `CsBorderLine` (divider and focus ring widths).

## Shadows

`context.cs.shadows` (`CsShadows.light` / `.dark`): `dropdown`, `popover`, `modal`, `sticky`, `stickyEmbedded`, `panel`, `splitBottom`, `splitSide`, `container`... Resting containers have none in visual refresh.

## Motion

`CsDurations` (`responsive` 115ms, `expressive` 165ms, `complex` 250ms, `showPaced` 180ms, `fast` 90ms...) and `CsCurves` (`responsive`, `expressive`, `sticky`, `showPaced`...). See [Motion](motion.md).

## Breakpoints

`CsBreakpoint`: `xxs` 465, `xs` 688 (the mobile breakpoint), `s` 912, `m` 1120, `l` 1320, `xl` 1840. `context.csIsNarrow` is true at 688px and below.

---
source: doc/components/CsActionCard.md
---

# CsActionCard

Cloudscape's `ActionCard`: a card that is one button or link, for choosing between a few actions or destinations.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/action-card/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsActionCard(
  header: const Text('Launch instance'),
  description: const Text('Start a virtual server from an image.'),
  icon: const CsIcon(CsIcons.angleRight),
  onPress: () {},
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use action cards for a small set of starting points ("Create bucket", "Import a template"). Do not put buttons or links inside an action card; use `CsItemCard` for cards that hold their own actions.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `header` | `Widget?` |  | Title, heading-s |
| `description` | `Widget?` |  | Body-s under the title |
| `child` | `Widget?` |  | More content |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` |  | Cloudscape `onClick` |
| `isLink` / `onFollow` | `bool` / `VoidCallback?` | `false` | Announce as a link and follow it (Cloudscape `href`) |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` |  | Accessible name; replaces the content in the name |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disabled colors, no presses |
| `icon` | `Widget?` |  | At the end of the card |
| `iconVerticalAlignment` | `CsActionCardIconVerticalAlignment` | `top` | `top` or `center` |
| `variant` | `CsActionCardVariant` | `defaultVariant` | `defaultVariant` or `embedded` |
| `disableHeaderPaddings`, `disableContentPaddings`, `fitHeight` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `focusNode`, `autofocus` |  |  | Focus control (Cloudscape `ref.focus()`) |

## Examples

### Embedded, centered icon

```dart
CsActionCard(
  variant: CsActionCardVariant.embedded,
  iconVerticalAlignment: CsActionCardIconVerticalAlignment.center,
  header: const Text('Import a template'),
  icon: const CsIcon(CsIcons.upload),
  onPress: () {},
)
```

### Disabled

```dart
const CsActionCard(header: Text('Create stack'), description: Text('Unavailable while a stack updates.'), disabled: true)
```

## Accessibility

A button (or link with `isLink`) named by `ariaLabel` or its content; disabled cards report disabled. Tab focuses with a 2px ring outside the card; Enter and Space activate.

## Motion

Pressing scales the card to 0.98 with a spring from pointer-down. Hover and active colors switch at once (Cloudscape animates them; this package never animates hover colors). Reduced motion turns the scale off.

## Mobile

Touch targets are the whole card. Text wraps at 2x without overflow.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `onClick` | `onPress` |
| `href`, `target`, `rel`, `download` | `isLink` + `onFollow` (navigation is the app's) |
| `variant: 'default'` | `CsActionCardVariant.defaultVariant` |
| `ref.focus()` | `focusNode.requestFocus()` |
| `nativeButtonAttributes`, `nativeAnchorAttributes`, `ariaDescribedby` | web only, not ported |

---
source: doc/components/CsAlert.md
---

# CsAlert

Cloudscape's `Alert`: a short, important message in the context of a page or form, such as a warning before a destructive action or a constraint the user should know about.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/alert/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsAlert(
  type: CsAlertType.warning,
  header: 'Instance is running',
  content: 'Stop i-0abc123 before you change its instance type.',
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use an alert for a message tied to the content around it that stays until the situation changes. For feedback on an action the user just took (created, deleted, failed) use `CsFlashbar` at the top of the page. For field validation use the `errorText` of `CsFormField`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `CsAlertType` | `info` | `success`, `error`, `warning`, `info` |
| `header` | `String?` | | Bold heading |
| `headerWidget` | `Widget?` | | Rich content in place of `header` |
| `content` | `String?` | | Message text |
| `child` | `Widget?` | | Rich message in place of `content` |
| `action` | `Widget?` | | An action next to the message (a button) |
| `buttonText` | `String?` | | Shows a normal button as the action; ignored when `action` is set |
| `onButtonPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | Pressed `buttonText` button |
| `dismissible` | `bool` | `false` | Shows a close button |
| `onDismiss` | `VoidCallback?` | | Close button pressed |
| `dismissAriaLabel` | `String?` | `'Dismiss alert'` | Close button name (i18nStrings wins) |
| `statusIconAriaLabel` | `String?` | type name | Status icon name (i18nStrings wins) |
| `visible` | `bool` | `true` | Hidden alerts take no space |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsAlertI18nStrings?` | | `successIconAriaLabel`, `errorIconAriaLabel`, `warningIconAriaLabel`, `infoIconAriaLabel`, `dismissAriaLabel` |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | | Lets the page move focus to the message (Cloudscape `ref.focus()`) |

## Examples

### Every type

```dart
Column(
  children: [
    for (final t in CsAlertType.values)
      Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
        child: CsAlert(type: t, content: 'Sample ${t.name} message about example-bucket.'),
      ),
  ],
)
```

### Action and dismiss

```dart
CsAlert(
  type: CsAlertType.error,
  header: 'Could not delete bucket',
  content: 'example-bucket is not empty.',
  action: CsButton(text: 'Empty bucket', onPress: () {}),
  dismissible: true,
  onDismiss: () {},
)
```

## Accessibility

The status icon carries the type name ("Warning") so status is never color alone. The message is a semantics group; the header is marked as a heading. Alerts are not announced on their own, as in Cloudscape: move focus to them with `focusNode` after a failed submit, or wrap them in a `CsLiveRegion`. The close button has an accessible name.

## Motion

The alert fades in over Cloudscape's 180ms `motion-duration-show-paced` whenever it becomes visible; reduced motion shows it at once.

## Mobile

The action sits beside the message while the message keeps at least 70% of the width and moves below it otherwise (indented under the text), as Cloudscape's flex-wrap does. At 390px with a button action it wraps. Text wraps; nothing has a fixed height.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `type`, `action`, `buttonText`, `dismissible`, `onDismiss`, `dismissAriaLabel`, `statusIconAriaLabel`, `visible`, `i18nStrings` | same names |
| `header` | `header` / `headerWidget` |
| `children` | `content` / `child` |
| `onButtonClick` | `onButtonPress` |
| `ref.focus()` | `focusNode` |
| `persistenceConfig`, `analyticsMetadata`, `style` | not applicable |

---
source: doc/components/CsAnchorNavigation.md
---

# CsAnchorNavigation

A table of contents for a long page that jumps to sections and highlights the one in view.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/anchor-navigation/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsAnchorNavigation(
  anchors: const [
    CsAnchorNavigationAnchor(text: 'Overview', href: '#overview'),
    CsAnchorNavigationAnchor(text: 'Pricing', href: '#pricing'),
    CsAnchorNavigationAnchor(text: 'On-demand', href: '#on-demand', level: 2),
  ],
  activeHref: '#pricing',
  onFollow: (anchor) {},
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use on long documentation or detail pages with several sections, usually in the tools panel or beside the content.
- Do not use for moving between pages (use `CsSideNavigation`) or for a few short sections that fit one screen.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `anchors` | `List<CsAnchorNavigationAnchor>` | required | Anchors in page order. |
| `activeHref` | `String?` | `null` | The active anchor. When set, the highlight is controlled and the scroll spy is ignored. |
| `scrollSpy` | `CsAnchorScrollSpy?` | `null` | Follows the scroll position when `activeHref` is null and scrolls to sections on follow. |
| `scrollOnFollow` | `bool` | `true` | Scroll to the section through `scrollSpy` when an anchor is followed. |
| `onFollow` | `ValueChanged<CsAnchorNavigationAnchor>?` | `null` | Called when an anchor is followed. |
| `onActiveHrefChange` | `ValueChanged<CsAnchorNavigationAnchor>?` | `null` | Called when the active anchor changes, from scrolling or from `activeHref`. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `CsStrings.tableOfContents` | Accessible name of the list. |

`CsAnchorNavigationAnchor(text:, href:, level: 1, info:)`: `level` starts at 1 and indents 16px per level; `info` adds a short bold tag such as "New".

### CsAnchorScrollSpy

`CsAnchorScrollSpy(controller:, sections:, offset: 0)` is a `ChangeNotifier` that tracks which section of a scroll view is in view. `sections` maps each anchor href to the `GlobalKey` of its section, in page order. `offset` is the height covering the top of the viewport (a sticky header). Read `activeHref`, call `scrollTo(href)`, and dispose it with the scroll controller.

## Examples

### Following the scroll position

```dart
class DocsPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const DocsPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<DocsPage> createState() => _DocsPageState();
}

class _DocsPageState extends State<DocsPage> {
  final controller = ScrollController();
  final overview = GlobalKey();
  final pricing = GlobalKey();
  late final spy = CsAnchorScrollSpy(
    controller: controller,
    sections: {'#overview': overview, '#pricing': pricing},
  );

  @override
  void dispose() {
    spy.dispose();
    controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Row(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            controller: controller,
            child: Column(
              children: [
                CsContainer(key: overview, child: const Text('Overview')),
                CsContainer(key: pricing, child: const Text('Pricing')),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
        SizedBox(
          width: 240,
          child: CsAnchorNavigation(
            scrollSpy: spy,
            anchors: const [
              CsAnchorNavigationAnchor(text: 'Overview', href: '#overview'),
              CsAnchorNavigationAnchor(text: 'Pricing', href: '#pricing', info: 'Updated'),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

## Accessibility

- The list is a labeled container ("Table of contents" by default).
- Anchors are links; the active one is marked selected (Cloudscape's `aria-current`). The info tag is read after the text.
- Tab moves through anchors; Enter and Space follow them.

## Motion

The accent bar fades between anchors over `CsDurations.slow`. Scrolling to a section animates over `CsDurations.complex`; both are instant under reduced motion. Hover colors switch instantly.

## Mobile

The list wraps long titles. On touch screens each anchor row is at least 36px tall. On phones, place it above the content or in a sheet rather than beside it.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `anchors` (`text`, `href`, `level`, `info`) | `anchors` (`CsAnchorNavigationAnchor`) |
| `activeHref` | `activeHref` |
| `scrollSpyOffset` | `CsAnchorScrollSpy.offset` |
| internal scroll spy (window scroll) | `scrollSpy` (`CsAnchorScrollSpy` on a `ScrollController`) |
| `onFollow` | `onFollow` |
| `onActiveHrefChange` | `onActiveHrefChange` |
| `ariaLabelledby` | `ariaLabel` |

---
source: doc/components/CsAnchoredOverlay.md
---

# CsAnchoredOverlay

The positioning primitive behind every popover, tooltip, menu, select and combobox: it places a popup next to its trigger, flips and shifts it to stay on screen, follows the trigger and animates it in and out from the trigger.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/popover/ (a foundation primitive; Cloudscape has no public equivalent)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsAnchoredOverlay(
  open: true,
  onDismiss: () {},
  overlayBuilder: (context, placement) => CsPopupSurface(
    placement: placement,
    showArrow: true,
    child: const Text('Copied'),
  ),
  child: CsButton(text: 'Copy', onPress: () {}),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to build a custom floating panel attached to a trigger. Reach for the finished components first: `CsPopover` for detail panels, `CsTooltip` for labels, `CsDropdown` for option lists (it also becomes a bottom sheet on phones). For full-screen or blocking UI use `CsModal` or `showCsSheet`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `bool` | required | Shows the popup; the parent owns it |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The anchor (trigger) |
| `overlayBuilder` | `CsPopupBuilder` | required | `(context, CsPopupPlacement placement) => Widget` |
| `onDismiss` | `VoidCallback?` | | Outside tap or Escape; set `open` to false |
| `side` | `CsSide` | `bottom` | `top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`; flips when the side has less than `preferredExtent` and the other side has more |
| `align` | `CsAlign` | `center` | `start`, `center`, `end` along the anchor edge |
| `sideOffset` | `double` | `8` | Gap between anchor and popup |
| `alignOffset` | `double` | `0` | Shift along the edge |
| `collisionPadding` | `double` | `8` | Minimum distance from the screen edges (and the keyboard) |
| `preferredExtent` | `double` | `200` | Room the popup would like before it flips |
| `matchAnchorWidth` | `bool` | `false` | At least as wide as the anchor |
| `dismissOnOutsideTap` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `closeOnEscape` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `trapFocus` | `bool` | `false` | Move focus in, cycle Tab inside, restore on close |
| `restoreFocus` | `bool` | `true` | With `trapFocus`, give focus back to the anchor |
| `useRootOverlay` | `bool` | `true` | Render in the root overlay |
| `animate` | `bool` | `true` | False shows and hides instantly |
| `onClosed` | `VoidCallback?` | | After the exit animation finished |
| `tapRegionGroupId` | `Object?` | | Treat taps inside other widgets of this group as inside |
| `focusPopupWhenUnfocused` | `bool` | `true` | Give the popup focus when nothing had keyboard focus, so Escape reaches it |

`CsPopupPlacement` tells the builder the resolved `side`, `align`, `anchorRect`, the room left (`maxWidth`, `maxHeight`) and, while painting, `popupRect` and `arrowOffset(popup)` for an arrow.

## Examples

### A menu below a button

```dart
CsAnchoredOverlay(
  open: true,
  side: CsSide.bottom,
  align: CsAlign.start,
  matchAnchorWidth: true,
  trapFocus: true,
  onDismiss: () {},
  overlayBuilder: (context, placement) => CsPopupSurface(
    padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
    child: ConstrainedBox(
      constraints: BoxConstraints(maxHeight: placement.maxHeight),
      child: const SingleChildScrollView(child: Text('Stop instance\nReboot instance\nTerminate instance')),
    ),
  ),
  child: CsButton(text: 'Instance state', onPress: () {}),
)
```

## Accessibility

Escape and outside taps call `onDismiss`. With `trapFocus` the popup is a focus trap (see `CsFocusTrap`); without it, focus stays on the anchor, and when nothing had focus the popup takes it so Escape works. Give the popup content its own semantics (a label, a header).

## Motion

The popup scales from 0.9 with its transform origin on the anchor and fades over Cloudscape's 115ms responsive motion; closing runs the same path. The scale is a spring, so reopening mid-close turns around from where it is. Reduced motion keeps only the fade.

## Mobile

The popup flips to the side with more room, shifts along the edge to stay `collisionPadding` inside the screen, and treats the on-screen keyboard as an edge. On phones prefer `CsDropdown` with `CsPresentation.auto`, which turns long lists into bottom sheets.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape concept | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| popover `position` | `side` + `align` |
| `renderWithPortal` | `useRootOverlay` |
| dropdown `expandToViewport`, `stretchWidth` | `useRootOverlay`, `matchAnchorWidth` |

---
source: doc/components/CsAnnotationContext.md
---

# CsAnnotationContext

Runs a tutorial over the app: wrap the page in it so `CsHotspot`s below open the current step's annotation popover and a `CsTutorialPanel` shows progress.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/annotation-context/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

class Console extends StatefulWidget {
  const Console({super.key, required this.tutorials, required this.page});

  final List<CsTutorial> tutorials;
  final Widget page;

  @override
  State<Console> createState() => _ConsoleState();
}

class _ConsoleState extends State<Console> {
  CsTutorial? _tutorial;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => CsAnnotationContext(
    currentTutorial: _tutorial,
    onStartTutorial: (t) => setState(() => _tutorial = t.copyWith(completed: false)),
    onExitTutorial: (_) => setState(() => _tutorial = null),
    onFinish: () => setState(() => _tutorial = _tutorial!.copyWith(completed: true)),
    child: Row(
      children: [
        Expanded(child: widget.page),
        SizedBox(width: 320, child: CsTutorialPanel(tutorials: widget.tutorials)),
      ],
    ),
  );
}
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it with `CsHotspot` and `CsTutorialPanel` for hands-on tutorials that guide users through real tasks in the app.
- Keep tutorials short: a few tasks of a few steps each.
- Do not use it for one-off hints (use a popover) or for product announcements.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `currentTutorial` | `CsTutorial?` | required | The running tutorial, or null. |
| `onStartTutorial` | `ValueChanged<CsTutorial>` | required | The user started a tutorial from the panel. Set `currentTutorial`. |
| `onExitTutorial` | `ValueChanged<CsTutorial>` | required | The user left the tutorial. Set `currentTutorial` to null. |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The page. |
| `onStepChange` | `void Function(int step, CsStepChangeReason reason)?` | `null` | Current step changed: `next`, `previous`, `open` (a marker was pressed) or `autoFallback`. |
| `onFinish` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Finish pressed on the last step. Mark the tutorial completed. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsAnnotationI18nStrings` | English | `nextButtonText`, `previousButtonText`, `finishButtonText`, `labelDismissAnnotation`, `labelHotspot(open, stepIndex, total)`, `stepCounterText(stepIndex, total)`, `taskTitle(taskIndex, title)`. Indexes are 0-based. |
| `pulseHotspots` | `bool` | `true` | The current step's marker pulses a few times when it becomes current. |

Tutorial data:

| Class | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| `CsTutorial` | `title`, `description` (`Widget`), `tasks`, `completedScreenDescription` (`Widget`), `completed` (`false`), `prerequisitesNeeded` (`false`), `prerequisitesAlert` (`Widget?`), `onLearnMore` (`VoidCallback?`); `copyWith(completed:, prerequisitesNeeded:)`, `totalStepCount` |
| `CsTutorialTask` | `title`, `steps` |
| `CsTutorialStep` | `title`, `content` (`Widget`), `hotspotId`, `warningAlert` (`Widget?`) |

`CsAnnotationContext.maybeOf(context)` returns `CsAnnotationContextData` (current tutorial, current step, and the actions hotspots and the panel use). `CsTutorialStepInfo.of(tasks, index)` resolves a global step index to its task and step.

## Examples

### Tutorial data

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

const createBucket = CsTutorial(
  title: 'Create a bucket',
  description: Text('Store objects in a new bucket.'),
  completedScreenDescription: Text('You created a bucket. Upload objects next.'),
  tasks: [
    CsTutorialTask(
      title: 'Name the bucket',
      steps: [
        CsTutorialStep(title: 'Enter a name', content: Text('Type a globally unique name.'), hotspotId: 'bucket-name'),
        CsTutorialStep(
          title: 'Choose a region',
          content: Text('Pick the region closest to your users.'),
          warningAlert: Text('The region cannot change later.'),
          hotspotId: 'bucket-region',
        ),
      ],
    ),
  ],
);
```

## Accessibility

The context itself renders nothing. Its popovers are dialogs named by the task title and step counter; the hotspot markers are buttons with `labelHotspot` labels and an expanded state.

## Motion

None of its own; see `CsHotspot` for the popover and pulse.

## Mobile

Popovers flip and shift to stay on screen, are at most 310px wide, and scroll when the content is taller than the room available.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `currentTutorial` | `currentTutorial` |
| `onStartTutorial` / `onExitTutorial` (`detail.tutorial`) | `onStartTutorial` / `onExitTutorial` (the tutorial) |
| `onStepChange` (`detail.step`, `detail.reason`) | `onStepChange(step, reason)`; `'auto-fallback'` is `CsStepChangeReason.autoFallback` |
| `onFinish` | `onFinish` |
| `i18nStrings` | `i18nStrings` (`CsAnnotationI18nStrings`) |
| `children` | `child` |
| tutorial `learnMoreUrl` | `CsTutorial.onLearnMore` |

source: doc/components/CsAppLayout.md

# CsAppLayout

Cloudscape's `AppLayout`: the frame of a console page with navigation, breadcrumbs, notifications, content, a split panel and the tools panel or drawers.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/app-layout/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsAppLayout(
  navigation: const Text('Side navigation'),
  breadcrumbs: const Text('Instances'),
  tools: const CsHelpPanel(header: 'Instances', child: Text('Help')),
  content: const CsContentLayout(
    header: CsHeader(variant: CsHeaderVariant.h1, title: 'Instances'),
    child: Text('Instances table'),
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it once, as the root of every console page. Give it a bounded size (it fills its parent). Use `CsAppLayoutToolbar` for the toolbar variant with triggers in a top row.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `Widget?` |  | Page content, often a `CsContentLayout` |
| `contentHeader` | `Widget?` |  | Header above the content |
| `navigation` | `Widget?` |  | Side navigation |
| `navigationOpen` | `bool?` |  | Controlled; null lets the layout manage it (from `contentType`, closed on phones) |
| `onNavigationChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` |  |  |
| `navigationWidth` | `double` | `280` |  |
| `navigationHide` | `bool` | `false` | Removes navigation and its toggle |
| `tools` | `Widget?` |  | Help content, usually `CsHelpPanel` |
| `toolsOpen` | `bool?` |  | Controlled; null lets the layout manage it |
| `onToolsChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` |  |  |
| `toolsWidth` | `double` | `290` |  |
| `toolsHide` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `breadcrumbs` | `Widget?` |  |  |
| `notifications` | `Widget?` |  | Usually a `CsFlashbar`; announced as a live region |
| `stickyNotifications` | `bool` | `false` | Notifications stay pinned while content scrolls |
| `contentType` | `CsAppLayoutContentType` | `defaultVariant` | `defaultVariant`, `form` (nav closed, 800px), `table`, `cards`, `wizard` (nav closed, 1080px), `dashboard` |
| `maxContentWidth` | `double?` |  | Overrides the content type cap |
| `minContentWidth` | `double` | `280` |  |
| `disableContentPaddings` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `disableContentHeaderOverlap` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `headerVariant` | `CsAppLayoutHeaderVariant` | `defaultVariant` | `defaultVariant` or `highContrast` |
| `splitPanel` | `Widget?` |  | Usually a `CsSplitPanel` |
| `splitPanelOpen` | `bool?` |  | Controlled; null lets the layout manage it (starts closed) |
| `onSplitPanelToggle` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` |  |  |
| `splitPanelSize` | `double?` |  | Height (bottom) or width (side) |
| `onSplitPanelResize` | `ValueChanged<double>?` |  |  |
| `splitPanelPosition` | `CsSplitPanelPosition?` |  | `bottom` or `side`; controlled preferences |
| `onSplitPanelPreferencesChange` | `ValueChanged<CsSplitPanelPosition>?` |  |  |
| `drawers` | `List<CsAppLayoutDrawer>` | `[]` | `id`, `content`, `ariaLabels`, `icon`, `iconWidget`, `badge`, `resizable`, `defaultSize`, `onResize` |
| `activeDrawerId` | `String?` |  | Controlled open drawer |
| `onDrawerChange` | `ValueChanged<String?>?` |  | Drawer to open, or null |
| `ariaLabels` | `CsAppLayoutLabels` |  | Region and toggle names |
| `mobile` | `bool?` |  | Forces the phone (true) or wide (false) layout |

## Examples

### Controlled panels and drawers

```dart
CsAppLayout(
  navigation: const Text('Side navigation'),
  navigationOpen: true,
  onNavigationChange: (open) {},
  drawers: const [
    CsAppLayoutDrawer(
      id: 'security',
      icon: CsIcons.security,
      badge: true,
      resizable: true,
      ariaLabels: CsAppLayoutDrawerLabels(drawerName: 'Security findings'),
      content: CsDrawer(header: Text('Security findings'), child: Text('2 findings')),
    ),
  ],
  activeDrawerId: 'security',
  onDrawerChange: (id) {},
  content: const Text('Instances table'),
)
```

### Split panel

```dart
CsAppLayout(
  splitPanel: const CsSplitPanel(header: 'i-0abc123', child: Text('Details')),
  splitPanelOpen: true,
  onSplitPanelToggle: (open) {},
  splitPanelPosition: CsSplitPanelPosition.side,
  onSplitPanelPreferencesChange: (position) {},
  content: const Text('Instances table'),
)
```

## Accessibility

Navigation, tools, drawers and notifications are named regions (`ariaLabels`). Toggles are labelled buttons with toggled state. Phone overlays trap focus and close with Escape. Notifications are a live region.

## Motion

Wide-screen navigation opens and closes by animating its width over `motion-duration-complex` (250ms, expressive easing). Phone overlays slide in from their edge over the same duration. Reduced motion makes both instant. Resizing drawers and the split panel follows the pointer 1:1.

## Mobile

At or below 688px of the layout's own width (so it also works inside a narrower frame), or with `mobile: true`, a 40px bar along the top holds the navigation toggle, breadcrumbs and the tools and drawer triggers. Navigation, tools, drawers and an open split panel open as full-screen overlays. Moving to the phone layout closes an uncontrolled navigation.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `content / contentHeader` | same names |
| `navigation / navigationOpen / onNavigationChange / navigationWidth / navigationHide` | same names (`onNavigationChange` gets a bool) |
| `tools / toolsOpen / onToolsChange / toolsWidth / toolsHide` | same names |
| `breadcrumbs / notifications / stickyNotifications` | same names |
| `contentType` | `contentType` (`CsAppLayoutContentType`) |
| `maxContentWidth / minContentWidth` | same names |
| `disableContentPaddings / disableContentHeaderOverlap / headerVariant` | same names |
| `splitPanel / splitPanelOpen / onSplitPanelToggle / splitPanelSize / onSplitPanelResize` | same names |
| `splitPanelPreferences / onSplitPanelPreferencesChange` | `splitPanelPosition` / `onSplitPanelPreferencesChange` |
| `drawers / activeDrawerId / onDrawerChange` | same names (`CsAppLayoutDrawer`) |
| `ariaLabels` | `ariaLabels` (`CsAppLayoutLabels`) |
| `navigationCloseBehavior / navigationCollapsedWidth` | not supported |
| `headerSelector / footerSelector / disableBodyScroll` | not needed (the layout fills its parent) |
| `ref (openTools, focusSplitPanel...)` | drive the controlled props instead |

---
source: doc/components/CsAppLayoutToolbar.md

# CsAppLayoutToolbar

Cloudscape's `AppLayoutToolbar`: the app layout with a 42px toolbar row holding the navigation trigger, breadcrumbs and the tools and drawer triggers. Same API as `CsAppLayout`.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/app-layout-toolbar/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsAppLayoutToolbar(
  navigation: const Text('Side navigation'),
  breadcrumbs: const Text('Buckets'),
  tools: const CsHelpPanel(header: 'Buckets', child: Text('Help')),
  content: const Text('Bucket list'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it instead of `CsAppLayout` when the service uses the toolbar layout: all panel triggers live in one row and panels open under it.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `Widget?` |  | Page content, often a `CsContentLayout` |
| `contentHeader` | `Widget?` |  | Header above the content |
| `navigation` | `Widget?` |  | Side navigation |
| `navigationOpen` | `bool?` |  | Controlled; null lets the layout manage it (from `contentType`, closed on phones) |
| `onNavigationChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` |  |  |
| `navigationWidth` | `double` | `280` |  |
| `navigationHide` | `bool` | `false` | Removes navigation and its toggle |
| `tools` | `Widget?` |  | Help content, usually `CsHelpPanel` |
| `toolsOpen` | `bool?` |  | Controlled; null lets the layout manage it |
| `onToolsChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` |  |  |
| `toolsWidth` | `double` | `290` |  |
| `toolsHide` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `breadcrumbs` | `Widget?` |  |  |
| `notifications` | `Widget?` |  | Usually a `CsFlashbar`; announced as a live region |
| `stickyNotifications` | `bool` | `false` | Notifications stay pinned while content scrolls |
| `contentType` | `CsAppLayoutContentType` | `defaultVariant` | `defaultVariant`, `form` (nav closed, 800px), `table`, `cards`, `wizard` (nav closed, 1080px), `dashboard` |
| `maxContentWidth` | `double?` |  | Overrides the content type cap |
| `minContentWidth` | `double` | `280` |  |
| `disableContentPaddings` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `disableContentHeaderOverlap` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `headerVariant` | `CsAppLayoutHeaderVariant` | `defaultVariant` | `defaultVariant` or `highContrast` |
| `splitPanel` | `Widget?` |  | Usually a `CsSplitPanel` |
| `splitPanelOpen` | `bool?` |  | Controlled; null lets the layout manage it (starts closed) |
| `onSplitPanelToggle` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` |  |  |
| `splitPanelSize` | `double?` |  | Height (bottom) or width (side) |
| `onSplitPanelResize` | `ValueChanged<double>?` |  |  |
| `splitPanelPosition` | `CsSplitPanelPosition?` |  | `bottom` or `side`; controlled preferences |
| `onSplitPanelPreferencesChange` | `ValueChanged<CsSplitPanelPosition>?` |  |  |
| `drawers` | `List<CsAppLayoutDrawer>` | `[]` | `id`, `content`, `ariaLabels`, `icon`, `iconWidget`, `badge`, `resizable`, `defaultSize`, `onResize` |
| `activeDrawerId` | `String?` |  | Controlled open drawer |
| `onDrawerChange` | `ValueChanged<String?>?` |  | Drawer to open, or null |
| `ariaLabels` | `CsAppLayoutLabels` |  | Region and toggle names |
| `mobile` | `bool?` |  | Forces the phone (true) or wide (false) layout |

## Examples

### Drawers in the toolbar

```dart
CsAppLayoutToolbar(

    CsAppLayoutDrawer(
      id: 'notes',
      icon: CsIcons.edit,
```

## Accessibility

The toolbar stays at all widths; at or below 688px panels open as full-screen overlays instead of beside the content.
