# CsAreaChart

An area chart that stacks series to show how parts add up to a total over time; the popover ends with the total.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/area-chart/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
final days = [for (var i = 1; i <= 7; i++) DateTime(2026, 11, i)];
final inbound = CsChartSeries<DateTime>.area(
  title: 'Inbound',
  data: [for (final d in days) CsChartDatum(d, 120 + d.day * 4)],
  valueFormatter: (y, x) => '$y GB',
);
final outbound = CsChartSeries<DateTime>.area(
  title: 'Outbound',
  data: [for (final d in days) CsChartDatum(d, 60 + d.day * 2)],
  valueFormatter: (y, x) => '$y GB',
);

CsAreaChart<DateTime>(
  series: [inbound, outbound, const CsChartSeries<DateTime>.threshold(title: 'Capacity', y: 300)],
  xScaleType: CsChartScaleType.time,
  detailTotalFormatter: (v) => '$v GB',
  height: 300,
  ariaLabel: 'Network traffic',
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it to show the composition of a total over time (traffic by Region, cost by service).
- Every area series must use the same x values. Areas stack in series order, so the top edge is the total.
- Use `CsLineChart` when the series should be compared, not added.

## Parameters

`T` is the x value type: `num` (`int`, `double`) for linear and log axes, `DateTime` for time axes, `String` for categories. Series, data and helper types are documented in [CsChartSeries](CsChartSeries.md).

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `series` | `List<CsChartSeries<T>>` | required | The series, in legend order. Keep the same instances between builds: the chart compares series by identity. |
| `visibleSeries` | `List<CsChartSeries<T>>?` | `null` | Series shown. Null lets the built-in filter manage it; pass a list and update it in `onFilterChange` to control it. |
| `onFilterChange` | `ValueChanged<List<CsChartSeries<T>>>?` | `null` | The built-in filter changed the visible series. |
| `highlightedSeries` | `CsChartSeries<T>?` | `null` | Series to highlight. The chart also highlights on hover and focus; a new value passed here replaces the current highlight. |
| `onHighlightChange` | `ValueChanged<CsChartSeries<T>?>?` | `null` | The user highlighted a series (legend, point, keyboard) or cleared it. |
| `xScaleType` | `CsChartScaleType` | `CsChartScaleType.linear` | `linear`, `log`, `time` (`DateTime` x) or `categorical` (needed for bars). |
| `yScaleType` | `CsChartYScaleType` | `linear` | `linear` or `log`. |
| `xDomain` | `List<T>?` | `null` | `[min, max]` for numbers and dates, the ordered categories for `categorical`. Null fits all series (hidden ones too, so filtering never rescales). |
| `yDomain` | `List<num>?` | `null` | `[min, max]`. Null fits all data plus zero and rounds out to tick steps. |
| `xTitle / yTitle` | `String?` | `null` | Bold axis titles: x below the axis, y above the plot. |
| `legendTitle` | `String?` | `null` | Bold title above the legend. |
| `xTickFormatter` | `CsChartTickFormatter<T>?` | `null` | Formats x ticks and the popover title. `\n` makes two lines. Default: numbers as written, dates by span (`Nov 3`, `14:00`, `Mar 2026`). |
| `yTickFormatter` | `CsChartTickFormatter<num>?` | `null` | Formats value ticks. |
| `height` | `double` | `500` | Plot height in logical pixels; axis labels and titles add to it. |
| `fitHeight` | `bool` | `false` | Fill a parent with bounded height. Without a bounded parent it falls back to `height`. |
| `hideFilter` | `bool` | `false` | Hides the built-in series filter. |
| `hideLegend` | `bool` | `false` | Hides the legend. |
| `additionalFilters` | `Widget?` | `null` | Extra filters placed next to the built-in one. |
| `statusType` | `CsChartStatusType` | `finished` | `loading`, `finished` or `error`. |
| `empty / noMatch` | `Widget?` | `null` | Shown when `series` is empty / when the filter hides every series. |
| `loadingText / errorText / recoveryText` | `String?` | `null` | Status copy. Defaults: "Loading chart", "The data couldn't be fetched. Try again later.", "Retry". |
| `onRecoveryClick` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called from the recovery link next to `errorText`. Without it there is no link. |
| `detailPopoverSize` | `CsChartPopoverSize` | `medium` | Popover max width: `small` 210, `medium` 310, `large` 482. |
| `detailPopoverFooter` | `Widget Function(T x)?` | `null` | Content under a divider at the bottom of the popover. |
| `detailTotalFormatter` | `CsChartTickFormatter<num>?` | `null` | Formats the popover's total row. Defaults to `yTickFormatter`. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsChartI18nStrings` | `const CsChartI18nStrings()` | Filter, legend, popover and screen reader labels (see CsChartSeries.md). |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name; match the visible heading. |
| `ariaDescription` | `String?` | `null` | Short summary read before the generated series and axis summary. |

## Examples

### Custom total label

```dart
CsAreaChart<int>(
  series: series,
  i18nStrings: const CsChartI18nStrings(detailTotalLabel: 'All Regions'),
  ariaLabel: 'Traffic',
)
```

## Accessibility

- The plot is one focusable element announced as `ariaLabel` plus the chart kind ("Line chart"), with a hint that reads `ariaDescription` and a generated summary (series titles, x range or categories, y range).
- Keyboard, as in Cloudscape: Tab focuses the plot and highlights the first position. Left and Right move between x positions (bar groups; Up and Down for horizontal bars), Up and Down cycle between all series and one series at a time, Home and End jump to the ends, Enter or Space pins the popover, Escape dismisses it.
- The semantics value is the highlighted position and every value ("h2, i-0abc123 20%, Alarm 45"); screen reader increase and decrease gestures move between positions.
- A 2px `color-border-item-focused` outline marks the focused point, x line or group.
- The legend is one tab stop with Left and Right between entries; each entry is a toggle button. The filter is a labelled button that opens a list of checkable rows.
- Loading, error and empty states sit in a live region. Series are never told apart by color alone: the legend, filter and popover pair each color with its title and marker shape (line, bar, dashed threshold).

## Motion

- Data animates in once when it first appears (250ms `motion-duration-complex`, `showPaced` easing): lines and areas reveal from the start of the x axis, bars grow out of the baseline, pie segments sweep clockwise.
- Dimming non-highlighted series and legend entries fades over 90ms (`motion-duration-transition-quick`), like Cloudscape's opacity transitions.
- The popover scales and fades in from its anchor (`CsAnchoredOverlay`).
- Reduced motion (`MediaQuery.disableAnimations` or the theme's `disableMotion`) shows everything at once.

## Mobile

- Touch: tap or drag a finger across the plot to scrub the crosshair (or bar groups) with a selection haptic per step; lifting the finger keeps the popover, pinned, with its close button. Tap outside to dismiss. Vertical drags still scroll the page.
- At or below 688px the popover opens above the highlighted point instead of beside it, so it gets the full width.
- The filter opens as a bottom sheet on phones (`CsDropdown`, `CsPresentation.auto`).
- Axis labels drop until they no longer overlap, and the legend wraps. Labels and popover text scale with the platform text size.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `series` (`title`, `type`, `data`, `color`, `valueFormatter`) | `series` with `CsChartSeries.line/.bar/.area/.threshold`; `color` is a `Color`, plus `colorToken` |
| threshold `y` / `x` | `CsChartSeries.threshold(y:)` / `CsChartSeries.threshold(x:)` |
| `xScaleType`, `yScaleType` | `xScaleType` (`CsChartScaleType`), `yScaleType` (`CsChartYScaleType`) |
| `xDomain`, `yDomain`, `xTitle`, `yTitle`, `legendTitle` | same names |
| `xTickFormatter`, `yTickFormatter` (also the deprecated `i18nStrings` versions) | `xTickFormatter`, `yTickFormatter` |
| `detailTotalFormatter`, `i18nStrings.detailTotalLabel` | `detailTotalFormatter`, `CsChartI18nStrings.detailTotalLabel` |
| `height`, `fitHeight`, `hideFilter`, `hideLegend`, `additionalFilters` | same names |
| `statusType`, `empty`, `noMatch`, `loadingText`, `errorText`, `recoveryText`, `onRecoveryClick` | same names |
| `detailPopoverSize`, `detailPopoverFooter` | `detailPopoverSize` (`CsChartPopoverSize`), `detailPopoverFooter` (builder) |
| `visibleSeries` + `onFilterChange` (`detail.visibleSeries`) | `visibleSeries` + `onFilterChange(List)` |
| `highlightedSeries` + `onHighlightChange` (`detail.highlightedSeries`) | `highlightedSeries` + `onHighlightChange(series)` |
| `ariaLabel`, `ariaDescription` | same names |
| `ariaLabelledby` | not supported (web only); use `ariaLabel` |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsChartI18nStrings` |

source: doc/components/CsAttributeEditor.md

# CsAttributeEditor

Cloudscape's `AttributeEditor`: rows of form fields with add and remove buttons, for key-value pairs, environment variables, headers and other repeated attributes.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/attribute-editor/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsAttributeEditor<MapEntry<String, String>>(
  items: vars,
  addButtonText: 'Add environment variable',
  onAddButtonClick: () => setState(() => vars = [...vars, const MapEntry('', '')]),
  onRemoveButtonClick: (i) => setState(() => vars = [...vars]..removeAt(i)),
  definition: [
    CsAttributeEditorField(
      label: 'Key',
      control: (item, i) => CsInput(value: item.key, invalid: item.key.isEmpty, onChange: (v) => setKey(i, v)),
      errorText: (item, i) => item.key.isEmpty ? 'Enter a key.' : null,
    ),
    CsAttributeEditorField(
      label: 'Value',
      control: (item, i) => CsInput(value: item.value, onChange: (v) => setValue(i, v)),
    ),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it when users add, edit and remove a variable number of structured entries (one to six fields per row) in a form. For resource tags use `CsTagEditor`, which adds tag validation and suggestions on top of this component. For a fixed set of fields use `CsFormField`s; for picking existing items use a multiselect.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<T>` | required | One row per item |
| `definition` | `List<CsAttributeEditorField<T>>` | required | The columns of each row; more than six need a `gridLayout` |
| `addButtonText` | `String` | required | |
| `onAddButtonClick` | `VoidCallback?` | | Append an item here |
| `onRemoveButtonClick` | `ValueChanged<int>?` | | Gets the row index; remove the item here |
| `removeButtonText` | `String?` | `i18nStrings.removeButtonText` ("Remove") | |
| `removeButtonAriaLabel` | `String Function(T)?` | | Accessible name of a row's remove button |
| `isItemRemovable` | `bool Function(T)?` | all removable | False hides the row's remove button |
| `disableAddButton` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `hideAddButton` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `additionalActions` | `Widget?` | | Next to (or instead of) the add button |
| `addButtonVariant` | `CsAttributeEditorAddButtonVariant` | `normal` | `normal` or `inlineLink` (with an add icon) |
| `empty` | `Widget?` | | Shown when `items` is empty, in `color-text-empty` |
| `additionalInfo` | `Widget?` | | Under the add button, body-s, announced when it changes |
| `itemLimit` | `int?` | | Disables the add button once `items.length` reaches it |
| `gridLayout` | `List<CsAttributeEditorGridLayout>?` | Cloudscape defaults for 1 to 6 fields | Row layouts by container breakpoint |
| `customRowActions` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, CsAttributeEditorRowActions<T>)?` | | Replaces the remove button (a button dropdown) |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsAttributeEditorI18nStrings` | English | `errorIconAriaLabel`, `warningIconAriaLabel`, `itemRemovedAriaLive`, `removeButtonText` |

`CsAttributeEditorField<T>`: `label`, `labelWidget`, `description`, `info`, `control` (`(item, index) => Widget`), `errorText`, `warningText`, `constraintText` (each `(item, index) => String?`).

`CsAttributeEditorGridLayout`: `breakpoint` (`CsBreakpoint?`, null is the narrowest fallback), `rows` (`List<List<int>>` of relative widths), `removeButton` (`CsAttributeEditorRemoveButtonLayout(ownRow:, width:, autoWidth:)`). `CsAttributeEditorGridLayout.defaultsFor(n)` returns Cloudscape's defaults.

`CsAttributeEditorState<T>` (through a `GlobalKey`): `focusAddButton()`, `focusRemoveButton(index)`.

## Examples

### Item limit and additional info

```dart
CsAttributeEditor<String>(
  items: headers,
  addButtonText: 'Add header',
  itemLimit: 5,
  additionalInfo: Text('You can add up to ${5 - headers.length} more headers.'),
  empty: const Text('No custom headers.'),
  onAddButtonClick: () {},
  onRemoveButtonClick: (i) {},
  definition: [CsAttributeEditorField(label: 'Header', control: (h, i) => CsInput(value: h))],
)
```

### Custom layout for four fields

```dart
CsAttributeEditor<List<String>>(
  items: rules,
  addButtonText: 'Add rule',
  addButtonVariant: CsAttributeEditorAddButtonVariant.inlineLink,
  onAddButtonClick: () {},
  onRemoveButtonClick: (i) {},
  gridLayout: const [
    CsAttributeEditorGridLayout(breakpoint: CsBreakpoint.s, rows: [[2, 1, 2, 3]]),
    CsAttributeEditorGridLayout(breakpoint: CsBreakpoint.xxs, rows: [[1, 1], [1, 1]]),
    CsAttributeEditorGridLayout(rows: [[1], [1], [1], [1]]),
  ],
  definition: [
    CsAttributeEditorField(label: 'Type', control: (r, i) => CsInput(value: r[0])),
    CsAttributeEditorField(label: 'Port', control: (r, i) => CsInput(value: r[1])),
    CsAttributeEditorField(label: 'Source', control: (r, i) => CsInput(value: r[2])),
    CsAttributeEditorField(label: 'Description', control: (r, i) => CsInput(value: r[3])),
  ],
)
```

### Focus after removing the last row

```dart
// editorKey: a GlobalKey<CsAttributeEditorState<String>> passed as the editor's key.
void afterRemovingLastItem(GlobalKey<CsAttributeEditorState<String>> editorKey) {
  editorKey.currentState?.focusAddButton();
}
```

## Accessibility

Each row is a semantics group named after the first field's label. Labels show above the first row only when a row fits on one line; every field keeps its label as its accessible name. The remove button takes `removeButtonAriaLabel`. Removing a row announces `itemRemovedAriaLive` ("Item removed"); `additionalInfo` is a live region. Validation messages use the form field's error and warning treatment with icon labels.

## Motion

None of its own. Buttons give press feedback through `CsButton`.

## Mobile

Layout follows the editor's own width, not the window (Cloudscape container breakpoints). With the default layouts, fields stack below 465px (two fields) and the remove button moves to its own line, end-aligned, followed by a divider. Pass `gridLayout` to change where rows wrap.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `items`, `definition`, `addButtonText`, `removeButtonText`, `removeButtonAriaLabel`, `isItemRemovable`, `disableAddButton`, `hideAddButton`, `additionalActions`, `addButtonVariant`, `empty`, `additionalInfo`, `gridLayout`, `customRowActions`, `i18nStrings` | same names |
| `onAddButtonClick` | `onAddButtonClick` (`VoidCallback`) |
| `onRemoveButtonClick` (`detail.itemIndex`) | `onRemoveButtonClick` (`ValueChanged<int>`) |
| `gridLayout[].removeButton.width: 'auto'` | `removeButton: CsAttributeEditorRemoveButtonLayout(autoWidth: true)` |
| `ref.focusAddButton()`, `ref.focusRemoveButton(i)` | `GlobalKey<CsAttributeEditorState<T>>` methods |
| `customRowActions` `ref` | `CsAttributeEditorRowActions.focusNode` |
| (none) | `itemLimit` (extra) |

# CsAutosuggest

Cloudscape's `Autosuggest`: a text input that suggests options while the user types. Any text is a valid value; suggestions only help.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/autosuggest/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsAutosuggest(
  value: 'logs',
  placeholder: 'Enter a bucket name',
  options: const [CsOption(value: 'example-bucket'), CsOption(value: 'logs-bucket')],
  onChange: (value) {},
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it when users may type a new value but common values help (tags, names, search). When the value must be one of the options, use `CsSelect` with filtering.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String` | required | The text |
| `options` | `List<CsOptionItem>` | required | Suggestions and groups |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | Every edit, and the picked value |
| `onSelect` | `ValueChanged<CsAutosuggestSelectDetail>?` | | A pick: `value` and `selectedOption` (null for the typed text) |
| `enteredTextLabel` | `String Function(String)?` | `Use: "<value>"` | Label of the row that uses the typed text |
| `hideEnteredTextOption` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `filteringType` | `CsFilteringType` | `auto` | `auto` filters and highlights here; `manual` leaves it to `onLoadItems` |
| `placeholder`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `warning` | | | |
| `empty` | `Widget?` | | Shown when there are no suggestions |
| `filteringResultsText` | `String Function(int, int)?` | | Footer text |
| `statusType`, `loadingText`, `finishedText`, `errorText`, `recoveryText`, `errorIconAriaLabel`, `onLoadItems` | | | As `CsSelect` |
| `ariaLabel`, `clearAriaLabel`, `selectedAriaLabel` | `String?` | | |
| `autoFocus`, `focusNode`, `onFocus`, `onBlur` | | | |
| `onSubmit` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | Enter with no highlighted suggestion |
| `presentation` | `CsPresentation` | `popover` | The list stays anchored so the keyboard and text stay in view |
| `renderOption` | builder | | Custom rows |

## Examples

### Async suggestions

```dart
CsAutosuggest(
  value: '',
  options: const [],
  filteringType: CsFilteringType.manual,
  statusType: CsDropdownStatusType.loading,
  loadingText: 'Loading instances',
  onLoadItems: (detail) {},
  onChange: (value) {},
)
```

### Picking reports the option

```dart
CsAutosuggest(
  value: '',
  options: const [CsOption(value: 'i-0abc123', label: 'web-server-1', description: 't3.micro')],
  enteredTextLabel: (v) => 'Use: "$v"',
  onSelect: (detail) {},
  onChange: (value) {},
)
```

## Accessibility

The input is a text field; the list does not take focus. Up and Down open and move the highlight, Enter picks, Escape closes the list and a second Escape clears the text. A clear button with `clearAriaLabel` appears when there is text. The status footer is a live region.

## Motion

The list scales and fades in from the input and closes along the same path; reduced motion keeps only the fade.

## Mobile

The list stays anchored under the field on phones (it flips above when the keyboard leaves no room). Pass `CsPresentation.auto` for a bottom sheet instead.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value`, `options`, `enteredTextLabel`, `hideEnteredTextOption`, `filteringType`, `placeholder`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `warning`, `empty`, `filteringResultsText` | same names |
| `onChange` (`detail.value`) | `onChange` |
| `onSelect` (`detail.value`, `detail.selectedOption`) | `onSelect` (`CsAutosuggestSelectDetail`) |
| `statusType`, `loadingText`, `finishedText`, `errorText`, `recoveryText`, `onLoadItems` | same names |
| `ariaLabel`, `clearAriaLabel`, `selectedAriaLabel`, `autoFocus`, `onFocus`, `onBlur`, `renderOption` | same names |
| `onKeyDown` (Enter) | `onSubmit` |
| `expandToViewport`, `virtualScroll`, `name`, `controlId`, `autoComplete`, `inputMode` | not applicable |

# CsAvatar

A round picture of a person or a generative AI assistant in a chat, with initials, an icon, an image or a loading state.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/avatar/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsAvatar(
  color: CsAvatarColor.genAi,
  icon: CsIcons.genAi,
  ariaLabel: 'Generative AI assistant',
  tooltipText: 'Generative AI assistant',
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use next to a `CsChatBubble` to show who wrote a message.
- Use `CsAvatarColor.genAi` (the gen-AI gradient) only for AI assistants, and `defaultColor` for people.
- Set `loading` on the assistant's avatar while it generates a response, together with the bubble's `showLoadingBar`.
- Do not use it as a profile menu trigger in the top navigation; that is a button.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ariaLabel` | `String` | required | Accessible name, such as "Avatar of the sample user". Include `tooltipText` in it when both are set. |
| `color` | `CsAvatarColor` | `defaultColor` | `defaultColor` (`color-background-avatar-default`) or `genAi` (the `colorBackgroundAvatarGenAi` radial gradient). |
| `tooltipText` | `String?` | `null` | Tooltip shown on hover, keyboard focus and touch. |
| `initials` | `String?` | `null` | One or two characters; later characters are ignored. Takes precedence over the icon. |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Shows three bouncing dots. The dots (and, for gen-AI, the rotating gradient) animate only while true. Takes precedence over everything else. |
| `icon` | `CsIconData?` | `CsIcons.userProfile` | Icon when there are no initials. Use `CsIcons.genAi` for assistants. |
| `iconWidget` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom icon (Cloudscape `iconSvg`). Takes precedence over `icon`. |
| `image` | `ImageProvider?` | `null` | Picture cropped to the circle (Cloudscape `imgUrl`). Takes precedence over initials and icon. |
| `width` | `double` | `28` | Width and height. Values below 28 are raised to 28. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | Focus node of the avatar, which is focusable so keyboard users reach the tooltip. |

## Examples

### Person with initials and a tooltip

```dart
const CsAvatar(ariaLabel: 'Avatar of the sample user', initials: 'SU', tooltipText: 'Account')
```

### Assistant generating a response

```dart
const CsAvatar(
  color: CsAvatarColor.genAi,
  icon: CsIcons.genAi,
  loading: true,
  ariaLabel: 'Generative AI assistant, generating a response',
)
```

### Larger avatar

```dart
const CsAvatar(ariaLabel: 'Avatar of the sample user', initials: 'SU', width: 48)
```

## Accessibility

- Exposed as one image node with `ariaLabel`; its content is hidden from screen readers.
- Focusable with Tab (Cloudscape `tabIndex=0`) and shows the 2px focus ring 4px outside the circle. Focus opens the tooltip.

## Motion

- Loading dots: each dot jumps by its own height at 28% of a 1.2s loop (`motion-duration-avatar-loading-dots`), staggered by 100ms.
- Gen-AI loading: the gradient rotates once per 3.6s and grows to 150% halfway (`motion-duration-avatar-gen-ai-gradient`, `motion-easing-avatar-gen-ai-gradient`); reversed in RTL.
- Nothing animates when `loading` is false. Under reduced motion the dots and gradient are still.

## Mobile

The avatar keeps its size on phones. A touch shows the tooltip while the finger is down.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `color` | `color` (`'gen-ai'` is `CsAvatarColor.genAi`) |
| `tooltipText` | `tooltipText` |
| `initials` | `initials` |
| `loading` | `loading` |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `iconName` | `icon` |
| `iconSvg` | `iconWidget` |
| `iconUrl`, `imgUrl` | `image` (any `ImageProvider`) |
| `width` | `width` |
| `style` | not supported; theme with color overrides |

# CsBadge

A small colored label for a count, a category or a severity, such as "New", "3" or "Critical".

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/badge/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';

const badge = CsBadge(text: 'New', color: CsBadgeColor.blue);
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use a badge to tag an item with a short, static attribute: a count next to a heading, "Beta" next to a feature name, the severity of a finding.
- Use the severity colors (`severityCritical` to `severityNeutral`) only for severity scales, and always with the severity name as text.
- Do not use a badge for the state of a resource (running, stopped, failed): use `CsStatusIndicator`.
- A badge is not interactive. For a removable label use a token.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `String?` | `null` | Text inside the badge. Required unless `child` is set. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom content in place of `text`. |
| `color` | `CsBadgeColor` | `CsBadgeColor.grey` | `blue`, `grey`, `green`, `red`, `severityCritical`, `severityHigh`, `severityMedium`, `severityLow`, `severityNeutral`. |
| `style` | `CsBadgeStyle?` | `null` | Overrides `background`, `borderColor`, `borderRadius`, `borderWidth`, `color` (text), `paddingBlock`, `paddingInline`. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Spoken instead of `text`, for example "3 unread". |

`CsBadge.colorsFor(colors, color)` returns the `(background, border, text)` token colors of a badge color.

## Examples

### Counter next to a heading

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

Widget header() => const Row(
  children: [
    Text('Instances'),
    SizedBox(width: CsSpace.xs),
    CsBadge(text: '12', semanticLabel: '12 instances'),
  ],
);
```

### Severity

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

Widget severities() => const Wrap(
  spacing: CsSpace.xs,
  children: [
    CsBadge(text: 'Critical', color: CsBadgeColor.severityCritical),
    CsBadge(text: 'High', color: CsBadgeColor.severityHigh),
    CsBadge(text: 'Medium', color: CsBadgeColor.severityMedium),
    CsBadge(text: 'Low', color: CsBadgeColor.severityLow),
    CsBadge(text: 'Informational', color: CsBadgeColor.severityNeutral),
  ],
);
```

### Custom style

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';

const beta = CsBadge(text: 'Beta', style: CsBadgeStyle(borderRadius: 16, paddingInline: 12));
```

## Accessibility

The badge's text is read as plain text. Give counts a `semanticLabel` that says what is counted. Never convey meaning by color alone: the severity colors always carry the severity word.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Body-s text (12px) on a 20px line with 8px side padding. Long text wraps inside the badge instead of overflowing; keep badge text to one or two words.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `color` | `color` (`'severity-critical'` is `CsBadgeColor.severityCritical`) |
| `children` | `text` or `child` |
| `style.root` | `style` (`CsBadgeStyle`) |
| `nativeAttributes` | not applicable (web only) |

source: doc/components/CsBarChart.md
---

# CsBarChart

A bar chart that compares values across categories, grouped or stacked, vertical or horizontal.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/bar-chart/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsBarChart<String>(
  series: const [
    CsChartSeries.bar(
      title: 'Site 1',
      data: [CsChartDatum('Jan', 1200), CsChartDatum('Feb', 1340), CsChartDatum('Mar', 980)],
    ),
    CsChartSeries.bar(
      title: 'Site 2',
      data: [CsChartDatum('Jan', 800), CsChartDatum('Feb', 760), CsChartDatum('Mar', 1100)],
    ),
    CsChartSeries.threshold(title: 'Budget', y: 2000),
  ],
  stackedBars: true,
  yTitle: 'Requests',
  height: 300,
  ariaLabel: 'Requests per month',
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it to compare values between categories (Regions, months, instance types). Stack bars to show a total and its parts.
- Use horizontal bars for long category names or many categories on narrow screens.
- Use `CsLineChart` for continuous trends and `CsMixedLineBarChart` to add a line (an average) to bars.

## Parameters

`T` is the x value type: `num` (`int`, `double`) for linear and log axes, `DateTime` for time axes, `String` for categories. Series, data and helper types are documented in [CsChartSeries](CsChartSeries.md).

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `series` | `List<CsChartSeries<T>>` | required | The series, in legend order. Keep the same instances between builds: the chart compares series by identity. |
| `visibleSeries` | `List<CsChartSeries<T>>?` | `null` | Series shown. Null lets the built-in filter manage it; pass a list and update it in `onFilterChange` to control it. |
| `onFilterChange` | `ValueChanged<List<CsChartSeries<T>>>?` | `null` | The built-in filter changed the visible series. |
| `highlightedSeries` | `CsChartSeries<T>?` | `null` | Series to highlight. The chart also highlights on hover and focus; a new value passed here replaces the current highlight. |
| `onHighlightChange` | `ValueChanged<CsChartSeries<T>?>?` | `null` | The user highlighted a series (legend, point, keyboard) or cleared it. |
| `xScaleType` | `CsChartScaleType` | `CsChartScaleType.categorical` | `linear`, `log`, `time` (`DateTime` x) or `categorical` (needed for bars). |
| `yScaleType` | `CsChartYScaleType` | `linear` | `linear` or `log`. |
| `xDomain` | `List<T>?` | `null` | `[min, max]` for numbers and dates, the ordered categories for `categorical`. Null fits all series (hidden ones too, so filtering never rescales). |
| `yDomain` | `List<num>?` | `null` | `[min, max]`. Null fits all data plus zero and rounds out to tick steps. |
| `xTitle / yTitle` | `String?` | `null` | Bold axis titles: x below the axis, y above the plot. |
| `legendTitle` | `String?` | `null` | Bold title above the legend. |
| `xTickFormatter` | `CsChartTickFormatter<T>?` | `null` | Formats x ticks and the popover title. `\n` makes two lines. Default: numbers as written, dates by span (`Nov 3`, `14:00`, `Mar 2026`). |
| `yTickFormatter` | `CsChartTickFormatter<num>?` | `null` | Formats value ticks. |
| `stackedBars` | `bool` | `false` | Stack bars of one x instead of grouping them. |
| `horizontalBars` | `bool` | `false` | Bars run left to right (bars and thresholds only). |
| `emphasizeBaselineAxis` | `bool` | `true` | Draws the zero line 2px wide. |
| `height` | `double` | `500` | Plot height in logical pixels; axis labels and titles add to it. |
| `fitHeight` | `bool` | `false` | Fill a parent with bounded height. Without a bounded parent it falls back to `height`. |
| `hideFilter` | `bool` | `false` | Hides the built-in series filter. |
| `hideLegend` | `bool` | `false` | Hides the legend. |
| `additionalFilters` | `Widget?` | `null` | Extra filters placed next to the built-in one. |
| `statusType` | `CsChartStatusType` | `finished` | `loading`, `finished` or `error`. |
| `empty / noMatch` | `Widget?` | `null` | Shown when `series` is empty / when the filter hides every series. |
| `loadingText / errorText / recoveryText` | `String?` | `null` | Status copy. Defaults: "Loading chart", "The data couldn't be fetched. Try again later.", "Retry". |
| `onRecoveryClick` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called from the recovery link next to `errorText`. Without it there is no link. |
| `detailPopoverSize` | `CsChartPopoverSize` | `medium` | Popover max width: `small` 210, `medium` 310, `large` 482. |
| `detailPopoverFooter` | `Widget Function(T x)?` | `null` | Content under a divider at the bottom of the popover. |
| `detailPopoverSeriesContent` | `CsChartDetailPopoverSeriesContent<T>?` | `null` | Replaces a series row: other key or value, widgets, `subItems`, `expandable`. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsChartI18nStrings` | `const CsChartI18nStrings()` | Filter, legend, popover and screen reader labels (see CsChartSeries.md). |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name; match the visible heading. |
| `ariaDescription` | `String?` | `null` | Short summary read before the generated series and axis summary. |

## Examples

### Horizontal bars

```dart
CsBarChart<String>(
  series: series,
  horizontalBars: true,
  height: 240,
  ariaLabel: 'Storage by bucket',
)
```

### Custom popover rows with a breakdown

```dart
CsBarChart<String>(
  series: series,
  detailPopoverSize: CsChartPopoverSize.large,
  detailPopoverSeriesContent: (series, x, y) => CsChartSeriesDetail(
    value: '$y requests',
    expandable: true,
    subItems: const [
      CsChartDetailPair(key: 'GET', value: '70%'),
      CsChartDetailPair(key: 'PUT', value: '30%'),
    ],
  ),
  ariaLabel: 'Requests per month',
)
```

## Accessibility

- The plot is one focusable element announced as `ariaLabel` plus the chart kind ("Line chart"), with a hint that reads `ariaDescription` and a generated summary (series titles, x range or categories, y range).
- Keyboard, as in Cloudscape: Tab focuses the plot and highlights the first position. Left and Right move between x positions (bar groups; Up and Down for horizontal bars), Up and Down cycle between all series and one series at a time, Home and End jump to the ends, Enter or Space pins the popover, Escape dismisses it.
- The semantics value is the highlighted position and every value ("h2, i-0abc123 20%, Alarm 45"); screen reader increase and decrease gestures move between positions.
- A 2px `color-border-item-focused` outline marks the focused point, x line or group.
- The legend is one tab stop with Left and Right between entries; each entry is a toggle button. The filter is a labelled button that opens a list of checkable rows.
- Loading, error and empty states sit in a live region. Series are never told apart by color alone: the legend, filter and popover pair each color with its title and marker shape (line, bar, dashed threshold).

## Motion

- Data animates in once when it first appears (250ms `motion-duration-complex`, `showPaced` easing): lines and areas reveal from the start of the x axis, bars grow out of the baseline, pie segments sweep clockwise.
- Dimming non-highlighted series and legend entries fades over 90ms (`motion-duration-transition-quick`), like Cloudscape's opacity transitions.
- The popover scales and fades in from its anchor (`CsAnchoredOverlay`).
- Reduced motion (`MediaQuery.disableAnimations` or the theme's `disableMotion`) shows everything at once.

## Mobile

- Touch: tap or drag a finger across the plot to scrub the crosshair (or bar groups) with a selection haptic per step; lifting the finger keeps the popover, pinned, with its close button. Tap outside to dismiss. Vertical drags still scroll the page.
- At or below 688px the popover opens above the highlighted point instead of beside it, so it gets the full width.
- The filter opens as a bottom sheet on phones (`CsDropdown`, `CsPresentation.auto`).
- Axis labels drop until they no longer overlap, and the legend wraps. Labels and popover text scale with the platform text size.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `series` (`title`, `type`, `data`, `color`, `valueFormatter`) | `series` with `CsChartSeries.line/.bar/.area/.threshold`; `color` is a `Color`, plus `colorToken` |
| threshold `y` / `x` | `CsChartSeries.threshold(y:)` / `CsChartSeries.threshold(x:)` |
| `xScaleType`, `yScaleType` | `xScaleType` (`CsChartScaleType`), `yScaleType` (`CsChartYScaleType`) |
| `xDomain`, `yDomain`, `xTitle`, `yTitle`, `legendTitle` | same names |
| `xTickFormatter`, `yTickFormatter` (also the deprecated `i18nStrings` versions) | `xTickFormatter`, `yTickFormatter` |
| `stackedBars`, `horizontalBars` | same names |
| `emphasizeBaselineAxis` | same name |
| `detailPopoverSeriesContent` | `detailPopoverSeriesContent` returning `CsChartSeriesDetail` |
| `height`, `fitHeight`, `hideFilter`, `hideLegend`, `additionalFilters` | same names |
| `statusType`, `empty`, `noMatch`, `loadingText`, `errorText`, `recoveryText`, `onRecoveryClick` | same names |
| `detailPopoverSize`, `detailPopoverFooter` | `detailPopoverSize` (`CsChartPopoverSize`), `detailPopoverFooter` (builder) |
| `visibleSeries` + `onFilterChange` (`detail.visibleSeries`) | `visibleSeries` + `onFilterChange(List)` |
| `highlightedSeries` + `onHighlightChange` (`detail.highlightedSeries`) | `highlightedSeries` + `onHighlightChange(series)` |
| `ariaLabel`, `ariaDescription` | same names |
| `ariaLabelledby` | not supported (web only); use `ariaLabel` |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsChartI18nStrings` |

---
source: doc/components/CsBoard.md
---

# CsBoard

A configurable dashboard grid whose items people rearrange by dragging, resize from the corner, add from a palette and remove.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/board/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsBoard<String>(
  items: const [
    CsBoardEntry(id: 'health', data: 'Instance health', columnSpan: 2),
    CsBoardEntry(id: 'cost', data: 'Monthly cost', columnSpan: 2),
  ],
  onItemsChange: (change) => setState(() {}),
  renderItem: (context, item, actions) => CsBoardItem(
    header: CsHeader(title: item.data),
    settings: CsButton(
      variant: CsButtonVariant.icon,
      icon: CsIcons.close,
      semanticLabel: 'Remove ${item.data}',
      onPress: actions.removeItem,
    ),
    child: const Text('No alarms'),
  ),
  empty: const Text('No widgets. Add widgets from the palette.'),
)
```

Store `change.items` in your state and pass it back as `items`: the board is controlled and never changes its items itself.

## When to use / when not to

- Use for dashboards people personalize: overview pages with widgets of different sizes.
- Use a static grid (`CsColumnLayout`, `CsGrid`) when the layout is fixed.
- Persist `items` (for example to local storage) so arrangements survive reloads; `columnOffset` stores one arrangement per column count.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<CsBoardEntry<T>>` | required | Items and their positions. |
| `renderItem` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, CsBoardEntry<T>, CsBoardItemActions)` | required | Builds each item; return a `CsBoardItem`. `actions.removeItem()` removes it. |
| `onItemsChange` | `ValueChanged<CsBoardItemsChange<T>>` | required | Called on every commit with the new `items` and one of `movedItem`, `resizedItem`, `addedItem`, `removedItem`. |
| `empty` | `Widget?` | `null` | Shown when `items` is empty; also the loading slot while items load. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsBoardI18nStrings<T>?` | English | Live announcement builders (all optional): `liveAnnouncementDndStarted`, `liveAnnouncementDndItemReordered`, `liveAnnouncementDndItemResized`, `liveAnnouncementDndItemInserted`, `liveAnnouncementDndCommitted`, `liveAnnouncementDndDiscarded`, `liveAnnouncementItemRemoved`. |
| `columns` | `int?` | `null` | Forces 1, 2, 4 or 6 columns instead of following the width. |

`CsBoardEntry<T>`: `id` (`String`, unique on the page), `data` (`T`), `definition` (`CsBoardItemDefinition?`: `minRowSpan`, `minColumnSpan`, `defaultRowSpan`, `defaultColumnSpan`), `columnOffset` (`Map<int, int>?`, column per column count), `rowSpan` (`int?`, 2 or more), `columnSpan` (`int?`).

`CsBoardLayout` holds the grid math as pure functions: `interpret(items, columns)` returns a `CsBoardGrid` of `CsBoardPlacement`s, and `place`, `resize` and `remove` return updated item lists, for app code that adds items at a given spot.

## Examples

### Adding from a palette

```dart
Column(
  children: [
    CsBoard<String>(
      items: const [],
      onItemsChange: (change) {},
      renderItem: (context, item, actions) => CsBoardItem(header: CsHeader(title: item.data)),
      empty: const Text('Drag a widget here'),
    ),
    CsItemsPalette<String>(
      items: const [CsItemsPaletteItem(id: 'traffic', data: 'Network traffic')],
      renderItem: (context, item, ctx) => CsBoardItem(header: CsHeader(title: item.data)),
      onItemAdd: (item) {},
    ),
  ],
)
```

### Custom announcements

```dart
CsBoard<String>(
  items: const [],
  onItemsChange: (change) {},
  renderItem: (context, item, actions) => CsBoardItem(header: CsHeader(title: item.data)),
  i18nStrings: CsBoardI18nStrings<String>(
    liveAnnouncementDndItemReordered: (s) => '${s.item.data} moved to column ${s.placement.x + 1}, row ${s.placement.y + 1}',
    liveAnnouncementItemRemoved: (s) => 'Removed ${s.item.data}',
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Each item has a drag handle and a resize handle (buttons with labels and hints from `CsBoardItemI18nStrings`).
- Keyboard: focus a handle and press Enter or Space to start moving or resizing; arrow keys move the item a cell or change its size by a column or row (left and right swap in RTL); Enter or Space commits, Escape discards, and moving focus away commits.
- Every start, step, commit, discard and removal is announced through `SemanticsService`; the step messages say where the item lands and how many items moved.

## Motion

- The dragged item follows the pointer 1:1 and lifts with `shadow-container-active`; the others slide out of the way over 200ms (Cloudscape `TRANSITION_DURATION_MS`). On release it settles from where it was dropped into its slot.
- While dragging, the grid shows placeholder cells (`color-board-placeholder-active`) and the landing cells (`color-board-placeholder-hover`).
- Under reduced motion items jump to their slots without sliding.

## Mobile

Columns come from the board's own width: 1 below 688px, 2 below 912px, 4 below 2100px, 6 above (override with `columns`). Each column count keeps its own arrangement in `columnOffset`. Handles grow to 44px hit areas on touch screens and start a drag on contact, so the page scrolls everywhere except on a handle. Rows are 96px with 20px gaps (76px and 16px in compact density).

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `items` | `items` (`CsBoardEntry<T>`) |
| `renderItem(item, actions)` | `renderItem(context, item, actions)` |
| `onItemsChange` | `onItemsChange` (`CsBoardItemsChange<T>`) |
| `empty` | `empty` |
| `i18nStrings` | `i18nStrings` (`CsBoardI18nStrings<T>`, optional) |
| `i18nStrings.navigationAriaLabel`, `navigationAriaDescription`, `navigationItemAriaLabel` | not applicable (deprecated, no effect in Cloudscape) |
| container query columns | `columns` override |

source: doc/components/CsBoardItem.md

# CsBoardItem

The container for one item on a `CsBoard` or in a `CsItemsPalette`, with a drag handle, header, settings slot, content, footer and resize handle.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/board-item/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsBoardItem(
  header: const CsHeader(title: 'Instance health'),
  settings: CsButton(variant: CsButtonVariant.icon, icon: CsIcons.ellipsis, semanticLabel: 'Settings', onPress: () {}),
  footer: const Text('Updated 2 minutes ago'),
  child: const Text('12 of 12 instances healthy'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Return it from `CsBoard.renderItem` and `CsItemsPalette.renderItem`.
- Outside a board it renders as a plain container with an inert drag handle; use `CsContainer` there instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `header` | `Widget?` | `null` | Heading, usually a `CsHeader`. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | Main content. On a board it fills the remaining height and clips. |
| `footer` | `Widget?` | `null` | Footer below a divider. |
| `settings` | `Widget?` | `null` | Slot after the header for an overflow actions menu or a remove button. |
| `disableContentPaddings` | `bool` | `false` | Removes the content padding for full-bleed charts or tables. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsBoardItemI18nStrings` | English | `dragHandleAriaLabel`, `dragHandleAriaDescription`, `resizeHandleAriaLabel`, `resizeHandleAriaDescription`, `dragHandleTooltipText`, `resizeHandleTooltipText`, and `addButtonAriaLabel` (the add button on palette items). |

## Examples

### Full-bleed content

```dart
const CsBoardItem(
  header: CsHeader(title: 'Requests per minute'),
  disableContentPaddings: true,
  child: SizedBox(height: 120),
)
```

### Localized handles

```dart
const CsBoardItem(
  header: CsHeader(title: 'Alarms'),
  i18nStrings: CsBoardItemI18nStrings(
    dragHandleAriaLabel: 'Move Alarms',
    resizeHandleAriaLabel: 'Resize Alarms',
    dragHandleTooltipText: 'Drag to move',
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

Handles are labelled buttons with a hint that explains the keyboard interaction. In keyboard mode the active handle keeps a 2px `color-border-item-focused` outline. See `CsBoard` for the keys.

## Motion

The active shadow fades in over `motion-duration-responsive` when the item lifts.

## Mobile

On a board the item takes the size of its grid cells; the header wraps and the content clips rather than overflowing. Handles have 44px hit areas on touch screens.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `header` | `header` |
| `children` | `child` |
| `footer` | `footer` |
| `settings` | `settings` |
| `disableContentPaddings` | `disableContentPaddings` |
| `i18nStrings` | `i18nStrings` (optional, English defaults) |

# CsBox

Cloudscape's `Box`: the text and spacing primitive. A `variant` gives semantic text styles (headings, paragraph, small, code, key label, large value), with overrides for size, weight and color, and token-based padding and margin. `CsVisualAccent` is Box's `visualAccent`.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/box/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsBox(variant: CsBoxVariant.h1, text: 'Distributions')
```

## When to use / when not to

Use `CsBox` for any text that needs a Cloudscape style: headings outside a `CsHeader`, paragraphs, descriptions, key-value labels, large dashboard values, inline code. For page and container titles with actions use `CsHeader`; for long formatted content use `CsTextContent`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `String?` | | Text content |
| `child` | `Widget?` | | Any content; receives the variant's text style |
| `variant` | `CsBoxVariant` | `div` | `div`, `span`, `h1`-`h5`, `p`, `strong`, `small`, `code`, `pre`, `samp`, `awsuiKeyLabel`, `awsuiGenAiLabel`, `awsuiValueLarge`, `awsuiInlineCode` |
| `color` | `CsBoxColor` | `defaultColor` | `inherit`, `textLabel`, `textBodySecondary`, `textStatusError`, `textStatusSuccess`, `textStatusInfo`, `textStatusInactive`, `textStatusWarning`, `inverted` |
| `fontSize` | `CsTypeScale?` | | Overrides the variant's size |
| `fontWeight` | `CsBoxFontWeight?` | | `light`, `normal`, `bold`, `heavy` |
| `textAlign` | `TextAlign?` | | |
| `padding`, `margin` | `CsBoxSpacing?` | | Per-side `CsSpacingSize` (`n`, `xxxs` to `xxxl`); headings and `p` default to 4px vertical padding |
| `maxLines`, `overflow` | | | |

`CsVisualAccent(color:, child:, equalAspect:, radius:, fullyRounded:)` draws a tinted tile behind an icon or short label.

## Examples

### Headings and text

```dart
const Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
  CsBox(variant: CsBoxVariant.h2, text: 'Origin settings'),
  CsBox(variant: CsBoxVariant.p, text: 'Choose where CloudFront gets your content.'),
  CsBox(variant: CsBoxVariant.small, text: 'Changes take a few minutes to deploy.'),
])
```

### Key-value and large value

```dart
const Column(crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start, children: [
  CsBox(variant: CsBoxVariant.awsuiKeyLabel, text: 'Running instances'),
  CsBox(variant: CsBoxVariant.awsuiValueLarge, text: '14'),
])
```

### Status color and inline code

```dart
const Wrap(spacing: 4, children: [
  CsBox(color: CsBoxColor.textStatusError, text: 'Validation failed.'),
  CsBox(variant: CsBoxVariant.awsuiInlineCode, text: 'aws s3 ls'),
])
```

### Visual accent

```dart
const CsVisualAccent(color: CsVisualAccentColor.indigo, equalAspect: true, child: CsIcon(CsIcons.globe))
```

## Accessibility

Heading variants (`h1`-`h5`) are marked as headings. Color is never the only signal: pair status colors with words or a `CsStatusIndicator`.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Text wraps; use `maxLines` with `overflow` only where the full value is reachable elsewhere.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `variant="awsui-key-label"` | `variant: CsBoxVariant.awsuiKeyLabel` |
| `color="text-body-secondary"` | `color: CsBoxColor.textBodySecondary` |
| `fontSize="heading-m"` | `fontSize: CsTypeScale.headingM` |
| `fontWeight`, `textAlign` | same names |
| `padding={{ vertical: 's' }}` | `padding: CsBoxSpacing.symmetric(vertical: CsSpacingSize.s)` |
| `margin` | `margin` |
| `visualAccent` | `CsVisualAccent` |
| `display`, `float`, `tagOverride` | not applicable (use Flutter layout) |

# CsBreadcrumbGroup

Shows the path from the top of a service's hierarchy to the current page, so people can see where they are and move up.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/breadcrumb-group/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsBreadcrumbGroup(
  items: const [
    CsBreadcrumbGroupItem(text: 'Service', href: '/'),
    CsBreadcrumbGroupItem(text: 'Buckets', href: '/buckets'),
    CsBreadcrumbGroupItem(text: 'example-bucket', href: '/buckets/example-bucket'),
  ],
  onFollow: (item) => Navigator.of(context).pushNamed(item.href),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use at the top of every page below the service root, inside the app layout's breadcrumbs slot.
- Do not use for a flat app with one level, or as a step indicator (use `CsWizard` or `CsSteps`).
- The last item is always the current page and is not a link.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<CsBreadcrumbGroupItem>` | required | The path, root first. The last item is the current page. |
| `onFollow` | `ValueChanged<CsBreadcrumbGroupItem>?` | `null` | Called when an item other than the current page is followed. Navigate here. |
| `onClick` | `ValueChanged<CsBreadcrumbGroupItem>?` | `null` | Called on every item activation before `onFollow`, for side effects. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `CsStrings.breadcrumbs` | Accessible name of the group. |
| `expandAriaLabel` | `String?` | `'Show path'` | Accessible name of the ellipsis button. Overrides `i18nStrings`. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsBreadcrumbGroupI18nStrings` | English | `expandAriaLabel`, `ariaLabel`. |
| `presentation` | `CsPresentation` | `auto` | How the collapsed items open: a dropdown on wide screens, a bottom sheet on phones. |

`CsBreadcrumbGroupItem(text:, href:, data:)`: `href` is a path or route name that identifies the item; the widget never opens it. `data` carries any value of yours.

## Examples

### Collapsing on narrow widths

When the items do not fit, the ones after the first collapse into an ellipsis button that lists them. When only the first item would remain, the whole path becomes one button with the current page title.

```dart
SizedBox(
  width: 280,
  child: CsBreadcrumbGroup(
    items: const [
      CsBreadcrumbGroupItem(text: 'Service', href: '/'),
      CsBreadcrumbGroupItem(text: 'Distributions', href: '/distributions'),
      CsBreadcrumbGroupItem(text: 'd111111abcdef8', href: '/distributions/d111111abcdef8'),
      CsBreadcrumbGroupItem(text: 'Behaviors', href: '/distributions/d111111abcdef8/behaviors'),
    ],
    onFollow: (item) {},
  ),
)
```

### Carrying route data

```dart
CsBreadcrumbGroup(
  items: const [
    CsBreadcrumbGroupItem(text: 'Instances', href: 'instances'),
    CsBreadcrumbGroupItem(text: 'i-0abc123', href: 'instance', data: 'i-0abc123'),
  ],
  onFollow: (item) => Navigator.of(context).pushNamed(item.href, arguments: item.data),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The group is a labeled container ("Breadcrumbs" by default).
- Items are links; the current page is announced as a disabled, selected link (Cloudscape's `aria-current="page"`).
- The ellipsis button announces `expandAriaLabel` and its expanded state. Its menu takes focus; arrow keys move between items and Escape closes it.
- A truncated current page title shows the full text in a tooltip on hover, focus and long press.

## Motion

The caret of the collapsed path button turns 180 degrees when the list opens (`CsDurations.responsive`). The dropdown scales from its trigger; reduced motion makes both instant.

## Mobile

At or below 688px the list of collapsed items opens as a bottom sheet. Widths are measured with the current text scale, so 2x text collapses earlier instead of overflowing.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `items` (`text`, `href`) | `items` (`CsBreadcrumbGroupItem.text`, `.href`) |
| `onFollow` | `onFollow` (receives the item) |
| `onClick` | `onClick` (receives the item) |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `expandAriaLabel` | `expandAriaLabel` or `i18nStrings.expandAriaLabel` |
| one-theme `slash-divider` separators | not applicable (visual refresh only) |

---
source: doc/components/CsButton.md
---

# CsButton

Cloudscape's `Button`: the control for actions, in normal, primary, link and icon variants, with icons, a loading state and a disabled reason.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/button/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsButton(text: 'Launch instance', variant: CsButtonVariant.primary, onPress: () {})
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a button for an action on the current page. One `primary` button per view for the main action, `normal` (the default) for the others, `link` for Cancel next to a primary button and for actions in headers and tables, `icon` for compact toolbar actions, `inlineIcon` and `inlineLink` inside text and rows. For navigation inside text use `CsLink`; for a menu of actions use `CsButtonDropdown`; for an on/off state use `CsToggleButton`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `String?` | | Button text, sentence case, a verb |
| `child` | `Widget?` | | Custom content in place of `text` |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | Null renders the button disabled |
| `onLongPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | |
| `variant` | `CsButtonVariant` | `normal` | `normal`, `primary`, `link`, `icon`, `inlineIcon`, `inlineLink`, `modalDismiss`, `flashbarIcon` |
| `icon` | `CsIconData?` | | A `CsIcons` icon (Cloudscape `iconName`) |
| `iconWidget` | `Widget?` | | Any widget in the icon slot (Cloudscape `iconSvg` / `iconUrl`) |
| `iconAlign` | `CsButtonIconAlign` | `left` | `left` or `right` of the text |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Spinner in place of the icon; presses ignored |
| `loadingText` | `String?` | | Announced while loading |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `disabledReason` | `String?` | | Keeps a disabled button focusable and explains it in a tooltip |
| `fullWidth` | `bool` | `false` | Stretch to the parent's width |
| `wrapText` | `bool` | `true` | False keeps one line with an ellipsis |
| `external` | `bool` | `false` | External-link icon after the text, announced as opening a new tab |
| `isLink` | `bool` | `false` | Announce as a link (a button with `href`) |
| `expanded` | `bool?` | | Disclosure state for buttons that open a menu or panel (`ariaExpanded`) |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name; required for icon-only variants (`ariaLabel`) |
| `haptic` | `CsHaptic` | `none` | Haptic on press |
| `focusNode`, `autofocus` | | | |

## Examples

### Variants

```dart
Wrap(spacing: 8, runSpacing: 8, children: [
  CsButton(text: 'Cancel', variant: CsButtonVariant.link, onPress: () {}),
  CsButton(text: 'Edit', onPress: () {}),
  CsButton(text: 'Create distribution', variant: CsButtonVariant.primary, onPress: () {}),
])
```

### Icons

```dart
Wrap(spacing: 8, children: [
  CsButton(text: 'Add item', icon: CsIcons.addPlus, onPress: () {}),
  CsButton(text: 'Actions', icon: CsIcons.caretDownFilled, iconAlign: CsButtonIconAlign.right, onPress: () {}),
  CsButton(icon: CsIcons.refresh, semanticLabel: 'Refresh', onPress: () {}),
  CsButton(icon: CsIcons.settings, variant: CsButtonVariant.icon, semanticLabel: 'Preferences', onPress: () {}),
])
```

### Loading and disabled with a reason

```dart
Wrap(spacing: 8, children: [
  CsButton(text: 'Launching', variant: CsButtonVariant.primary, loading: true, loadingText: 'Launching instance', onPress: () {}),
  CsButton(text: 'Stop', disabled: true, disabledReason: 'The instance is already stopped.', onPress: () {}),
])
```

### Inline link

```dart
CsButton(text: 'Reset filters', variant: CsButtonVariant.inlineLink, onPress: () {})
```

## Accessibility

Announced as a button (or link with `isLink`) with its text and enabled state. Icon-only variants assert a `semanticLabel`. While loading, `loadingText` is the accessible name. A disabled button with `disabledReason` stays in the Tab order and announces the reason as its hint. Tab focuses, Enter and Space activate, keyboard focus shows the 2px focus ring 4px outside the button. On touch the hit area grows to 44x44.

## Motion

- Pointer-down scales the button to 0.98 with a spring; release springs back from wherever it is. Hover and active colors change instantly.
- The icon slot cross-fades between icon and spinner when `loading` changes.
- Reduced or disabled motion removes the scale and the cross-fade.

## Mobile

Visual heights stay Cloudscape's (32px, 28px compact); the touch hit area is padded to 44px. `fullWidth: true` is the usual choice for the main action at the bottom of a phone screen.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `text` / `child` |
| `onClick` | `onPress` |
| `variant="inline-icon"` | `variant: CsButtonVariant.inlineIcon` |
| `iconName="add-plus"` | `icon: CsIcons.addPlus` |
| `iconSvg`, `iconUrl` | `iconWidget` |
| `iconAlign`, `loading`, `loadingText`, `disabled`, `disabledReason`, `fullWidth`, `wrapText`, `external` | same names |
| `ariaLabel` | `semanticLabel` |
| `ariaExpanded` | `expanded` |
| `href`, `onFollow` | `isLink: true` + `onPress` (Flutter has no URLs) |
| `formAction`, `form`, `target`, `rel`, `download`, `nativeButtonAttributes`, `ariaDescribedby`, `ariaControls` | not applicable |

source: doc/components/CsButtonDropdown.md

# CsButtonDropdown

Cloudscape's `ButtonDropdown`: a button that opens a menu of actions, with groups, checkbox items, expandable groups, disabled reasons, external links and a split-button main action.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/button-dropdown/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsButtonDropdown(
  text: 'Actions',
  items: const [
    CsButtonDropdownItem(id: 'start', text: 'Start instance'),
    CsButtonDropdownItem(id: 'stop', text: 'Stop instance', disabled: true, disabledReason: 'Already stopped'),
  ],
  onItemClick: (details) {},
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to group related secondary actions. For a single action use `CsButton`; for a choice that is a value, use `CsSelect`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<CsButtonDropdownItemOrGroup>` | required | `CsButtonDropdownItem`, `CsButtonDropdownCheckboxItem`, `CsButtonDropdownGroup` |
| `text` | `String?` | | Trigger text |
| `variant` | `CsButtonDropdownVariant` | `normal` | `normal`, `primary`, `icon`, `inlineIcon` |
| `icon`, `iconWidget` | | ellipsis for icon variants | |
| `disabled`, `disabledReason` | | | |
| `loading`, `loadingText` | | | Spinner, cannot open |
| `expandableGroups` | `bool` | `false` | Groups collapse behind their heading and expand in place |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | | Required for icon variants |
| `onItemClick` | `ValueChanged<CsButtonDropdownItemClickDetails>?` | | `id`, `checked` (next state of a checkbox item) |
| `onItemFollow` | same | | Links (`isLink`) and `external` items |
| `mainAction` | `CsButtonDropdownMainAction?` | | Split button: `text`, `onPress`, `disabled`, `disabledReason`, `loading`, `loadingText`, `icon`, `external`, `ariaLabel` |
| `fullWidth` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `filteringType` | `bool` | `false` | Filter input above the items |
| `filteringPlaceholder`, `filteringAriaLabel`, `noMatch` | | | |
| `presentation` | `CsPresentation` | `auto` | Bottom sheet at or below 688px |

Item fields: `id`, `text`, `secondaryText`, `description` (tooltip), `labelTag`, `icon`, `iconWidget`, `disabled`, `disabledReason`, `external`, `externalIconAriaLabel`, `isLink`, `ariaLabel`. Checkbox items add `checked`. Groups: `items`, `text`, `id`, `icon`, `disabled`, `disabledReason`, `expandable`.

## Examples

### Groups, checkboxes and external links

```dart
CsButtonDropdown(
  text: 'Instance actions',
  items: const [
    CsButtonDropdownGroup(text: 'State', items: [
      CsButtonDropdownItem(id: 'start', text: 'Start'),
      CsButtonDropdownItem(id: 'reboot', text: 'Reboot', labelTag: 'R'),
    ]),
    CsButtonDropdownCheckboxItem(id: 'monitoring', text: 'Detailed monitoring', checked: true),
    CsButtonDropdownItem(id: 'docs', text: 'Documentation', external: true),
  ],
  onItemClick: (details) {},
  onItemFollow: (details) {},
)
```

### Split button

```dart
CsButtonDropdown(
  variant: CsButtonDropdownVariant.primary,
  ariaLabel: 'More launch options',
  mainAction: CsButtonDropdownMainAction(text: 'Launch instance', onPress: () {}),
  items: const [CsButtonDropdownItem(id: 'template', text: 'Launch from template')],
)
```

### Icon variant with expandable groups

```dart
const CsButtonDropdown(
  variant: CsButtonDropdownVariant.icon,
  ariaLabel: 'More actions',
  expandableGroups: true,
  items: [
    CsButtonDropdownGroup(text: 'Networking', items: [CsButtonDropdownItem(id: 'ip', text: 'Associate IP address')]),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

The trigger announces its expanded state. The menu takes focus (first enabled item); Up and Down move, Home and End jump, Enter and Space activate, Escape closes and focus returns to the trigger. Checkbox items announce checked state; external items announce that they open in a new window; disabled items explain themselves in a tooltip.

## Motion

The menu scales and fades from the trigger; expandable group carets rotate. Reduced motion removes the scale and rotation.

## Mobile

At or below 688px the menu opens as a bottom sheet with 40px rows; expandable groups expand inside it.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `items`, `variant`, `disabled`, `disabledReason`, `loading`, `loadingText`, `expandableGroups`, `ariaLabel`, `onItemClick`, `onItemFollow`, `mainAction`, `fullWidth`, `filteringPlaceholder`, `filteringAriaLabel`, `noMatch` | same names |
| `children` | `text` |
| `iconName` / `iconSvg` / `iconUrl` | `icon` / `iconWidget` |
| `filteringType: 'auto'` | `filteringType: true` |
| `item.href` | `isLink: true` + `onItemFollow` |
| `expandToViewport`, `renderItem`, `asyncLoadingProps`, `onLoadItems`, `nativeTriggerAttributes` | not applicable / not implemented |
| nested side flyouts on desktop | groups expand in place on every screen size |

# CsButtonGroup

Cloudscape's `ButtonGroup`: a compact row of icon actions (icon buttons, icon toggles, copy and an overflow menu), with tooltips and click feedback.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/button-group/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsButtonGroup(
  ariaLabel: 'Message actions',
  items: const [
    CsButtonGroupIconButton(id: 'refresh', text: 'Refresh', icon: CsIcons.refresh),
    CsButtonGroupMenuDropdown(id: 'more', text: 'More actions', items: [CsButtonDropdownItem(id: 'share', text: 'Share')]),
  ],
  onItemClick: (details) {},
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for small sets of related icon actions, such as under a chat message or in a card header. For text actions use `CsButton`s in a `CsSpaceBetween`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<CsButtonGroupItemOrGroup>` | required | Items and `CsButtonGroupGroup(text, items)` |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name of the group |
| `onItemClick` | `ValueChanged<CsButtonGroupItemClickDetails>?` | | `id`, `pressed` (toggles), `checked` (menu checkbox items) |
| `onCopySuccess`, `onCopyFailure` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | Item id after a copy |

Items: `CsButtonGroupIconButton` (`id`, `text`, `icon`, `iconWidget`, `disabled`, `disabledReason`, `loading`, `loadingText`, `popoverFeedback`), `CsButtonGroupIconToggleButton` (`pressed`, `icon`, `pressedIcon`, `popoverFeedback`, `pressedPopoverFeedback`, ...), `CsButtonGroupMenuDropdown` (`items` as `CsButtonDropdown`), `CsButtonGroupCopyToClipboard` (`textToCopy`, `copySuccessText`, `copyErrorText`).

## Examples

### Feedback group

```dart
CsButtonGroup(
  items: [
    CsButtonGroupGroup(text: 'Vote', items: [
      CsButtonGroupIconToggleButton(id: 'up', text: 'Helpful', icon: CsIcons.thumbsUp, pressedIcon: CsIcons.thumbsUpFilled, pressed: false, pressedPopoverFeedback: 'Thanks for the feedback'),
      CsButtonGroupIconToggleButton(id: 'down', text: 'Not helpful', icon: CsIcons.thumbsDown, pressedIcon: CsIcons.thumbsDownFilled, pressed: false),
    ]),
    const CsButtonGroupCopyToClipboard(id: 'copy', text: 'Copy', textToCopy: 'Sample response', copySuccessText: 'Copied', copyErrorText: 'Failed to copy'),
  ],
  onItemClick: (details) {},
)
```

## Accessibility

Each button is labelled by its `text`, which also shows in a tooltip; toggles announce their pressed state. Feedback text is a live region. Groups are labelled containers separated by a divider.

## Motion

Feedback appears above the button for two seconds, then fades.

## Mobile

Items wrap at 390px; icon buttons have 44px touch targets.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `items`, `ariaLabel`, `onItemClick` | same names |
| `type: 'icon-button' / 'icon-toggle-button' / 'menu-dropdown' / 'icon-copy-to-clipboard' / 'group'` | `CsButtonGroupIconButton` / `IconToggleButton` / `MenuDropdown` / `CopyToClipboard` / `Group` |
| `onCopySuccess`, `onCopyFailure` | same names (item id) |
| `variant` | always icon |
| `icon-file-input`, `onFilesChange`, `dropdownExpandToViewport`, `href` | not applicable |

# CsCalendar

An inline month grid (or a year of months) for picking one date; reach for it when the calendar should stay on the page, and for `CsDatePicker` when it belongs behind a field.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/calendar/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsCalendar(
  value: date, // '2026-03-15', or '' for none
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => date = v),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it to pick a single date that should be visible at all times, such as a scheduling side panel.
- Use `CsDatePicker` when the date also needs to be typed, or space is tight.
- Use `CsDateRangePicker` for a start and end date.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String` | required | Selected date, `YYYY-MM-DD` (`YYYY-MM` with month granularity), or `''`. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Called with the picked date in the same format. Null makes the days read-only. |
| `isDateEnabled` | `bool Function(DateTime)?` | all enabled | Days (or months) that can be picked. |
| `dateDisabledReason` | `String? Function(DateTime)?` | `null` | Why a disabled day can not be picked. A reason keeps the day focusable and shows a tooltip. |
| `startOfWeek` | `int?` | `CsStrings.firstDayOfWeek` (Sunday) | First column, 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday. |
| `granularity` | `CsDateGranularity` | `day` | `day` shows a month of days; `month` shows the months of a year. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name of the calendar. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsCalendarI18nStrings?` | English | `todayAriaLabel`, `nextMonthAriaLabel`, `previousMonthAriaLabel`, `currentMonthAriaLabel`, `nextYearAriaLabel`, `previousYearAriaLabel`, `weekdayNamesShort`. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | Focus the selected day (or today) when shown. |
| `stretch` | `bool` | `false` | Fill the available width instead of the 238px grid. |

Month and weekday names come from `context.csStrings` (`CsLocale`).

## Examples

### Weekdays only, with a reason

```dart
CsCalendar(
  value: maintenanceDay,
  isDateEnabled: (d) => d.weekday != DateTime.saturday && d.weekday != DateTime.sunday,
  dateDisabledReason: (d) => 'Maintenance runs on weekdays only.',
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => maintenanceDay = v),
)
```

### Month picker

```dart
CsCalendar(
  value: billingMonth, // '2026-03'
  granularity: CsDateGranularity.month,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => billingMonth = v),
)
```

### Week starting on Monday, translated labels

```dart
CsCalendar(
  value: date,
  startOfWeek: 1,
  i18nStrings: const CsCalendarI18nStrings(todayAriaLabel: 'Hari ini', nextMonthAriaLabel: 'Bulan berikutnya'),
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => date = v),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Each day is a button labeled like "March 15, 2026", with ". Today" appended for today, and the selected state. Disabled days are announced as disabled; a disabled reason is their hint.
- The grid is one Tab stop: the selected day, else today, else the first enabled day.
- Arrows move by day and week (month and quarter in a month calendar), Page Up and Page Down by month (Shift for a year), Home and End to the start and end of the row, Enter and Space pick. Disabled days are skipped; days with a reason can be focused.
- The previous and next buttons are labeled; the month heading is a live region.

## Motion

Each page fades in with Cloudscape's `motion-duration-show-quick` (135ms). Reduced motion swaps pages instantly. On touch, a horizontal swipe changes the month with a selection haptic.

## Mobile

The calendar keeps Cloudscape's 238px width (scaled with text up to 1.6x) and never exceeds its parent. With `stretch` it fills the parent and, on touch, rows grow to 40px. Day cells do not pad their hit areas to 44px because they tile edge to edge.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` | `value` |
| `onChange` (`detail.value`) | `onChange` |
| `isDateEnabled` | `isDateEnabled` |
| `dateDisabledReason` (ReactNode) | `dateDisabledReason` (String) |
| `startOfWeek` | `startOfWeek` |
| `granularity` | `granularity` |
| `locale` | not supported: copy comes from `CsStrings` / `i18nStrings` |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `ariaLabelledby`, `ariaDescribedby` | not applicable |
| `i18nStrings` | `i18nStrings` |
| `todayAriaLabel`, `nextMonthAriaLabel`, `previousMonthAriaLabel` (deprecated) | `i18nStrings` fields |
| (none) | `autofocus`, `stretch` |

---
source: doc/components/CsCards.md

# CsCards

Cloudscape's `Cards`: a collection shown as a grid of cards, with the header, filter, pagination and preferences slots of a collection and optional selection.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/cards/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsCards<Map<String, Object?>>(
  header: const CsHeader(title: 'Distributions', counter: '(1)'),
  items: const [
    {'id': 'd111111abcdef8', 'domain': 'd111111abcdef8.example.net', 'status': 'Deployed'},
  ],
  cardDefinition: CsCardDefinition(
    header: (context, item) => Text('${item['id']}'),
    sections: [
      CsCardSection(id: 'domain', header: 'Domain name', content: (context, item) => Text('${item['domain']}')),
      CsCardSection(id: 'status', header: 'Status', content: (context, item) => Text('${item['status']}')),
    ],
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use cards when each item benefits from a visual summary (images, status, a few key attributes) and users browse rather than compare. Use `CsTable` to compare many attributes across items.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<T>` | required | The cards, in order |
| `cardDefinition` | `CsCardDefinition<T>` | required | `header(context, item)` and `sections` |
| `header`, `filter`, `pagination`, `preferences` | `Widget?` |  | Collection slots, in a container above the cards |
| `empty` | `Widget?` |  | Shown when `items` is empty |
| `loading` / `loadingText` | `bool` / `String?` | `false` | Loading status instead of cards |
| `cardsPerRow` | `List<CsCardsLayout>` | `CsCardsLayout.defaults` | Cards per row from a minimum width |
| `trackBy` | `Object? Function(T)?` |  | Item identity |
| `selectionType` | `CsSelectionType?` |  | `single` or `multi` |
| `selectedItems` / `onSelectionChange` | `List<T>` / `ValueChanged<List<T>>?` | `[]` | Controlled selection |
| `isItemDisabled` | `bool Function(T)?` |  | Disabled items cannot be selected |
| `visibleSections` | `List<String>?` |  | Ids of the visible sections |
| `entireCardClickable` | `bool` | `false` | Pressing the card selects it |
| `variant` | `CsCardsVariant` | `container` | `container` or `fullPage` |
| `stickyHeader` / `stickyHeaderVerticalOffset` | `bool` / `double` | `false` / `0` | Pinned header in a bounded height, off on phones |
| `totalItemsCount`, `firstIndex`, `renderAriaLive` |  |  | Screen reader counts and page announcements |
| `ariaLabels` | `CsCardsAriaLabels<T>?` |  | `itemSelectionLabel`, `selectionGroupLabel`, `cardsLabel` |

`CsCardSection<T>`: `id`, `header` or `headerWidget`, `content(context, item)`, `width` (percent, default 100).

`CsCardsLayout`: `cards` and `minWidth`. Default: 1 card, 2 from 768px, 3 from 992px, 4 from 1200px, 5 from 1400px, 6 from 1920px. `CsCardsLayout.cardsPerRow(width, config)` computes it.

## Examples

### Selectable cards

```dart
CsCards<Map<String, Object?>>(
  items: items,
  cardDefinition: definition,
  selectionType: CsSelectionType.multi,
  selectedItems: selected,
  onSelectionChange: (next) => setState(() => selected = next),
  entireCardClickable: true,
  ariaLabels: CsCardsAriaLabels(itemSelectionLabel: (selected, item) => 'Select ${item['id']}'),
)
```

### Side by side sections and a fixed grid

```dart
CsCards<Map<String, Object?>>(
  items: items,
  cardsPerRow: const [CsCardsLayout(cards: 1), CsCardsLayout(cards: 3, minWidth: 600)],
  cardDefinition: CsCardDefinition(
    header: (context, item) => Text('${item['id']}'),
    sections: [
      CsCardSection(id: 'status', header: 'Status', width: 50, content: (context, item) => Text('${item['status']}')),
      CsCardSection(id: 'origin', header: 'Origin', width: 50, content: (context, item) => Text('${item['origin']}')),
    ],
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

The list is a semantics container named by `cardsLabel`. Card titles are headings. Selection controls are checkboxes or radios labeled by `itemSelectionLabel`; selected cards expose their state. Up and Down arrows move focus between selection controls.

## Motion

Selecting a card eases its background and 2px border in (`CsDurations.showPaced`); reduced motion makes it instant.

## Mobile

The grid uses one column below 768px with the default layout. Cards in a row share the tallest card's height. With the `fullPage` variant on phones the pagination moves below the cards, as in Cloudscape, and the sticky header is turned off.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `cardDefinition.header(item)` | `CsCardDefinition.header(context, item)` |
| `cardDefinition.sections[].content(item)` | `CsCardSection.content(context, item)` |
| `cardsPerRow` | `List<CsCardsLayout>` |
| `variant: 'full-page'` | `CsCardsVariant.fullPage` |
| `ariaLabels.itemSelectionLabel(data, item)` | `itemSelectionLabel(selectedItems, item)` |
| `ref.scrollToTop()` | use a `ScrollController` on the parent |
| `analyticsMetadata` | web only, not ported |

source: doc/components/CsChartSeries.md
