# CsChartSeries

The data types shared by `CsLineChart`, `CsBarChart`, `CsMixedLineBarChart` and `CsAreaChart`: series, data points, popover details, palette and copy.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/mixed-line-bar-chart/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
final latency = CsChartSeries<int>.line(
  title: 'p99 latency',
  data: const [CsChartDatum(0, 120), CsChartDatum(1, 135), CsChartDatum(2, 98)],
  valueFormatter: (y, x) => '${y}ms',
);
const sla = CsChartSeries<int>.threshold(title: 'SLA', y: 150, colorToken: CsColor.chartsThresholdNegative);
```

## When to use / when not to

- Build series once (fields, `const`) and pass the same instances on every build: charts track filtering and highlight by series identity.
- Use `colorToken` for color overrides so they follow light and dark mode; leave colors out to get Cloudscape's categorical palette in order.

## Parameters

### CsChartSeries<T>

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CsChartSeries.line/.bar/.area(title:, data:)` | constructors | | A data series of that `type`. |
| `CsChartSeries.threshold(title:, y: or x:)` | constructor | | Dashed reference line at a value (`y`) or position (`x`, not in area charts). |
| `type` | `CsChartSeriesType` | | `line`, `bar`, `area`, `threshold`. |
| `title` | `String` | required | Shown in legend, filter and popover. |
| `data` | `List<CsChartDatum<T>>` | `[]` | `CsChartDatum(x, y)`; `y` is a `num`. |
| `color` | `Color?` | `null` | Raw color override (Cloudscape `color`). |
| `colorToken` | `CsColor?` | `null` | Token color override. |
| `valueFormatter` | `CsChartValueFormatter<T>?` | `null` | `(y, x) => String` for popover values. |
| `valueFormatter` (threshold) | `CsChartTickFormatter<num>?` | `null` | `(y) => String` for the threshold value, stored as `thresholdValueFormatter`. |

### Other types

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CsChartScaleType` | enum | | `linear`, `log`, `time`, `categorical`. |
| `CsChartYScaleType` | enum | | `linear`, `log`. |
| `CsChartStatusType` | enum | | `loading`, `finished`, `error`. |
| `CsChartPopoverSize` | enum | | `small` (210), `medium` (310), `large` (482); `maxWidth`. |
| `CsChartSeriesDetail` | class | | Returned by `detailPopoverSeriesContent`: `key`/`keyWidget`, `value`/`valueWidget`, `subItems`, `expandable`. |
| `CsChartDetailPair` | class | | `key`/`keyWidget`, `value`/`valueWidget`; popover rows and sub-items. |
| `CsChartColors` | class | | `categorical` (the 50 palette tokens in Cloudscape order), `threshold`, `at(theme, i)`, `resolve(...)`. |
| `CsChartI18nStrings` | class | all `null` | `filterLabel` ("Filter displayed data"), `filterPlaceholder` ("Filter data"), `filterSelectedAriaLabel`, `legendAriaLabel` ("Legend"), `detailPopoverDismissAriaLabel` ("Dismiss"), `chartAriaRoleDescription`, `xAxisAriaRoleDescription` ("x-axis"), `yAxisAriaRoleDescription` ("y-axis"), `detailTotalLabel` ("Total"), `expandAriaLabel`, `collapseAriaLabel`. |

## Examples

### Palette colors outside a chart

```dart
Widget swatch(BuildContext context, int i) => Container(
  width: 14,
  height: 14,
  color: CsChartColors.at(context.cs, i),
);
```

### Popover breakdown

```dart
CsChartSeriesDetail detail(CsChartSeries<String> s, String x, num y) => CsChartSeriesDetail(
  value: '$y requests',
  expandable: true,
  subItems: const [CsChartDetailPair(key: 'GET', value: '640'), CsChartDetailPair(key: 'PUT', value: '120')],
);
```

## Accessibility

Series titles name everything a color shows: legend entries, filter rows, popover rows and the chart's screen reader summary.

## Motion

Not animated on their own; see the chart pages.

## Mobile

No layout of their own; see the chart pages.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `MixedLineBarChartProps.ChartSeries`, `AreaChartProps.Series` | `CsChartSeries<T>` |
| `Datum` | `CsChartDatum<T>` |
| `DetailPopoverSeriesKeyValuePair` | `CsChartSeriesDetail` |
| `ChartDetailPair` | `CsChartDetailPair` |
| `CartesianChartProps.I18nStrings` | `CsChartI18nStrings` |
| `color-charts-palette-categorical-*` | `CsChartColors.categorical` |

source: doc/components/CsChatBubble.md

# CsChatBubble

One message in a conversation with a person or a generative AI assistant, paired with an avatar and optional actions.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/chat-bubble/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsChatBubble(
  type: CsChatBubbleType.incoming,
  ariaLabel: 'Generative AI assistant at 3:42pm',
  avatar: const CsAvatar(
    color: CsAvatarColor.genAi,
    icon: CsIcons.genAi,
    ariaLabel: 'Generative AI assistant',
  ),
  child: const Text('Bucket example-bucket has versioning enabled.'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use `incoming` for messages from the assistant or other people (filled) and `outgoing` for the current user's messages (no fill).
- Use `hideAvatar` on consecutive messages from the same author.
- Use `actions` for message actions (copy, thumbs up and down), not for navigation.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `CsChatBubbleType` | required | `incoming` or `outgoing`. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String` | required | Unique accessible name of the message group, such as "Sample user at 3:42pm". |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | Message content. Text uses body-m on a 22px line. |
| `avatar` | `Widget?` | `null` | Usually a `CsAvatar`. |
| `actions` | `Widget?` | `null` | Footer below the content. |
| `showLoadingBar` | `bool` | `false` | Shows `CsLoadingBar(variant: genAiMasked)` along the bottom edge. |
| `hideAvatar` | `bool` | `false` | Hides the avatar but keeps its space; also removes it from focus and semantics (Cloudscape `inert`). |
| `stretch` | `bool` | `false` | Fills the available width instead of fitting the content. |
| `align` | `CsChatBubbleAlign` | `start` | `end` places the bubble first and the avatar after it, aligned to the end. |

## Examples

### Outgoing message aligned to the end

```dart
const CsChatBubble(
  type: CsChatBubbleType.outgoing,
  align: CsChatBubbleAlign.end,
  ariaLabel: 'Sample user at 3:41pm',
  avatar: CsAvatar(ariaLabel: 'Account', initials: 'SU'),
  child: Text('Is versioning enabled on example-bucket?'),
)
```

### Streaming response with actions

```dart
CsChatBubble(
  type: CsChatBubbleType.incoming,
  ariaLabel: 'Generative AI assistant at 3:42pm',
  showLoadingBar: true,
  avatar: const CsAvatar(
    color: CsAvatarColor.genAi,
    icon: CsIcons.genAi,
    loading: true,
    ariaLabel: 'Generative AI assistant, generating',
  ),
  actions: CsButton(variant: CsButtonVariant.icon, icon: CsIcons.copy, semanticLabel: 'Copy', onPress: () {}),
  child: const Text('Checking the bucket configuration'),
)
```

## Accessibility

The row is a labelled semantics group (`role="group"` with `aria-label`), so each message is announced with its author and time. Children keep their own semantics.

## Motion

Only the optional loading bar and the avatar's loading state animate.

## Mobile

The bubble wraps its text inside the available width, so long messages never overflow at 390px. Use `stretch` when messages contain footers that should line up.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `type` | `type` |
| `children` | `child` |
| `avatar` | `avatar` |
| `actions` | `actions` |
| `showLoadingBar` | `showLoadingBar` |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `hideAvatar` | `hideAvatar` |
| `stretch` | `stretch` |
| `align` | `align` |
| `style` | not supported; theme with color overrides |

# CsCheckbox

A box with a label for a single on or off choice that is submitted with a form, or the "select all" control above a list.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/checkbox/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsCheckbox(
  checked: versioning,
  label: 'Enable versioning',
  description: 'Keeps every version of each object.',
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => versioning = v),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for independent choices, or for selecting several items from a list.
- Use `CsToggle` for settings that take effect immediately, and `CsRadioGroup` for one choice among several.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `bool` | required | The controlled state. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | `null` | Called with the next state; an indeterminate box becomes checked. Null disables it. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Label text; tapping it toggles too. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom label in place of `label`. |
| `description` | `String?` | `null` | Body-s text under the label. |
| `indeterminate` | `bool` | `false` | A dash for "some selected". |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Focusable, but taps and keys do nothing. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name without a label. |
| `ariaRequired` | `bool` | `false` | Adds a "Required" hint. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | |

### CsCheckboxIcon

`CsCheckboxIcon(checked:, indeterminate: false, disabled: false, readOnly: false)` is the bare 16px glyph, for table rows and option lists that handle the tap themselves. Its check mark draws in over `CsDurations.expressive` when it becomes checked.

## Examples

### Select all

```dart
CsCheckbox(
  checked: selected.length == instances.length,
  indeterminate: selected.isNotEmpty && selected.length < instances.length,
  label: 'All instances',
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => v ? selected.addAll(instances) : selected.clear()),
)
```

### Without a visible label

```dart
CsCheckbox(checked: rowSelected, ariaLabel: 'Select i-0abc123', onChange: (v) => setState(() => rowSelected = v))
```

## Accessibility

Announced as a checkbox with checked, unchecked or mixed state, its label and description. Tab focuses it; Space or Enter toggles. Keyboard focus draws the 2px focus ring around the box.

## Motion

The check mark (or dash) draws along its path when the box becomes checked; the fill switches instantly. Reduced motion shows it at once.

## Mobile

The whole row (box, label, description) is the touch target, padded to 44px on touch. Labels wrap at 2x text.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `checked` / `onChange` | `checked` / `onChange` |
| `indeterminate` | `indeterminate` |
| `children` | `label` / `child` |
| `description` | `description` |
| `disabled` / `readOnly` | `disabled` / `readOnly` |
| `ariaLabel`, `ariaRequired` | `ariaLabel`, `ariaRequired` |
| `name`, `controlId`, `ariaControls`, `nativeInputAttributes`, `style` | web only |

# CsCodeEditor

Cloudscape's `CodeEditor`, rebuilt in Flutter without Ace: a monospace editor with line numbers, syntax highlighting, an active line marker, validation and Cloudscape's status bar.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/code-editor/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsCodeEditor(
  value: policy,
  language: 'json',
  validator: CsCodeEditor.jsonValidator,
  preferences: prefs,
  onPreferencesChange: (p) => setState(() => prefs = p),
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => policy = v),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it when users write or edit code or structured documents (policies, templates, scripts, queries). To show code read-only, use a code view. For short free text use a textarea.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String` | required | |
| `language` | `String` | required | `json`, `yaml`, `javascript`, `typescript`, `python`, `sh` are highlighted; others show plain text |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | Every edit |
| `onDelayedChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | 500ms after the last edit |
| `onValidate` | `ValueChanged<List<CsCodeEditorAnnotation>>?` | | When the problems found change |
| `languageLabel` | `String?` | readable language name | Status bar label |
| `preferences` | `CsCodeEditorPreferences?` | wrap lines, app theme | `wrapLines`, `theme` (`auto`, `light`, `dark`) |
| `onPreferencesChange` | `ValueChanged<CsCodeEditorPreferences>?` | | Shows the preferences button |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Loading state in place of the editor |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `annotations` | `List<CsCodeEditorAnnotation>?` | | Problems to show; take precedence over `validator` |
| `validator` | `CsCodeEditorValidator?` | | `(value) => annotations`, run on every change |
| `editorContentHeight` | `double?` | 480 (240 on phones) | Height of the editing area |
| `onEditorContentResize` | `ValueChanged<double>?` | | Controls the height from the resize handle |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | | |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | | |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsCodeEditorI18nStrings` | English | `loadingState`, `cursorPosition(row, column)`, `errorsTab`, `warningsTab`, `preferencesButtonAriaLabel`, `paneCloseButtonAriaLabel`, preference labels, `resizeHandleAriaLabel`, ... |

`CsCodeEditorAnnotation`: `row` and `column` (zero-based), `text`, `type` (`error`, `warning`, `info`). `CsCodeEditor.jsonValidator` reports the first JSON syntax error. `CsCodeEditorHighlighter.tokenize(code, language)` exposes the tokenizer.

## Examples

### Custom annotations

```dart
CsCodeEditor(
  value: template,
  language: 'yaml',
  annotations: const [
    CsCodeEditorAnnotation(row: 3, column: 4, text: 'Versioning is off.', type: CsCodeEditorAnnotationType.warning),
  ],
  onChange: (v) {},
)
```

### Fixed height, dark editor

```dart
CsCodeEditor(
  value: script,
  language: 'sh',
  editorContentHeight: 200,
  preferences: const CsCodeEditorPreferences(wrapLines: false, theme: CsCodeEditorTheme.dark),
  onChange: (v) {},
)
```

### Loading

```dart
const CsCodeEditor(value: '', language: 'json', loading: true)
```

## Accessibility

The editor is a labelled group ("Code editor") holding a multi-line text field. Tab inserts two spaces; Escape closes the errors pane or moves focus out of the editor, so keyboard users are never trapped; Shift+Tab moves focus back. The status bar is a group: the cursor position is a live region, the errors and warnings tabs announce their counts and selected state and open a pane whose rows ("Ln 3, Col 5: message") move the cursor to the problem. The resize handle responds to Up and Down while focused.

## Motion

None beyond `CsDropdown` for the preferences menu. Hover colors in the status bar switch instantly.

## Mobile

The default height drops to 240px below 688px. With `wrapLines` (the default) there is no horizontal scrolling; without it the code area scrolls sideways while the gutter stays put. Below 500px of width the errors and warnings tabs show their counts only.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value`, `language`, `languageLabel`, `loading`, `editorContentHeight`, `ariaLabel`, `i18nStrings` | same names |
| `onChange`, `onDelayedChange` (`detail.value`) | `ValueChanged<String>` |
| `onValidate` (`detail.annotations`) | `onValidate` + `annotations` / `validator` |
| `preferences`, `onPreferencesChange` | `CsCodeEditorPreferences` (`theme` is `auto`, `light` or `dark`, Cloudscape's two editor themes) |
| `onEditorContentResize` (`detail.height`) | `ValueChanged<double>` |
| `themes` | not supported (two themes) |
| `ace`, `onRecoveryClick` | not applicable (no Ace to load) |
| preferences modal | preferences menu |

source: doc/components/CsCodeView.md

# CsCodeView

A read-only code snippet with optional line numbers, line wrapping, syntax highlighting and a copy button.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/code-view/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const String policy = '{\n  "Bucket": "example-bucket",\n  "Versioning": true\n}';

CsCodeView(
  content: policy,
  lineNumbers: true,
  highlight: CsCodeViewHighlighter.of('json'),
  actions: const CsCodeViewCopyButton(content: policy),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for code people read or copy: CLI commands, policies, configuration, responses from an assistant.
- Use a code editor when people need to edit the code.
- Use `CsBox(variant: CsBoxVariant.code)` for short inline code in a sentence.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `String` | required | The code. |
| `lineNumbers` | `bool` | `false` | Shows a line number column, separated by a divider. Without `wrapLines` it stays fixed while code scrolls. |
| `wrapLines` | `bool` | `false` | Wraps long lines instead of scrolling horizontally. |
| `highlight` | `CsCodeViewHighlight?` | `null` | `List<CsCodeViewToken> Function(String code)`. Use `CsCodeViewHighlighter.of(lang)`; null shows plain text. |
| `actions` | `Widget?` | `null` | Top end slot, usually `CsCodeViewCopyButton`. Adds end padding so code never runs under it. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Makes the snippet a labelled region. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsCodeViewI18nStrings?` | `null` | `lineNumberLabel` and `codeLabel`. With both, line numbers are read by screen readers; otherwise they are hidden. |

`CsCodeViewHighlighter` supports `json`, `javascript` (`js`, `jsx`), `typescript` (`ts`, `tsx`), `python` (`py`), `yaml` (`yml`), `sh` (`bash`, `shell`, `zsh`) and `html` (`xml`, `svg`); other names render plain text. `CsCodeViewHighlighter.tokenize(code, lang)` and `splitLines(tokens)` are public, and `CsCodeViewColors.of(context.cs)` gives the token colors.

`CsCodeViewCopyButton`: `content` (`String`, required), `i18nStrings` (`CsCodeViewCopyButtonI18nStrings`: `copyButtonAriaLabel`, `copySuccessText`, `copyErrorText`; default to `CsStrings.copy`, `copied`, `copyFailed`), `onCopy` (`ValueChanged<bool>?`). It writes to the clipboard with `Clipboard.setData`, shows the result in a tooltip for 1.5 seconds and announces it.

## Examples

### Shell command with wrapped lines

```dart
const String command = 'aws s3 cp ./build s3://example-bucket/releases/ --recursive --exclude "*.map"';

CsCodeView(
  content: command,
  wrapLines: true,
  highlight: CsCodeViewHighlighter.of('sh'),
  ariaLabel: 'Upload command',
  actions: const CsCodeViewCopyButton(
    content: command,
    i18nStrings: CsCodeViewCopyButtonI18nStrings(copySuccessText: 'Command copied'),
  ),
)
```

### Custom highlight function

```dart
CsCodeView(
  content: 'TODO: rotate keys',
  highlight: (code) => [CsCodeViewToken(CsCodeViewTokenType.comment, code)],
)
```

## Accessibility

- With `ariaLabel` the snippet is a labelled region.
- Line numbers are hidden from screen readers unless `i18nStrings` has both labels.
- The copy button is an icon button with a label and announces the result.

## Motion

Only the copy confirmation tooltip animates (with the tooltip motion tokens).

## Mobile

Without `wrapLines` long lines scroll horizontally inside the snippet (the page never scrolls sideways); with it they wrap and line numbers align to the first line of each wrapped line. Code is always laid out left to right, also in RTL apps (`dir="ltr"`).

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | `content` |
| `lineNumbers` | `lineNumbers` |
| `wrapLines` | `wrapLines` |
| `highlight` | `highlight` (returns tokens instead of React nodes) |
| `actions` | `actions` |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `ariaLabelledby` | not applicable (web only); use `ariaLabel` |
| `i18nStrings` | `i18nStrings` |
| `@cloudscape-design/code-view/highlight/*` | `CsCodeViewHighlighter.of('<language>')` |

source: doc/components/CsCollection.md

# CsCollection

A pure-Dart port of Cloudscape's `useCollection` hook (`@cloudscape-design/collection-hooks`): text and property filtering, sorting, pagination and selection over an in-memory list, with the values `CsTable`, `CsCards`, a text filter and a pagination control need.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/get-started/dev-guides/collection-hooks/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
final collection = CsCollection<Map<String, Object?>>(
  instances,
  filtering: const CsCollectionFiltering(
    fields: ['id', 'name'],
    empty: Text('No instances'),
    noMatch: Text('No matches'),
  ),
  sorting: const CsCollectionSorting(),
  pagination: const CsCollectionPagination(pageSize: 20),
  selection: CsCollectionSelection(trackBy: (item) => item['id']),
);
```

Wire it to a table with a `ListenableBuilder`:

```dart
ListenableBuilder(
  listenable: collection,
  builder: (context, _) => CsTable<Map<String, Object?>>(
    header: CsHeader(title: 'Instances', counter: '(${collection.filteredItemsCount})'),
    filter: CsInput(
      value: collection.filteringText,
      type: CsInputType.search,
      placeholder: 'Find instances',
      onChange: collection.setFiltering,
    ),
    pagination: Row(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        CsButton(icon: CsIcons.angleLeft, variant: CsButtonVariant.icon, semanticLabel: 'Previous page',
            onPress: () => collection.setCurrentPage(collection.currentPageIndex - 1)),
        Text('${collection.currentPageIndex} / ${collection.pagesCount}'),
        CsButton(icon: CsIcons.angleRight, variant: CsButtonVariant.icon, semanticLabel: 'Next page',
            onPress: () => collection.setCurrentPage(collection.currentPageIndex + 1)),
      ],
    ),
    items: collection.items,
    columnDefinitions: columns,
    trackBy: collection.trackBy,
    sortingColumn: collection.sortingColumn,
    sortingDescending: collection.sortingDescending,
    onSortingChange: collection.setSorting,
    selectionType: CsSelectionType.multi,
    selectedItems: collection.selectedItems,
    onSelectionChange: collection.setSelectedItems,
    empty: collection.emptyState,
    firstIndex: collection.firstIndex,
    totalItemsCount: collection.filteredItemsCount,
  ),
)
```

Create it in `initState` and `dispose()` it with its owner. Assign `allItems` after a fetch.

## When to use / when not to

Use it when the whole list is in memory. For server-side filtering, sorting and paging, keep that state yourself and pass the page of items to the table.

## API

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CsCollection(allItems, {getField, filtering, propertyFiltering, sorting, pagination, selection})` |  | `getField(item, field)` reads named fields; maps work without it |
| `items` | `List<T>` | Current page, filtered and sorted |
| `allPageItems` | `List<T>` | All filtered and sorted items |
| `filteredItemsCount` | `int` | Items that pass the filters |
| `pagesCount`, `currentPageIndex`, `firstIndex` | `int` | One-based paging values |
| `filteringText`, `propertyFilteringQuery`, `sortingState` |  | Current state |
| `sortingColumn`, `sortingDescending` |  | For `CsTable` |
| `selectedItems`, `trackBy` |  | For selection |
| `emptyState` | `Widget?` | `empty` with no items, `noMatch` when filters hide all |
| `isFiltered` | `bool` | A filter is active |
| `allItems` (setter) | `List<T>` | Replace the source list |
| `setFiltering(text)` |  | Resets to page 1 |
| `setPropertyFiltering(query)` |  | Resets to page 1 |
| `setSorting(state)` |  | Matches `onSortingChange` |
| `setCurrentPage(index)` |  | Clamped to the pages |
| `setSelectedItems(items)` |  | Matches `onSelectionChange` |

Options:

- `CsCollectionFiltering<T>`: `fields`, `filteringFunction(item, text)`, `defaultFilteringText`, `empty`, `noMatch`. The default match is case-insensitive "contains" over `fields` (all map values without them).
- `CsCollectionPropertyFiltering<T>`: `filteringProperties` (`CsCollectionFilterProperty`: `key`, `propertyLabel`, `operators`, `defaultOperator`), `filteringFunction(item, query)`, `defaultQuery`, `empty`, `noMatch`.
- `CsCollectionFilterQuery`: `tokens` (`CsCollectionFilterToken`: `propertyKey`, `operator`, `value`) and `operation` (`and`, `or`). Operators: `=`, `!=`, `:`, `!:`, `^`, `!^`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`. A token without `propertyKey` is free text across all filtering properties. `csCollectionMatchOperator` exposes the matching.
- `CsCollectionSorting<T>`: `defaultState`. Sorting uses the column's `sortingComparator`, else `sortingField` through `getField`; it is stable.
- `CsCollectionPagination`: `pageSize` (10), `defaultPage` (1).
- `CsCollectionSelection<T>`: `defaultSelectedItems`, `keepSelection` (false clears the selection when filter, sort or page change), `trackBy`.

## Examples

### Property filtering

```dart
collection.setPropertyFiltering(
  const CsCollectionFilterQuery(
    tokens: [
      CsCollectionFilterToken(propertyKey: 'state', operator: '=', value: 'Running'),
      CsCollectionFilterToken(propertyKey: 'cpu', operator: '>=', value: 4),
    ],
  ),
);
```

### Typed items

```dart
final collection = CsCollection<Instance>(
  instances,
  getField: (item, field) => switch (field) {
    'id' => item.id,
    'name' => item.name,
    _ => null,
  },
  filtering: const CsCollectionFiltering(fields: ['id', 'name']),
);
```

## Accessibility

Pass `firstIndex` and `filteredItemsCount` to the table's `firstIndex` and `totalItemsCount`, and a `renderAriaLive` builder, so page changes are announced.

## Motion

None: it holds no UI.

## Mobile

Nothing specific; the table and cards it drives handle phones.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| collection-hooks | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `useCollection(allItems, options)` | `CsCollection<T>(allItems, ...)` (a `ChangeNotifier`) |
| `items`, `filteredItemsCount`, `allPageItems` | same |
| `actions.setFiltering` etc. | `setFiltering` etc. |
| `collectionProps` spread | individual getters (`sortingColumn`, `selectedItems`, `emptyState`...) |
| `filterProps`, `paginationProps`, `propertyFilterProps` | `filteringText`, `currentPageIndex`, `pagesCount`, `propertyFilteringQuery` |
| `expandableRows` option, `tokenGroups`, custom operator `match` | not supported yet; use `filteringFunction` |

---
source: doc/components/CsCollectionPreferences.md
---

# CsCollectionPreferences

Cloudscape's `CollectionPreferences`: a settings button for a table or cards that opens a modal with page size, line wrapping, striped rows, density, sticky columns, column order and visibility, and custom preferences.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/collection-preferences/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsCollectionPreferences<void>(
  preferences: prefs,
  onConfirm: (next) => setState(() => prefs = next),
  pageSizePreference: const CsPageSizePreference(
    options: [
      CsPageSizeOption(value: 10, label: '10 instances'),
      CsPageSizeOption(value: 20, label: '20 instances'),
    ],
  ),
  wrapLinesPreference: const CsCheckboxPreference(),
  stripedRowsPreference: const CsCheckboxPreference(),
  contentDensityPreference: const CsCheckboxPreference(),
  contentDisplayPreference: const CsContentDisplayPreference(
    options: [
      CsContentDisplayOption(id: 'id', label: 'Instance ID', alwaysVisible: true),
      CsContentDisplayOption(id: 'state', label: 'State'),
    ],
  ),
)
```

Pass it to the `preferences` slot of `CsTable` or `CsCards`, and feed the confirmed values back: `pageSize` to your `CsCollectionPagination`, `wrapLines`, `stripedRows`, `contentDensity`, `stickyColumns` and `contentDisplay` (as `columnDisplay`) to the table, `visibleContent` to `CsCards.visibleSections`.

## When to use / when not to

Use it on collections where people work for long periods and want control over density and columns. Keep it out of small, read-only lists.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preferences` | `CsCollectionPreferencesValue<C>` | empty | Current values; the modal starts from them |
| `onConfirm` | `ValueChanged<CsCollectionPreferencesValue<C>>?` |  | Every configured preference, even unchanged |
| `onCancel` | `VoidCallback?` |  | Cancel, close or Escape |
| `title`, `confirmLabel`, `cancelLabel`, `closeAriaLabel` | `String?` | English | Modal copy; `title` names the trigger |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disables the trigger |
| `pageSizePreference` | `CsPageSizePreference?` |  | `title`, `options` (`value`, `label`) as radios |
| `wrapLinesPreference`, `stripedRowsPreference`, `contentDensityPreference` | `CsCheckboxPreference?` |  | Checkboxes with `label` and `description` |
| `stickyColumnsPreference` | `CsStickyColumnsPreference?` |  | `firstColumns` and `lastColumns` radio groups |
| `contentDisplayPreference` | `CsContentDisplayPreference?` |  | Column order and visibility, with optional filter |
| `visibleContentPreference` | `CsVisibleContentPreference?` |  | Grouped visibility toggles (cards); ignored with content display |
| `customPreference` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, C?, ValueChanged<C>)?` |  | Your own control for `custom` |
| `contentBefore` | `Widget?` |  | Above the preferences |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsCollectionPreferencesI18nStrings` | English | All fixed copy and announcements |

`CsCollectionPreferencesValue<C>`: `pageSize`, `wrapLines`, `stripedRows`, `contentDensity` (`CsDensity`), `visibleContent`, `stickyColumns` (`CsStickyColumns`), `contentDisplay` (`List<CsColumnDisplay>`), `custom`; `copyWith`.

`open(context)` opens the modal from code.

## Examples

### Sticky columns and a custom preference

```dart
CsCollectionPreferences<bool>(
  preferences: prefs,
  onConfirm: (next) => setState(() => prefs = next),
  stickyColumnsPreference: const CsStickyColumnsPreference(
    firstColumns: CsStickyColumnPreference(
      title: 'Stick first column(s)',
      description: 'Keep the first column(s) visible while horizontally scrolling the table content.',
      options: [(label: 'None', value: 0), (label: 'First column', value: 1), (label: 'First two columns', value: 2)],
    ),
  ),
  customPreference: (context, value, setValue) =>
      CsCheckbox(checked: value ?? false, label: 'Show tags column', onChange: setValue),
)
```

### Visible content for cards

```dart
CsCollectionPreferences<void>(
  preferences: prefs,
  onConfirm: (next) => setState(() => prefs = next),
  visibleContentPreference: const CsVisibleContentPreference(
    title: 'Select visible content',
    options: [
      CsVisibleContentOptionsGroup(
        label: 'Distribution properties',
        options: [
          CsVisibleContentOption(id: 'domain', label: 'Domain name', editable: false),
          CsVisibleContentOption(id: 'status', label: 'Status'),
        ],
      ),
    ],
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

The trigger is an icon button named by `title`. The modal traps focus, closes on Escape and restores focus to the trigger. Radios are mutually exclusive checked controls; toggles report their state and are labeled by the column. Drag handles are focusable buttons: Space or Enter picks a column up, Up and Down move it, Space or Enter drops it and Escape restores the order; each step is announced with Cloudscape's messages.

## Motion

The modal fades and scales in from 0.9 (`CsDialogRoute`). Toggles slide their handle over `CsDurations.responsive`. A dragged column lifts with the dropdown shadow. Reduced motion makes these instant.

## Mobile

The modal takes the screen width less 12px each side. Below 600px the two columns stack, with the column preferences under the others. Drag works with touch on the handle.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `preferences` / `onConfirm` detail | `CsCollectionPreferencesValue<C>` |
| `contentDensity: 'compact'` | `CsDensity.compact` |
| `wrapLinesPreference` etc. | `CsCheckboxPreference` |
| `stickyColumnsPreference.firstColumns.options` | records `(label:, value:)` |
| `customPreference(value, setValue)` | `customPreference(context, value, setValue)` |
| `contentDisplayPreference.groups` (column groups) | not supported yet |
| `getModalRoot`, `removeModalRoot` | not needed (a route) |

source: doc/components/CsColumnLayout.md

# CsColumnLayout

Cloudscape's `ColumnLayout`: lays content out in 1 to 4 equal columns (more with a minimum column width) that collapse on narrow widths.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/column-layout/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsColumnLayout(
  columns: 3,
  variant: CsColumnLayoutVariant.textGrid,
  children: [Text('Instance ID'), Text('Status'), Text('Type')],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a column layout for key-value summaries and equal blocks of content. Use `CsGrid` when columns need different widths, and `CsKeyValuePairs` for labelled values.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` |  | One child per cell |
| `columns` | `int` | `1` | 1 to 4, or any count with `minColumnWidth` |
| `variant` | `CsColumnLayoutVariant` | `defaultVariant` | `defaultVariant` or `textGrid` (lines between columns, wider gutters) |
| `borders` | `CsColumnLayoutBorders` | `none` | `none`, `vertical`, `horizontal`, `all` (default variant only) |
| `disableGutters` | `bool` | `false` | Default variant only |
| `minColumnWidth` | `double?` |  | Fits as many columns of at least this width as possible, up to `columns` |

## Examples

### Borders

```dart
const CsColumnLayout(
  columns: 2,
  borders: CsColumnLayoutBorders.all,
  children: [Text('A'), Text('B'), Text('C'), Text('D')],
)
```

### Flexible columns

```dart
const CsColumnLayout(
  columns: 6,
  minColumnWidth: 160,
  children: [Text('1'), Text('2'), Text('3'), Text('4'), Text('5'), Text('6')],
)
```

## Accessibility

The layout adds no semantics; children read in order, row by row.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Columns follow the layout's own width: one per row under 465px, two per row up to 688px (for 2 to 4 columns), all columns above. The flexible layout keeps an even column count when it drops below `columns`. Cells in a row share the tallest height.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `columns` | `columns` |
| `variant` | `variant` |
| `borders` | `borders` |
| `disableGutters` | `disableGutters` |
| `minColumnWidth` | `minColumnWidth` |
| `children` | `children` |

source: doc/components/CsContainer.md

# CsContainer

Cloudscape's `Container`: the standard panel for a block of related content, with an optional header, footer and media.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/container/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsContainer(
  header: const CsHeader(title: 'General configuration'),
  footer: CsButton(text: 'Edit', onPress: () {}),
  child: const CsBox(text: 'Price class: use all edge locations'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a container to group related content and actions on a page. Use `CsExpandableSection` with the container variant for optional content, `CsTabs` with the container variant for switching views, and plain spacing (`CsSpaceBetween`) rather than nested containers inside a container.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget?` |  | The content (Cloudscape `children`) |
| `header` | `Widget?` |  | Usually a `CsHeader` (h2) |
| `footer` | `Widget?` |  | Content under a divider |
| `media` | `CsContainerMedia?` |  | Image or video at the top or side (`content`, `position`, `width`, `height`) |
| `variant` | `CsContainerVariant` | `defaultVariant` | `defaultVariant` or `stacked` |
| `stackPosition` | `CsStackPosition` | `only` | `first`, `middle`, `last` or `only` for stacked containers |
| `disableHeaderPaddings` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `disableContentPaddings` | `bool` | `false` | For content with its own padding (tables, maps) |
| `disableFooterPaddings` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `fitHeight` | `bool` | `false` | Fill the parent height; the content takes the rest |
| `footerDivider` | `bool` | `true` | Divider above the footer |
| `style` | `CsContainerStyle?` |  | Background, border, radius, shadow and padding overrides |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  | Name of the container region |

## Examples

### Stacked

```dart
const Column(
  children: [
    CsContainer(variant: CsContainerVariant.stacked, stackPosition: CsStackPosition.first, child: Text('Origin')),
    CsContainer(variant: CsContainerVariant.stacked, stackPosition: CsStackPosition.last, child: Text('Behaviors')),
  ],
)
```

### Side media

```dart
CsContainer(
  media: CsContainerMedia(
    content: Image.network('https://example.com/preview.png', fit: BoxFit.cover),
    position: CsContainerMediaPosition.side,
    width: 160,
  ),
  header: const CsHeader(title: 'Preview'),
  child: const Text('Sample media'),
)
```

### Equal heights in a row

```dart
const SizedBox(
  height: 160,
  child: Row(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
    children: [
      Expanded(child: CsContainer(fitHeight: true, header: CsHeader(title: 'Requests'), child: Text('1,024'))),
      SizedBox(width: 20),
      Expanded(child: CsContainer(fitHeight: true, header: CsHeader(title: 'Errors'), child: Text('3'))),
    ],
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

The container is a semantic container; pass `semanticLabel` to name it. Its header keeps the heading semantics of `CsHeader`.

## Motion

None. Hover and selection belong to the content.

## Mobile

Side media moves above the content at or below 688px. Padding stays at 20px; text wraps at 2x scale.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `header` | `header` |
| `children` | `child` |
| `footer` | `footer` |
| `media {content, position, width, height}` | `media: CsContainerMedia(...)` |
| `variant` | `variant` |
| `(sibling selectors)` | `stackPosition` |
| `disableHeaderPaddings / disableContentPaddings / disableFooterPaddings` | same names |
| `fitHeight` | `fitHeight` |
| `style` | `style: CsContainerStyle(...)` |
| `analyticsMetadata` | not supported (web only) |

# CsContentLayout

Cloudscape's `ContentLayout`: the page frame inside the app layout content, with notifications, breadcrumbs, a page header and the content.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/content-layout/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsContentLayout(
  header: CsHeader(variant: CsHeaderVariant.h1, title: 'Distributions'),
  child: CsContainer(child: Text('d111111abcdef8')),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it as the `content` of `CsAppLayout` on every page with a page header. Use `highContrast` for dashboards and landing pages where the first container should overlap a dark header band.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget?` |  | Page content |
| `header` | `Widget?` |  | Usually a `CsHeader` h1 |
| `headerVariant` | `CsContentLayoutHeaderVariant` | `defaultVariant` | `defaultVariant`, `highContrast`, `divider` |
| `headerBackgroundStyle` | `CsHeaderBackgroundBuilder?` |  | `Decoration Function(Brightness)` |
| `maxContentWidth` | `double?` |  |  |
| `disableOverlap` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `secondaryHeader` | `Widget?` |  | Beside the header on wide screens |
| `breadcrumbs` | `Widget?` |  |  |
| `notifications` | `Widget?` |  |  |
| `defaultPadding` | `bool` | `false` | App layout padding for pages without one |

## Examples

### High contrast with a secondary header

```dart
const CsContentLayout(
  headerVariant: CsContentLayoutHeaderVariant.highContrast,
  header: CsHeader(variant: CsHeaderVariant.h1, title: 'example-bucket'),
  secondaryHeader: CsContainer(child: Text('1,204 objects')),
  child: CsContainer(child: Text('Objects')),
)
```

### Custom background

```dart
CsContentLayout(
  headerBackgroundStyle: (b) => BoxDecoration(
    gradient: LinearGradient(colors: b == Brightness.dark
        ? const [Color(0xFF0F1B2A), Color(0xFF1B2D44)]
        : const [Color(0xFFE8F1FB), Color(0xFFF7FAFD)]),
  ),
  header: const CsHeader(variant: CsHeaderVariant.h1, title: 'Dashboard'),
  child: const Text('Widgets'),
)
```

## Accessibility

The high-contrast band uses the dark header visual context, so text keeps its contrast. Content overlapping the band stays reachable and tappable.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

The secondary header moves under the header at or below 688px. Inside `CsAppLayout` the band reaches the content edges.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `child` |
| `header` | `header` |
| `headerVariant` | `headerVariant` |
| `headerBackgroundStyle` | `headerBackgroundStyle` (builder) |
| `maxContentWidth` | `maxContentWidth` |
| `disableOverlap` | `disableOverlap` |
| `secondaryHeader` | `secondaryHeader` |
| `breadcrumbs / notifications` | same names |
| `defaultPadding` | `defaultPadding` |

# CsControlGroup

Cloudscape's `ControlGroup` (`src/control-group`): joins form controls, such as an input and a select, or an input and an icon button, into one visual control with shared borders.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/control-group/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsControlGroup(
  children: [
    CsInput(value: size, type: CsInputType.number, onChange: (v) => setState(() => size = v)),
    Flexible(
      flex: 0,
      child: SizedBox(
        width: 96,
        child: CsSelect(
          options: const [CsOption(value: 'gib', label: 'GiB'), CsOption(value: 'tib', label: 'TiB')],
          selectedOption: unit,
          onChange: (o) => setState(() => unit = o),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a control group when two or more controls describe one value (a size and its unit, a value and its operator) or when an input has one closely tied action (clear, remove). Do not use it to lay out unrelated fields side by side; use `CsColumnLayout` or `CsSpaceBetween` with separate `CsFormField`s.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | The grouped controls in order. Each takes an equal share of the width; wrap one in `Flexible` for another `flex`, or `Flexible(flex: 0, ...)` around a sized child for a fixed width |
| `direction` | `CsControlGroupDirection` | `auto` | `horizontal`, `vertical`, or `auto` (side by side while every control gets `minControlWidth`, stacked otherwise) |
| `inlineLabelText` | `String?` |  | Label drawn on the group's top border |
| `actionButton` | `CsControlGroupActionButton?` |  | Icon button joined to the end of the group |
| `invalid` | `bool` | `false` | Error state: red outer borders, 8px start edge on the leading control |
| `warning` | `bool` | `false` | Warning state (ignored when `invalid`) |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `inlineLabelText` | Accessible name of the group |
| `minControlWidth` | `double` | `120` | Narrowest control width before `auto` stacks |

`CsControlGroupActionButton`:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `CsIconData` | required | Icon (Cloudscape `iconName`) |
| `ariaLabel` | `String` | required | Accessible name, also shown as a tooltip |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` |  | Called on press (Cloudscape `onClick`) |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disables the button |
| `disabledReason` | `String?` |  | Keeps a disabled button focusable and explains why in a tooltip |
| `iconWidget` | `Widget?` |  | Custom icon in place of `icon` |

## Examples

### Input with a remove action

```dart
CsControlGroup(
  actionButton: CsControlGroupActionButton(
    icon: CsIcons.remove,
    ariaLabel: 'Remove tag',
    onPress: () => setState(() => tag = ''),
  ),
  children: [CsInput(value: tag, placeholder: 'Tag key', onChange: (v) => setState(() => tag = v))],
)
```

### Invalid, stacked

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Retention',
  errorText: 'Enter a number of days.',
  child: CsControlGroup(
    direction: CsControlGroupDirection.vertical,
    invalid: true,
    children: [
      CsInput(value: days, onChange: (v) => setState(() => days = v)),
      CsInput(value: note, placeholder: 'Reason', onChange: (v) => setState(() => note = v)),
    ],
  ),
)
```

### Inline label

```dart
CsControlGroup(
  inlineLabelText: 'Port range',
  children: [
    CsInput(value: from, onChange: (v) => setState(() => from = v)),
    CsInput(value: to, onChange: (v) => setState(() => to = v)),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

The group is one semantics container labelled by `semanticLabel` or `inlineLabelText`. Each control keeps its own semantics and Tab stop; the action button is a labelled button whose disabled reason is read as its hint. Validation is drawn with color and the 8px start edge; pair it with `CsFormField.errorText` so it is never color alone.

## Motion

Hover colors on the action button change instantly. Focus shows the field focus border and a 1px ring.

## Mobile

With `direction: auto` the group stacks its controls when they would get narrower than `minControlWidth` (at 390px a group of three stacks). In the stacked layout the action button spans the full column height. Field heights grow with the text scale.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `children` |
| `direction` | `direction` (`CsControlGroupDirection`) |
| `inlineLabelText` | `inlineLabelText` |
| `actionButton` | `actionButton` (`CsControlGroupActionButton`) |
| `actionButton.onClick` | `CsControlGroupActionButton.onPress` |
| `actionButton.iconName` | `CsControlGroupActionButton.icon` |
| form field `invalid` / `warning` context | `invalid` / `warning` |
| `ariaLabelledby` | `semanticLabel` |
| `ariaDescribedby`, `actionButton.ariaDescribedby` | not supported (web only) |
| grouped control context | `CsGroupedControl` (read by `CsFieldBox`; custom controls can read it too) |

---
source: doc/components/CsCopyToClipboard.md

# CsCopyToClipboard

Cloudscape's `CopyToClipboard`: copies a value (an ID, an ARN, a command) to the clipboard and confirms in a small popover.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/copy-to-clipboard/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsCopyToClipboard(
  variant: CsCopyToClipboardVariant.inline,
  textToCopy: 'i-0abc123',
  copySuccessText: 'Instance ID copied',
  copyErrorText: 'Instance ID failed to copy',
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it next to values users paste elsewhere. Don't use it for long text blocks; offer a download instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `textToCopy` | `String` | required | Placed on the clipboard |
| `copySuccessText` | `String` | required | Popover after success |
| `copyErrorText` | `String` | required | Popover after failure |
| `variant` | `CsCopyToClipboardVariant` | `button` | `button`, `icon`, `inline` |
| `copyButtonText` | `String?` | "Copy" | Button variant text |
| `copyButtonAriaLabel` | `String?` | "Copy to clipboard" | Icon and inline variants |
| `textToDisplay` | `String?` | `textToCopy` | Inline variant text |
| `wrapText` | `bool` | `true` | Inline text wraps or truncates |
| `disabled`, `disabledReason` | | | |
| `onCopySuccess`, `onCopyFailure` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | |
| `mono` | `bool` | `false` | Monospace inline text |

## Examples

### Button and icon

```dart
Wrap(spacing: 8, children: const [
  CsCopyToClipboard(textToCopy: 'arn:aws:s3:::example-bucket', copyButtonText: 'Copy ARN', copySuccessText: 'ARN copied', copyErrorText: 'ARN failed to copy'),
  CsCopyToClipboard(variant: CsCopyToClipboardVariant.icon, textToCopy: 'd111111abcdef8', copySuccessText: 'Copied', copyErrorText: 'Failed to copy'),
])
```

## Accessibility

The copy control is a button; the popover content is a live region with a status icon and text. Escape and an outside tap close the popover.

## Motion

The popover scales and fades from the button (reduced motion: fade only).

## Mobile

The popover flips below when there is no room above. Inline text wraps at 390px unless `wrapText` is false.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `variant`, `textToCopy`, `textToDisplay`, `copyButtonText`, `copyButtonAriaLabel`, `copySuccessText`, `copyErrorText`, `wrapText`, `disabled`, `disabledReason` | same names |
| `onCopySuccess`, `onCopyFailure` | same names (the text) |
| `popoverRenderWithPortal` | not applicable (always in the overlay) |

# CsDateInput

A masked text field for typing a date as `YYYY/MM/DD`; reach for it when users know the date and a calendar would slow them down.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/date-input/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Snapshot date',
  constraintText: 'Use YYYY/MM/DD format.',
  child: CsDateInput(
    value: snapshotDate, // ISO: '2026-03-15'
    placeholder: 'YYYY/MM/DD',
    onChange: (v) => setState(() => snapshotDate = v),
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for dates people type from memory or copy from elsewhere (birth dates, known deadlines).
- Use `CsDatePicker` when a calendar helps (relative to today, weekdays only).
- Validate the value yourself; the input only enforces the shape.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String` | required | ISO date `YYYY-MM-DD` (`YYYY-MM` for months), partial while typing, or `''`. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | ISO text on every edit, including partial dates such as `2026-0`. |
| `onBlur` / `onFocus` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Focus changes. Blur first completes a partial date. |
| `onSubmit` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Enter pressed; receives the completed ISO value. |
| `granularity` | `CsDateGranularity` | `day` | `month` masks `YYYY/MM`. |
| `format` | `CsDateFormat` | `slashed` | `iso` (`2026-03-15`), `slashed` (`2026/03/15`) or `longLocalized` (`March 15, 2026` until focused). |
| `inputFormat` | `CsDateInputFormat` | `slashed` | Typing format while a `longLocalized` field is focused. |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | `null` | Such as `YYYY/MM/DD`. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Not focusable, disabled fill. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Focusable, not editable. |
| `invalid` / `warning` | `bool` | `false` | Red or yellow border with an 8px start edge. |
| `autoFocus` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name without a visible label. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | For moving focus programmatically. |
| `trailing` | `Widget?` | `null` | Content at the end of the field. |

## Examples

### Masking rules

Typing `2026` shows `2026/`; a 13th month becomes `12`; a first day digit above 3 is padded (`4` becomes `04`). Backspace right after a separator removes the digit before it. Pasting `20260115` gives `2026/01/15`. On blur or Enter, `2026/1` becomes `2026/01/01`.

### ISO display with an error

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Retention ends',
  errorText: error,
  child: CsDateInput(
    value: retentionEnd,
    format: CsDateFormat.iso,
    invalid: error != null,
    onChange: (v) => setState(() => retentionEnd = v),
  ),
)
```

### Month only, long display

```dart
CsDateInput(
  value: billingMonth, // '2026-03' shows "March 2026" until focused
  granularity: CsDateGranularity.month,
  format: CsDateFormat.longLocalized,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => billingMonth = v),
)
```

## Accessibility

It is a text field labeled by its `CsFormField` or `ariaLabel`. Pair errors with `CsFormField.errorText`, which is announced. The keyboard is the platform's date/time keyboard.

## Motion

None beyond the field's focus ring.

## Mobile

The field fills its parent's width, keeps a minimum 32px height (28px compact) and grows with text scale.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` | `value` |
| `onChange` (`detail.value`) | `onChange` |
| `onBlur`, `onFocus` | `onBlur`, `onFocus` |
| `granularity` | `granularity` |
| `format` (`iso`, `slashed`, `long-localized`) | `format` (`CsDateFormat`) |
| `inputFormat` | `inputFormat` (`CsDateInputFormat`) |
| `placeholder`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `warning`, `autoFocus` | same names (`autoFocus`) |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `locale` | not supported: long dates use `CsStrings` month names |
| `name`, `controlId`, `ariaDescribedby`, `ariaLabelledby`, `ariaRequired`, `nativeInputAttributes` | not applicable |
| `ref.focus()` | `focusNode` |

---
source: doc/components/CsDatePicker.md
---

# CsDatePicker

A date field with a calendar button that opens a `CsCalendar` in a dropdown, or a bottom sheet on phones; the default way to ask for one date.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/date-picker/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Certificate expiry',
  constraintText: 'Use YYYY/MM/DD format.',
  child: CsDatePicker(
    value: expiry, // ISO '2026-03-15' or ''
    placeholder: 'YYYY/MM/DD',
    onChange: (v) => setState(() => expiry = v),
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for a single date that people may type or pick.
- Use `CsDateRangePicker` for ranges, `CsCalendar` for an always-visible calendar, `CsDateInput` when a calendar adds nothing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String` | required | ISO date (`YYYY-MM` for months), partial while typing, or `''`. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Typed text as it changes, and the picked date. |
| `isDateEnabled` | `bool Function(DateTime)?` | all | Days that can be picked in the calendar. Typed dates are not checked. |
| `dateDisabledReason` | `String? Function(DateTime)?` | `null` | Tooltip for disabled days; keeps them focusable. |
| `startOfWeek` | `int?` | Sunday | 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday. |
| `granularity` | `CsDateGranularity` | `day` | `month` picks `YYYY-MM`. |
| `format` / `inputFormat` | `CsDateFormat` / `CsDateInputFormat` | `slashed` | As in `CsDateInput`. |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | `null` | |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disables the field and the button. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Field focusable but not editable; button disabled. |
| `invalid` / `warning` | `bool` | `false` | Field border states. |
| `autoFocus` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Name of the field and the calendar. |
| `onFocus` / `onBlur` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsDatePickerI18nStrings?` | English | The calendar's strings plus `openCalendarAriaLabel(String? selectedDate)`. |
| `presentation` | `CsPresentation` | `auto` | Dropdown on wide screens, bottom sheet at or below 688px. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | Focus node of the text field. |

## Examples

### Future weekdays only

```dart
CsDatePicker(
  value: launchDate,
  placeholder: 'YYYY/MM/DD',
  isDateEnabled: (d) => d.weekday <= DateTime.friday,
  dateDisabledReason: (d) => 'Launches run on weekdays.',
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => launchDate = v),
)
```

### Month picker with translated button label

```dart
CsDatePicker(
  value: reportMonth,
  granularity: CsDateGranularity.month,
  placeholder: 'YYYY/MM',
  i18nStrings: CsDatePickerI18nStrings(
    openCalendarAriaLabel: (d) => d == null ? 'Pilih bulan' : 'Pilih bulan, terpilih $d',
  ),
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => reportMonth = v),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The calendar button is labeled "Choose date" or "Choose date, selected date is March 15, 2026", and announces whether the calendar is expanded.
- Opening moves focus to the selected day (or today); Tab stays inside the calendar. Picking a day or pressing Escape closes it and returns focus to the button. Focusing the text field closes it.
- See `CsCalendar` for grid keys.

## Motion

The dropdown scales and fades from the field (`CsAnchoredOverlay`); the phone sheet slides up and follows the finger. Reduced motion keeps only the fade.

## Mobile

At or below 688px the calendar opens in a bottom sheet at full width with taller rows; override with `presentation`. The field itself is at most 234px wide, as in Cloudscape.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value`, `onChange` | `value`, `onChange` |
| `isDateEnabled`, `dateDisabledReason` | same names |
| `startOfWeek`, `granularity` | same names |
| `format`, `inputFormat` | `format`, `inputFormat` |
| `placeholder`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `warning`, `autoFocus` | same names |
| `onFocus`, `onBlur` | same names |
| `openCalendarAriaLabel`, `i18nStrings` | `i18nStrings` (`CsDatePickerI18nStrings`) |
| `todayAriaLabel`, `nextMonthAriaLabel`, `previousMonthAriaLabel` (deprecated) | `i18nStrings` fields |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `expandToViewport` | not applicable (overlays always render above the page) |
| `locale` | not supported: copy comes from `CsStrings` |
| `name`, `controlId`, `ariaDescribedby`, `ariaLabelledby`, `ariaRequired` | not applicable |
| `ref.focus()` | `focusNode` |
| (none) | `presentation` |

# CsDateRangePicker

A trigger that opens a dropdown for picking an absolute range on a calendar, with optional times, or a relative range such as "Last 5 minutes"; the standard filter for time-based data.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/date-range-picker/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsDateRangePicker(
  value: range, // CsDateRangeValue? (absolute, relative or null)
  placeholder: 'Filter by a date and time range',
  relativeOptions: const [
    CsRelativeDateRange(key: 'previous-5-minutes', amount: 5, unit: CsTimeUnit.minute),
    CsRelativeDateRange(key: 'previous-1-hour', amount: 1, unit: CsTimeUnit.hour),
    CsRelativeDateRange(key: 'previous-1-day', amount: 1, unit: CsTimeUnit.day),
  ],
  isValidRange: (v) {
    if (v is CsAbsoluteDateRange && v.end.isBefore(v.start)) {
      return const CsDateRangeValidationResult.invalid('The end date must be after the start date.');
    }
    if (v is CsRelativeDateRange && v.amount <= 0) {
      return const CsDateRangeValidationResult.invalid('Enter a duration greater than 0.');
    }
    return const CsDateRangeValidationResult.valid();
  },
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => range = v),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it to filter logs, metrics or events by time.
- Use `CsDatePicker` for a single date.
- Use `rangeSelectorMode` to offer only absolute or only relative ranges.

## Value model

| Type | Fields | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CsAbsoluteDateRange` | `start`, `end` (`DateTime`, local) | With `dateOnly` both are midnight; with month granularity both are the first of their month. Calendar picks set 00:00:00 and 23:59:59. |
| `CsRelativeDateRange` | `key`, `amount`, `unit` (`CsTimeUnit`) | Options carry a `key`; a custom range has none. An empty custom duration reports `amount: 0`. `startFrom(now)` computes the start. |

`isValidRange` receives the value (null when nothing is picked). An absolute range with a missing or unreadable date never reaches it: the picker shows `i18nStrings.incompleteRangeErrorMessage` instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `CsDateRangeValue?` | required | The applied range. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<CsDateRangeValue?>?` | `null` | Fires on Apply (after validation) and with null on Clear. |
| `relativeOptions` | `List<CsRelativeDateRange>` | `[]` | Suggested relative ranges, shown as radio buttons with a "Custom range" option. |
| `isValidRange` | `CsDateRangeValidator?` | valid | Returns `CsDateRangeValidationResult.valid()` or `.invalid(message)`. |
| `isDateEnabled` | `bool Function(DateTime)?` | all | Days that can be picked in the calendar. |
| `dateDisabledReason` | `String? Function(DateTime)?` | `null` | Tooltip for disabled days. |
| `startOfWeek` | `int?` | Sunday | 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsDateRangePickerI18nStrings` | English | Every label, `formatRelativeRange`, `formatUnit`, constraint texts, placeholders. |
| `dateOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Hide time inputs. |
| `granularity` | `CsDateGranularity` | `day` | `month` shows years of months. |
| `rangeSelectorMode` | `CsDateRangeSelectorMode` | `defaultMode` | `absoluteOnly`, `relativeOnly`. |
| `dateInputFormat` | `CsDateInputFormat` | `slashed` | Typing format of the date inputs. |
| `timeInputFormat` | `CsTimeInputFormat` | `hhMmSs` | Parts of the time inputs. |
| `absoluteFormat` | `CsDateFormat` | `iso` | Trigger text: `iso` (`2026-03-01T00:00:00+07:00`), `slashed`, `longLocalized` (`March 1, 2026, 00:00:00 (UTC+7)`). |
| `hideTimeOffset` | `bool` | `false` | Drop the UTC offset from the trigger text. |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | `null` | Trigger text with no value. |
| `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `warning` | `bool` | `false` | Trigger states. |
| `showClearButton` | `bool` | `true` | "Clear and dismiss" in the footer. |
| `customAbsoluteRangeControl` | `CsAbsoluteRangeControlBuilder?` | `null` | Extra content under the calendar; gets the `CsPendingAbsoluteRange` and a setter. |
| `customRelativeRangeUnits` | `List<CsTimeUnit>?` | by mode | Units offered for a custom range. |
| `renderRelativeRangeContent` | `CsRelativeRangeContentBuilder?` | `null` | Replaces the relative tab. |
| `renderTriggerContent` | `CsDateRangeTriggerBuilder?` | `null` | Replaces the trigger content; gets the formatted text. |
| `absoluteMultiGridStartPeriod` | `CsDateRangeStartPeriod` | `auto` | Whether the first of two grids shows the previous or current month. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Name of the trigger and dropdown. |
| `onFocus` / `onBlur` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Trigger focus. |
| `presentation` | `CsPresentation` | `auto` | Dropdown, or a bottom sheet at or below 688px. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | Trigger focus node. |

## Examples

### Dates only, absolute only

```dart
CsDateRangePicker(
  value: billingRange,
  dateOnly: true,
  rangeSelectorMode: CsDateRangeSelectorMode.absoluteOnly,
  placeholder: 'Filter by a date range',
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => billingRange = v),
)
```

### Month ranges with translated copy

```dart
CsDateRangePicker(
  value: reportRange,
  granularity: CsDateGranularity.month,
  relativeOptions: const [
    CsRelativeDateRange(key: 'previous-3-months', amount: 3, unit: CsTimeUnit.month),
    CsRelativeDateRange(key: 'previous-1-year', amount: 1, unit: CsTimeUnit.year),
  ],
  i18nStrings: CsDateRangePickerI18nStrings(
    applyButtonLabel: 'Terapkan',
    cancelButtonLabel: 'Batal',
    formatRelativeRange: (r) => '${r.amount} ${r.unit.name} terakhir',
  ),
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => reportRange = v),
)
```

### Using a relative value

```dart
DateTime? rangeStart(CsDateRangeValue? value) => switch (value) {
  CsRelativeDateRange() => value.startFrom(), // counts back from clock.now()
  CsAbsoluteDateRange() => value.start,
  null => null,
};
```

## Accessibility

- The trigger is a button whose value is the formatted range; it announces whether the dropdown is expanded.
- Opening focuses the calendar's selected start, today or the first enabled day; Tab stays inside the dropdown; Escape, Cancel, Clear and a successful Apply close it and return focus to the trigger.
- Calendar picks are announced ("Start date, March 3, 2026, Start time, 00:00:00." then "Range selected from March 3, 2026 to March 7, 2026"). Validation errors are announced and shown with an error icon labeled `errorIconAriaLabel`.
- The mode switch and relative options expose selected / checked states in mutually exclusive groups.

## Motion

The dropdown scales and fades from the trigger; the phone sheet slides and follows the finger. Calendar pages fade in (135ms). Reduced motion keeps only fades.

## Mobile

At or below 688px the picker shows one month grid and opens in a bottom sheet at full width, with the start and end fields stacked and the custom duration and unit stacked. The trigger is at most 32em wide (39em for long-localized dates with times).

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` (absolute or relative object) | `value` (`CsAbsoluteDateRange` / `CsRelativeDateRange`) |
| `onChange` (`detail.value`) | `onChange` |
| `relativeOptions` | `relativeOptions` (`CsRelativeDateRange` with `key`) |
| `isValidRange` | `isValidRange` |
| `isDateEnabled`, `dateDisabledReason`, `startOfWeek` | same names |
| `i18nStrings` | `i18nStrings` |
| `dateOnly`, `granularity`, `rangeSelectorMode` | same names |
| `dateInputFormat`, `timeInputFormat` | same names (enums) |
| `absoluteFormat`, `hideTimeOffset` | same names |
| `placeholder`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `warning` | same names |
| `showClearButton` | `showClearButton` |
| `customAbsoluteRangeControl`, `customRelativeRangeUnits`, `renderRelativeRangeContent`, `renderTriggerContent` | same names (builders) |
| `absoluteMultiGridStartPeriod` | `absoluteMultiGridStartPeriod` |
| `ariaLabel`, `onFocus`, `onBlur` | same names |
| `timeOffset`, `getTimeOffset` | not applicable: values are local `DateTime`s |
| `expandToViewport` | not applicable |
| `locale` | not supported: copy comes from `CsStrings` / `i18nStrings` |
| `controlId`, `ariaDescribedby`, `ariaLabelledby` | not applicable |
| `ref.focus()` | `focusNode` |

# CsDialog

Cloudscape's `Dialog`: a small panel that opens in place, next to the content it is about (a quick rename inside a card, a confirmation in a side panel), without a backdrop and without blocking the rest of the page.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/dialog/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsDialog(
  header: 'Rename distribution',
  onDismiss: () {},
  child: const Text('d111111abcdef8'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a dialog for a short, optional task that belongs to one spot on the page, when the user may still want to look at or use the page around it. When the user must answer before going on, use `CsModal`. For read-only detail on a trigger, use `CsPopover`.

Render the dialog while it should show and remove it in `onDismiss`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `header` | `String?` | | Heading (heading-s) and accessible name. `header` or `headerWidget` is required |
| `headerWidget` | `Widget?` | | Rich content in place of `header` |
| `onDismiss` | `VoidCallback` | required | Close button and Escape |
| `headerActions` | `Widget?` | | Controls in the header row before the close button |
| `child` | `Widget?` | | Content |
| `footer` | `Widget?` | | Footer, usually actions. Hidden when null |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsDialogI18nStrings?` | | `dismissAriaLabel` (default `'Close dialog'`) |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `true` | Move focus into the dialog when it appears |

## Examples

### Inline edit

```dart
class RenameCard extends StatefulWidget {
  const RenameCard({super.key});

  @override
  State<RenameCard> createState() => _RenameCardState();
}

class _RenameCardState extends State<RenameCard> {
  bool _editing = false;
  String _name = 'storefront-cdn';

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        CsButton(text: 'Rename', onPress: () => setState(() => _editing = true)),
        if (_editing)
          CsDialog(
            header: 'Rename distribution',
            onDismiss: () => setState(() => _editing = false),
            footer: Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.end,
              children: [
                CsButton(text: 'Cancel', variant: CsButtonVariant.link, onPress: () => setState(() => _editing = false)),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                CsButton(text: 'Save', variant: CsButtonVariant.primary, onPress: () => setState(() => _editing = false)),
              ],
            ),
            child: CsInput(value: _name, onChange: (v) => setState(() => _name = v)),
          ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

### Header actions

```dart
CsDialog(
  header: 'Cache behavior',
  onDismiss: () {},
  headerActions: CsButton(variant: CsButtonVariant.icon, icon: CsIcons.settings, semanticLabel: 'Settings', onPress: () {}),
  child: const Text('Requests for /images/* are cached for 24 hours.'),
)
```

## Accessibility

The dialog is a semantics container named by its header. Focus moves into it when it appears and returns to the widget that had focus before when it is removed, if that widget still exists. Escape calls `onDismiss`. Tab is not trapped, because the page stays usable. The close button is announced with `dismissAriaLabel`.

## Motion

The dialog has no motion of its own, as in Cloudscape. Wrap it in your own transition if it should animate where it appears.

## Mobile

The dialog takes the width its parent gives it and wraps its header and content, so it fits a 390px screen at 2x text. Keep footers short or let them wrap.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `header` | `header` / `headerWidget` |
| `headerActions`, `footer`, `onDismiss`, `i18nStrings.dismissAriaLabel` | same names |
| `children` | `child` |
| focus restore on unmount | built in; `autofocus` to opt out of moving focus in |

---
source: doc/components/CsDialogRoute.md
---

# CsDialogRoute

A navigator route that draws the Cloudscape backdrop (`CsScrim`) and runs dialog motion around a custom widget; Escape, a backdrop tap and the back gesture pop it.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/modal/ (a foundation primitive; use `CsModal` for Cloudscape's modal)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
Future<void> openPanel(BuildContext context) => Navigator.of(context).push(
  CsDialogRoute<void>(
    semanticLabel: 'Keyboard shortcuts',
    builder: (context) => const Center(child: CsContainer(child: Text('Press / to search'))),
  ),
);
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for a custom blocking overlay that `CsModal` does not cover (a command palette, a full-screen image). For Cloudscape's modal use `CsModal` or `showCsModal`, which add the header, footer, sizes and dismiss reasons.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `builder` | `WidgetBuilder` | required | Route content, laid out over the whole screen |
| `transition` | `CsDialogTransition` | `scale` | `scale` (fade plus scale from 0.9) or `slideUp` (fade plus a 40px rise, for full-screen pages on phones) |
| `dismissible` | `bool` | `true` | A backdrop tap pops the route |
| `closeOnEscape` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `restoreFocusOnUnmount` | `bool` | `true` | Return focus to the widget focused before |
| `showScrim` | `bool` | `true` | Draw the backdrop |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Name of the route for screen readers |
| `settings` | `RouteSettings?` | | |

## Examples

### Full-screen page on phones

```dart
Future<void> openImage(BuildContext context) => Navigator.of(context).push(
  CsDialogRoute<void>(
    transition: CsDialogTransition.slideUp,
    semanticLabel: 'Architecture diagram',
    builder: (context) => const SafeArea(child: Placeholder()),
  ),
);
```

## Accessibility

The content is wrapped in a `CsFocusTrap` and a semantics scope that names the route; the scrim is a "Close" button when `dismissible`.

## Motion

Fade plus scale from 0.9 (or a 40px rise) over 115ms with Cloudscape's responsive easing; the backdrop fades with it. Reduced motion shortens the transition and drops the scale and slide.

## Mobile

The builder gets the whole screen; add `SafeArea` and your own padding.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape concept | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| modal overlay | `showScrim` |
| `onDismiss` reason `overlay` / `keyboard` | `dismissible`, `closeOnEscape` |

---
source: doc/components/CsDivider.md
---

# CsDivider

Cloudscape's `Divider` (`src/divider`): a 1px line that separates content, horizontal (optionally labelled) or vertical.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/divider/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsDivider()
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a divider to separate groups of content inside a panel, or a label such as "or" between alternatives. Do not use it between containers (they have their own borders) or to separate table rows.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `CsDividerOrientation` | `horizontal` | `horizontal` or `vertical` |
| `label` | `String?` |  | Text in the middle of a horizontal line (Cloudscape `children`) |
| `labelWidget` | `Widget?` |  | Custom label content |
| `dangerouslySetLineColor` | `Color?` |  | Line color override (Cloudscape `style.root.lineColor`) |
| `lineWidth` | `double` | `1` | Line thickness (`border-divider-section-width`) |

## Examples

### Labelled

```dart
const CsDivider(label: 'or')
```

### Vertical between actions

```dart
const SizedBox(
  height: 24,
  child: Row(
    spacing: 12,
    children: [Text('Edit'), CsDivider(orientation: CsDividerOrientation.vertical), Text('Copy')],
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

The divider is decorative and has no semantics of its own. A label is read as plain text.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

A horizontal divider takes the full width; a labelled one keeps at least 16px of line on each side of the label and the label wraps at 2x text.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `orientation` | `orientation` (`CsDividerOrientation`) |
| `children` | `label` / `labelWidget` |
| `style.root.lineColor / lineWidth` | `dangerouslySetLineColor` / `lineWidth` |
| `nativeAttributes` | not supported (web only) |

---
source: doc/components/CsDrawer.md

# CsDrawer

Cloudscape's `Drawer`: a panel with a header, scrolling content and a sticky footer, used in the app layout or over the screen.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/drawer/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsDrawer(
  header: const Text('Instance details'),
  footer: CsButton(text: 'Stop instance', onPress: () {}),
  child: const Text('i-0abc123'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a drawer for supplementary content and tools beside the main content, such as details or filters. For a blocking decision use `CsModal`; for help text use `CsHelpPanel`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `header` | `Widget?` |  | Title in the panel header font |
| `headerActions` | `Widget?` |  |  |
| `child` | `Widget?` |  | Content |
| `footer` | `Widget?` |  |  |
| `stickyFooter` | `bool` | `true` | Footer stays visible while content scrolls |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `disableContentPaddings` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsDrawerI18nStrings` |  | `loadingText` |
| `position` | `CsDrawerPosition` | `static` | `static`, `sticky`, `absolute`, `fixed` |
| `placement` | `CsDrawerPlacement` | `end` | `start`, `end`, `top`, `bottom` (overlay positions) |
| `size` | `double` | `320` | Width (or height) of an overlay drawer |
| `open` | `bool` | `true` | Shows an overlay drawer |
| `onClose` | `ValueChanged<CsDrawerCloseMethod>?` |  | `closeAction`, `backdropClick`, `escape`; shows the close button |
| `closeAction` | `CsDrawerCloseAction?` |  | Label, disabled state and icon of the close button |
| `hideCloseAction` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `backdrop` | `bool` | `false` | Dims the content behind an overlay drawer |
| `autoFocus` | `bool` | `true` |  |
| `trapFocus` | `bool` | `true` |  |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  |

## Examples

### Over the screen

```dart
CsDrawer(
  position: CsDrawerPosition.fixed,
  open: true,
  backdrop: true,
  header: const Text('Filters'),
  onClose: (method) {},
  child: const Text('State: running'),
)
```

## Accessibility

The header is a level-2 heading; the close button has a label. Overlay drawers trap focus, move focus in on open and close with Escape.

## Motion

Overlay drawers slide in from their edge over `motion-duration-complex` (250ms) with the expressive easing; the backdrop fades. Reduced motion shows them instantly. Keep the drawer mounted and drive `open` so it animates out.

## Mobile

Fixed start and end drawers take the full width at or below 688px.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `header / headerActions` | same names |
| `children` | `child` |
| `footer` | `footer` (`stickyFooter`) |
| `loading / i18nStrings.loadingText` | `loading` / `i18nStrings` |
| `position / placement` | `position` / `placement` |
| `open / onClose` | `open` / `onClose` (`CsDrawerCloseMethod`) |
| `closeAction / hideCloseAction` | `closeAction` / `hideCloseAction` |
| `backdrop` | `backdrop` |
| `focusBehavior` | `autoFocus` / `trapFocus` |
| `offset / stickyOffset / zIndex / role` | not supported (Flutter layout) |

source: doc/components/CsDropdown.md
