# CsDropdown

The floating container behind selects, multiselects, autosuggests and button dropdowns: Cloudscape's dropdown, anchored under its trigger on wide screens and a bottom sheet on phones.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/select/ (the dropdown is internal in Cloudscape)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsDropdown(
  open: true,
  onDismiss: () {},
  contentBuilder: (context, inSheet) => CsMenuPanel(children: [CsMenuRow(label: 'Edit', onPress: () {})]),
  child: CsButton(text: 'Open', onPress: () {}),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to build your own picker or menu that should behave like Cloudscape's. Prefer the finished components (`CsSelect`, `CsButtonDropdown`) when they fit. For a popover with arbitrary content and an arrow use `CsAnchoredOverlay` with `CsPopupSurface`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `bool` | required | Controlled visibility; false also closes the sheet |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The trigger |
| `contentBuilder` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, bool inSheet)` | required | Rebuilt whenever the dropdown rebuilds, also inside the sheet |
| `onDismiss` | `VoidCallback?` | | Outside tap, Escape, or sheet swiped away |
| `presentation` | `CsPresentation` | `auto` | `auto` (sheet at or below 688px), `popover`, `sheet` |
| `matchTriggerWidth` | `bool` | `true` | At least as wide as the trigger |
| `align` | `CsAlign` | `start` | |
| `preferredHeight` | `double` | `300` | Room wanted below before flipping up |
| `trapFocus` | `bool` | `false` | Move focus into the content (menus) |
| `sheetLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name of the sheet |
| `tapRegionGroupId` | `Object?` | | Share outside-tap handling with other regions |
| `dismissOnOutsideTap` | `bool` | `true` | False for content with nested dropdowns |

## Examples

### A custom picker that keeps its sheet open

```dart
CsDropdown(
  open: true,
  presentation: CsPresentation.auto,
  sheetLabel: 'Columns',
  onDismiss: () {},
  contentBuilder: (context, inSheet) => CsMenuPanel(children: [
    CsMenuRow(label: 'Name', checked: true, onPress: () {}),
    CsMenuRow(label: 'Status', checked: false, onPress: () {}),
  ]),
  child: CsButton(text: 'Columns', onPress: () {}),
)
```

## Accessibility

With `trapFocus` focus moves into the content and returns to the trigger on close; otherwise focus stays on the trigger and the content is driven from it. Escape closes either way.

## Motion

Anchored: scales from 0.9 and fades from the trigger with a spring, closes along the same path. Sheet: slides up and follows the finger. Reduced motion keeps only fades.

## Mobile

`CsPresentation.auto` switches to a bottom sheet at or below 688px. The sheet content rebuilds with the owner's state, so lists can toggle options while it stays open.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape (internal `Dropdown`) | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `open`, `onDropdownClose`, `trigger`, `content` | `open`, `onDismiss`, `child`, `contentBuilder` |
| `stretchWidth` / `minWidth` | `matchTriggerWidth` |
| `expandToViewport` | not applicable (always in the root overlay) |

# CsEditable

The bare text-editing core shared by every Cloudscape field: styled text, caret, selection color and placeholder, with no box or label.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/input/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsEditable(
  controller: controller,
  focusNode: focusNode,
  placeholder: 'example-bucket',
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => name = v),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use inside `CsFieldBox` (or another custom chrome) to build a field that `CsInput` does not cover: a token input, a command palette search, a one-time-code field.
- Use `CsInput` or `CsTextarea` for ordinary text entry.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `controller` | `TextEditingController?` | `null` | |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | `null` | Italic `color-text-input-placeholder` hint. |
| `size` | `CsTypeScale` | `bodyM` | Text size. |
| `mono` | `bool` | `false` | Monospace text. |
| `enabled` / `readOnly` | `bool` | `true` / `false` | |
| `obscureText` | `bool` | `false` | Password entry; forces one line and turns off suggestions. |
| `autofocus`, `autocorrect`, `enableSuggestions` | `bool` | `false`, `true`, `true` | |
| `keyboardType` | `TextInputType?` | multiline when `maxLines != 1` | |
| `textInputAction`, `textCapitalization`, `inputFormatters`, `autofillHints` | | | Passed to the text field. |
| `maxLength` | `int?` | `null` | Enforced without Material's counter. |
| `minLines` / `maxLines` | `int?` | `null` / `1` | `maxLines: null` grows without limit. |
| `textAlign` | `TextAlign` | `start` | |
| `onChanged`, `onSubmitted`, `onTap`, `onTapOutside`, `onEditingComplete` | callbacks | `null` | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name when the parent does not provide one. |
| `color` | `CsColor` | `textBodyDefault` | Text color token. |
| `scrollPadding` | `EdgeInsets` | `EdgeInsets.all(20)` | Space kept around the field when it scrolls into view. |
| `showCursor` | `bool?` | `null` | `false` hides the caret (hidden-field patterns). |

## Examples

### A borderless search in a toolbar

```dart
Row(
  children: [
    const CsIcon(CsIcons.search, variant: CsIconVariant.subtle),
    const SizedBox(width: CsSpace.xs),
    Expanded(
      child: CsEditable(
        controller: controller,
        placeholder: 'Search resources',
        textInputAction: TextInputAction.search,
        onSubmitted: (q) => runSearch(q),
      ),
    ),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

It is a platform text field: screen readers announce it as an editable text field with its value; pass `semanticLabel` when no surrounding label names it. Selection handles and the context menu are the platform's.

## Motion

None beyond the platform caret blink.

## Mobile

On-screen keyboards, selection handles and the paste menu come from the platform. Text scales with the system setting; give the field a minimum height (as `CsFieldBox` does), never a fixed one.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape source | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| native `<input>` / `<textarea>` inside Input and Textarea | `CsEditable` |
| `placeholder` | `placeholder` |
| `autoComplete`, `spellcheck` | `enableSuggestions`, `autocorrect` |
| `inputMode` | `keyboardType` |

# CsErrorBoundary

Cloudscape's `ErrorBoundary` (`src/error-boundary`): shows an error fallback in place of content that failed to build, so one broken section does not take down the screen.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/error-boundary/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsErrorBoundary(
  errorBoundaryId: 'instance-details',
  onError: (detail) => debugPrint('${detail.errorBoundaryId}: ${detail.error}'),
  child: const Text('Instance i-0abc123'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Wrap independent sections (a dashboard item, a details panel, a split panel's content) so a build error in one of them shows a contained fallback with a way to retry. Do not use it for expected failures such as a failed request; show those with `CsAlert`, a status indicator or a collection's error state.

## How it works

Flutter cannot catch a descendant's build error the way React does. While at least one boundary is mounted it installs, chained to the previous one, an `ErrorWidget.builder` that builds a small probe in place of the failed widget. The probe finds the nearest boundary above it and switches it to the fallback after the frame; with no boundary above, the previous builder runs (the usual error box). When the last boundary unmounts, the previous builder is restored. Errors thrown by `builder` are caught directly. Flutter still reports every error to `FlutterError.onError`, so logging keeps working.

Only build errors reach a boundary. Errors in layout, paint, gesture callbacks or async code do not, as in React.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget?` |  | The guarded content (pass this or `builder`) |
| `builder` | `WidgetBuilder?` |  | Builds the content; errors it throws are caught too. Wins over `child` |
| `onError` | `ValueChanged<CsErrorBoundaryErrorDetail>` | required | Called once per caught error, to log or report it |
| `errorBoundaryId` | `String?` |  | Passed to `onError` and set as the semantics identifier |
| `renderFallback` | `Widget? Function(BuildContext, CsErrorBoundaryFallbackSlots)?` |  | Custom fallback from the default slots; return null for the default alert |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsErrorBoundaryI18nStrings` | English | Header, description, refresh text and an optional inline feedback action |
| `suppressNested` | `bool` | `false` | Disables nested `suppressible` boundaries so their errors reach this one |
| `suppressible` | `bool` | `false` | Lets an outer `suppressNested` boundary disable this one |
| `onRefresh` | `VoidCallback?` |  | Called when "Refresh" is pressed, after the error is cleared (refetch data here) |
| `showRefreshAction` | `bool` | `true` | Shows the "Refresh" button |

`CsErrorBoundaryErrorDetail`: `error` (`Object`), `stackTrace` (`StackTrace?`), `details` (`FlutterErrorDetails?`, null for errors thrown by `builder`), `errorBoundaryId` (`String?`).

`CsErrorBoundaryFallbackSlots`: `header`, `description`, `action` (`Widget?`), `reset` (`VoidCallback`).

`CsErrorBoundaryI18nStrings`: `headerText` ("Unexpected error, content failed to show"), `descriptionText` ("Refresh to try again."), `refreshActionText` ("Refresh"), `feedbackText` and `feedbackBuilder` for an inline feedback action.

`CsErrorBoundaryState` (through a `GlobalKey`): `hasError`, `reset()`, `forceError([error])`.

## Examples

### Custom fallback

```dart
CsErrorBoundary(
  onError: (detail) {},
  renderFallback: (context, slots) => CsBox(
    padding: const CsBoxSpacing.all(CsSpacingSize.m),
    child: Column(children: [slots.header, slots.description, if (slots.action != null) slots.action!]),
  ),
  child: const Text('Distribution d111111abcdef8'),
)
```

### Feedback action in the description

```dart
CsErrorBoundary(
  onError: (detail) {},
  i18nStrings: CsErrorBoundaryI18nStrings(
    feedbackText: 'Report a problem',
    feedbackBuilder: (context, text) => CsLink(text: text, onFollow: () {}),
  ),
  builder: (context) => const Text('Bucket example-bucket'),
)
```

### Retry with fresh data

```dart
CsErrorBoundary(
  onError: (detail) {},
  onRefresh: () => setState(() => reloadKey++),
  child: const Text('Metrics'),
)
```

## Accessibility

The default fallback is an error `CsAlert`: an error icon with its label, the bold header, the description and a "Refresh" button. Focus is not moved; the content that failed is replaced in place.

## Motion

The fallback alert fades in with Cloudscape's `motion-duration-show-paced`.

## Mobile

The fallback takes the width of the failed section; the alert's action moves below the message at phone widths.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `child` / `builder` |
| `onError` (`error`, `errorInfo`, `errorBoundaryId`) | `onError` (`error`, `stackTrace`, `details`, `errorBoundaryId`) |
| `errorBoundaryId` | `errorBoundaryId` |
| `renderFallback` (`header`, `description`, `action`) | `renderFallback` (`CsErrorBoundaryFallbackSlots`, plus `reset`) |
| `i18nStrings.headerText / descriptionText / refreshActionText` | `i18nStrings` fields of the same names |
| `i18nStrings.components.Feedback` | `i18nStrings.feedbackBuilder` + `feedbackText` |
| `suppressNested` / `suppressible` | `suppressNested` / `suppressible` |
| page reload on "Refresh" | clears the error and rebuilds; `onRefresh` for more |
| `__awsui__.forceError` / `clearForcedError` | `CsErrorBoundaryState.forceError` / `reset` |

source: doc/components/CsExpandableSection.md

# CsExpandableSection

Cloudscape's `ExpandableSection`: a header that shows and hides its content, in six variants.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/expandable-section/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsExpandableSection(
  headerText: 'Additional settings',
  child: Text('Detailed monitoring: off'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to hide secondary or advanced content. Use the `container` variant for an optional container, `footer` at the end of a form or container, `navigation` for groups of links, `inline` inside text. Do not hide content people need to finish their task.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget?` |  | The content (Cloudscape `children`) |
| `headerText` | `String?` |  | Title |
| `header` | `Widget?` |  | Custom title content |
| `variant` | `CsExpandableSectionVariant` | `defaultVariant` | `defaultVariant`, `footer`, `container`, `stacked`, `navigation`, `inline` |
| `expanded` | `bool?` |  | Controlled state; null lets the section manage it |
| `defaultExpanded` | `bool` | `false` | Starting state when uncontrolled |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` |  | Next expanded state |
| `headerCounter` | `String?` |  | "(2)" after the title (container variants) |
| `headerDescription` | `String?` |  | Text under the title |
| `headerInfo` | `Widget?` |  | Info link (container variants) |
| `headerActions` | `Widget?` |  | Buttons in the header (container variants); they do not toggle |
| `headerSecondaryContent` | `Widget?` |  |  |
| `headingTagOverride` | `int?` |  | Heading level announced |
| `headerAriaLabel` | `String?` |  | Accessible name of the toggle |
| `hideHeaderText` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `disableContentPaddings` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `stackPosition` | `CsStackPosition` | `only` | For the `stacked` variant |

## Examples

### Controlled container

```dart
CsExpandableSection(
  variant: CsExpandableSectionVariant.container,
  headerText: 'Tags',
  headerCounter: '(2)',
  headerActions: CsButton(text: 'Manage tags', onPress: () {}),
  expanded: true,
  onChange: (v) {},
  child: const Text('environment: test'),
)
```

### Navigation group

```dart
const CsExpandableSection(
  variant: CsExpandableSectionVariant.navigation,
  headerText: 'Images',
  defaultExpanded: true,
  child: Text('AMIs'),
)
```

## Accessibility

The toggle is a button with `expanded` state and Enter/Space activation; the title is a heading. In the navigation variant only the caret is the button.

## Motion

Content reveals over `motion-duration-expandable-content-enter` (180ms) with the expandable easing; the fade and 4px slide start a third of the way in. Collapse runs over `motion-duration-show-quick` (135ms). The caret turns 90 degrees over 135ms. Reduced motion snaps.

## Mobile

Header text and actions wrap; the 44px touch target comes from `CsPressable`.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `headerText / header` | `headerText` / `header` |
| `variant` | `variant` |
| `expanded / onChange` | `expanded` / `onChange` (bool) |
| `defaultExpanded` | `defaultExpanded` |
| `headerCounter / headerDescription / headerInfo / headerActions` | same names |
| `headerSecondaryContent` | `headerSecondaryContent` |
| `headingTagOverride` | `headingTagOverride` (int) |
| `headerAriaLabel` | `headerAriaLabel` |
| `disableContentPaddings` | `disableContentPaddings` |
| `analyticsMetadata` | not supported (web only) |

# CsFieldBox

The chrome of every Cloudscape text field: background, border, radius, focus ring and validation states, around any content.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/input/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFieldBox(
  focused: focusNode.hasFocus,
  child: CsEditable(controller: controller, focusNode: focusNode),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use to build a field that must match `CsInput` but holds something else: a token list, a copyable ARN, a custom picker trigger.
- For plain text entry use `CsInput` or `CsTextarea`, which already combine `CsFieldBox`, `CsEditable` and `CsTextFieldState`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The field content. |
| `focused` | `bool` | `false` | Draws `color-border-input-focused` and the 1px focus ring (2px with a status). |
| `status` | `CsFieldStatus` | `none` | `invalid` (red) or `warning` (yellow) border with an 8px start edge. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | `color-background-input-disabled` fill and disabled border. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Disabled border on the default fill. |
| `leading` | `Widget?` | `null` | An icon before the content, 12px from the start edge. |
| `trailing` | `Widget?` | `null` | Content after the field text (a clear button, a caret). |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry?` | field tokens | Overrides `space-field-vertical` / `space-field-horizontal`. |
| `minHeight` | `double?` | `size-vertical-input` | 32px, 28px compact. |
| `borderRadius` | `double` | `CsBorderRadius.input` (8) | |
| `multiline` | `bool` | `false` | Aligns content to the top (text areas). |

## Examples

### A copyable value

```dart
CsFieldBox(
  focused: focusNode.hasFocus,
  trailing: CsButton(
    icon: CsIcons.copy,
    variant: CsButtonVariant.inlineIcon,
    semanticLabel: 'Copy ARN',
    onPress: () => Clipboard.setData(ClipboardData(text: controller.text)),
  ),
  child: CsEditable(controller: controller, focusNode: focusNode, mono: true),
)
```

### A trigger that is not a text field

```dart
CsPressable(
  onPress: () => setState(() => open = true),
  showFocusRing: false,
  builder: (context, state) => CsFieldBox(
    focused: state.focused || open,
    trailing: const Padding(
      padding: EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(end: CsSpace.xs),
      child: CsIcon(CsIcons.caretDownFilled),
    ),
    child: Text(selectedLabel),
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

`CsFieldBox` draws only; it adds no semantics. Give the content its own (a `CsEditable` is a text field; a pressable trigger is a button with a label and value). The invalid and warning states must be paired with a message, as in `CsFormField`.

## Motion

None: focus and status colors switch instantly. Borders are drawn inside the box and the focus ring outside it, so states never shift layout.

## Mobile

It uses a minimum height, so 2x text grows the field instead of clipping. The thick status edge eats into the start padding so text does not move when validation changes.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape source | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `.input` styles (`internal/styles/forms`) | `CsFieldBox` |
| `invalid` / `warning` | `status` |
| `disabled` / `readOnly` | `disabled` / `readOnly` |
| `:focus` styles | `focused` |
| `input-icon-left` / `input-icon-right` | `leading` / `trailing` |

source: doc/components/CsFileDropzone.md

# CsFileDropzone

Cloudscape's `FileDropzone`: the dashed area files are dropped onto, with Cloudscape's hovered state.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/file-dropzone/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFileDropzone(
  onPick: (request) => myPicker(multiple: request.multiple),
  onChange: (files) => setState(() => uploads = [...uploads, ...files]),
  child: const Text('Drop files to upload, or tap to choose'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for a large drop target in an upload page or panel. `CsFileUpload` already swaps its button for a dropzone while files are dragged (`dropzoneActive`), so you only need this component for custom layouts.

## Drag and drop in Flutter

Flutter has no cross-platform drag and drop of operating system files without a plugin, so the dropzone supports three sources:

- **Tap.** With `onPick`, the whole zone is a button that opens the app's picker. This is the main path on phones.
- **Your drag and drop plugin.** Wrap the zone with the plugin's drop target (`desktop_drop`, `super_drag_and_drop`), set `active` while files hover over it, and handle the drop in the plugin's callback. `active` shows the hovered colors.
- **In-app drags.** The zone is a `DragTarget` for `Draggable<CsFile>` and `Draggable<List<CsFile>>`: hovering lights it up and dropping calls `onChange`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | Centered content with a 4px gap (text, an icon, a `CsFileInput`) |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<List<CsFile>>?` | | Dropped or picked files |
| `onPick` | `CsFilePicker?` | | Makes the zone a button that opens the app picker |
| `active` | `bool` | `false` | Files are dragged over the zone (hovered colors) |
| `multiple` | `bool` | `true` | Passed to `onPick` |
| `accept` | `String?` | | Passed to `onPick` |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name |

## Examples

### Driven by a plugin

```dart
CsFileDropzone(
  active: draggingOver,
  child: const Text('Drop files to upload'),
)
```

### With a file input inside

```dart
CsFileDropzone(
  onChange: (files) {},
  child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
    const Text('Drop files here'),
    CsFileInput(value: const [], text: 'Choose files', multiple: true, onPick: (r) async => null, onChange: (f) {}),
  ]),
)
```

## Accessibility

With `onPick` it is a button named by `semanticLabel` (Enter and Space open the picker); otherwise a labelled container. The text inside should say what to drop.

## Motion

Hovered colors switch instantly (`color-dropzone-*-hover`), as Cloudscape does on drag over.

## Mobile

Use `onPick` so a tap opens the picker; there is no drag source on phones. The zone keeps 20px padding and wraps its text at 390px.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `child` |
| `onChange` (`detail.value`) | `onChange` (`ValueChanged<List<CsFile>>`) |
| browser drag over state | `active` (or in-app `Draggable<CsFile>`) |
| (none) | `onPick`, `multiple`, `accept`, `semanticLabel` (extras) |

---
source: doc/components/CsFileInput.md
---

# CsFileInput

Cloudscape's `FileInput`: a button (or icon button) that opens a file picker, for custom upload flows.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/file-input/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFileInput(
  value: files,
  text: 'Choose file',
  accept: '.json',
  onPick: (request) => myPicker(multiple: request.multiple, accept: request.accept),
  onChange: (picked) => setState(() => files = picked),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it when the chosen files are shown somewhere else (a chat composer, a table) or when you need an icon-only upload trigger. For the standard form control with file tokens, constraint and validation text use `CsFileUpload`.

## The picker

The package has no file picker dependency. `onPick` receives a `CsFilePickRequest` (`multiple`, `accept`) and returns the user's choice as `List<CsFile>` (or null when cancelled). Wire it to the picker your app already uses; for example with `file_picker`:

```dart
Future<List<CsFile>?> pick(CsFilePickRequest request) async {
  final result = await myFilePicker(allowMultiple: request.multiple);
  if (result == null) return null;
  return [
    for (final f in result)
      CsFile(name: f.name, size: f.size, type: f.mimeType ?? '', lastModified: f.modified, data: f.path),
  ];
}
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `List<CsFile>` | required | The selected files (not drawn by the input) |
| `onPick` | `CsFilePicker?` | | Opens the app's picker; null disables the button |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<List<CsFile>>?` | | The picked files (only the first one unless `multiple`) |
| `text` | `String?` | | Button text, also the accessible name without `ariaLabel` |
| `variant` | `CsFileInputVariant` | `button` | `button` or `icon` (needs `ariaLabel`) |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | | |
| `accept` | `String?` | | Allow-list passed to `onPick` (`'image/*,.pdf'`) |
| `multiple` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `ariaRequired` | `bool` | `false` | Announced as required |
| `invalid` | `bool` | `false` | Announced as invalid |
| `warning` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | | Focus the button (Cloudscape `ref.focus()`) |

`CsFile`: `name`, `size` (bytes), `lastModified`, `type` (MIME), `thumbnail` (`ImageProvider?`), `data` (your payload), `isImage`.

## Examples

### Icon variant

```dart
CsFileInput(
  value: const [],
  variant: CsFileInputVariant.icon,
  ariaLabel: 'Attach file',
  onPick: (request) async => null,
  onChange: (files) {},
)
```

## Accessibility

A button named by `ariaLabel` or `text`, with "Required" and "Error" hints when `ariaRequired` or `invalid`. Tab focuses, Enter and Space open the picker.

## Motion

`CsButton`'s press feedback.

## Mobile

The button keeps Cloudscape's size with a 44px touch target. Pick from the platform's document or photo picker in `onPick`.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value`, `variant`, `ariaLabel`, `accept`, `multiple`, `ariaRequired`, `invalid`, `warning` | same names |
| `children` | `text` |
| `onChange` (`detail.value`) | `onChange` (`ValueChanged<List<CsFile>>`) |
| native file dialog | `onPick` (your picker) |
| `File` | `CsFile` |
| `ref.focus()` | `focusNode` |
| `controlId`, `ariaDescribedby`, `ariaLabelledby` | not applicable |

---
source: doc/components/CsFileTokenGroup.md

# CsFileTokenGroup

Cloudscape's `FileTokenGroup`: chosen files as tokens with name, size, date and image thumbnail, a dismiss button, and loading, error and warning states.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/file-token-group/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFileTokenGroup(
  items: [for (final f in files) CsFileTokenGroupItem(file: f)],
  showFileSize: true,
  onDismiss: (i) => setState(() => files = [...files]..removeAt(i)),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to show files attached somewhere other than a `CsFileUpload` (a chat prompt, a support case) or to show per-file upload progress. `CsFileUpload` already renders one for its value.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<CsFileTokenGroupItem>` | required | `file`, `loading`, `errorText`, `warningText` |
| `onDismiss` | `ValueChanged<int>?` | | Gets the index; the group does not remove tokens itself |
| `showFileSize` | `bool` | `false` | `482.13 KB` (decimal units) |
| `showFileLastModified` | `bool` | `false` | `2024-01-15T13:45:00` |
| `showFileThumbnail` | `bool` | `false` | 48px preview for image files |
| `thumbnailBuilder` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, CsFile)?` | | Custom preview; defaults to `CsFile.thumbnail` or a file icon |
| `limit` | `int?` | | Tokens shown before "Show more (+N)" |
| `alignment` | `CsFileTokenGroupAlignment` | `vertical` | `vertical` or `horizontal` (230px grid) |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Dismiss buttons disabled |
| `limitShowMoreAriaLabel`, `limitShowFewerAriaLabel` | `String?` | | |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsFileTokenGroupI18nStrings` | English | `limitShowMore`, `limitShowFewer`, `removeFileAriaLabel`, `errorIconAriaLabel`, `warningIconAriaLabel`, `formatFileSize`, `formatFileLastModified` |

## Examples

### Upload progress and validation

```dart
CsFileTokenGroup(
  items: [
    CsFileTokenGroupItem(file: const CsFile(name: 'diagram.png', size: 1200000, type: 'image/png'), loading: true),
    CsFileTokenGroupItem(file: const CsFile(name: 'server.crt', size: 2048), errorText: 'The certificate has expired.'),
    CsFileTokenGroupItem(file: const CsFile(name: 'policy.json', size: 912), warningText: 'Public read access.'),
  ],
  showFileSize: true,
  showFileThumbnail: true,
  onDismiss: (i) {},
)
```

### Horizontal with a limit

```dart
CsFileTokenGroup(
  items: [for (final f in files) CsFileTokenGroupItem(file: f)],
  alignment: CsFileTokenGroupAlignment.horizontal,
  limit: 3,
  onDismiss: (i) {},
)
```

## Accessibility

Each token is a group named "file name, n of total" (plus "Loading" while loading); its dismiss button is "Remove file n, name". Errors and warnings are announced with their icon labels. After a dismiss, focus moves to the token that took its place, else the previous token, else the "Show more" toggle. The toggle announces its expanded state. Long names truncate with an ellipsis and show in full in a tooltip.

## Motion

None of its own; the loading spinner runs only while `loading` is true.

## Mobile

Below 688px a horizontal group falls back to one full-width token per line, as Cloudscape does.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `items`, `showFileSize`, `showFileLastModified`, `showFileThumbnail`, `limit`, `alignment`, `readOnly`, `limitShowFewerAriaLabel`, `limitShowMoreAriaLabel`, `i18nStrings` | same names |
| `onDismiss` (`detail.fileIndex`) | `onDismiss` (`ValueChanged<int>`) |
| `Item.file` (`File`) | `CsFileTokenGroupItem.file` (`CsFile`) |
| (none) | `thumbnailBuilder` (extra) |

source: doc/components/CsFileUpload.md

# CsFileUpload

Cloudscape's `FileUpload`: a "Choose file" button with constraint and validation text, and the chosen files as tokens.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/file-upload/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Certificate',
  stretch: true,
  child: CsFileUpload(
    value: files,
    accept: '.pem,.crt',
    constraintText: 'PEM or CRT, up to 1 MB.',
    showFileSize: true,
    onPick: (request) => myPicker(multiple: request.multiple),
    onChange: (next) => setState(() => files = next),
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it in forms where users attach one or more files. Validate files in your app and pass the messages as `errorText`, `fileErrors` and `fileWarnings`. For a bare picker button use `CsFileInput`; for a large drop area use `CsFileDropzone`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `List<CsFile>` | required | |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<List<CsFile>>?` | | The next list: picks append when `multiple`, replace otherwise; dismiss removes |
| `onPick` | `CsFilePicker?` | | Opens the app's picker (see `CsFileInput`); null disables the button |
| `accept` | `String?` | | Allow-list passed to `onPick` |
| `multiple` | `bool` | `false` | Also switches "Choose file" to "Choose files" |
| `ariaRequired` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `showFileSize`, `showFileLastModified`, `showFileThumbnail` | `bool` | `false` | Token metadata |
| `tokenLimit` | `int?` | | Tokens shown before "Show more" |
| `constraintText` | `String?` | | File rules under the button |
| `errorText` | `String?` | | |
| `warningText` | `String?` | | Shown only without `errorText` |
| `fileErrors`, `fileWarnings` | `List<String?>?` | | Per file, by index |
| `fileLoading` | `List<bool>?` | | Per-file spinner (extra) |
| `fileTokenAlignment` | `CsFileTokenGroupAlignment` | `vertical` | |
| `dropzoneActive` | `bool` | `false` | Show the dropzone in place of the button (files dragged over the app) |
| `invalid` | `bool` | `false` | Implied by `errorText` and `fileErrors` |
| `disabled`, `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | | Focus the button (Cloudscape `ref.focus()`) |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsFileUploadI18nStrings` | English | `uploadButtonText(multiple)`, `dropzoneText(multiple)`, `removeFileAriaLabel`, `limitShowMore`, `limitShowFewer`, `errorIconAriaLabel`, `warningIconAriaLabel`, `formatFileSize`, `formatFileLastModified` |

## Examples

### Multiple files with per-file errors

```dart
CsFileUpload(
  value: files,
  multiple: true,
  tokenLimit: 3,
  showFileSize: true,
  fileErrors: [for (final f in files) f.size > 1000000 ? 'Files must be 1 MB or smaller.' : null],
  constraintText: 'Up to 10 files, 1 MB each.',
  onPick: (request) async => null,
  onChange: (next) {},
)
```

### Dropzone while dragging

```dart
CsFileUpload(
  value: files,
  multiple: true,
  dropzoneActive: draggingOverWindow,
  onChange: (next) {},
)
```

## Accessibility

The button is named "Choose file(s)" with required and invalid hints. Error and warning text are announced with icon labels; constraint text follows them. Tokens behave as in `CsFileTokenGroup`; their remove buttons are "Remove file n".

## Motion

None of its own.

## Mobile

The button stays at its natural width; tokens stack full width below 688px. On phones, `onPick` opens the platform document or photo picker; drag states do not apply.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value`, `accept`, `multiple`, `ariaRequired`, `showFileSize`, `showFileLastModified`, `showFileThumbnail`, `tokenLimit`, `constraintText`, `errorText`, `warningText`, `fileErrors`, `fileWarnings`, `fileTokenAlignment`, `invalid`, `i18nStrings` | same names |
| `onChange` (`detail.value`) | `onChange` (`ValueChanged<List<CsFile>>`) |
| native file dialog | `onPick` |
| browser drag detection | `dropzoneActive` (or in-app `Draggable<CsFile>`) |
| `ref.focus()` | `focusNode` |
| `controlId`, `ariaDescribedby`, `ariaLabelledby` | not applicable |

# CsFlashbar

Cloudscape's `Flashbar`: page-level messages about the result of an action (an instance launched, a deletion failed) or an ongoing process, shown at the top of the page, optionally collapsed into a stack with a notification bar.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/flashbar/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFlashbar(
  items: [
    CsFlashbarItem(
      id: 'deleted',
      type: CsFlashbarType.success,
      content: 'Bucket example-bucket deleted.',
      dismissible: true,
      onDismiss: () {},
    ),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a flashbar for feedback on something the user did or started: success, failure, a long operation in progress. Remove success messages when the user dismisses them or navigates. For messages tied to a part of the page that stay while a condition holds, use `CsAlert`. For field validation use `CsFormField`'s `errorText`.

## Parameters

### CsFlashbar

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<CsFlashbarItem>` | required | Messages, newest first |
| `stackItems` | `bool` | `false` | Collapse two or more messages into a stack with a notification bar |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsFlashbarI18nStrings` | English | `ariaLabel` (`'Notifications'`), `notificationBarAriaLabel` (`'All notifications'`), `notificationBarText` (`'Notifications'`), and `errorIconAriaLabel`, `warningIconAriaLabel`, `successIconAriaLabel`, `infoIconAriaLabel`, `inProgressIconAriaLabel` (default to `CsStrings`) |

### CsFlashbarItem

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `String?` | | Identifies the message so the right one animates out. Always set it |
| `type` | `CsFlashbarType` | `info` | `success`, `error`, `warning`, `info`, `inProgress` |
| `header` / `headerWidget` | `String?` / `Widget?` | | Bold heading |
| `content` / `contentWidget` | `String?` / `Widget?` | | Message; `contentWidget` takes a `CsProgressBar(variant: CsProgressBarVariant.flash)` |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Spinner instead of the icon, info colors, counted as in progress |
| `dismissible` | `bool` | `false` | Close button |
| `dismissLabel` | `String?` | `'Dismiss'` | Close button name |
| `onDismiss` | `VoidCallback?` | | Close button pressed; remove the item in response |
| `statusIconAriaLabel` | `String?` | type name | Status icon name |
| `ariaRole` | `CsFlashbarAriaRole?` | | `alert` announces assertively, `status` (and null) politely |
| `action` | `Widget?` | | An action button |
| `buttonText` / `onButtonPress` | `String?` / `VoidCallback?` | | A normal button as the action; ignored when `action` is set |

`CsFlash(item: ...)` renders a single message on its own.

## Examples

### Message types

```dart
CsFlashbar(
  items: const [
    CsFlashbarItem(id: '1', type: CsFlashbarType.success, header: 'Instance launched', content: 'i-0abc123 is starting.'),
    CsFlashbarItem(id: '2', type: CsFlashbarType.error, header: 'Launch failed', content: 'You reached the instance limit.'),
    CsFlashbarItem(id: '3', type: CsFlashbarType.warning, content: 'The certificate expires in 7 days.'),
    CsFlashbarItem(id: '4', type: CsFlashbarType.info, content: 'Maintenance is scheduled for Sunday.'),
    CsFlashbarItem(id: '5', loading: true, content: 'Creating distribution d111111abcdef8'),
  ],
)
```

### Progress inside a flash

```dart
CsFlashbar(
  items: [
    CsFlashbarItem(
      id: 'snapshot',
      type: CsFlashbarType.inProgress,
      contentWidget: const CsProgressBar(
        variant: CsProgressBarVariant.flash,
        label: 'Creating snapshot of vol-0abc123',
        value: 42,
      ),
      buttonText: 'View snapshot',
      onButtonPress: () {},
    ),
  ],
)
```

### Stacked

```dart
CsFlashbar(
  stackItems: true,
  items: [
    CsFlashbarItem(id: 'a', type: CsFlashbarType.error, content: 'Could not delete example-bucket.', dismissible: true, onDismiss: () {}),
    CsFlashbarItem(id: 'b', type: CsFlashbarType.success, content: 'Instance i-0abc123 stopped.', dismissible: true, onDismiss: () {}),
    CsFlashbarItem(id: 'c', type: CsFlashbarType.info, content: 'A new console version is available.', dismissible: true, onDismiss: () {}),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

The flashbar is a semantics group named `ariaLabel`. Each message is a group with its status icon name ("Error"), so status is never color alone. Messages added after the first render are announced with their full text (assertively for `ariaRole: alert`). The notification bar is a button named `notificationBarAriaLabel`, exposes its expanded state, and carries the counts per type as its value; count changes are announced. Collapsed messages behind the top one are hidden from screen readers until the stack expands.

## Motion

- New messages fade in while sliding 20px down over Cloudscape's 250ms complex motion with the expressive easing.
- Removed messages fade out while sliding 20px up over 115ms, then their space closes.
- In a stack, every message moves between its stacked and listed position over 115ms (responsive) when the notification bar expands or collapses, the stack's colored edges widen into full messages, and the chevron turns 180 degrees.
- Reduced motion makes all of it instant.

## Mobile

Text wraps and nothing has a fixed height. The action moves below the message when the message would keep less than 70% of the width, indented under the text, as Cloudscape's flex-wrap does at phone widths. The notification bar's content wraps and stays centered with a 30px margin on each side.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `items`, `stackItems`, `i18nStrings` | same names |
| item `header`, `content` | `header` / `headerWidget`, `content` / `contentWidget` |
| item `type="in-progress"` | `type: CsFlashbarType.inProgress` |
| item `ariaRole` | `ariaRole: CsFlashbarAriaRole.alert` / `.status` |
| item `onButtonClick` | `onButtonPress` |
| item `id`, `loading`, `dismissible`, `dismissLabel`, `statusIconAriaLabel`, `action`, `buttonText`, `onDismiss` | same names |
| item `persistenceConfig`, `analyticsMetadata`, `style` | not applicable |

source: doc/components/CsFocusRing.md

# CsFocusRing

Cloudscape's keyboard focus ring: 2px of `color-border-item-focused`, drawn outside a control so layout never shifts. `CsPressable` draws it for you; use `CsFocusRing` around focusable widgets that are not built on it.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/foundation/visual-foundation/focus-indicators/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFocusRing(
  visible: true,
  offset: 4,
  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(CsBorderRadius.controlDefaultFocusRing),
  child: const CsBox(text: 'Focused'),
)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `visible` | `bool` | | Show the ring |
| `child` | `Widget` | | |
| `borderRadius` | `BorderRadius` | zero | |
| `color` | `CsColor` | `borderItemFocused` | |
| `width` | `double` | 2 | |
| `offset` | `double` | 0 | Gap between the control and the ring (Cloudscape's focus outline gutter) |

`CsFocusRingPainter` paints the same ring for custom painters.

## Accessibility

Show it only for keyboard focus (use `FocusableActionDetector.onShowFocusHighlight`), never hide it for keyboard users.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Visible with a hardware keyboard.

## Cloudscape React mapping

The `focus-visible` styles of every Cloudscape control.

---
source: doc/components/CsFocusTrap.md
---

# CsFocusTrap

Keeps keyboard focus inside a subtree while it is on screen and hands focus back to whatever had it before when the subtree goes away. Cloudscape's `FocusLock`, used by modals, sheets and popovers with controls.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/modal/ (a foundation primitive; Cloudscape's internal `FocusLock`)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFocusTrap(
  onEscPress: () {},
  child: Column(
    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
    children: [
      CsButton(text: 'Save', onPress: () {}),
      CsButton(text: 'Cancel', variant: CsButtonVariant.link, onPress: () {}),
    ],
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for custom overlays that hold controls. `CsModal`, `CsDialog`, `showCsSheet`, `CsDialogRoute` and `CsAnchoredOverlay(trapFocus: true)` already wrap their content in one.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | |
| `onEscPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | Escape pressed while focus is inside |
| `disableFocusTrap` | `bool` | `false` | Let Tab leave at the ends (inline panels such as `CsDialog`) |
| `restoreFocusOnUnmount` | `bool` | `true` | Give focus back to the previously focused widget, if focus is still lost |
| `disableAutoFocus` | `bool` | `false` | Do not move focus in on mount |
| `disableArrowKeyNavigation` | `bool` | `true` | False makes Up and Down move focus like Shift+Tab and Tab |

## Examples

### Arrow keys between actions

```dart
CsFocusTrap(
  disableArrowKeyNavigation: false,
  child: Column(
    mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
    children: [
      CsButton(text: 'Start instance', variant: CsButtonVariant.link, onPress: () {}),
      CsButton(text: 'Stop instance', variant: CsButtonVariant.link, onPress: () {}),
    ],
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

Tab and Shift+Tab wrap at the ends instead of escaping to the page behind. Focus returns to the previous widget only when it is still lost when the trap goes away, so an overlay that opened in the meantime keeps its focus.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Hardware keyboards on tablets and phones get the same behavior; touch users are unaffected.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape concept | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `FocusLock disabled` | `disableFocusTrap` |
| `restoreFocus` | `restoreFocusOnUnmount` |
| `autoFocus` | `disableAutoFocus` (inverted) |

---
source: doc/components/CsForm.md
---

# CsForm

The frame of a create or edit flow: header, form content, a form-level error and the action row.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/form/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsForm(
  header: const CsHeader(variant: CsHeaderVariant.h1, title: 'Create bucket'),
  actions: CsSpaceBetween(
    direction: CsSpaceBetweenDirection.horizontal,
    size: CsSpacingSize.xs,
    children: [
      CsButton(text: 'Cancel', variant: CsButtonVariant.link, onPress: () {}),
      CsButton(text: 'Create bucket', variant: CsButtonVariant.primary, onPress: () {}),
    ],
  ),
  child: CsContainer(
    header: const CsHeader(title: 'General configuration'),
    child: CsFormField(
      label: 'Bucket name',
      child: CsInput(value: name, onChange: (v) => setState(() => name = v)),
    ),
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for a page or section whose purpose is to submit a set of fields.
- Do not use for a single inline edit (edit the value in place) or for multi-page flows (use a wizard).
- Put field errors on each `CsFormField`; use `errorText` here for failures that are not about one field (a server error, a quota).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | The form content, usually containers of form fields. |
| `header` | `Widget?` | `null` | Usually a `CsHeader` with `CsHeaderVariant.h1`. |
| `errorText` | `String?` | `null` | Form-level error in an error alert under the content, announced. |
| `errorWidget` | `Widget?` | `null` | Rich error content in place of `errorText`. |
| `errorIconAriaLabel` | `String?` | "Error" | Name of the alert icon. |
| `actions` | `Widget?` | `null` | Primary actions at the end of the row: a link-variant Cancel and a primary submit, in a horizontal `CsSpaceBetween` of size xs. |
| `secondaryActions` | `Widget?` | `null` | Actions at the start of the row. |
| `variant` | `CsFormVariant` | `fullPage` | Kept for parity; Cloudscape no longer draws variants differently. |

## Examples

### Submit with a form-level error

```dart
CsForm(
  header: const CsHeader(variant: CsHeaderVariant.h1, title: 'Create distribution'),
  errorText: submitError,
  secondaryActions: CsButton(text: 'Save draft', onPress: () {}),
  actions: CsSpaceBetween(
    direction: CsSpaceBetweenDirection.horizontal,
    size: CsSpacingSize.xs,
    children: [
      CsButton(text: 'Cancel', variant: CsButtonVariant.link, onPress: () {}),
      CsButton(
        text: 'Create distribution',
        variant: CsButtonVariant.primary,
        loading: saving,
        onPress: () {},
      ),
    ],
  ),
  child: fields,
)
```

## Accessibility

- The error alert is a live region read as "Error, <text>" when it appears, with an icon so status is not color alone.
- Tab order follows the layout: header, fields, then the action row (primary actions first in the row as Cloudscape lays it out in reverse).
- After a failed submit, move focus to the first invalid field.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

The action row wraps: when the primary and secondary actions do not fit side by side, the secondary actions move to their own line under the primary ones, both aligned to the end. Spacing follows the density (`space-scaled-*`).

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `child` |
| `header` | `header` |
| `errorText` | `errorText` / `errorWidget` |
| `errorIconAriaLabel` | `errorIconAriaLabel` |
| `actions` | `actions` |
| `secondaryActions` | `secondaryActions` |
| `variant` (`full-page`, `embedded`) | `variant` (`fullPage`, `embedded`) |
| `analyticsMetadata` | web only |

---
source: doc/components/CsFormField.md

# CsFormField

Wraps a form control with its label, description, constraint text, character count and validation message.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/form-field/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Bucket name',
  description: 'The name must be unique across all accounts.',
  constraintText: 'Use 3 to 63 characters.',
  errorText: nameError,
  child: CsInput(value: name, invalid: nameError != null, onChange: (v) => setState(() => name = v)),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use around every input, textarea, select, radio group, tiles or slider in a form.
- A checkbox or toggle carries its own label; wrap it only when it needs a group label or an error.
- Use `CsForm` for the page-level frame and form-level errors.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The control. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Bold label above the control. |
| `labelWidget` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom label in place of `label`. |
| `labelHidden` | `bool` | `false` | Keep the label for screen readers only. |
| `info` | `Widget?` | `null` | An "Info" link after the label, separated by a divider. |
| `description` / `descriptionWidget` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | Body-s text under the label. |
| `constraintText` | `String?` | `null` | Rules for the value, under the control. |
| `characterCountText` | `String?` | `null` | For example `'12/63'`, after the constraint text. |
| `errorText` | `String?` | `null` | Red message with an error icon, announced. Replaces the warning. |
| `warningText` | `String?` | `null` | Yellow message with a warning icon. |
| `secondaryControl` | `Widget?` | `null` | A control beside the main one (a Remove button). Moves under it at or below 688px. |
| `stretch` | `bool` | `false` | Let the control take the full width; otherwise it takes 66% on wide layouts. |
| `errorIconAriaLabel` / `warningIconAriaLabel` | `String?` | "Error" / "Warning" | Names of the status icons. |

## Examples

### Info link and character count

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Description',
  info: CsLink(text: 'Info', variant: CsLinkVariant.info, onFollow: () {}),
  characterCountText: '${description.length}/200',
  stretch: true,
  child: CsTextarea(value: description, onChange: (v) => setState(() => description = v)),
)
```

### Secondary control

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Tag key',
  secondaryControl: CsButton(text: 'Remove', onPress: () {}),
  child: CsInput(value: key, onChange: (v) => setState(() => key = v)),
)
```

### Warning

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Tag value',
  warningText: 'Changing production tags can affect cost reports.',
  child: CsInput(value: tag, warning: true, onChange: (v) => setState(() => tag = v)),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The error and warning messages are live regions read as "Error. <text>" or "Warning. <text>" when they appear; the status is shown by icon and text, never color alone.
- With `labelHidden` the label stays in the semantics tree.
- Set the control's `invalid` or `warning` together with the message so the field border matches.

## Motion

None. Messages appear and disappear instantly, as in Cloudscape.

## Mobile

At or below 688px the control takes the full width and `secondaryControl` moves under it. Label, description and messages wrap at 2x text.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `label` | `label` / `labelWidget` |
| `info` | `info` |
| `description` | `description` / `descriptionWidget` |
| `constraintText` | `constraintText` |
| `characterCountText` | `characterCountText` |
| `errorText` / `warningText` | `errorText` / `warningText` |
| `secondaryControl` | `secondaryControl` |
| `stretch` | `stretch` |
| `i18nStrings.errorIconAriaLabel` / `warningIconAriaLabel` | `errorIconAriaLabel` / `warningIconAriaLabel` |
| `children` | `child` |
| `controlId`, `analyticsMetadata` | web only |

source: doc/components/CsGrid.md

# CsGrid

Cloudscape's `Grid`: a 12-column responsive grid where each child sets its span, offset, push and pull per breakpoint.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/grid/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsGrid(
  gridDefinition: [
    CsGridDefinition(colspan: {CsBreakpoint.base: 12, CsBreakpoint.xs: 8}),
    CsGridDefinition(colspan: {CsBreakpoint.base: 12, CsBreakpoint.xs: 4}),
  ],
  children: [Text('Main'), Text('Aside')],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use the grid for page-level layouts with unequal columns. Use `CsColumnLayout` for equal columns and `CsSpaceBetween` for simple stacks.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` |  |  |
| `gridDefinition` | `List<CsGridDefinition>` | `[]` | One per child; children without one span 12 |
| `disableGutters` | `bool` | `false` | Removes `space-grid-gutter` between cells |

## Examples

### Same values at every breakpoint

```dart
const CsGrid(
  gridDefinition: [CsGridDefinition.all(colspan: 6, offset: 3)],
  children: [Text('Centered')],
)
```

### Reorder with push and pull

```dart
const CsGrid(
  gridDefinition: [
    CsGridDefinition.all(colspan: 6, push: 6),
    CsGridDefinition.all(colspan: 6, pull: 6),
  ],
  children: [Text('First in order'), Text('Second in order')],
)
```

## Accessibility

Children are read in source order regardless of push and pull, so keep the source order meaningful.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Breakpoints follow the grid's own width (Cloudscape container query): `base` under 465, `xxs` 465, `xs` 688, `s` 912, `m` 1120, `l` 1320, `xl` 1840. A missing breakpoint falls back to the nearest smaller one. Cells that do not fit wrap to a new row; cells in a row stretch to the tallest.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `gridDefinition` | `gridDefinition: [CsGridDefinition(...)]` |
| `colspan / offset / push / pull (number)` | `CsGridDefinition.all(colspan:, offset:, push:, pull:)` |
| `colspan / offset / push / pull (mapping)` | `Map<CsBreakpoint, int>`; `default` is `CsBreakpoint.base` |
| `disableGutters` | `disableGutters` |

---
source: doc/components/CsHeader.md
---

# CsHeader

Cloudscape's `Header`: the title of a page, container or section, with a counter, info link, description, secondary content and actions.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/header/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsHeader(
  variant: CsHeaderVariant.h1,
  title: 'Distributions',
  counter: '(24)',
  description: 'Sample distributions in this account.',
  actions: CsButton(text: 'Create distribution', variant: CsButtonVariant.primary, onPress: () {}),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use `h1` once per page for the page title, `h2` for container titles and `h3` for sections inside a container. Use `awsuiH1Sticky` for full-page tables and cards whose header sticks. For plain headings in text use `CsBox` variants.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String?` |  | Heading text (Cloudscape `children`); pass this or `titleWidget` |
| `titleWidget` | `Widget?` |  | Custom heading content |
| `variant` | `CsHeaderVariant` | `h2` | `h1` (heading-xl), `h2` (heading-l), `h3` (heading-m), `awsuiH1Sticky` |
| `counter` | `String?` |  | "(12)" in `color-text-counter`, normal weight |
| `info` | `Widget?` |  | Info link after the title |
| `description` | `String?` |  | Text under the title in `color-text-heading-secondary` |
| `descriptionWidget` | `Widget?` |  | Custom description |
| `actions` | `Widget?` |  | Buttons at the end of the title row |
| `secondaryContent` | `Widget?` |  | Content between the title and the actions |
| `headingTagOverride` | `int?` |  | Heading level announced, 1 to 6 |

## Examples

### Sticky page header while stuck

```dart
const CsHeaderStickyScope(
  stuck: true,
  child: CsHeader(variant: CsHeaderVariant.awsuiH1Sticky, title: 'Instances', description: 'Hidden while stuck'),
)
```

### Secondary content

```dart
CsHeader(
  title: 'Origins',
  secondaryContent: const CsStatusIndicator(text: 'Healthy'),
  actions: CsButton(text: 'Add origin', onPress: () {}),
)
```

## Accessibility

The title is a heading (`Semantics.header`) with `headingLevel` from the variant (1, 2, 3) or `headingTagOverride`. The counter is part of the heading text.

## Motion

None. `awsuiH1Sticky` switches size instantly when `CsHeaderStickyScope.stuck` changes.

## Mobile

The title and actions share a row when both fit at their natural widths (CSS flex-wrap) and the actions move under the title otherwise. The title is centered on the 32px button row. Everything wraps at 2x text.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `title` / `titleWidget` |
| `variant` | `variant` (`CsHeaderVariant`, `awsui-h1-sticky` is `awsuiH1Sticky`) |
| `counter` | `counter` |
| `info` | `info` |
| `description` | `description` / `descriptionWidget` |
| `actions` | `actions` |
| `secondaryContent` | `secondaryContent` |
| `headingTagOverride` | `headingTagOverride` (int) |
| `(sticky state)` | `CsHeaderStickyScope` |

# CsHelpPanel

Cloudscape's `HelpPanel`: help content for the app layout's tools panel, with a header, body and a footer of related links.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/help-panel/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsHelpPanel(
  header: 'Instances',
  child: CsHelpPanel.paragraph('An instance is a virtual server.'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it as the `tools` content of `CsAppLayout` to explain the current page. Keep it short; link to longer documentation in the footer.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `header` | `String?` |  | Panel title |
| `headerWidget` | `Widget?` |  | Custom title |
| `child` | `Widget?` |  | The help content |
| `footer` | `Widget?` |  | Related links under a divider |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Spinner instead of the content |
| `loadingText` | `String?` |  | Defaults to "Loading" |

## Examples

### Text helpers

```dart
CsHelpPanel(
  header: 'Buckets',
  footer: CsLink(text: 'Bucket naming rules', onFollow: () {}),
  child: Column(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
    children: [
      CsHelpPanel.paragraph('Buckets hold objects.'),
      CsHelpPanel.heading('Versioning'),
      CsHelpPanel.list(const ['Enabled', 'Suspended']),
      CsHelpPanel.divider(),
      CsHelpPanel.code('aws s3 ls'),
    ],
  ),
)
```

### Loading

```dart
const CsHelpPanel(loading: true, loadingText: 'Loading help content')
```

## Accessibility

The header is a level-2 heading; `heading()` adds headings in the content. The loading text is a live region.

## Motion

None; the spinner runs only while `loading`.

## Mobile

Content wraps; in `CsAppLayout` on phones the panel opens full screen.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `header` | `header` / `headerWidget` |
| `children` | `child` |
| `footer` | `footer` |
| `loading / loadingText` | `loading` / `loadingText` |
| `(HTML content styles)` | `CsHelpPanel.heading/paragraph/list/divider/code` |
