# CsHotspot

A marked place in the app that a tutorial step points to; while a tutorial runs it shows a marker that opens the step's annotation popover.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/hotspot/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

Widget createButton(VoidCallback create) => CsHotspot(
  hotspotId: 'create-bucket-button',
  child: CsButton(text: 'Create bucket', variant: CsButtonVariant.primary, onPress: create),
);
```

## When to use / when not to

- Wrap each control or field a tutorial step refers to. A hotspot outside a running tutorial (or one the tutorial does not use) renders only its child, so it can stay in the code.
- Without a child, the marker sits inline, for example in a checkbox label.
- Hotspot IDs are unique in the whole app; several tutorials can reuse one.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hotspotId` | `String` | required | ID that `CsTutorialStep.hotspotId` refers to. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | The marked element. Without it the marker is inline with `space-xxs` on both sides. |
| `side` | `CsHotspotSide` | `right` | Side of the child the marker sits on (`left`, `right`). |
| `direction` | `CsSide` | `CsSide.top` | Side the annotation popover opens on; it flips when there is no room. |

## Examples

### Inline marker in a label

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

Widget versioning() => const Row(
  children: [
    Text('Enable versioning'),
    CsHotspot(hotspotId: 'versioning', direction: CsSide.bottom),
  ],
);
```

## Accessibility

The marker is a button named by `labelHotspot` ("Annotation for step 1 of 3") with an expanded state, and a 24px hit area (44px on touch screens). The popover takes focus when nothing else has it; Escape and its close button dismiss it, and focus returns to the marker. Previous and Next are disabled when their step's hotspot is not on screen.

## Motion

The popover scales and fades from the marker and follows it while scrolling; opening a step scrolls its hotspot into view. While a tutorial runs, the current step's marker pulses three times (an expanding ring over 2s each) when it becomes current, then rests. Reduced motion turns the pulse and the scroll animation off.

## Mobile

The popover is at most 310px wide, stays inside the screen, and scrolls when its content is taller than the room available. Step buttons wrap under the step counter on narrow screens.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `hotspotId` | `hotspotId` |
| `side` (`'left'`, `'right'`) | `side` (`CsHotspotSide`) |
| `direction` (`'top'`, `'right'`, `'bottom'`, `'left'`) | `direction` (`CsSide`) |
| `children` | `child` |

---
source: doc/components/CsIcon.md
---

# CsIcon

Cloudscape's `Icon`: one of the 148 built-in `CsIcons`, drawn as a vector outline in the current text color, with Cloudscape's stroke width for each size.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/icon/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsIcon(CsIcons.statusPositive, variant: CsIconVariant.success)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use icons to support a label or status, not to replace text people need to read. Most components take an `icon` parameter directly (`CsButton(icon: CsIcons.addPlus)`), so you rarely build `CsIcon` yourself.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `CsIconData` | | A `CsIcons` icon or your own `CsIconData` |
| `size` | `CsIconSize` | `normal` | `xSmall` 12, `small` 16, `normal` 16 (20px line), `medium` 20, `big` 32, `large` 48 |
| `variant` | `CsIconVariant` | `normal` | `normal` (current color), `disabled`, `inverted`, `subtle`, `warning`, `error`, `success`, `link`, `info` |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Without it the icon is decorative and hidden from screen readers |
| `badge` | `bool` | `false` | A small dot at the top end corner |
| `mapHeight` | `bool` | `false` | Size the box to the icon's line height, to align with text |
| `dangerouslySetColor` | `Color?` | | Raw color override |

`CsIcon.custom(widget)` puts an image or any widget in an icon-sized box (Cloudscape `url` / `svg`). `CsIcons.all` lists every icon; `CsIcons.byName('status-positive')` looks one up by its Cloudscape name.

## Examples

### Sizes

```dart
const Row(children: [
  CsIcon(CsIcons.settings, size: CsIconSize.small),
  CsIcon(CsIcons.settings, size: CsIconSize.medium),
  CsIcon(CsIcons.settings, size: CsIconSize.big),
])
```

### Custom icon data

```dart
const CsIcon(CsIconData('diamond', [CsIconPart('M8 1L15 8L8 15L1 8Z', roundJoin: true)]))
```

## Accessibility

Decorative by default. Pass `semanticLabel` when the icon carries meaning on its own. Directional icons (arrows, angles, external, undo, redo, send) mirror in right-to-left layouts.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Icons keep their size; tappable icons go in `CsButton(variant: icon)` for a 44px hit area.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `name="status-positive"` | `CsIcons.statusPositive` |
| `size`, `variant`, `badge` | same names |
| `ariaLabel`, `alt` | `semanticLabel` |
| `url`, `svg` | `CsIcon.custom(widget)` |

---
source: doc/components/CsIconProvider.md
---

# CsIconProvider

Cloudscape's `IconProvider` (`src/icon-provider`): replaces built-in icons by name for everything below it, including the icons inside components.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/icon-provider/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsIconProvider(
  icons: {'close': CsIcons.arrowLeft, 'status-positive': CsIcons.check},
  child: Text('Content'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to adapt the icon set to a brand or a platform convention (a back arrow in place of a close icon in a full-screen flow) without changing each component. Do not use it to change one icon in one place; pass a different `icon` there.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icons` | `Map<String, CsIconData?>?` |  | Overrides by Cloudscape icon name (`'close'`, `'caret-down-filled'`); a `null` value resets that name |
| `iconWidgets` | `Map<String, Widget?>?` |  | Widget overrides (an image, an SVG widget), sized like the icon they replace; wins over `icons` for the same name |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The subtree |

`CsIconProvider.reset(child:)` resets every override from outer providers (Cloudscape `icons={null}`).

Names are the `name` of `CsIconData` (the Cloudscape icon name). `CsIcons.byName('settings')` looks a built-in icon up by name.

## Examples

### Nested providers

```dart
const CsIconProvider(
  icons: {'close': CsIcons.arrowLeft},
  child: Column(
    children: [
      CsIcon(CsIcons.close),
      CsIconProvider(icons: {'close': null}, child: CsIcon(CsIcons.close)),
    ],
  ),
)
```

### Custom drawing

```dart
CsIconProvider(
  icons: const {
    'notification': CsIconData('notification', [CsIconPart('M3 12h10M5 12V7a3 3 0 0 1 6 0v5M7 14h2', roundJoin: true)]),
  },
  child: CsButton(icon: CsIcons.notification, variant: CsButtonVariant.icon, semanticLabel: 'Notifications', onPress: () {}),
)
```

### Image in place of an icon

```dart
const CsIconProvider(
  iconWidgets: {'user-profile': ColoredBox(color: Color(0xFF0972D3))},
  child: CsIcon(CsIcons.userProfile, size: CsIconSize.medium),
)
```

## Accessibility

An override keeps the icon's `semanticLabel`. Decorative icons stay hidden from screen readers.

## Motion

None. Changing the overrides rebuilds the icons below.

## Mobile

No layout change: an override is drawn in the size of the icon it replaces.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `icons` (`ReactNode` values) | `icons` (`CsIconData`) or `iconWidgets` (`Widget`) |
| `icons={null}` | `CsIconProvider.reset` |
| `{name: null}` | `null` map value |
| `componentIcons` (table, tree view, expandable section stateful icons) | not supported yet |
| infinite loop when an override uses its own name | never loops: an override is drawn with its own name reset |

---
source: doc/components/CsInput.md
---

# CsInput

A single-line text field for names, IDs, numbers, passwords and search queries.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/input/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Bucket name',
  child: CsInput(
    value: name,
    placeholder: 'example-bucket',
    onChange: (v) => setState(() => name = v),
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for short free-form values: a resource name, a tag value, a number with a unit.
- Use `CsTextarea` for text that spans lines, a select for a fixed list of values, and `CsSlider` when the relative position in a range matters more than the exact number.
- Always give it a label: a `CsFormField`, `inlineLabelText` or `ariaLabel`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String` | required | The controlled text. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Called with the new text on every edit. |
| `onSubmit` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Enter or the keyboard action key. |
| `onFocus` / `onBlur` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Focus enters or leaves the field. |
| `onKeyEvent` | `FocusOnKeyEventCallback?` | `null` | Key events before the text field handles them (Cloudscape `onKeyDown`). Return `KeyEventResult.handled` to stop a key. |
| `type` | `CsInputType` | `text` | `text`, `password` (obscured), `search` (search icon and clear button), `number`, `email`, `url` (keyboard type). |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | `null` | Italic hint while empty. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Not focusable or editable, disabled colors. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Focusable and selectable, not editable. |
| `invalid` | `bool` | `false` | Error border with an 8px start edge. Pair with `CsFormField.errorText`. |
| `warning` | `bool` | `false` | Warning border. Ignored when `invalid`. |
| `prefix` / `suffix` | `Widget?` | `null` | Fixed content before or after the value (`https://`, `GiB`), separated by a divider and colored by the status. Ignored for search inputs. |
| `inlineLabelText` | `String?` | `null` | A small label on the field's top border, for layouts without a form field. |
| `leading` / `trailing` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom content inside the field before or after the text. |
| `mono` | `bool` | `false` | Monospace text for IDs and ARNs. |
| `autoFocus` | `bool` | `false` | Focus on mount. |
| `autoComplete` | `bool` | `true` | Platform suggestions and autofill. |
| `spellcheck` | `bool` | `true` | Spell checking and autocorrect. |
| `keyboardType` | `TextInputType?` | from `type` | Cloudscape `inputMode`. |
| `textInputAction` | `TextInputAction?` | `search` for search | Keyboard action key. |
| `inputFormatters` | `List<TextInputFormatter>?` | `null` | For example `FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly`. |
| `autofillHints` | `Iterable<String>?` | `null` | Used when `autoComplete` is true. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name without a visible label. |
| `ariaRequired` | `bool` | `false` | Adds a "Required" hint. |
| `clearAriaLabel` | `String?` | "Clear" | Name of the search clear button. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |

## Examples

### Search

```dart
CsInput(
  type: CsInputType.search,
  value: query,
  placeholder: 'Find instances',
  ariaLabel: 'Find instances',
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => query = v),
)
```

### Number with a unit suffix

```dart
CsInput(
  type: CsInputType.number,
  value: size,
  suffix: const Text('GiB'),
  inputFormatters: [FilteringTextInputFormatter.digitsOnly],
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => size = v),
)
```

### Prefix and inline label

```dart
CsInput(
  value: subdomain,
  inlineLabelText: 'Subdomain',
  prefix: const Text('https://'),
  suffix: const Text('.example.com'),
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => subdomain = v),
)
```

### Validation

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Bucket name',
  errorText: error,
  child: CsInput(
    value: name,
    invalid: error != null,
    onChange: (v) => setState(() => name = v),
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Exposed as a text field with its label (from `CsFormField`, `ariaLabel` or `inlineLabelText`), enabled and read-only state, and a "Required" hint with `ariaRequired`.
- Prefix and suffix are decorative to screen readers; put their meaning in the label.
- The search clear button is a labelled button reachable with Tab.

## Motion

Focus switches the border to `color-border-input-focused` and draws a 1px ring (2px when invalid or warning) instantly, as Cloudscape does. Nothing animates.

## Mobile

32px tall (28px compact), with a minimum height so 2x text grows the field instead of clipping. Prefix and suffix are capped at 160px and ellipsize, leaving room to type at 390px. `type` picks the matching on-screen keyboard.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` / `onChange` | `value` / `onChange` |
| `type` | `type` (`CsInputType`) |
| `placeholder` | `placeholder` |
| `disabled` / `readOnly` | `disabled` / `readOnly` |
| `invalid` / `warning` | `invalid` / `warning` |
| `autoFocus` | `autoFocus` |
| `autoComplete` | `autoComplete` (+ `autofillHints`) |
| `spellcheck`, `disableBrowserAutocorrect` | `spellcheck` |
| `inputMode` | `keyboardType` |
| `step` | not supported; use `inputFormatters` |
| `prefix` / `suffix` | `prefix` / `suffix` |
| `inlineLabelText` | `inlineLabelText` |
| `onKeyDown` / `onKeyUp` | `onKeyEvent` |
| `onFocus` / `onBlur` | `onFocus` / `onBlur` |
| `onDelayedInput` (autosuggest) | not supported; debounce in `onChange` |
| `ariaLabel`, `ariaRequired` | `ariaLabel`, `ariaRequired` |
| `clearAriaLabel` | `clearAriaLabel` |
| `name`, `controlId`, `ariaDescribedby`, `ariaLabelledby`, `nativeInputAttributes`, `style` | web only |

---
source: doc/components/CsItemCard.md
---

# CsItemCard

Cloudscape's `ItemCard`: a bordered card for one item, with an icon, title, description and actions in the header, content and a footer.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/item-card/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsItemCard(
  icon: const CsIcon(CsIcons.folder),
  header: const Text('example-bucket'),
  description: const Text('us-east-1'),
  footer: const Text('Updated 2 hours ago'),
  child: const Text('Versioning enabled'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use an item card to present one resource in a grid or list of similar resources. `CsCards` builds a collection of them. Use `CsActionCard` when the whole card is a single action, and `CsContainer` for a page section.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `header` | `Widget?` |  | Title, heading-s |
| `description` | `Widget?` |  | Under the title, body-s secondary |
| `icon` | `Widget?` |  | Before the title |
| `actions` | `Widget?` |  | End of the header row; wraps below when narrow |
| `child` | `Widget?` |  | Content |
| `footer` | `Widget?` |  | Bottom content |
| `variant` | `CsItemCardVariant` | `defaultVariant` | `defaultVariant` (16px radius, 20px padding) or `embedded` (8px, 12px) |
| `disableHeaderPaddings`, `disableContentPaddings`, `disableFooterPaddings` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `fitHeight` | `bool` | `false` | Fill a bounded height; the footer goes to the bottom |
| `highlighted` | `bool` | `false` | Selected look (used by `CsCards`) |
| `onPress` / `semanticLabel` | `VoidCallback?` / `String?` |  | Makes the card pressable |
| `style` | `CsItemCardStyle?` |  | Background, border, radius, shadow, paddings and footer divider |

## Examples

### Embedded with actions

```dart
CsItemCard(
  variant: CsItemCardVariant.embedded,
  header: const Text('i-0abc123'),
  actions: CsButton(icon: CsIcons.ellipsis, variant: CsButtonVariant.icon, semanticLabel: 'Actions', onPress: () {}),
  child: const CsStatusIndicator(text: 'Running'),
)
```

### Footer divider through style

```dart
const CsItemCard(
  header: Text('example-bucket'),
  style: CsItemCardStyle(footerDividerColor: Color(0xFFE9EBED)),
  footer: Text('3 objects'),
  child: Text('Standard storage'),
)
```

## Accessibility

The card is a semantics container and its title a heading. With `onPress` the card is a focusable button with `semanticLabel` and exposes `highlighted` as selected.

## Motion

Highlight changes ease the background and border over `CsDurations.showPaced`; reduced motion is instant.

## Mobile

Actions wrap under the title below 200px of header width. Text wraps; minimum heights only.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `header`, `description`, `footer`, `actions`, `icon`, `children` | same (`child`) |
| `variant: 'default'` | `CsItemCardVariant.defaultVariant` |
| `style` | `CsItemCardStyle` |
| internal `highlighted`, `onClick` | `highlighted`, `onPress` |
| `nativeAttributes` | web only, not ported |

---
source: doc/components/CsItemsPalette.md
---

# CsItemsPalette

A catalog of items people drag onto a `CsBoard`, with an add button as the keyboard and screen reader alternative.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/items-palette/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsItemsPalette<String>(
  items: const [
    CsItemsPaletteItem(
      id: 'traffic',
      data: 'Network traffic',
      definition: CsBoardItemDefinition(defaultColumnSpan: 2, defaultRowSpan: 3),
    ),
  ],
  renderItem: (context, item, ctx) => CsBoardItem(
    header: CsHeader(title: item.data),
    child: Text(ctx.showPreview ? 'Bytes in and out per minute' : 'Shows network traffic'),
  ),
  onItemAdd: (item) {},
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use with a `CsBoard`, usually in a split panel or drawer next to it.
- Remove an item from `items` once it is on the board (from `onItemsChange`'s `addedItem` or from `onItemAdd`).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<CsItemsPaletteItem<T>>` | required | `id`, `data` and an optional `definition` whose default spans size the item on the board. `toBoardEntry()` converts one. |
| `renderItem` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, CsItemsPaletteItem<T>, CsItemsPaletteItemContext)` | required | Return a `CsBoardItem`. `showPreview` is true while the item is dragged over a board. |
| `onItemAdd` | `ValueChanged<CsItemsPaletteItem<T>>?` | `null` | Adds without dragging. Shows an add button on each item and makes Enter or Space on the drag handle add the item. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsItemsPaletteI18nStrings` | English | `liveAnnouncementDndStarted`, `liveAnnouncementDndDiscarded`. |
| `columns` | `int?` | `null` | Forces a column count; by default 1 below 688px, 2 below 912px, 3 above. |

## Examples

### Adding with the button

```dart
CsItemsPalette<String>(
  items: const [CsItemsPaletteItem(id: 'errors', data: 'Error rate')],
  renderItem: (context, item, ctx) => CsBoardItem(header: CsHeader(title: item.data)),
  onItemAdd: (item) => setState(() {}),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Dragging is pointer only, as in Cloudscape's palette; `onItemAdd` gives keyboard and screen reader users an equivalent (the add button, or Enter on the drag handle). Always provide it.
- The start of a drag and a drop outside a board are announced.

## Motion

The dragged item follows the pointer, keeping its offset from the finger; the item left in the palette dims to 50% until the drag ends. Over a board, the board shows where the item will land.

## Mobile

Drag by the handle (immediately) or press and hold anywhere on the item (touch, with haptic feedback). Items stack in one column below 688px.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `items` | `items` (`CsItemsPaletteItem<T>`) |
| `renderItem(item, context)` | `renderItem(context, item, itemContext)` |
| `i18nStrings.liveAnnouncementDndStarted`, `liveAnnouncementDndDiscarded` | `i18nStrings` |
| `i18nStrings.navigationAriaLabel`, `navigationAriaDescription`, `navigationItemAriaLabel` | not applicable (deprecated, no effect) |
| (none) | `onItemAdd`, the keyboard alternative |

source: doc/components/CsKeyValuePairs.md

# CsKeyValuePairs

Labeled values of a resource in up to four responsive columns, such as the details section of an instance or a distribution.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/key-value-pairs/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';

const details = CsKeyValuePairs(
  columns: 3,
  items: [
    CsKeyValuePair(label: 'Distribution ID', value: 'd111111abcdef8'),
    CsKeyValuePair(label: 'Price class', value: 'Use all edge locations'),
    CsKeyValuePair(label: 'Domain name', value: 'd111111abcdef8.cloudfront.example'),
  ],
);
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for read-only properties of one resource, usually inside a `CsContainer` on a details page.
- Group related pairs with `CsKeyValueGroup` and a title when there are many.
- Do not use it for editable values (use a form) or for many resources (use a table).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<CsKeyValueItem>` | required | `CsKeyValuePair`s and `CsKeyValueGroup`s, mixed freely, laid out row by row. |
| `columns` | `int` | `1` | Maximum columns, 1 to 4 (values above 4 use 4). |
| `minColumnWidth` | `double` | `150` | Minimum width of a column. Fewer columns are used when they do not fit. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name of the whole list. |

`CsKeyValuePair`:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` | required | The key. |
| `labelWidget` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom label content. |
| `value` | `String?` | `null` | The value as text. One of `value` and `valueWidget` is required. |
| `valueWidget` | `Widget?` | `null` | The value as a widget (status indicator, link, copy control). Wins over `value`. |
| `info` | `Widget?` | `null` | Area after the label, usually an "Info" link. |
| `id` | `String?` | `null` | Stable identifier, used as the pair's key. |

`CsKeyValueGroup`: `items` (`List<CsKeyValuePair>`, required) and `title` (`String?`, an h3 heading).

`CsKeyValuePairs.columnCountFor(columns, minColumnWidth, width)` returns the columns used at a width.

## Examples

### Values with status and an info link

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

Widget details(VoidCallback openHelp) => CsKeyValuePairs(
  columns: 2,
  items: [
    const CsKeyValuePair(label: 'Instance ID', value: 'i-0abc123'),
    CsKeyValuePair(
      label: 'State',
      info: CsLink(text: 'Info', variant: CsLinkVariant.info, onFollow: openHelp),
      valueWidget: const CsStatusIndicator(type: CsStatusType.success, text: 'Running'),
    ),
  ],
);
```

### Groups

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';

const groups = CsKeyValuePairs(
  columns: 2,
  items: [
    CsKeyValueGroup(
      title: 'Origin',
      items: [
        CsKeyValuePair(label: 'Bucket', value: 'example-bucket'),
        CsKeyValuePair(label: 'Origin path', value: '/static'),
      ],
    ),
    CsKeyValueGroup(
      title: 'Behavior',
      items: [CsKeyValuePair(label: 'Viewer protocol', value: 'Redirect HTTP to HTTPS')],
    ),
  ],
);
```

## Accessibility

Each pair is its own semantics node, so a screen reader reads the label and then its value. Links inside values default to the underlined primary variant (`CsLinkDefaults`), as in Cloudscape. Pass `ariaLabel` when the list has no visible heading.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Columns follow the width, not the device: at most `columns`, each at least `minColumnWidth` wide, and an even count when wrapping (four columns become two, never three). At 390px with the default 150px minimum, four columns become two, and inside a padded container usually one. Labels and values wrap; nothing overflows at 2x text.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `items` (`type: 'pair'`) | `CsKeyValuePair` |
| `items` (`type: 'group'`) | `CsKeyValueGroup` |
| `columns` | `columns` |
| `minColumnWidth` | `minColumnWidth` |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `ariaLabelledby` | not applicable (use `ariaLabel`) |
| pair `label`, `value`, `info`, `id` | `label`/`labelWidget`, `value`/`valueWidget`, `info`, `id` |

source: doc/components/CsLineChart.md

# CsLineChart

A line chart that shows how one or more values change over a continuous range, usually time, with optional thresholds.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/line-chart/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
final cpu = CsChartSeries<DateTime>.line(
  title: 'i-0abc123',
  data: [
    CsChartDatum(DateTime(2026, 11, 1, 8), 42),
    CsChartDatum(DateTime(2026, 11, 1, 9), 57),
    CsChartDatum(DateTime(2026, 11, 1, 10), 49),
  ],
  valueFormatter: (y, x) => '$y%',
);

CsLineChart<DateTime>(
  series: [cpu, const CsChartSeries<DateTime>.threshold(title: 'Alarm', y: 80)],
  xScaleType: CsChartScaleType.time,
  yDomain: const [0, 100],
  yTitle: 'CPU utilization (%)',
  height: 300,
  ariaLabel: 'CPU utilization',
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for trends over time or another continuous range, and to compare a few series against a threshold.
- Use `CsBarChart` to compare categories, `CsAreaChart` to show how parts add up to a total, `CsPieChart` for parts of a single whole.
- Keep it under about 10 series; past that, filter or split the chart.

## Parameters

`T` is the x value type: `num` (`int`, `double`) for linear and log axes, `DateTime` for time axes, `String` for categories. Series, data and helper types are documented in [CsChartSeries](CsChartSeries.md).

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `series` | `List<CsChartSeries<T>>` | required | The series, in legend order. Keep the same instances between builds: the chart compares series by identity. |
| `visibleSeries` | `List<CsChartSeries<T>>?` | `null` | Series shown. Null lets the built-in filter manage it; pass a list and update it in `onFilterChange` to control it. |
| `onFilterChange` | `ValueChanged<List<CsChartSeries<T>>>?` | `null` | The built-in filter changed the visible series. |
| `highlightedSeries` | `CsChartSeries<T>?` | `null` | Series to highlight. The chart also highlights on hover and focus; a new value passed here replaces the current highlight. |
| `onHighlightChange` | `ValueChanged<CsChartSeries<T>?>?` | `null` | The user highlighted a series (legend, point, keyboard) or cleared it. |
| `xScaleType` | `CsChartScaleType` | `CsChartScaleType.linear` | `linear`, `log`, `time` (`DateTime` x) or `categorical` (needed for bars). |
| `yScaleType` | `CsChartYScaleType` | `linear` | `linear` or `log`. |
| `xDomain` | `List<T>?` | `null` | `[min, max]` for numbers and dates, the ordered categories for `categorical`. Null fits all series (hidden ones too, so filtering never rescales). |
| `yDomain` | `List<num>?` | `null` | `[min, max]`. Null fits all data plus zero and rounds out to tick steps. |
| `xTitle / yTitle` | `String?` | `null` | Bold axis titles: x below the axis, y above the plot. |
| `legendTitle` | `String?` | `null` | Bold title above the legend. |
| `xTickFormatter` | `CsChartTickFormatter<T>?` | `null` | Formats x ticks and the popover title. `\n` makes two lines. Default: numbers as written, dates by span (`Nov 3`, `14:00`, `Mar 2026`). |
| `yTickFormatter` | `CsChartTickFormatter<num>?` | `null` | Formats value ticks. |
| `emphasizeBaselineAxis` | `bool` | `true` | Draws the zero line 2px wide. |
| `height` | `double` | `500` | Plot height in logical pixels; axis labels and titles add to it. |
| `fitHeight` | `bool` | `false` | Fill a parent with bounded height. Without a bounded parent it falls back to `height`. |
| `hideFilter` | `bool` | `false` | Hides the built-in series filter. |
| `hideLegend` | `bool` | `false` | Hides the legend. |
| `additionalFilters` | `Widget?` | `null` | Extra filters placed next to the built-in one. |
| `statusType` | `CsChartStatusType` | `finished` | `loading`, `finished` or `error`. |
| `empty / noMatch` | `Widget?` | `null` | Shown when `series` is empty / when the filter hides every series. |
| `loadingText / errorText / recoveryText` | `String?` | `null` | Status copy. Defaults: "Loading chart", "The data couldn't be fetched. Try again later.", "Retry". |
| `onRecoveryClick` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called from the recovery link next to `errorText`. Without it there is no link. |
| `detailPopoverSize` | `CsChartPopoverSize` | `medium` | Popover max width: `small` 210, `medium` 310, `large` 482. |
| `detailPopoverFooter` | `Widget Function(T x)?` | `null` | Content under a divider at the bottom of the popover. |
| `detailPopoverSeriesContent` | `CsChartDetailPopoverSeriesContent<T>?` | `null` | Replaces a series row: other key or value, widgets, `subItems`, `expandable`. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsChartI18nStrings` | `const CsChartI18nStrings()` | Filter, legend, popover and screen reader labels (see CsChartSeries.md). |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name; match the visible heading. |
| `ariaDescription` | `String?` | `null` | Short summary read before the generated series and axis summary. |

## Examples

### Controlled filtering

```dart
CsLineChart<int>(
  series: series,
  visibleSeries: visible,
  onFilterChange: (next) => setState(() => visible = next),
  ariaLabel: 'Latency',
)
```

### Loading, error and empty

```dart
CsLineChart<DateTime>(
  series: const [],
  statusType: CsChartStatusType.error,
  errorText: 'Metrics could not be loaded.',
  recoveryText: 'Retry',
  onRecoveryClick: () {},
  empty: const Text('No metrics in this time range'),
  ariaLabel: 'Network in',
)
```

### Popover footer and tick formatting

```dart
CsLineChart<int>(
  series: series,
  xTitle: 'Hour',
  xTickFormatter: (x) => '${x.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:00',
  yTickFormatter: (y) => '${y}ms',
  detailPopoverFooter: (x) => CsLink(text: 'View logs', onFollow: () {}),
  ariaLabel: 'Latency',
)
```

## Accessibility

- The plot is one focusable element announced as `ariaLabel` plus the chart kind ("Line chart"), with a hint that reads `ariaDescription` and a generated summary (series titles, x range or categories, y range).
- Keyboard, as in Cloudscape: Tab focuses the plot and highlights the first position. Left and Right move between x positions (bar groups; Up and Down for horizontal bars), Up and Down cycle between all series and one series at a time, Home and End jump to the ends, Enter or Space pins the popover, Escape dismisses it.
- The semantics value is the highlighted position and every value ("h2, i-0abc123 20%, Alarm 45"); screen reader increase and decrease gestures move between positions.
- A 2px `color-border-item-focused` outline marks the focused point, x line or group.
- The legend is one tab stop with Left and Right between entries; each entry is a toggle button. The filter is a labelled button that opens a list of checkable rows.
- Loading, error and empty states sit in a live region. Series are never told apart by color alone: the legend, filter and popover pair each color with its title and marker shape (line, bar, dashed threshold).

## Motion

- Data animates in once when it first appears (250ms `motion-duration-complex`, `showPaced` easing): lines and areas reveal from the start of the x axis, bars grow out of the baseline, pie segments sweep clockwise.
- Dimming non-highlighted series and legend entries fades over 90ms (`motion-duration-transition-quick`), like Cloudscape's opacity transitions.
- The popover scales and fades in from its anchor (`CsAnchoredOverlay`).
- Reduced motion (`MediaQuery.disableAnimations` or the theme's `disableMotion`) shows everything at once.

## Mobile

- Touch: tap or drag a finger across the plot to scrub the crosshair (or bar groups) with a selection haptic per step; lifting the finger keeps the popover, pinned, with its close button. Tap outside to dismiss. Vertical drags still scroll the page.
- At or below 688px the popover opens above the highlighted point instead of beside it, so it gets the full width.
- The filter opens as a bottom sheet on phones (`CsDropdown`, `CsPresentation.auto`).
- Axis labels drop until they no longer overlap, and the legend wraps. Labels and popover text scale with the platform text size.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `series` (`title`, `type`, `data`, `color`, `valueFormatter`) | `series` with `CsChartSeries.line/.bar/.area/.threshold`; `color` is a `Color`, plus `colorToken` |
| threshold `y` / `x` | `CsChartSeries.threshold(y:)` / `CsChartSeries.threshold(x:)` |
| `xScaleType`, `yScaleType` | `xScaleType` (`CsChartScaleType`), `yScaleType` (`CsChartYScaleType`) |
| `xDomain`, `yDomain`, `xTitle`, `yTitle`, `legendTitle` | same names |
| `xTickFormatter`, `yTickFormatter` (also the deprecated `i18nStrings` versions) | `xTickFormatter`, `yTickFormatter` |
| `emphasizeBaselineAxis` | same name |
| `detailPopoverSeriesContent` | `detailPopoverSeriesContent` returning `CsChartSeriesDetail` |
| `height`, `fitHeight`, `hideFilter`, `hideLegend`, `additionalFilters` | same names |
| `statusType`, `empty`, `noMatch`, `loadingText`, `errorText`, `recoveryText`, `onRecoveryClick` | same names |
| `detailPopoverSize`, `detailPopoverFooter` | `detailPopoverSize` (`CsChartPopoverSize`), `detailPopoverFooter` (builder) |
| `visibleSeries` + `onFilterChange` (`detail.visibleSeries`) | `visibleSeries` + `onFilterChange(List)` |
| `highlightedSeries` + `onHighlightChange` (`detail.highlightedSeries`) | `highlightedSeries` + `onHighlightChange(series)` |
| `ariaLabel`, `ariaDescription` | same names |
| `ariaLabelledby` | not supported (web only); use `ariaLabel` |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsChartI18nStrings` |

---
source: doc/components/CsLink.md
---

# CsLink

A text link that navigates somewhere or opens related content, such as the help panel.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/link/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsLink(
  text: 'View bucket policy',
  onFollow: () => Navigator.of(context).pushNamed('/buckets/example-bucket/policy'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use a link to move to another page or to open related content (an "Info" link opening the help panel).
- Use a button (`CsButton`) for actions that change something, such as "Delete" or "Launch instance".
- Use `CsLinkVariant.primary` next to other text (inside a paragraph, a table cell, a key-value pair, an alert) so the underline separates it from the surrounding words.
- Use `CsLinkVariant.secondary` (the default) where the context already says the text is interactive, such as a list of links.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `String` | required | The link text. |
| `onFollow` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called when the link is followed. Navigate here. Without `onFollow` and `onClick` the link is inert text. |
| `onClick` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called on every activation before `onFollow`, for side effects such as metrics. |
| `href` | `String?` | `null` | Where the link points. Only used for semantics (announced as a link instead of a button). Never opened by the widget. |
| `variant` | `CsLinkVariant?` | `null` | `primary`, `secondary`, `info` or `awsuiValueLarge`. Null takes the nearest `CsLinkDefaults`, else `secondary`. |
| `color` | `CsLinkColor` | `normal` | `inverted` for links on colored backgrounds (flash messages). Ignored for `info`. |
| `fontSize` | `CsLinkFontSize?` | `null` | `bodyS` to `headingXl`, `displayL` or `inherit`. Null inherits the surrounding text size (display-l for `awsuiValueLarge`). Ignored for `info`. |
| `external` | `bool` | `false` | Adds the external icon and announces that the link opens in a new window. |
| `externalIconAriaLabel` | `String?` | `CsStrings.opensInNewWindow` | Accessible text for the external icon. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name that replaces `text`. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | Move focus to the link (`ref.focus()` in Cloudscape). |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | Focus the link when it first builds. |
| `maxLines` | `int?` | `null` | Clamp the text with an ellipsis. |

`CsLinkDefaults(variant:, child:)` sets the default variant for the links below it. Tables, cards, alerts and popovers set it to `primary`, as Cloudscape does.

## Examples

### Variants

```dart
Wrap(
  spacing: 16,
  children: [
    CsLink(text: 'Secondary', onFollow: () {}),
    CsLink(text: 'Primary', variant: CsLinkVariant.primary, onFollow: () {}),
    CsLink(text: 'Info', variant: CsLinkVariant.info, onFollow: () {}),
    CsLink(text: '128', variant: CsLinkVariant.awsuiValueLarge, onFollow: () {}),
  ],
)
```

### External link

```dart
CsLink(
  text: 'Pricing details',
  external: true,
  externalIconAriaLabel: 'Opens in a new tab',
  onFollow: () {},
)
```

### Inside running text

```dart
Text.rich(
  TextSpan(
    children: [
      const TextSpan(text: 'Objects in '),
      WidgetSpan(
        alignment: PlaceholderAlignment.baseline,
        baseline: TextBaseline.alphabetic,
        child: CsLink(text: 'example-bucket', variant: CsLinkVariant.primary, onFollow: () {}),
      ),
      const TextSpan(text: ' are encrypted at rest.'),
    ],
  ),
)
```

### Inverted, on a colored background

```dart
CsLink(text: 'View instance', color: CsLinkColor.inverted, onFollow: () {})
```

## Accessibility

- Without `href` (and not `external`) the link is announced as a button, as Cloudscape does for a link without `href`; with `href` or `external` it is announced as a link.
- `external` adds the hint "Opens in a new window" (or `externalIconAriaLabel`).
- Keyboard: Tab focuses the link and shows the 2px focus ring; Enter activates it.
- `ariaLabel` replaces the text for screen readers, for example to add context to "Info".

## Motion

Hover and pressed colors switch instantly. There is no press scale on links.

## Mobile

Links wrap with the surrounding text and keep their text box as the hit area so lines are not pushed apart. Give standalone links on touch screens room around them (a list row) when they are the only target.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `text` |
| `variant` | `variant` (`'awsui-value-large'` is `CsLinkVariant.awsuiValueLarge`) |
| `fontSize` | `fontSize` (`CsLinkFontSize`) |
| `color` | `color` |
| `external` | `external` |
| `externalIconAriaLabel` | `externalIconAriaLabel` |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `onFollow` | `onFollow` |
| `onClick` | `onClick` |
| `href` | `href` (semantics only) |
| `target`, `rel`, `nativeAttributes` | not applicable (web only) |
| `style` | not supported; theme with color overrides |
| `ref.focus()` | `focusNode.requestFocus()` |

---
source: doc/components/CsList.md
---

# CsList

A vertical list of structured items (icon, content, secondary content, actions) separated by dividers, with an optional sortable mode for drag and keyboard reordering.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/list/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

Widget buckets() => CsList<String>(
  items: const ['example-bucket', 'logs-bucket'],
  renderItem: (name) => CsListItem(
    id: name,
    content: Text(name),
    icon: const CsIcon(CsIcons.folder),
  ),
);
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for a short collection of items that need no columns: attached policies, recent resources, a ranked list of rules.
- Use `sortable` when the order matters and users set it (rule priority, column order).
- Do not use it for many items with several attributes: use a table or cards.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<T>` | required | The items. |
| `renderItem` | `CsListItem Function(T)` | required | Describes one item. |
| `sortable` | `bool` | `false` | Adds drag handles and reordering. |
| `sortDisabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disables the handles temporarily. |
| `onSortingChange` | `ValueChanged<List<T>>?` | `null` | Called with the reordered items after a drop. Pass them back in `items`. |
| `disableItemPaddings` | `bool` | `false` | Removes the vertical padding inside items and the gaps between icon, content and actions. |
| `disablePaddings` | `bool` | `false` | Removes the padding above the first and below the last item (not for sortable lists). |
| `ordered` | `bool?` | `sortable` | Order is meaningful: screen readers hear "2 of 5" per item. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name of the list. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsListI18nStrings` | English | Drag handle label and hint, and the live announcements. |

`CsListItem`:

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `String` | required | Unique, stable identifier. |
| `content` | `Widget` | required | Main content (body text). |
| `secondaryContent` | `Widget?` | `null` | Below the content, in body-s secondary text. |
| `icon` | `Widget?` | `null` | At the start, aligned with the first line. |
| `actions` | `Widget?` | `null` | At the end of the first line. |
| `announcementLabel` | `String?` | text of `content` | Name of the item in reorder announcements. |

`CsListI18nStrings`: `dragHandleAriaLabel` (`'Drag handle'`), `dragHandleAriaDescription`, `liveAnnouncementDndStarted(position, total)`, `liveAnnouncementDndItemReordered(initial, current, total)`, `liveAnnouncementDndItemCommitted(initial, final, total)`, `liveAnnouncementDndDiscarded` (`'Reordering canceled'`).

## Examples

### Items with descriptions and actions

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

Widget policies(void Function(String) detach) => CsList<String>(
  items: const ['ReadOnlyAccess', 'ExampleBucketWrite'],
  renderItem: (name) => CsListItem(
    id: name,
    content: Text(name),
    secondaryContent: const Text('Customer managed policy'),
    actions: CsButton(text: 'Detach', onPress: () => detach(name)),
  ),
);
```

### Sortable

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

class Rules extends StatefulWidget {
  const Rules({super.key});

  @override
  State<Rules> createState() => _RulesState();
}

class _RulesState extends State<Rules> {
  List<String> rules = ['Block bad bots', 'Rate limit login', 'Allow office IPs'];

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => CsList<String>(
    items: rules,
    sortable: true,
    ariaLabel: 'Rule priority',
    renderItem: (rule) => CsListItem(id: rule, content: Text(rule)),
    onSortingChange: (next) => setState(() => rules = next),
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

Each item is its own semantics node; in an ordered (or sortable) list it also reports its position ("2 of 3"). Drag handles are buttons named "Drag handle, <item>" with a hint that explains the keyboard interaction: Space or Enter picks the item up, the arrow keys move it, Space or Enter drops it and Escape cancels. Moving focus away also cancels. Every step is announced with the `liveAnnouncement*` strings, as in Cloudscape.

## Motion

While dragged by pointer, the item lifts with `shadow-container-active` on the container background and follows the finger 1:1; the other items slide out of its way and the item settles into its slot on release. Keyboard moves are instant and the picked-up item keeps the lifted look.

## Mobile

Drag starts as soon as the finger moves on the handle (the handle has a 44px wide hit area on touch screens), so the rest of the item still scrolls the page. Content and secondary content wrap; actions stay at the end of the first line.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `items` | `items` |
| `renderItem` | `renderItem` returning `CsListItem` |
| `sortable`, `sortDisabled` | `sortable`, `sortDisabled` |
| `onSortingChange` (`detail.items`) | `onSortingChange` (the list) |
| `disableItemPaddings`, `disablePaddings` | same |
| `tagOverride` (`'ol'`/`'ul'`) | `ordered` |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `ariaLabelledby`, `ariaDescribedby` | not applicable (use `ariaLabel`) |
| `i18nStrings` | `i18nStrings` (`CsListI18nStrings`) |

---
source: doc/components/CsLiveRegion.md

# CsLiveRegion

Cloudscape's `LiveRegion`: announces content to screen readers whenever it changes, without moving focus, for results of filtering, saved states and other updates the user cannot see happen.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/live-region/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsLiveRegion(child: Text('12 instances match'))
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a live region for a change that happens away from the user's focus: a result count after filtering, "Saved" after an autosave, the progress of a background task. Do not announce what the user just typed or every keystroke. Components such as `CsFlashbar` and `CsProgressBar` already announce their own changes.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget?` | | Content shown on screen and, without `message`, the source of the announcement |
| `message` | `String?` | | Text to announce; wins over the text of `child` |
| `assertive` | `bool` | `false` | Interrupt the screen reader; only for urgent messages |
| `hidden` | `bool` | `false` | Hide `child` visually and from semantics; still announced |
| `delay` | `Duration` | 1 second | Minimum time between announcements; changes inside it merge. `Duration.zero` announces right after each frame |
| `preventInitialAnnouncement` | `bool` | `false` | Announce only later changes |

Statics: `CsLiveRegion.announce(context, message, {assertive})` sends one announcement; `CsLiveRegion.textOf(context)` reads the text rendered under a context. `CsLiveRegionState.reannounce()` (through a `GlobalKey<CsLiveRegionState>`) repeats the current text.

## Examples

### Result count

```dart
CsLiveRegion(
  child: CsBox(variant: CsBoxVariant.small, text: '3 matches for "prod"'),
)
```

### Announce without showing

```dart
const CsLiveRegion(hidden: true, message: 'Settings saved')
```

### One-off announcement

```dart
CsButton(text: 'Copy ARN', onPress: () => CsLiveRegion.announce(context, 'ARN copied'))
```

## Accessibility

Announcements go through `SemanticsService.sendAnnouncement` for the current view, so they reach VoiceOver and TalkBack. The text of `child` is read the way Cloudscape reads `textContent`: every `Text` and `RichText` below it, in order, with whitespace collapsed. Equal consecutive messages are announced once; call `reannounce` when repeating the same text is meaningful.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

No layout of its own: `child` lays out as it would without the region.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `child` (or `message`) |
| `assertive`, `hidden` | same names |
| `tagName` | not applicable |
| internal `delay`, `preventInitialAnnouncement`, `reannounce()` | `delay`, `preventInitialAnnouncement`, `CsLiveRegionState.reannounce()` |

---
source: doc/components/CsLoadingBar.md
---

# CsLoadingBar

A 2px animated gradient bar that shows a generative AI process is running.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/loading-bar/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsLoadingBar(variant: CsLoadingBarVariant.genAi)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use while a gen-AI response streams, at the top or bottom edge of the area that will receive it.
- Use `genAiMasked` at the edge of an element with rounded corners; `CsChatBubble(showLoadingBar: true)` already does this.
- Remove the bar when the process ends: it loops only while it is mounted.
- For non-AI loading use `CsSpinner` or a progress bar.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `CsLoadingBarVariant` | `genAi` | `genAi` (full width) or `genAiMasked` (fades out over the first and last 30%). |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Optional accessible name. The bar is decorative by default, as in Cloudscape. |

`CsLoadingBar.height` is 2. The gradient comes from `CsGenAiGradients.loadingBar` (token `colorBackgroundLoadingBarGenAi`).

## Examples

### Masked bar under a custom card

```dart
Column(
  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
  children: const [
    Text('Summarizing 42 log groups'),
    SizedBox(height: 8),
    CsLoadingBar(variant: CsLoadingBarVariant.genAiMasked),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

The bar is not announced. Tell screen reader users about the process another way: set the avatar's `loading` with an `ariaLabel` such as "Generating a response", or pass `semanticLabel`.

## Motion

The gradient tile is twice the bar's width and slides one tile every 3 seconds (`cubic-bezier(0, 0.08, 1, 0.82)`), reversed in RTL, and fades in over `motion-duration-complex`. Under reduced motion it is a still gradient.

## Mobile

Full width at every size; nothing to adapt.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `variant` | `variant` (`'gen-ai'` is `genAi`, `'gen-ai-masked'` is `genAiMasked`) |

source: doc/components/CsMenuPanel.md

# CsMenuPanel

The surface and rows of dropdown menus: `CsMenuPanel` (the container), `CsMenuRow` (an option), `CsMenuGroupLabel` (a group heading), `CsMenuSeparator` (a divider) and `CsMenuKeyboard` (arrow-key movement).

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/button-dropdown/ (menu items are internal in Cloudscape)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsMenuPanel(children: [
  CsMenuRow(label: 'Edit', icon: CsIcons.edit, onPress: () {}),
  CsMenuRow(label: 'Delete', icon: CsIcons.remove, destructive: true, onPress: () {}),
])
```

## When to use / when not to

Use these to build custom menus inside `CsDropdown` or `CsAnchoredOverlay`. For a ready menu button use `CsButtonDropdown`.

## Parameters

### CsMenuPanel

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | Rows, labels, separators |
| `minWidth` | `double` | `144` | |
| `maxHeight` | `double?` | | Scrolls beyond it |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry` | 4px vertical | |
| `scrollController` | `ScrollController?` | | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | |

### CsMenuRow

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` | required | |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | |
| `icon` / `leading` | `CsIconData?` / `Widget?` | | Leading content |
| `description` | `String?` | | Small text under the label |
| `trailing` | `Widget?` | | Caret, check, badge |
| `shortcut` | `String?` | | Shortcut hint |
| `selected`, `checked`, `expanded`, `inMutuallyExclusiveGroup` | `bool?` | | Announced states |
| `highlighted` | `bool` | `false` | Force the highlight (lists driven from a text field) |
| `disabled`, `destructive`, `inset`, `isLink` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `focusNode`, `autofocus`, `canRequestFocus` | | | |
| `onHover` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | |

`CsMenuGroupLabel(text)`, `const CsMenuSeparator()`, `CsMenuKeyboard(child:)` take no other options.

## Examples

### Grouped menu

```dart
CsMenuPanel(maxHeight: 320, children: [
  const CsMenuGroupLabel('Instance'),
  CsMenuRow(label: 'Start', onPress: () {}),
  CsMenuRow(label: 'Stop', disabled: true, onPress: () {}),
  const CsMenuSeparator(),
  CsMenuRow(label: 'View logs', shortcut: 'L', onPress: () {}),
])
```

## Accessibility

Rows are buttons announcing their label and state; group labels are headers. Inside a panel (or `CsMenuKeyboard`), Up and Down move focus between rows and Home and End jump to the ends.

## Motion

Rows change colors instantly on hover and focus; no animation.

## Mobile

Rows are at least 40px tall on touch devices. In a sheet, pass the rows without the panel surface if the sheet already provides one.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape (internal) | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| dropdown container | `CsMenuPanel` |
| `selectable-item` / menu item | `CsMenuRow` |
| option group label | `CsMenuGroupLabel` |
| group divider | `CsMenuSeparator` |

# CsMixedLineBarChart

A chart that combines bars and lines on one categorical x axis, such as monthly costs with their running average and a budget threshold.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/mixed-line-bar-chart/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsMixedLineBarChart<String>(
  series: const [
    CsChartSeries.bar(title: 'Cost', data: [CsChartDatum('Jan', 1200), CsChartDatum('Feb', 1350), CsChartDatum('Mar', 980)]),
    CsChartSeries.line(title: 'Average', data: [CsChartDatum('Jan', 1100), CsChartDatum('Feb', 1150), CsChartDatum('Mar', 1176)]),
    CsChartSeries.threshold(title: 'Budget', y: 1500),
    CsChartSeries.threshold(title: 'Migration', x: 'Feb'),
  ],
  xScaleType: CsChartScaleType.categorical,
  yTickFormatter: (v) => '\$$v',
  height: 300,
  ariaLabel: 'Monthly cost',
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it when a line explains the bars (an average, a target trend) on the same categories.
- Bars need `xScaleType: CsChartScaleType.categorical` (the default here is `linear`, as in Cloudscape).
- Use `CsBarChart` or `CsLineChart` when one series kind is enough.

## Parameters

`T` is the x value type: `num` (`int`, `double`) for linear and log axes, `DateTime` for time axes, `String` for categories. Series, data and helper types are documented in [CsChartSeries](CsChartSeries.md).

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `series` | `List<CsChartSeries<T>>` | required | The series, in legend order. Keep the same instances between builds: the chart compares series by identity. |
| `visibleSeries` | `List<CsChartSeries<T>>?` | `null` | Series shown. Null lets the built-in filter manage it; pass a list and update it in `onFilterChange` to control it. |
| `onFilterChange` | `ValueChanged<List<CsChartSeries<T>>>?` | `null` | The built-in filter changed the visible series. |
| `highlightedSeries` | `CsChartSeries<T>?` | `null` | Series to highlight. The chart also highlights on hover and focus; a new value passed here replaces the current highlight. |
| `onHighlightChange` | `ValueChanged<CsChartSeries<T>?>?` | `null` | The user highlighted a series (legend, point, keyboard) or cleared it. |
| `xScaleType` | `CsChartScaleType` | `CsChartScaleType.linear` | `linear`, `log`, `time` (`DateTime` x) or `categorical` (needed for bars). |
| `yScaleType` | `CsChartYScaleType` | `linear` | `linear` or `log`. |
| `xDomain` | `List<T>?` | `null` | `[min, max]` for numbers and dates, the ordered categories for `categorical`. Null fits all series (hidden ones too, so filtering never rescales). |
| `yDomain` | `List<num>?` | `null` | `[min, max]`. Null fits all data plus zero and rounds out to tick steps. |
| `xTitle / yTitle` | `String?` | `null` | Bold axis titles: x below the axis, y above the plot. |
| `legendTitle` | `String?` | `null` | Bold title above the legend. |
| `xTickFormatter` | `CsChartTickFormatter<T>?` | `null` | Formats x ticks and the popover title. `\n` makes two lines. Default: numbers as written, dates by span (`Nov 3`, `14:00`, `Mar 2026`). |
| `yTickFormatter` | `CsChartTickFormatter<num>?` | `null` | Formats value ticks. |
| `stackedBars` | `bool` | `false` | Stack bars of one x instead of grouping them. |
| `horizontalBars` | `bool` | `false` | Bars run left to right (bars and thresholds only). |
| `emphasizeBaselineAxis` | `bool` | `true` | Draws the zero line 2px wide. |
| `height` | `double` | `500` | Plot height in logical pixels; axis labels and titles add to it. |
| `fitHeight` | `bool` | `false` | Fill a parent with bounded height. Without a bounded parent it falls back to `height`. |
| `hideFilter` | `bool` | `false` | Hides the built-in series filter. |
| `hideLegend` | `bool` | `false` | Hides the legend. |
| `additionalFilters` | `Widget?` | `null` | Extra filters placed next to the built-in one. |
| `statusType` | `CsChartStatusType` | `finished` | `loading`, `finished` or `error`. |
| `empty / noMatch` | `Widget?` | `null` | Shown when `series` is empty / when the filter hides every series. |
| `loadingText / errorText / recoveryText` | `String?` | `null` | Status copy. Defaults: "Loading chart", "The data couldn't be fetched. Try again later.", "Retry". |
| `onRecoveryClick` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called from the recovery link next to `errorText`. Without it there is no link. |
| `detailPopoverSize` | `CsChartPopoverSize` | `medium` | Popover max width: `small` 210, `medium` 310, `large` 482. |
| `detailPopoverFooter` | `Widget Function(T x)?` | `null` | Content under a divider at the bottom of the popover. |
| `detailPopoverSeriesContent` | `CsChartDetailPopoverSeriesContent<T>?` | `null` | Replaces a series row: other key or value, widgets, `subItems`, `expandable`. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsChartI18nStrings` | `const CsChartI18nStrings()` | Filter, legend, popover and screen reader labels (see CsChartSeries.md). |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name; match the visible heading. |
| `ariaDescription` | `String?` | `null` | Short summary read before the generated series and axis summary. |

## Examples

### Vertical threshold

`CsChartSeries.threshold(x: 'Feb')` draws a dashed vertical line at a category and appears in the popover only at that x.

```dart
const CsChartSeries<String>.threshold(title: 'Deployment', x: 'Feb')
```

## Accessibility

- The plot is one focusable element announced as `ariaLabel` plus the chart kind ("Line chart"), with a hint that reads `ariaDescription` and a generated summary (series titles, x range or categories, y range).
- Keyboard, as in Cloudscape: Tab focuses the plot and highlights the first position. Left and Right move between x positions (bar groups; Up and Down for horizontal bars), Up and Down cycle between all series and one series at a time, Home and End jump to the ends, Enter or Space pins the popover, Escape dismisses it.
- The semantics value is the highlighted position and every value ("h2, i-0abc123 20%, Alarm 45"); screen reader increase and decrease gestures move between positions.
- A 2px `color-border-item-focused` outline marks the focused point, x line or group.
- The legend is one tab stop with Left and Right between entries; each entry is a toggle button. The filter is a labelled button that opens a list of checkable rows.
- Loading, error and empty states sit in a live region. Series are never told apart by color alone: the legend, filter and popover pair each color with its title and marker shape (line, bar, dashed threshold).

## Motion

- Data animates in once when it first appears (250ms `motion-duration-complex`, `showPaced` easing): lines and areas reveal from the start of the x axis, bars grow out of the baseline, pie segments sweep clockwise.
- Dimming non-highlighted series and legend entries fades over 90ms (`motion-duration-transition-quick`), like Cloudscape's opacity transitions.
- The popover scales and fades in from its anchor (`CsAnchoredOverlay`).
- Reduced motion (`MediaQuery.disableAnimations` or the theme's `disableMotion`) shows everything at once.

## Mobile

- Touch: tap or drag a finger across the plot to scrub the crosshair (or bar groups) with a selection haptic per step; lifting the finger keeps the popover, pinned, with its close button. Tap outside to dismiss. Vertical drags still scroll the page.
- At or below 688px the popover opens above the highlighted point instead of beside it, so it gets the full width.
- The filter opens as a bottom sheet on phones (`CsDropdown`, `CsPresentation.auto`).
- Axis labels drop until they no longer overlap, and the legend wraps. Labels and popover text scale with the platform text size.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `series` (`title`, `type`, `data`, `color`, `valueFormatter`) | `series` with `CsChartSeries.line/.bar/.area/.threshold`; `color` is a `Color`, plus `colorToken` |
| threshold `y` / `x` | `CsChartSeries.threshold(y:)` / `CsChartSeries.threshold(x:)` |
| `xScaleType`, `yScaleType` | `xScaleType` (`CsChartScaleType`), `yScaleType` (`CsChartYScaleType`) |
| `xDomain`, `yDomain`, `xTitle`, `yTitle`, `legendTitle` | same names |
| `xTickFormatter`, `yTickFormatter` (also the deprecated `i18nStrings` versions) | `xTickFormatter`, `yTickFormatter` |
| `stackedBars`, `horizontalBars` | same names |
| `emphasizeBaselineAxis` | same name |
| `detailPopoverSeriesContent` | `detailPopoverSeriesContent` returning `CsChartSeriesDetail` |
| `height`, `fitHeight`, `hideFilter`, `hideLegend`, `additionalFilters` | same names |
| `statusType`, `empty`, `noMatch`, `loadingText`, `errorText`, `recoveryText`, `onRecoveryClick` | same names |
| `detailPopoverSize`, `detailPopoverFooter` | `detailPopoverSize` (`CsChartPopoverSize`), `detailPopoverFooter` (builder) |
| `visibleSeries` + `onFilterChange` (`detail.visibleSeries`) | `visibleSeries` + `onFilterChange(List)` |
| `highlightedSeries` + `onHighlightChange` (`detail.highlightedSeries`) | `highlightedSeries` + `onHighlightChange(series)` |
| `ariaLabel`, `ariaDescription` | same names |
| `ariaLabelledby` | not supported (web only); use `ariaLabel` |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsChartI18nStrings` |

---
source: doc/components/CsModal.md
---

# CsModal

Cloudscape's `Modal`: a dialog over a dimmed page that collects a decision or a short task (confirm a deletion, edit a setting) before the user goes on, with a header, scrollable content and a footer of actions.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/modal/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsModal(
  visible: true,
  onDismiss: (reason) {},
  header: 'Delete instance',
  footerActions: [
    CsButton(text: 'Cancel', variant: CsButtonVariant.link, onPress: () {}),
    CsButton(text: 'Delete', variant: CsButtonVariant.primary, onPress: () {}),
  ],
  child: const Text('Permanently delete i-0abc123? You cannot undo this action.'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a modal when the user must answer before continuing: a destructive confirmation, a short form that belongs to the current page. Keep it small and focused. For long or multi-step tasks use a full page or `CsWizard`. For extra detail about something on the page use `CsPopover`; for a panel that opens in place without blocking the page use `CsDialog`; for feedback after an action use `CsFlashbar`.

Keep the modal mounted and drive `visible`. Never build it only while open: it could not animate out.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `visible` | `bool` | required | Shows the modal. Changes animate |
| `onDismiss` | `ValueChanged<CsModalDismissReason>?` | | Close button, backdrop tap, Escape or back gesture; set `visible` to false in response |
| `header` | `String?` | | Title (heading-m), also the dialog's accessible name |
| `headerWidget` | `Widget?` | | Rich content in place of `header` |
| `child` | `Widget?` | | Body; scrolls when taller than the window |
| `footer` | `Widget?` | | Footer below a divider; stays visible while the body scrolls |
| `footerActions` | `List<Widget>?` | | Buttons aligned to the end of the footer with an 8px gap; wrap on narrow screens. Ignored when `footer` is set |
| `size` | `CsModalSize` | `medium` | `small` 320, `medium` 600, `large` 820, `xLarge` 1024, `xxLarge` 1280, `max` (window width minus 120) |
| `position` | `CsModalPosition` | `center` | `center`, or `top` for content that changes height |
| `hideDismissButton` | `bool` | `false` | No close button; Escape, backdrop and back still call `onDismiss` |
| `closeAriaLabel` | `String?` | `'Close modal'` | Accessible name of the close button |
| `disableContentPaddings` | `bool` | `false` | Body without padding |
| `width` | `double?` | | Fixed width (at least 320), wins over `size`, capped at the window |
| `height` | `double?` | | Fixed height; the body scrolls inside it |
| `useRootOverlay` | `bool` | `true` | Render above every navigator |

`CsModalDismissReason`: `closeButton`, `overlay`, `keyboard` (Escape and the system back gesture or button).

### showCsModal

`showCsModal<T>({required BuildContext context, required WidgetBuilder builder, String? header, Widget? headerWidget, WidgetBuilder? footerBuilder, CsModalSize size, CsModalPosition position, bool hideDismissButton, bool dismissible = true, String? closeAriaLabel, bool disableContentPaddings, double? width, double? height, bool useRootNavigator = true})` opens the same modal in its own route and completes with the value passed to `Navigator.pop`. The close button always closes it; `dismissible: false` makes the backdrop, Escape and back do nothing.

## Examples

### Delete confirmation with state

```dart
class DeleteInstance extends StatefulWidget {
  const DeleteInstance({super.key});

  @override
  State<DeleteInstance> createState() => _DeleteInstanceState();
}

class _DeleteInstanceState extends State<DeleteInstance> {
  bool _visible = false;

  void _close() => setState(() => _visible = false);

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        CsButton(text: 'Delete', onPress: () => setState(() => _visible = true)),
        CsModal(
          visible: _visible,
          onDismiss: (_) => _close(),
          header: 'Delete instance',
          footerActions: [
            CsButton(text: 'Cancel', variant: CsButtonVariant.link, onPress: _close),
            CsButton(text: 'Delete', variant: CsButtonVariant.primary, onPress: _close),
          ],
          child: const Text('Permanently delete i-0abc123? You cannot undo this action.'),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

### Awaiting a result

```dart
Future<void> confirm(BuildContext context) async {
  final ok = await showCsModal<bool>(
    context: context,
    header: 'Delete bucket',
    size: CsModalSize.small,
    builder: (context) => const Text('Permanently delete example-bucket?'),
    footerBuilder: (context) => Wrap(
      alignment: WrapAlignment.end,
      spacing: 8,
      children: [
        CsButton(text: 'Cancel', variant: CsButtonVariant.link, onPress: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(false)),
        CsButton(text: 'Delete', variant: CsButtonVariant.primary, onPress: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(true)),
      ],
    ),
  );
  if (ok == true) {
    // delete the bucket
  }
}
```

### A required choice

```dart
CsModal(
  visible: true,
  hideDismissButton: true,
  position: CsModalPosition.top,
  header: 'Choose a Region',
  onDismiss: (reason) {},
  footerActions: [CsButton(text: 'Continue', variant: CsButtonVariant.primary, onPress: () {})],
  child: const Text('Resources are created in the Region you choose.'),
)
```

## Accessibility

The dialog is its own semantics route named by `header`, and the page behind is hidden from screen readers while it is open. Focus moves to the close button (to the dialog when there is none), Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside it, and focus returns to the trigger when it closes. Escape and the Android back gesture call `onDismiss` with `keyboard`. The backdrop is announced as a "Close" button.

## Motion

The backdrop fades in and the dialog fades and scales from 0.95 over Cloudscape's 115ms responsive motion (`motion-duration-refresh-only-fast`, `motion-easing-refresh-only-a`). Closing runs the same path backwards, so the modal stays mounted until it has left. Reduced motion keeps only the fade (instant for `CsModal`).

## Mobile

On phones (and any window narrower than the size) the dialog is the full width minus a 12px gutter on each side, Cloudscape's `calc(100vw - 2 * space-s)`. The dialog never grows taller than the window: the body scrolls and the footer stays visible. The on-screen keyboard pushes the dialog up. `size: CsModalSize.max` only adds its 120px margin above 688px.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `visible`, `size`, `position`, `hideDismissButton`, `closeAriaLabel`, `disableContentPaddings`, `width`, `height` | same names |
| `size="x-large"`, `"xx-large"` | `CsModalSize.xLarge`, `CsModalSize.xxLarge` |
| `header` | `header` / `headerWidget` |
| `children` | `child` |
| `footer` | `footer` (or `footerActions`) |
| `onDismiss` (`detail.reason`) | `onDismiss(CsModalDismissReason)` |
| `modalRoot`, `getModalRoot`, `removeModalRoot` | `useRootOverlay` |
| `analyticsMetadata` | not applicable |

---
source: doc/components/CsMultiselect.md
---

# CsMultiselect

Cloudscape's `Multiselect`: pick any number of options from a dropdown list; the choice shows as dismissible tokens under the trigger.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/multiselect/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsMultiselect(
  selectedOptions: const [CsOption(value: 'us-east-1a')],
  placeholder: 'Choose availability zones',
  options: const [CsOption(value: 'us-east-1a'), CsOption(value: 'us-east-1b'), CsOption(value: 'us-east-1c')],
  onChange: (options) {},
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a multiselect to pick several items from a long list. For a handful of options that should stay visible, use checkboxes or tiles. For one choice use `CsSelect`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `List<CsOptionItem>` | required | Options and option groups |
| `selectedOptions` | `List<CsOption>` | required | The chosen options (matched by `value`) |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<List<CsOption>>?` | | Called with the next list |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | | Always shown in the trigger |
| `keepOpen` | `bool` | `true` | Keep the list open after each toggle |
| `tokenLimit` | `int?` | | Tokens shown before "Show more" |
| `hideTokens` | `bool` | `false` | Hide the tokens |
| `inlineTokens` | `bool` | `false` | Draw inline tokens inside the trigger |
| `enableSelectAll` | `bool` | `false` | "Select all" option acting on the shown options |
| `deselectAriaLabel` | `String Function(CsOption)?` | | Token dismiss label |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsMultiselectI18nStrings` | English | `selectAllText`, `tokenLimitShowMore`, `tokenLimitShowFewer` |
| `tokenLimitShowMoreAriaLabel`, `tokenLimitShowFewerAriaLabel` | `String?` | | |
| `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `warning` | `bool` | `false` | |
| filtering, status, `onLoadItems`, `inlineLabelText`, `ariaLabel`, `ariaRequired`, `autoFocus`, `focusNode`, `onFocus`, `onBlur`, `presentation`, `dropdownHeader`, `dropdownFooter`, `renderOption` | | | As `CsSelect` |

## Examples

### Groups and select all

```dart
CsMultiselect(
  selectedOptions: const [],
  placeholder: 'Choose buckets',
  enableSelectAll: true,
  options: const [
    CsOptionGroup(label: 'us-east-1', options: [CsOption(value: 'example-bucket'), CsOption(value: 'logs-bucket')]),
    CsOptionGroup(label: 'eu-west-1', options: [CsOption(value: 'archive-bucket', disabled: true)]),
  ],
  onChange: (options) {},
)
```

### Token limit and filtering

```dart
CsMultiselect(
  selectedOptions: const [CsOption(value: 'web'), CsOption(value: 'api'), CsOption(value: 'db')],
  tokenLimit: 2,
  filteringType: CsFilteringType.auto,
  options: const [CsOption(value: 'web'), CsOption(value: 'api'), CsOption(value: 'db'), CsOption(value: 'cache')],
  onChange: (options) {},
)
```

### Inline tokens

```dart
CsMultiselect(
  selectedOptions: const [CsOption(value: 'Running'), CsOption(value: 'Pending')],
  inlineTokens: true,
  inlineLabelText: 'State',
  options: const [CsOption(value: 'Running'), CsOption(value: 'Pending'), CsOption(value: 'Stopped')],
  onChange: (options) {},
)
```

## Accessibility

As `CsSelect`, with checkbox rows that announce their checked state (group rows announce mixed when partly selected). Space or Enter toggles the highlighted option and the list stays open. Token dismiss buttons are labelled "Remove <option>" by default.

## Motion

As `CsSelect`; checkboxes draw their check mark (reduced motion: instant).

## Mobile

At or below 688px the list opens in a bottom sheet that stays open while options are toggled; swipe it down or tap outside to finish. Tokens wrap under the trigger.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `selectedOptions`, `keepOpen`, `tokenLimit`, `hideTokens`, `inlineTokens`, `enableSelectAll`, `deselectAriaLabel` | same names |
| `onChange` (`detail.selectedOptions`) | `onChange` (the list) |
| `i18nStrings.selectAllText`, `tokenLimitShowMore`, `tokenLimitShowFewer` | `i18nStrings` |
| other props | as `CsSelect` |
| `expandToViewport`, `virtualScroll`, `name`, `controlId` | not applicable |

source: doc/components/CsNavigableGroup.md
