# CsNavigableGroup

Cloudscape's `NavigableGroup` (`src/navigable-group`): makes a set of buttons, toggle buttons, button dropdowns or links a single Tab stop, with the arrow keys moving focus between them.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/navigable-group/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsNavigableGroup(
  semanticLabel: 'Instance actions',
  child: Wrap(
    spacing: 8,
    children: [
      CsButton(text: 'Start', onPress: () {}),
      CsButton(text: 'Stop', onPress: () {}),
      CsButton(text: 'Reboot', onPress: () {}),
    ],
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for toolbars and other groups of related actions, so keyboard users cross the group with one Tab instead of one per control. Do not use it around form fields (each field needs its own Tab stop) or around a single control.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | Content holding the focusable controls; they do not need to be direct children |
| `navigationDirection` | `CsNavigationDirection` | `horizontal` | Which arrows move focus: `horizontal` (left and right), `vertical` (up and down) or `both` |
| `loop` | `bool` | `false` | Wrap from the last control to the first and back (Cloudscape wraps; set `true` to match it) |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  | Accessible name of the group |

`CsNavigableGroupState` (through a `GlobalKey<CsNavigableGroupState>`): `focus()` focuses the control that had focus last, or the first one (Cloudscape `ref.focus()`); `items` lists the focusable controls in reading order; `tabStop` is the control Tab lands on.

## Examples

### Vertical list of links with wrap-around

```dart
CsNavigableGroup(
  navigationDirection: CsNavigationDirection.vertical,
  loop: true,
  child: Column(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
    children: [
      CsLink(text: 'Overview', onFollow: () {}),
      CsLink(text: 'Monitoring', onFollow: () {}),
      CsLink(text: 'Tags', onFollow: () {}),
    ],
  ),
)
```

### Focus the group from code

```dart
CsNavigableGroup(
  key: groupKey, // a GlobalKey<CsNavigableGroupState> kept in your State
  child: CsButton(text: 'Start', onPress: () => groupKey.currentState?.focus()),
)
```

## Accessibility

Tab enters the group on the control that had focus last (the first at first) and leaves after one stop; Shift+Tab returns to the same control. Arrow keys follow reading order and mirror in right-to-left layouts; Home and End jump to the first and last control; disabled controls are skipped (a disabled button with a reason stays reachable). Arrow keys with a modifier are left to the app. Page Up and Page Down are claimed without moving focus, as in Cloudscape.

## Motion

None. A control moved to by arrow key scrolls into view if the group is in a scroll view.

## Mobile

Touch is unaffected. Wrap the controls (`Wrap`) so they flow onto more lines at 390px.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `child` |
| `navigationDirection` | `navigationDirection` (`CsNavigationDirection`) |
| `getItemKey` | not needed (focus is tracked by `FocusNode`) |
| `ref.focus()` | `CsNavigableGroupState.focus()` |
| always wraps around | `loop` (off by default) |

---
source: doc/components/CsOptionList.md
---

# CsOptionList

Cloudscape's `OptionList` (`src/option-list`): an always visible list of options to pick one or several from, without a trigger or dropdown.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/option-list/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsOptionList(
  ariaLabel: 'Instance type',
  selectionType: CsOptionListSelectionType.single,
  options: const [
    CsOption(value: 't3.micro', label: 't3.micro', description: '2 vCPU, 1 GiB'),
    CsOption(value: 't3.large', label: 't3.large', description: '2 vCPU, 8 GiB'),
  ],
  selectedOptions: selected,
  onChange: (options) => setState(() => selected = options),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use an option list inside a panel, popover or custom dropdown where the options are always shown. For a compact field that opens a list, use `CsSelect` or `CsMultiselect`; for a few mutually exclusive choices with more explanation, use `CsTiles` or `CsRadioGroup`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `List<CsOptionItem>` | required | `CsOption`s and `CsOptionGroup`s (one level of groups) |
| `selectionType` | `CsOptionListSelectionType` | required | `single` (check on the selected row) or `multi` (checkboxes; a group header toggles its group) |
| `selectedOptions` | `List<CsOption>?` | `null` | Selected options, matched by `value`. In `single` only the first is used. `null` lets the list keep its own selection |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<List<CsOption>>?` |  | Called with the next selection |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` |  | Accessible name of the list |
| `renderOption` | `Widget? Function(BuildContext, CsOptionListItem)?` |  | Custom row content; return null for the default |
| `renderHighlightedAriaLive` | `String Function(CsOptionItem, CsOptionGroup?)?` |  | Announcement for a newly highlighted option |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsOptionListI18nStrings` | `selectedAriaLabel: 'Selected'` | Announced with a highlighted option that is selected |
| `empty` | `Widget?` |  | Shown when there are no options |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` |  | The list's focus node |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | Focus on first build |
| `maxHeight` | `double?` |  | Scrolls the list beyond this height |

`CsOptionListItem` (for `renderOption`): `isGroup`, `index`, `option`, `selected`, `highlighted`, `disabled`, `indeterminate`, `group`, `parent`.

## Examples

### Multi selection with groups

```dart
CsOptionList(
  ariaLabel: 'Regions',
  selectionType: CsOptionListSelectionType.multi,
  options: const [
    CsOptionGroup(
      label: 'North America',
      options: [CsOption(value: 'us-east-1', label: 'US East (N. Virginia)'), CsOption(value: 'us-west-2', label: 'US West (Oregon)')],
    ),
    CsOptionGroup(
      label: 'Europe',
      options: [CsOption(value: 'eu-west-1', label: 'Europe (Ireland)', disabled: true, disabledReason: 'Not enabled for this account')],
    ),
  ],
  selectedOptions: regions,
  onChange: (options) => setState(() => regions = options),
)
```

### Custom rows

```dart
CsOptionList(
  selectionType: CsOptionListSelectionType.single,
  options: const [CsOption(value: 'example-bucket'), CsOption(value: 'logs-bucket')],
  renderOption: (context, item) => item.isGroup ? null : Text('s3://${item.option.value}'),
)
```

## Accessibility

The list is one Tab stop and a labelled semantics container; rows expose selected (single) or checked and mixed (multi) states. Focus highlights the first selected option, or the first option. Up and Down move the highlight and wrap, Home/Page Up and End/Page Down jump, Enter and Space choose, typing letters jumps to the next option starting with them. Every highlight change is announced (label, label tag, description, tags and "Selected"). Disabled options are skipped and show their reason in a tooltip.

## Motion

Highlight and selection colors change instantly. The highlighted option scrolls into view.

## Mobile

Rows are at least 44px tall on touch platforms; long labels, descriptions and tags wrap at 390px and 2x text.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `options` | `options` (`CsOption`, `CsOptionGroup`) |
| `selectionType` | `selectionType` (`CsOptionListSelectionType`) |
| `selectedOptions` / `onChange` | `selectedOptions` / `onChange` |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `renderOption` | `renderOption` (`CsOptionListItem`) |
| `renderHighlightedAriaLive` | `renderHighlightedAriaLive` |
| `i18nStrings.selectedAriaLabel` | `i18nStrings.selectedAriaLabel` |
| `option.icon` (`ReactNode`) | `CsOption.icon` / `CsOption.iconWidget` |
| `option.lang` | not supported |
| `ref.focus()` | `focusNode.requestFocus()` |
| `ariaLabelledby`, `ariaDescribedby` | not supported (web only) |
| (none) | `empty`, `maxHeight` |

source: doc/components/CsPagination.md

# CsPagination

Moves through pages of a table, cards or list, with page numbers, arrows and an optional jump-to-page field.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/pagination/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsPagination(
  currentPageIndex: 3,
  pagesCount: 12,
  onChange: (page) => setState(() {}),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use in a table or cards header (`CsHeader` actions or the collection's `pagination` slot) when the items do not fit one page.
- Use `openEnd` when the total is unknown and pages load on demand.
- Do not use for a short list that fits one screen, or for step-by-step flows (use `CsWizard`).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `currentPageIndex` | `int` | required | The current page, starting at 1. |
| `pagesCount` | `int` | required | Total pages (pages known so far when `openEnd`). |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<int>?` | `null` | Called with the page picked from a page button, an arrow or the jump field. |
| `onNextPageClick` | `ValueChanged<CsPaginationPageClickDetail>?` | `null` | Next arrow. `requestedPageAvailable` is false on the last loaded page of an open-ended pagination. |
| `onPreviousPageClick` | `ValueChanged<CsPaginationPageClickDetail>?` | `null` | Previous arrow. |
| `openEnd` | `bool` | `false` | The total is unknown: dots always follow the pages and the next arrow never disables. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disables every control, for example while items load. |
| `pagesVariant` | `CsPaginationPagesVariant?` | `null` | `normal` (page buttons) or `compact` ("3 of 12"). Null uses normal while it fits and compact when it does not. |
| `ariaLabels` | `CsPaginationAriaLabels` | English | `nextPageLabel`, `previousPageLabel`, `paginationLabel`, `pageLabel(int)`, `jumpToPageButton`. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsPaginationI18nStrings` | English | `jumpToPageInputLabel`, `jumpToPageError`, `jumpToPageLoadingText`, `pagesCompactText(current, count, openEnd)`. |
| `jumpToPage` | `CsPaginationJumpToPage?` | `null` | Adds a page field and a jump button. `loading` shows a spinner on the button. |

`CsPaginationState.setError(bool)` shows the jump-to-page error popover (Cloudscape `ref.setError`). Reach it with a `GlobalKey<CsPaginationState>`.

`CsPaginationWindow.of(current, count, openEnd:)` exposes the page window logic (up to 7 controls between the first and last page, with dots for the gaps).

## Examples

### Open ended, loading more on demand

```dart
CsPagination(
  currentPageIndex: 4,
  pagesCount: 4,
  openEnd: true,
  onChange: (page) {},
  onNextPageClick: (detail) {
    if (!detail.requestedPageAvailable) {
      // Fetch the next page of items, then raise pagesCount.
    }
  },
)
```

### Compact

```dart
CsPagination(
  currentPageIndex: 3,
  pagesCount: 12,
  pagesVariant: CsPaginationPagesVariant.compact,
  onChange: (page) {},
)
```

### Jump to page with an error

```dart
final key = GlobalKey<CsPaginationState>();

Widget build(BuildContext context) => CsPagination(
  key: key,
  currentPageIndex: 1,
  pagesCount: 40,
  jumpToPage: const CsPaginationJumpToPage(loading: false),
  onChange: (page) {
    // If the server reports the page does not exist:
    key.currentState?.setError(true);
  },
);
```

## Accessibility

- The group is a labeled container (`paginationLabel`, "Pagination" by default).
- Each page button is announced with `pageLabel` ("Page 3 of all pages"); the current page is marked selected.
- Disabled arrows leave the Tab order. Tab moves through the controls; Enter and Space activate.
- The compact text and the jump error are live regions, so page changes and errors are announced.

## Motion

None: colors switch instantly on hover. The error popover scales from the jump button and is instant under reduced motion.

## Mobile

With `pagesVariant` left null, the page buttons are measured against the available width with 44px touch targets; when they do not fit (a phone in portrait) the compact "3 of 12" form is used. Pass a variant to fix the layout. The jump field wraps onto its own line if needed.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `currentPageIndex` | `currentPageIndex` |
| `pagesCount` | `pagesCount` |
| `openEnd` | `openEnd` |
| `pagesVariant` | `pagesVariant` (null adds automatic switching) |
| `disabled` | `disabled` |
| `ariaLabels` | `ariaLabels` |
| `i18nStrings` | `i18nStrings` |
| `jumpToPage` | `jumpToPage` |
| `onChange` (`detail.currentPageIndex`) | `onChange` (the page) |
| `onNextPageClick`, `onPreviousPageClick` | same names (`CsPaginationPageClickDetail`) |
| `ref.setError` | `CsPaginationState.setError` |

source: doc/components/CsPanelLayout.md

# CsPanelLayout

Cloudscape's `PanelLayout`: a side panel next to main content with a draggable divider.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/panel-layout/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsPanelLayout(
  resizable: true,
  panelContent: Text('Filters'),
  mainContent: Text('Results'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for a panel that belongs to a part of the page, such as filters beside results or a list beside a preview. For page-level panels use `CsAppLayout`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `panelContent` | `Widget` |  |  |
| `mainContent` | `Widget` |  |  |
| `panelPosition` | `CsPanelPosition` | `sideStart` | `sideStart` or `sideEnd` |
| `defaultPanelSize` | `double?` |  | Defaults to `minPanelSize` or 200 |
| `panelSize` | `double?` |  | Controlled width |
| `minPanelSize` | `double?` |  |  |
| `maxPanelSize` | `double?` |  | Also capped at the layout width |
| `resizable` | `bool` | `false` | Shows the drag handle |
| `display` | `CsPanelLayoutDisplay` | `all` | `all`, `panelOnly`, `mainOnly` |
| `scrollable` | `bool` | `false` | Each side scrolls |
| `panelSemanticLabel / mainSemanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsPanelLayoutI18nStrings` |  | Handle label and tooltip |
| `onPanelResize` | `ValueChanged<CsPanelResizeDetail>?` |  | `totalSize`, `panelSize` |
| `onLayoutChange` | `ValueChanged<CsPanelResizeDetail>?` |  |  |

## Examples

### Controlled

```dart
CsPanelLayout(
  resizable: true,
  panelSize: 240,
  minPanelSize: 150,
  maxPanelSize: 400,
  onPanelResize: (d) {},
  panelContent: const Text('Filters'),
  mainContent: const Text('Results'),
)
```

## Accessibility

The handle is a focusable slider: arrows resize in 10px steps, Page Up / Page Down in 60px, Home and End go to the limits.

## Motion

Resizing follows the pointer 1:1.

## Mobile

On phones show one side at a time with `display` (`panelOnly` or `mainOnly`).

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `panelContent / mainContent` | same names |
| `panelPosition` | `panelPosition` (`side-start` is `sideStart`) |
| `defaultPanelSize / panelSize / minPanelSize / maxPanelSize` | same names |
| `resizable` | `resizable` |
| `display` | `display` |
| `scrollable` | `scrollable` |
| `panelFocusable / mainFocusable` | `panelSemanticLabel` / `mainSemanticLabel` |
| `onPanelResize / onLayoutChange` | same names |

# CsPieChart

A pie or donut chart that shows how parts make up a single whole, with segment labels, a legend, a segment filter and a detail popover.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/pie-chart/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsPieChart<CsPieChartDatum>(
  data: const [
    CsPieChartDatum(title: 'Running', value: 60),
    CsPieChartDatum(title: 'Stopped', value: 25),
    CsPieChartDatum(title: 'Terminated', value: 15),
  ],
  variant: CsPieChartVariant.donut,
  innerMetricValue: '100',
  innerMetricDescription: 'instances',
  segmentDescription: (segment, sum) => '${(segment.value * 100 / sum).round()}%',
  ariaLabel: 'Instance states',
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for parts of one whole with few segments (up to about 6). Order segments by size.
- Use the donut variant to show the total (or a key figure) in the middle.
- Use `CsBarChart` to compare values that are not parts of one total, or when segments are close in size.

## Parameters

`T` is your segment type: `CsPieChartDatum` or a subclass that carries more fields; callbacks receive your type.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `List<T>` | required | Segments, clockwise from 12 o'clock. Values of zero or less get no segment; each segment is drawn at least 1% of the pie. |
| `size` | `CsPieChartSize` | `medium` | Outer radius `small` 50, `medium` 100, `large` 140. With `fitHeight`, the minimum. On screens too narrow for the pie and its labels, the pie shrinks. |
| `variant` | `CsPieChartVariant` | `pie` | `pie` or `donut`. |
| `innerMetricValue` | `String?` | `null` | Large text in the middle of a donut. |
| `innerMetricDescription` | `String?` | `null` | Text under it, usually the unit. Not shown for `small`. |
| `segmentDescription` | `CsPieChartSegmentDescription<T>?` | `null` | `(segment, visibleSum) => String` shown under each label. |
| `hideTitles` / `hideDescriptions` | `bool` | `false` | Hide segment titles / descriptions next to the pie. With both, there are no labels. |
| `detailPopoverContent` | `CsPieChartDetailPopoverContent<T>?` | `null` | `(segment, visibleSum) => List<CsChartDetailPair>`. Defaults to "Value" and "Percentage". |
| `detailPopoverFooter` | `Widget Function(T segment)?` | `null` | Content under a divider in the popover. |
| `detailPopoverSize` | `CsChartPopoverSize` | `medium` | Popover max width (210, 310, 482). |
| `hideLegend` / `hideFilter` | `bool` | `false` | Hide the legend / the built-in filter. |
| `legendTitle` | `String?` | `null` | Bold title above the legend. |
| `additionalFilters` | `Widget?` | `null` | Extra filters next to the built-in one. |
| `highlightedSegment` | `T?` | `null` | Segment to highlight; a new value replaces the current highlight. |
| `onHighlightChange` | `ValueChanged<T?>?` | `null` | The user highlighted a segment or cleared it. |
| `visibleSegments` | `List<T>?` | `null` | Segments shown. Null lets the filter manage it. |
| `onFilterChange` | `ValueChanged<List<T>>?` | `null` | The built-in filter changed the visible segments. |
| `statusType` | `CsChartStatusType` | `finished` | `loading`, `finished` or `error`. |
| `empty` / `noMatch` | `Widget?` | `null` | No data (or all zero) / everything filtered out. |
| `loadingText` / `errorText` / `recoveryText` | `String?` | `null` | Defaults: "Loading chart", "The data couldn't be fetched. Try again later.", "Retry". |
| `onRecoveryClick` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Recovery link action. Without it there is no link. |
| `ariaLabel` / `ariaDescription` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name and summary. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsPieChartI18nStrings` | `const CsPieChartI18nStrings()` | `detailsValue`, `detailsPercentage`, `filterLabel`, `filterPlaceholder`, `filterSelectedAriaLabel`, `legendAriaLabel`, `detailPopoverDismissAriaLabel`, `chartAriaRoleDescription` ("Pie chart"), `segmentAriaRoleDescription` ("Segment"). |
| `fitHeight` | `bool` | `false` | Fill a parent with bounded height. |

`CsPieChartDatum(title:, value:, color:, colorToken:)`: `color` (a `Color`) or `colorToken` (a `CsColor`, follows light and dark) override the palette.

## Examples

### Custom segment type and popover

```dart
class BucketUsage extends CsPieChartDatum {
  const BucketUsage(String title, num value, this.region) : super(title: title, value: value);
  final String region;
}

final chart = CsPieChart<BucketUsage>(
  data: const [BucketUsage('example-bucket', 420, 'us-east-1'), BucketUsage('logs-bucket', 180, 'eu-west-1')],
  detailPopoverContent: (b, sum) => [
    CsChartDetailPair(key: 'Region', value: b.region),
    CsChartDetailPair(key: 'Size', value: '${b.value} GB'),
  ],
  detailPopoverFooter: (b) => CsLink(text: 'Open ${b.title}', onFollow: () {}),
  ariaLabel: 'Storage by bucket',
);
```

### Small donut without labels

```dart
const CsPieChart<CsPieChartDatum>(
  data: [CsPieChartDatum(title: 'Used', value: 72), CsPieChartDatum(title: 'Free', value: 28)],
  variant: CsPieChartVariant.donut,
  size: CsPieChartSize.small,
  innerMetricValue: '72%',
  hideTitles: true,
  hideDescriptions: true,
  hideFilter: true,
  ariaLabel: 'Quota used',
)
```

## Accessibility

- One focusable element announced as `ariaLabel` plus "Pie chart"; its hint reads `ariaDescription`, the inner metric and every segment with its value.
- Keyboard, as in Cloudscape: Tab focuses the chart and highlights a segment, Left and Right cycle segments, Enter or Space pins the popover, Escape clears. The semantics value reads "Segment 2 of 3, Stopped (25), 25%".
- A 2px focus outline wraps the highlighted segment; a 2px ring 4px outside the segment marks the highlight.
- The legend and filter follow the cartesian charts (one tab stop, Left and Right; checkable filter rows). Colors are always paired with titles.

## Motion

- Segments sweep in clockwise once (250ms, `showPaced`); labels appear after. Highlight dimming fades over 90ms. Reduced motion shows everything at once.

## Mobile

- Tap a segment to highlight it and pin its popover; tap it again or outside to dismiss. At or below 688px the popover opens above the segment.
- The pie shrinks when labels and pie do not fit side by side; label text truncates at the chart edge. The filter opens as a bottom sheet.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `data` (`title`, `value`, `color`) | `data` of `CsPieChartDatum` (`color` or `colorToken`) |
| `size`, `variant` | `size` (`CsPieChartSize`), `variant` (`CsPieChartVariant`) |
| `innerMetricValue`, `innerMetricDescription` | same names |
| `segmentDescription`, `detailPopoverContent`, `detailPopoverFooter`, `detailPopoverSize` | same names (Dart functions, `CsChartPopoverSize`) |
| `hideLegend`, `hideTitles`, `hideDescriptions`, `hideFilter`, `legendTitle`, `additionalFilters` | same names |
| `highlightedSegment` + `onHighlightChange` | same names, callback receives the segment |
| `visibleSegments` + `onFilterChange` | same names, callback receives the list |
| `statusType`, `empty`, `noMatch`, `loadingText`, `errorText`, `recoveryText`, `onRecoveryClick` | same names |
| `ariaLabel`, `ariaDescription`, `i18nStrings`, `fitHeight` | same names (`CsPieChartI18nStrings`) |
| `ariaLabelledby` | not supported (web only); use `ariaLabel` |

source: doc/components/CsPopover.md

# CsPopover

Cloudscape's `Popover`: a small panel of extra detail that opens from a trigger on tap, such as the full status of a resource, the definition of a term or a confirmation after copying a value.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/popover/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsPopover(
  header: 'Memory error',
  content: const Text('This instance contains insufficient memory. Stop the instance and choose a larger type.'),
  child: const CsStatusIndicator(type: CsStatusType.error, text: 'Error'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a popover for information the user asks for by tapping something: detail behind a status, a definition, a small summary. For a short label on hover use `CsTooltip`. For a list of actions use `CsButtonDropdown`. For a task with inputs use `CsDialog` or `CsModal`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The trigger |
| `content` | `Widget?` | | Body, in `color-text-body-secondary` |
| `header` | `String?` | | Heading (heading-xs) |
| `dismissButton` | `bool` | `true` | Close button; also moves focus into the popover and traps Tab |
| `dismissAriaLabel` | `String?` | `'Close popover'` | Accessible name of the close button |
| `position` | `CsPopoverPosition` | `right` | `top`, `right`, `bottom`, `left`; flips when there is no room. `left` and `right` are start and end in RTL |
| `size` | `CsPopoverSize` | `medium` | Maximum width: `small` 210, `medium` 310, `large` 482 (310 below 480px) |
| `fixedWidth` | `bool` | `false` | Always as wide as `size`; needed for content that cannot be measured intrinsically |
| `triggerType` | `CsPopoverTriggerType` | `text` | `text` (dashed line under the trigger), `textInline` (dashed text underline), `custom` (a button) |
| `triggerAriaLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name of a text trigger |
| `wrapTriggerText` | `bool` | `true` | False keeps a text trigger on one line with an ellipsis |
| `visible` | `bool?` | | Controls the open state; null for uncontrolled |
| `onVisibleChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | Next open state on every toggle and dismissal |
| `onDismiss` | `VoidCallback?` | | Closed by the close button, Escape, Tab or an outside tap |

`CsPopoverState.dismiss()` (through a `GlobalKey<CsPopoverState>`) closes the popover from code.

## Examples

### Inline text trigger

```dart
Wrap(
  children: [
    const Text('Requests are routed through an '),
    CsPopover(
      triggerType: CsPopoverTriggerType.textInline,
      header: 'Origin',
      size: CsPopoverSize.small,
      content: const Text('The server CloudFront fetches content from, such as example-bucket.'),
      child: const Text('origin'),
    ),
  ],
)
```

### Custom trigger without a close button

```dart
CsPopover(
  triggerType: CsPopoverTriggerType.custom,
  dismissButton: false,
  size: CsPopoverSize.small,
  position: CsPopoverPosition.top,
  content: const CsStatusIndicator(type: CsStatusType.success, text: 'ARN copied'),
  child: CsButton(text: 'Copy ARN', icon: CsIcons.copy, onPress: () {}),
)
```

### Controlled

```dart
CsPopover(
  visible: true,
  onVisibleChange: (open) {},
  header: 'Instance type',
  fixedWidth: true,
  size: CsPopoverSize.large,
  content: const Text('m5.large: 2 vCPU, 8 GiB memory.'),
  child: const Text('m5.large'),
)
```

## Accessibility

Text triggers are buttons with the dashed underline Cloudscape uses, an `expanded` state and an optional `triggerAriaLabel`; Enter and Space open them. With `dismissButton`, focus moves into the popover, Tab cycles inside it and focus returns to the trigger on close. Without it, focus stays on the trigger, Tab closes the popover and its content is announced as a live region. Escape and an outside tap close it either way.

## Motion

The popover scales from 0.9 at the trigger and fades in, and leaves along the same path; the scale is a spring, so reopening mid-close turns around smoothly. Reduced motion keeps only the fade.

## Mobile

At or below 688px, `left` and `right` positions open below the trigger, because a phone rarely has a popover's width beside it. The popover shifts to stay 8px inside the screen, and `large` falls back to 310px below 480px. Text triggers keep a 44px touch target where the platform asks for it.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `child` (the trigger) |
| `content`, `header`, `dismissButton`, `dismissAriaLabel`, `position`, `size`, `fixedWidth`, `triggerAriaLabel`, `wrapTriggerText` | same names |
| `triggerType="text-inline"` | `triggerType: CsPopoverTriggerType.textInline` |
| `ref.dismiss()` | `GlobalKey<CsPopoverState>().currentState!.dismiss()` |
| `ref.focus()` | focus the trigger with your own `FocusNode` |
| `renderWithPortal` | not applicable: popovers always render in the root overlay |

---
source: doc/components/CsPopupSurface.md
---

# CsPopupSurface

The floating surface of popovers, tooltips and dropdowns: Cloudscape's popover container (`color-background-popover`, a 2px `color-border-popover` border, 8px radius, `shadow-popover`) with an optional arrow that points at the anchor.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/popover/ (a foundation primitive; Cloudscape has no public equivalent)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsPopupSurface(child: Text('Copied'))
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it as the container inside a `CsAnchoredOverlay.overlayBuilder` for custom floating panels, so they match Cloudscape's popovers. Do not use it for content on the page (use `CsContainer`), and prefer the finished `CsPopover` and `CsTooltip`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | Content |
| `placement` | `CsPopupPlacement?` | | From `overlayBuilder`; needed for the arrow |
| `showArrow` | `bool` | `false` | Draw the 20x10 arrow toward the anchor |
| `borderRadius` | `double` | `CsBorderRadius.popover` (8) | |
| `borderWidth` | `double` | `CsBorderWidth.popover` (2) | Drawn inside the shape |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry` | 16 horizontal, 12 vertical | Cloudscape's popover body padding |
| `shadows` | `List<BoxShadow>?` | `shadow-popover` | |
| `fill` | `Color?` | `color-background-popover` | |
| `outline` | `Color?` | `color-border-popover` | |
| `clip` | `bool` | `true` | Clip content to the rounded shape |

`CsPopupSurface.arrowHeight` (10) is the arrow's height, to add to an overlay's `sideOffset`.

## Examples

### With an arrow

```dart
CsAnchoredOverlay(
  open: true,
  side: CsSide.top,
  sideOffset: CsPopupSurface.arrowHeight + 4,
  overlayBuilder: (context, placement) => CsPopupSurface(
    placement: placement,
    showArrow: true,
    child: const Text('vol-0abc123 is attached to i-0abc123.'),
  ),
  child: const Text('vol-0abc123'),
)
```

## Accessibility

The surface adds no semantics. Give its content a label or a heading, and use `CsAnchoredOverlay.trapFocus` when it holds controls.

## Motion

None of its own; `CsAnchoredOverlay` animates it. The arrow repaints as the popup moves, without rebuilding the content.

## Mobile

The surface takes the constraints its overlay gives it; pass `placement.maxWidth` and `placement.maxHeight` to scrollable content so it fits small screens.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape concept | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| popover `.container-body` | the surface |
| popover arrow | `showArrow` + `placement` |

source: doc/components/CsPressable.md

# CsPressable

The interaction primitive under every tappable Cloudscape component. Use it for custom rows, tiles and cards that need press feedback, hover, keyboard focus, a 44px touch target and semantics.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/foundation/core-principles/accessibility/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsPressable(
  onPress: () {},
  semanticLabel: 'Open bucket',
  builder: (context, state) => Container(
    color: state.active ? context.cs.colors.backgroundDropdownItemHover : null,
    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(CsSpace.s),
    child: const CsBox(text: 'example-bucket'),
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Whenever you build a tappable surface that no component covers. Do not use `GestureDetector` or `InkWell` for buttons, rows, chips or tabs.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `builder` | `CsPressableBuilder?` | | Builds visuals from `CsPressState` (`hovered`, `pressed`, `focused`, `disabled`, `active`) |
| `child` | `Widget?` | | Static content |
| `onPress`, `onLongPress`, `onPressIn`, `onPressOut` | | | |
| `disabled`, `loading` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `borderRadius` | `BorderRadius` | zero | Shape of the focus ring |
| `focusRingColor`, `focusRingWidth`, `focusRingOffset`, `showFocusRing` | | `borderItemFocused`, 2, 0, true | |
| `scaleOnPress`, `pressScale` | | true, 0.98 | |
| `haptic` | `CsHaptic` | `none` | |
| `debounce` | `Duration` | zero | Ignore repeat presses inside this window |
| `minTapTargetSize` | `double?` | theme | 44 on touch, 0 with a mouse |
| `semanticLabel`, `semanticHint`, `semanticValue`, `selected`, `toggled`, `checked`, `mixed`, `expanded`, `isButton`, `isLink` | | | Semantics |
| `focusNode`, `autofocus`, `canRequestFocus` | | | |
| `excludeChildSemantics`, `mergeChildSemantics` | `bool` | false, true | |

## Accessibility

Exposes role, label and state; Enter and Space activate; the focus ring shows only for keyboard focus.

## Motion

Pointer-down scales to 0.98 on a spring that starts from wherever the surface is; hover and pressed colors switch instantly. Reduced motion keeps colors and drops the scale.

## Mobile

Pads the hit area to 44x44 on touch platforms without changing the visual.

## Cloudscape React mapping

No direct counterpart: it is the shared behavior of Cloudscape's buttons, links, options and cards.

---
source: doc/components/CsProgressBar.md

# CsProgressBar

Cloudscape's `ProgressBar`: how far an operation of known length has got, with a label, a percentage and, when it ends, a success or error result.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/progress-bar/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsProgressBar(
  label: 'Creating snapshot',
  description: 'vol-0abc123',
  value: 42,
  additionalInfo: 'About 3 minutes remaining',
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a progress bar when you know how much of an operation is done. For work of unknown length use `CsSpinner` or a `CsStatusIndicator` of type `loading`. Inside a flash message use `variant: CsProgressBarVariant.flash`; as the value of a key-value pair use `keyValue`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `double` | `0` | Percent from 0 to 100, rounded for display |
| `status` | `CsProgressBarStatus` | `inProgress` | `inProgress`, `success`, `error` |
| `variant` | `CsProgressBarVariant` | `standalone` | `standalone`, `flash`, `keyValue` |
| `label` / `labelWidget` | `String?` / `Widget?` | | Name of the operation |
| `description` / `descriptionWidget` | `String?` / `Widget?` | | Small text under the label |
| `additionalInfo` / `additionalInfoWidget` | `String?` / `Widget?` | | Small text under the bar or result |
| `resultText` / `resultWidget` | `String?` / `Widget?` | | Shown with the status icon when the status is success or error |
| `resultButtonText` | `String?` | | Button after the result (not in the flash variant) |
| `onResultButtonPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | Result button pressed |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `label` | Accessible name of the bar |

## Examples

### Result states

```dart
Column(
  children: [
    const CsProgressBar(label: 'Uploading index.html', status: CsProgressBarStatus.success, resultText: 'Upload complete'),
    CsProgressBar(
      label: 'Creating snapshot',
      status: CsProgressBarStatus.error,
      resultText: 'Snapshot failed',
      resultButtonText: 'Retry',
      onResultButtonPress: () {},
    ),
  ],
)
```

### Key-value

```dart
const CsProgressBar(variant: CsProgressBarVariant.keyValue, label: 'Storage used', value: 73, additionalInfo: '73 of 100 GiB')
```

## Accessibility

The bar exposes its label and its value ("42%"). While the value changes, screen readers hear "label: 42%" at most every 5 seconds (Cloudscape's assertion throttle). When the status turns to success or error, the result text is announced. The result status is an icon plus text, never color alone.

## Motion

The bar moves to each new value linearly over Cloudscape's 135ms `motion-duration-moderate`; the result state fades in over 180ms. Reduced motion makes both instant.

## Mobile

The bar takes the available width (at most 800px) with the percentage in a 33px column at the end. Label, description and result text wrap; the result button wraps below the result at narrow widths.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value`, `status`, `variant`, `resultButtonText` | same names |
| `status="in-progress"`, `variant="key-value"` | `CsProgressBarStatus.inProgress`, `CsProgressBarVariant.keyValue` |
| `label`, `description`, `additionalInfo`, `resultText` | same names, plus `*Widget` slots |
| `onResultButtonClick` | `onResultButtonPress` |
| `ariaLabel` | `semanticLabel` |
| `ariaLabelledby`, `ariaDescribedby`, `style` | not applicable |

---
source: doc/components/CsPromptInput.md
---

# CsPromptInput

Cloudscape's `PromptInput`: the multi-line field of a chat or generative AI experience, with a send button, actions under the text and content above it.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/prompt-input/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsPromptInput(
  value: prompt,
  placeholder: 'Ask a question about your instances',
  actionButtonIcon: CsIcons.send,
  disableActionButton: prompt.trim().isEmpty,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => prompt = v),
  onAction: (v) => setState(() {
    send(v);
    prompt = '';
  }),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for conversational input that is sent as a whole (chat, assistants, prompts). For single-line form values use `CsInput`; for long-form text in a form use a textarea.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String` | required | |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | |
| `onAction` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | Enter or the action button; clear `value` here |
| `actionButtonIcon` | `CsIconData?` | | Usually `CsIcons.send`; no icon means no button |
| `actionButtonIconWidget` | `Widget?` | | Custom icon (Cloudscape `actionButtonIconSvg`) |
| `actionButtonAriaLabel` | `String?` | `i18nStrings.actionButtonAriaLabel` ("Submit prompt") | |
| `disableActionButton` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `customPrimaryAction` | `Widget?` | | Replaces the action button (a stop button while streaming) |
| `minRows` | `int` | `1` | |
| `maxRows` | `int` | `3` | `-1` grows without limit |
| `secondaryActions` | `Widget?` | | Actions under the text; the action button moves to this row |
| `secondaryContent` | `Widget?` | | Content above the text (attached files) |
| `disableSecondaryActionsPaddings`, `disableSecondaryContentPaddings` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | | |
| `disabled`, `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `invalid`, `warning` | `bool` | `false` | Status border with a thick start edge |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | | |
| `autoFocus` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `spellcheck`, `autoComplete` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `onFocus`, `onBlur` | `VoidCallback?` | | |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | | |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsPromptInputI18nStrings` | English | `actionButtonAriaLabel` |

## Examples

### Attachments and actions

```dart
CsPromptInput(
  value: prompt,
  actionButtonIcon: CsIcons.send,
  minRows: 2,
  maxRows: 6,
  onChange: (v) {},
  onAction: (v) {},
  secondaryContent: CsFileTokenGroup(
    alignment: CsFileTokenGroupAlignment.horizontal,
    items: [for (final f in attached) CsFileTokenGroupItem(file: f)],
    onDismiss: (i) {},
  ),
  secondaryActions: CsFileInput(
    value: attached,
    variant: CsFileInputVariant.icon,
    ariaLabel: 'Attach file',
    onPick: (request) async => null,
    onChange: (files) {},
  ),
)
```

### Stop while streaming

```dart
CsPromptInput(
  value: '',
  customPrimaryAction: CsButton(icon: CsIcons.stopCircle, variant: CsButtonVariant.icon, semanticLabel: 'Stop generating', onPress: () {}),
)
```

## Accessibility

A labelled container around a multi-line text field. Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a new line (IME composition is never interrupted). The action button is named "Submit prompt" by default and disabled while `disabled`, `readOnly` or `disableActionButton`. Focus anywhere inside draws the field's focus ring.

## Motion

The field grows line by line as text wraps, without animation, like Cloudscape.

## Mobile

The soft keyboard shows a send key, which calls `onAction`. Secondary actions and the send button sit in one row under the text; the field never scrolls horizontally.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value`, `placeholder`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `warning`, `minRows`, `maxRows`, `disableActionButton`, `customPrimaryAction`, `secondaryActions`, `secondaryContent`, `disableSecondaryActionsPaddings`, `disableSecondaryContentPaddings`, `ariaLabel`, `autoFocus`, `spellcheck`, `i18nStrings` | same names |
| `onChange`, `onAction` (`detail.value`) | `ValueChanged<String>` |
| `actionButtonIconName` | `actionButtonIcon` |
| `actionButtonIconSvg`, `actionButtonIconUrl` | `actionButtonIconWidget` |
| `actionButtonAriaLabel` | `actionButtonAriaLabel` |
| `autoComplete` (string) | `autoComplete` (`bool`) |
| `tokens`, `tokensToText`, `menus`, `onMenuItemSelect`, `onMenuLoadItems`, `onMenuFilter`, `onTriggerDetected`, `maxMenuHeight` | not supported (token mode) |
| `name`, `nativeTextareaAttributes`, `style`, `onKeyDown`, `onKeyUp` | not applicable |

---
source: doc/components/CsPropertyFilter.md

# CsPropertyFilter

Cloudscape's `PropertyFilter`: builds a query of `property operator value` tokens and free-text tokens for filtering a collection.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/property-filter/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsPropertyFilter(
  query: const CsPropertyFilterQuery(),
  onChange: (query) {},
  countText: '5 matches',
  filteringProperties: const [
    CsPropertyFilterProperty(key: 'type', propertyLabel: 'Instance type', groupValuesLabel: 'Instance type values'),
    CsPropertyFilterProperty(key: 'state', propertyLabel: 'State', groupValuesLabel: 'State values'),
  ],
  filteringOptions: const [
    CsPropertyFilterOption(propertyKey: 'type', value: 't3.micro'),
    CsPropertyFilterOption(propertyKey: 'state', value: 'Running'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it above large collections where users filter by several properties. For plain text search use `CsTextFilter`.

## How it works

1. With an empty input the suggestions list properties and values.
2. Picking a property fills "Instance type " and suggests its operators.
3. Picking an operator fills "Instance type = " and suggests that property's values.
4. Picking a value adds the token. Typing a whole query ("State = Running") and pressing Enter works too; other text becomes a free-text token (operator `contains`) unless `disableFreeTextFiltering`.
5. Tokens show under the input, joined by the and/or operation (tap it to switch). Tapping a token opens the editor (property, operator, value, Cancel and Apply). "Clear filters" removes every token.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | `CsPropertyFilterQuery` | required | `tokens` and `operation` (`and`, `or`) |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<CsPropertyFilterQuery>` | required | Next query |
| `filteringProperties` | `List<CsPropertyFilterProperty>` | required | `key`, `propertyLabel`, `groupValuesLabel`, `operators`, `defaultOperator`, `group` |
| `filteringOptions` | `List<CsPropertyFilterOption>` | `[]` | `propertyKey`, `value`, `label` |
| `countText` | `String?` | | Next to the input while there are tokens |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `hideOperations` | `bool` | `false` | Hide and/or |
| `readOnlyOperations` | `bool` | `false` | And/or as text |
| `disableFreeTextFiltering` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `freeTextOperators` | `List<CsPropertyFilterOperator>` | `contains`, `notContains` | Offered in the editor for free text |
| `customGroupsText` | `List<CsPropertyFilterGroupText>` | `[]` | Headings of custom property groups |
| `tokenLimit` | `int?` | | Tokens before "Show more" |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsPropertyFilterI18nStrings` | English | Every label, operator name and `formatToken`, `removeTokenButtonAriaLabel`, `enteredTextLabel` |
| `onLoadItems` | `ValueChanged<CsPropertyFilterLoadItemsDetail>?` | | As the user types: property, operator and value text |
| `filteringEmpty`, `filteringLoadingText`, `filteringFinishedText`, `filteringErrorText`, `filteringRecoveryText`, `filteringStatusType` | | | Suggestion status |
| `filteringConstraintText` | `String?` | | Help under the input |
| `customControl` | `Widget?` | | Before the input |
| `customFilterActions` | `Widget?` | | Replaces "Clear filters" |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Hides the count |
| `tokenLimitShowMoreAriaLabel`, `tokenLimitShowFewerAriaLabel` | `String?` | | |

Operators (`CsPropertyFilterOperator`): `lessThan` `<`, `lessThanOrEqual` `<=`, `greaterThan` `>`, `greaterThanOrEqual` `>=`, `contains` `:`, `notContains` `!:`, `equals` `=`, `notEquals` `!=`, `startsWith` `^`, `notStartsWith` `!^`.

## Examples

### Numeric operators and custom groups

```dart
CsPropertyFilter(
  query: const CsPropertyFilterQuery(tokens: [
    CsPropertyFilterToken(propertyKey: 'cpu', operator: CsPropertyFilterOperator.greaterThan, value: '80'),
  ], operation: CsPropertyFilterOperation.or),
  onChange: (query) {},
  filteringProperties: const [
    CsPropertyFilterProperty(
      key: 'cpu',
      propertyLabel: 'CPU utilization',
      groupValuesLabel: 'CPU values',
      operators: [CsPropertyFilterOperator.greaterThan, CsPropertyFilterOperator.lessThan],
      group: 'metrics',
    ),
  ],
  customGroupsText: const [CsPropertyFilterGroupText(group: 'metrics', properties: 'Metrics', values: 'Metric values')],
)
```

## Accessibility

The input is a text field with suggestions driven by Up, Down and Enter (see `CsAutosuggest`). Each token is a button announcing "<property> <operator name> <value>" (override with `formatToken`) that opens the editor, plus a remove button. The and/or control announces "Boolean operator" with its value. The editor traps focus, Escape closes it and focus returns to the token.

## Motion

Suggestions, the and/or menu and the editor scale and fade from their anchors; reduced motion keeps only the fade.

## Mobile

Tokens wrap. The token editor opens as a bottom sheet at or below 688px.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `query`, `onChange` (`detail`) | `query`, `onChange` (the query) |
| `filteringProperties`, `filteringOptions`, `countText`, `disabled`, `hideOperations`, `readOnlyOperations`, `disableFreeTextFiltering`, `customGroupsText`, `tokenLimit`, `i18nStrings`, `onLoadItems` | same names |
| `freeTextFiltering.operators` | `freeTextOperators` |
| `filteringEmpty`, `filteringLoadingText`, `filteringFinishedText`, `filteringErrorText`, `filteringRecoveryText`, `filteringStatusType`, `filteringConstraintText`, `customControl`, `customFilterActions` | same names |
| `filteringAriaLabel`, `filteringPlaceholder` | `i18nStrings.filteringAriaLabel`, `.filteringPlaceholder` |
| `enableTokenGroups`, extended operators with custom forms, `asyncProperties` | not implemented (tokens are flat; values are strings) |
| `expandToViewport`, `virtualScroll` | not applicable |

---
source: doc/components/CsRadioButton.md
---

# CsRadioButton

A single radio button with a label, for building custom single-choice layouts; also exports the `CsRadioIcon` glyph and the `CsControlRow` layout.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/radio-button/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsRadioButton(
  checked: plan == 'spot',
  label: 'Spot',
  description: 'Spare capacity at a discount.',
  onSelect: () => setState(() => plan = 'spot'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use when the options sit in a custom layout, such as a row with a price beside each radio.
- For a plain list use `CsRadioGroup`, which also handles arrow keys and a single Tab stop.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `bool` | required | Whether this radio is selected. |
| `onSelect` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Called when the user picks it while unchecked. Null disables it. |
| `label` / `child` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | Label; tapping it selects too. |
| `description` / `descriptionWidget` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | Body-s text under the label. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Focusable, not selectable. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name without a label. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | |

### CsRadioIcon

`CsRadioIcon(checked:, disabled: false, readOnly: false)` is the bare 16px glyph for option lists and tiles.

### CsControlRow

`CsControlRow(control:, controlHeight:, label:, description:, disabled: false)` lays out a control with a label and description the way Cloudscape's checkbox, radio and toggle do: the control centered on the first 20px line, the text 8px after it.

## Examples

### Priced options

```dart
Column(
  children: [
    for (final plan in const ['on-demand', 'reserved', 'spot'])
      Row(
        children: [
          Expanded(
            child: CsRadioButton(
              checked: selected == plan,
              label: plan,
              onSelect: () => setState(() => selected = plan),
            ),
          ),
          const CsBox(variant: CsBoxVariant.small, text: 'Sample price'),
        ],
      ),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

Announced as a radio button in a mutually exclusive group with its checked state. Tab focuses it and Space or Enter selects it. Standalone radios do not move with arrow keys; give a list of them a `CsRadioGroup` when possible.

## Motion

The checked ring grows in over 250ms; reduced motion shows it at once.

## Mobile

The row is padded to a 44px touch target; labels wrap at 2x text.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `checked` | `checked` |
| `onSelect` | `onSelect` |
| `children` | `label` / `child` |
| `description` | `description` / `descriptionWidget` |
| `disabled` / `readOnly` | `disabled` / `readOnly` |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `name`, `value`, `controlId`, `ariaLabelledby`, `ariaDescribedby`, `nativeInputAttributes`, `style` | web only |

source: doc/components/CsRadioGroup.md

# CsRadioGroup

A list of mutually exclusive options where all choices stay visible.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/radio-group/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Storage class',
  child: CsRadioGroup(
    value: storageClass,
    onChange: (v) => setState(() => storageClass = v),
    items: const [
      CsRadioGroupItem(value: 'standard', label: 'Standard', description: 'For frequently accessed data.'),
      CsRadioGroupItem(value: 'ia', label: 'Infrequent access'),
    ],
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for 2 to 7 options the user should compare at a glance.
- Use a select for longer lists, `CsTiles` when options need more description or an image, and `CsSegmentedControl` to switch views.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String?` | required | Value of the selected item; null for none. |
| `items` | `List<CsRadioGroupItem>` | required | The options. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Called with the newly selected value. Null disables the group. |
| `direction` | `CsRadioGroupDirection` | `vertical` | `horizontal` lays radios side by side, wrapping, 20px apart. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Focusable, not changeable. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disables every item (a Flutter addition). |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Group name outside a labelled form field. |
| `ariaRequired` | `bool` | `false` | Adds a "Required" hint. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | Focus the tab-stop radio on mount. |

`CsRadioGroupItem(value:, label:, labelWidget:, description:, descriptionWidget:, disabled: false)`: pass `label` or `labelWidget`.

## Examples

### Horizontal

```dart
CsRadioGroup(
  value: protocol,
  direction: CsRadioGroupDirection.horizontal,
  ariaLabel: 'Origin protocol',
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => protocol = v),
  items: const [
    CsRadioGroupItem(value: 'http', label: 'HTTP only'),
    CsRadioGroupItem(value: 'https', label: 'HTTPS only'),
    CsRadioGroupItem(value: 'match', label: 'Match viewer'),
  ],
)
```

### Disabled item

```dart
CsRadioGroup(
  value: tier,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => tier = v),
  items: const [
    CsRadioGroupItem(value: 'basic', label: 'Basic'),
    CsRadioGroupItem(value: 'archive', label: 'Archive', description: 'Not available in this Region.', disabled: true),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- Each radio is announced as a checked or unchecked radio button in a mutually exclusive group, with its label and description.
- The group is one Tab stop: the selected radio, or the first enabled one. Arrow keys (Up/Left previous, Down/Right next, mirrored in RTL) move to the next enabled radio and select it, wrapping at the ends, like native radios. Disabled items are skipped; in a read-only group arrows move focus without changing the value.

## Motion

When a radio becomes checked its ring grows in from a thin stroke over 250ms (Cloudscape's `awsui-radio-select`). Reduced motion shows the final state.

## Mobile

Each row is padded to a 44px touch target. Vertical groups suit phones best; horizontal groups wrap at 390px and cap each item at about 80 characters wide.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` / `onChange` | `value` / `onChange` (`ValueChanged<String>`) |
| `items` (`value`, `label`, `description`, `disabled`) | `items` (`CsRadioGroupItem`) |
| `direction` | `direction` |
| `readOnly` | `readOnly` |
| `ariaLabel`, `ariaRequired` | `ariaLabel`, `ariaRequired` |
| `name`, `controlId`, `items[].controlId`, `ariaControls`, `style` | web only |

source: doc/components/CsS3ResourceSelector.md
---

# CsS3ResourceSelector

Cloudscape's `S3ResourceSelector`: an S3 URI input with a Browse button that opens a modal to pick a bucket, object or object version, plus a version picker and a View button.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/s3-resource-selector/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFormField(
  errorText: error,
  child: CsS3ResourceSelector(
    resource: resource,
    selectableItemsTypes: const {CsS3SelectableItems.objects},
    fetchBuckets: () async => const [CsS3Bucket(name: 'example-bucket', region: 'us-east-1')],
    fetchObjects: (bucket, path) async => const [CsS3Object(key: 'report.csv', size: 2048)],
    fetchVersions: (bucket, path) async => const [],
    onChange: (change) => setState(() {
      resource = change.resource;
      error = change.errorText;
    }),
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it when a form needs a location in S3-style object storage. In read mode allow `objects` and `versions`; in write mode allow `buckets` and `objects`. Use a plain `CsInput` when browsing is not possible.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resource` | `CsS3Resource` | required | `uri` and optional `versionId` |
| `fetchBuckets` | `Future<List<CsS3Bucket>> Function()` | required | All buckets |
| `fetchObjects` | `Future<List<CsS3Object>> Function(String bucket, String path)` | required | Objects and folders under a path |
| `fetchVersions` | `Future<List<CsS3Version>> Function(String bucket, String path)` | required | Versions of an object |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<CsS3ResourceChange>?` |  | New resource and a validation `errorText` |
| `selectableItemsTypes` | `Set<CsS3SelectableItems>` | `{}` | `buckets`, `objects`, `versions` |
| `alert` | `Widget?` |  | Shown in the modal above the table |
| `inputPlaceholder`, `ariaLabel` | `String?` |  | URI input |
| `onView` | `VoidCallback?` |  | Opens the selected object; null disables View |
| `invalid` | `bool` | `false` | Invalid style on the URI input |
| `bucketsVisibleColumns` | `List<String>?` |  | `Name`, `CreationDate`, `Region` |
| `objectsVisibleColumns` | `List<String>?` |  | `Key`, `LastModified`, `Size` |
| `versionsVisibleColumns` | `List<String>?` |  | `ID`, `LastModified`, `Size` |
| `bucketsIsItemDisabled`, `objectsIsItemDisabled`, `versionsIsItemDisabled` | `bool Function(T)?` |  | Override selectability |
| `onInputFocus`, `onInputBlur` | `VoidCallback?` |  |  |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsS3ResourceSelectorI18nStrings` | English | All copy |

Helpers: `csS3ValidateUri(uri)`, `csS3SplitUri(uri)`, `csS3FormatSize(bytes)`. `CsS3ResourceSelectorState.focus()` focuses the input.

## Examples

### Versions in read mode

```dart
CsS3ResourceSelector(
  resource: resource,
  selectableItemsTypes: const {CsS3SelectableItems.objects, CsS3SelectableItems.versions},
  objectsIsItemDisabled: (object) => object.isFolder,
  fetchBuckets: listBuckets,
  fetchObjects: listObjects,
  fetchVersions: listVersions,
  onChange: (change) => setState(() => resource = change.resource),
)
```

## Behavior

- Validation runs once the input has lost focus once: the URI must start with `s3://`, and the bucket name must start with a lowercase letter or digit, have no uppercase letters, be 3 to 63 characters and follow DNS naming.
- With `versions` selectable, leaving the input loads the versions of a valid URI into the version picker ("Loading resource" shows meanwhile).
- The modal lists buckets, then objects under folders (breadcrumbs go back), then versions. Each table fetches once, then filters, sorts and pages 10 items locally; Refresh reloads and shows the time. Choose is enabled once an item is selected.

## Accessibility

The URI input is labeled "S3 URI"; the version picker is an expandable button with its value; the View button announces that it opens a new tab. The modal traps focus and closes on Escape. Tables use radios labeled per item; folder and object icons are labeled.

## Motion

The modal uses `CsDialogRoute` motion; the version list opens with `CsDropdown`. Reduced motion makes both instant.

## Mobile

Below 600px the URI input, version picker and buttons stack. The modal takes the screen width less 12px each side, and its tables scroll sideways with the first column stuck. The version picker opens as a bottom sheet on phones.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `resource`, `onChange` detail `{resource, errorText}` | `CsS3Resource`, `CsS3ResourceChange` |
| `fetchBuckets` etc. returning promises | functions returning `Future` |
| Bucket `Name`, Object `Key`/`IsFolder`, Version `VersionId` | `name`, `key`/`isFolder`, `versionId` |
| `selectableItemsTypes` array | `Set<CsS3SelectableItems>` |
| `viewHref` | `onView` |
| `labelsPagination`, `labelExpandBreadcrumbs` | local pager labels `labelPreviousPage`, `labelNextPage` |
| `getModalRoot`, `removeModalRoot`, `ariaLabelledby`, `ariaDescribedby`, `inputAriaDescribedby` | web only, not ported |

source: doc/components/CsScrim.md

# CsScrim

The backdrop behind modals and sheets: Cloudscape's `color-background-modal-overlay`, so the page behind recedes, and a full-screen tap target that closes the overlay.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/modal/ (a foundation primitive)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsScrim(onPress: () {})
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it under a custom blocking overlay you build yourself. `CsModal`, `showCsSheet` and `CsDialogRoute` already draw one.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` | | Tap on the backdrop; null makes it inert and hidden from screen readers |
| `opacity` | `double` | `1` | Multiplies the token's own opacity, for drag-driven dimming |
| `semanticLabel` | `String` | `'Close'` | Screen reader name when `onPress` is set |

## Examples

### Dimming with a drag

```dart
Stack(
  children: [
    const Positioned.fill(child: CsScrim(opacity: 0.5)),
    Align(alignment: Alignment.bottomCenter, child: CsContainer(child: const Text('Drag me down'))),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

With `onPress`, the scrim is a button named `semanticLabel`, so screen reader users can close the overlay without a gesture. It always absorbs taps, so the page behind stays inert.

## Motion

None of its own; overlays fade it in and out with their content.

## Mobile

Fills the screen it is given, including behind system bars.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape concept | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| modal `.root` background | the scrim |
| overlay click (`reason: 'overlay'`) | `onPress` |

source: doc/components/CsSegmentedControl.md

# CsSegmentedControl

A row of 2 to 6 buttons in a pill where exactly one is active, for switching between views of the same content.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/segmented-control/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsSegmentedControl(
  label: 'Time range',
  selectedId: range,
  onChange: (id) => setState(() => range = id),
  options: const [
    CsSegmentedControlOption(id: '1h', text: '1h'),
    CsSegmentedControlOption(id: '3h', text: '3h'),
    CsSegmentedControlOption(id: '12h', text: '12h'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use to switch the presentation of content in place: a chart range, a list or grid view.
- Use tabs to switch between different content, and a radio group for a form value.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selectedId` | `String?` | required | Id of the active segment; null for none. |
| `options` | `List<CsSegmentedControlOption>` | required | Up to 6 segments. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Called with the picked id. |
| `label` | `String?` | `null` | Group name; shown as the visible label of the select form. |
| `presentation` | `CsSegmentedControlPresentation` | `auto` | `auto`: segments above 688px, a select at or below. `segments` or `select` force one form. |
| `haptic` | `CsHaptic` | `selection` | Feedback on change. |

`CsSegmentedControlOption(id:, text:, icon:, iconWidget:, iconAlt:, disabled: false, disabledReason:)`: pass `text`, an icon, or both. Icon-only segments need `iconAlt`. A disabled segment with a `disabledReason` stays focusable and explains itself in a tooltip.

## Examples

### Icons

```dart
CsSegmentedControl(
  label: 'Layout',
  selectedId: view,
  presentation: CsSegmentedControlPresentation.segments,
  onChange: (id) => setState(() => view = id),
  options: const [
    CsSegmentedControlOption(id: 'list', icon: CsIcons.listView, iconAlt: 'List'),
    CsSegmentedControlOption(id: 'grid', icon: CsIcons.gridView, iconAlt: 'Grid'),
  ],
)
```

### Disabled with a reason

```dart
CsSegmentedControl(
  selectedId: range,
  onChange: (id) => setState(() => range = id),
  options: const [
    CsSegmentedControlOption(id: '1d', text: '1d'),
    CsSegmentedControlOption(id: '1w', text: '1w', disabled: true, disabledReason: 'Turn on detailed monitoring.'),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- Segments are buttons; the active one is marked selected. Icon-only segments are named by `iconAlt`.
- The control is one Tab stop (the active segment). Left and Right move focus between segments, wrapping (mirrored in RTL); Enter or Space picks the focused one.
- In the select form, the trigger announces the label and the current value and opens a list where the current option is selected.

## Motion

Hover and selection colors change instantly. The select form's dropdown scales in from the trigger; on phones it is a bottom sheet.

## Mobile

At or below 688px Cloudscape replaces the segments with a select; this widget does the same with a dropdown list that opens as a bottom sheet, labelled by `label`. Set `presentation: CsSegmentedControlPresentation.segments` to keep a short pill on phones (it scrolls sideways if it does not fit).

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `selectedId` / `onChange` | `selectedId` / `onChange` (`ValueChanged<String>`) |
| `options` (`id`, `text`, `iconName`, `iconAlt`, `iconSvg`, `iconUrl`, `disabled`, `disabledReason`) | `options` (`id`, `text`, `icon`, `iconAlt`, `iconWidget`, `disabled`, `disabledReason`) |
| `label` | `label` |
| narrow-container select | `presentation` |
| `ariaLabelledby`, `style` | web only |
