source: doc/components/CsSelect.md
---

# CsSelect

Cloudscape's `Select`: pick one option from a dropdown list, with optional filtering, option groups, rich options and asynchronous loading states.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/select/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsSelect(
  selectedOption: const CsOption(value: 't3.micro'),
  placeholder: 'Choose an instance type',
  options: const [
    CsOption(value: 't3.micro', description: '2 vCPU, 1 GiB'),
    CsOption(value: 't3.small', description: '2 vCPU, 2 GiB'),
  ],
  onChange: (option) {},
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a select for one choice from a list of more than about five options. For two to five options that should all stay visible, use radio buttons or a segmented control. For many choices use `CsMultiselect`; when any typed value is valid and options only help, use `CsAutosuggest`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `List<CsOptionItem>` | required | `CsOption`s and `CsOptionGroup`s, in display order |
| `selectedOption` | `CsOption?` | required | The chosen option (matched by `value`), or null for the placeholder |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<CsOption>?` | | Called with the picked option |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | | Shown while nothing is chosen |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Focusable, cannot open |
| `invalid` / `warning` | `bool` | `false` | Status border with a thick start edge |
| `filteringType` | `CsFilteringType` | `none` | `none`, `auto` (filters label, value, description, label tag, tags, filtering tags) or `manual` (filter in `onLoadItems`) |
| `filteringPlaceholder`, `filteringAriaLabel`, `filteringClearAriaLabel` | `String?` | | Filter input copy |
| `filteringResultsText` | `String Function(int matches, int total)?` | | Footer while filtering |
| `noMatch` | `Widget?` | | Shown when the filter matches nothing |
| `empty` | `Widget?` | | Shown when there are no options |
| `statusType` | `CsDropdownStatusType` | `finished` | `pending`, `loading`, `finished`, `error` |
| `loadingText`, `finishedText`, `errorText`, `recoveryText`, `errorIconAriaLabel` | `String?` | | Status footer copy; `recoveryText` is a retry link |
| `onLoadItems` | `ValueChanged<CsLoadItemsDetail>?` | | Open, filter change, scroll to end (while `pending`) and retry |
| `triggerVariant` | `CsSelectTriggerVariant` | `label` | `label` (icon and label) or `option` (the whole option) |
| `inlineLabelText` | `String?` | | Label drawn on the trigger's top border |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name without a visible label |
| `ariaRequired` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `selectedAriaLabel` | `String?` | | Announced with the selected option |
| `autoFocus`, `focusNode`, `onFocus`, `onBlur` | | | |
| `presentation` | `CsPresentation` | `auto` | Anchored list, or a bottom sheet at or below 688px |
| `dropdownHeader`, `dropdownFooter` | `Widget?` | | Content above and below the options |
| `renderOption` | `Widget Function(BuildContext, CsOption, bool highlighted, bool selected)?` | | Custom row content |

`CsOption` fields: `value` (required), `label`, `description`, `labelTag`, `tags`, `filteringTags`, `icon`, `iconWidget`, `iconAriaLabel`, `disabled`, `disabledReason`, `labelContent`. `CsOptionGroup`: `label`, `options`, `description`, `icon`, `disabled`, `disabledReason`, `labelTag`, `tags`.

## Examples

### Groups, label tags and disabled options

```dart
CsSelect(
  selectedOption: null,
  placeholder: 'Choose an instance type',
  options: const [
    CsOptionGroup(label: 'General purpose', options: [
      CsOption(value: 't3.micro', labelTag: 'Free tier', tags: ['2 vCPU', '1 GiB']),
      CsOption(value: 't3.xlarge', disabled: true, disabledReason: 'Service quota reached'),
    ]),
    CsOptionGroup(label: 'Compute optimized', options: [CsOption(value: 'c6i.large')]),
  ],
  onChange: (option) {},
)
```

### Filtering

```dart
CsSelect(
  selectedOption: null,
  options: const [CsOption(value: 'us-east-1', label: 'US East (N. Virginia)'), CsOption(value: 'eu-west-1', label: 'Europe (Ireland)')],
  filteringType: CsFilteringType.auto,
  filteringPlaceholder: 'Find region',
  noMatch: const Text('No regions match'),
  filteringResultsText: (matches, total) => '$matches of $total regions',
  onChange: (option) {},
)
```

### Loading from a server

```dart
CsSelect(
  selectedOption: null,
  options: const [],
  statusType: CsDropdownStatusType.error,
  loadingText: 'Loading buckets',
  errorText: 'Could not load buckets',
  recoveryText: 'Retry',
  onLoadItems: (detail) {},
  onChange: (option) {},
)
```

### Option trigger and inline label

```dart
CsSelect(
  selectedOption: const CsOption(value: 'vpc-0abc', label: 'main-vpc', description: '10.0.0.0/16'),
  options: const [CsOption(value: 'vpc-0abc', label: 'main-vpc', description: '10.0.0.0/16')],
  triggerVariant: CsSelectTriggerVariant.option,
  inlineLabelText: 'VPC',
  onChange: (option) {},
)
```

## Accessibility

The trigger is a button announcing its label, the selected option as its value, and its expanded state. Focus stays on the trigger (or the filter input) while the list is open; Up and Down move the highlight (wrapping and skipping disabled options and group headers), Home and End jump, Enter or Space picks, typing letters jumps to a matching option, Escape closes and Tab closes and moves on. Options announce their selected state; disabled options announce their reason. The status footer is a live region.

## Motion

The caret turns over (135ms) while the list is open. The list scales and fades in from the trigger and closes along the same path; on phones the sheet follows the finger. Reduced motion removes the rotation and scale.

## Mobile

At or below 688px (`CsPresentation.auto`) the list opens in a bottom sheet with 44px rows and closes after a pick. Pass `CsPresentation.popover` to keep the anchored list everywhere.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `options`, `selectedOption`, `placeholder`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `warning` | same names |
| `onChange` (`detail.selectedOption`) | `onChange` (the option) |
| `filteringType`, `filteringPlaceholder`, `filteringAriaLabel`, `filteringClearAriaLabel`, `filteringResultsText`, `noMatch`, `empty` | same names |
| `statusType`, `loadingText`, `finishedText`, `errorText`, `recoveryText`, `errorIconAriaLabel`, `onLoadItems` | same names |
| `triggerVariant`, `inlineLabelText`, `ariaLabel`, `ariaRequired`, `selectedAriaLabel`, `autoFocus`, `onFocus`, `onBlur`, `renderOption` | same names |
| `renderDropdownHeader`, `renderDropdownFooter` | `dropdownHeader`, `dropdownFooter` |
| `option.iconName` / `iconUrl` / `iconSvg` | `icon` / `iconWidget` |
| `expandToViewport`, `virtualScroll`, `name`, `controlId`, `ariaLabelledby`, `dropdownRole`, `renderHighlightedAriaLive` | not applicable (the overlay always escapes clipping; lists build all rows) |

---
source: doc/components/CsSheet.md
---

# CsSheet

A sheet attached to a screen edge that follows the finger, snaps by release velocity and dismisses with a flick, usually opened with `showCsSheet`. Cloudscape components use it on phones in place of anchored menus and panels.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/drawer/ (a foundation primitive; Cloudscape's web components have no sheet)

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
Future<void> chooseRegion(BuildContext context) async {
  final region = await showCsSheet<String>(
    context: context,
    semanticLabel: 'Choose a Region',
    builder: (context) => Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        for (final r in const ['us-east-1', 'eu-west-1', 'ap-southeast-1'])
          CsButton(text: r, variant: CsButtonVariant.link, onPress: () => CsSheetScope.closeFrom(context, r)),
      ],
    ),
  );
}
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a sheet on phones for choices and short tasks that would be a dropdown, popover or side panel on a wide screen. On desktop prefer `CsAnchoredOverlay`-based components, `CsModal` or `CsDrawer`. Components that switch automatically (`CsDropdown` with `CsPresentation.auto`) already use it.

## Parameters

### showCsSheet

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `context` | `BuildContext` | required | |
| `builder` | `WidgetBuilder` | required | Sheet content |
| `edge` | `CsSheetEdge` | `bottom` | `bottom`, `top`, `start`, `end` |
| `snapPoints` | `List<double>?` | | Visible heights as fractions of the screen (bottom and top sheets); null sizes to content |
| `initialSnapPointIndex` | `int?` | smallest | Index into the sorted snap points |
| `dismissible` | `bool` | `true` | Scrim tap, flick, Escape and back close it |
| `showHandle` | `bool` | `true` | Grab handle on bottom sheets |
| `maxExtentFraction` | `double` | `0.85` | Largest share of the screen |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | | Name of the sheet's route |
| `useRootNavigator` | `bool` | `true` | |

Returns `Future<T?>` with the value the sheet closed with. Close it from inside with `CsSheetScope.closeFrom(context, result)` or `Navigator.pop`.

### CsSheet

`CsSheet({required CsSheetEdge edge, required Widget child, Widget? header, double maxExtentFraction = 0.75, List<double>? snapPoints, int? initialSnapPointIndex, bool preventDismissGestures = false, VoidCallback? onCloseComplete, VoidCallback? onOpenComplete, String? accessibilityLabel, double borderRadius = 16, bool? reduceMotion})` is the widget `showCsSheet` builds, for hosting a sheet in your own route. `CsSheetHandle` is the grab handle.

## Examples

### Snap points

```dart
Future<void> showLogs(BuildContext context) => showCsSheet<void>(
  context: context,
  snapPoints: const [0.4, 0.9],
  semanticLabel: 'Logs for i-0abc123',
  builder: (context) => ListView(
    children: [for (var i = 0; i < 40; i++) Text('2026-11-16T10:00:${i.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}Z GET /index.html 200')],
  ),
);
```

## Accessibility

The sheet is its own route named by `semanticLabel`; focus is trapped inside it and returns when it closes. Escape and the back gesture close it (unless not dismissible). The handle is a "Close" button for screen readers, and the scrim is a "Close" button too.

## Motion

The sheet springs in from its edge and follows the finger 1:1 while dragged. On release the velocity is projected to pick the nearest snap point or dismiss; past its open position it rubberbands. It can be grabbed mid-animation, and a scroll view inside a bottom sheet hands its overscroll to the sheet. Dismissing runs the entry path backwards. Reduced motion replaces the slide with a fade.

## Mobile

Built for phones: bottom sheets respect the safe area and the keyboard, and `snapPoints` let long content open half-way first.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape concept | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| mobile dropdowns and panels | `showCsSheet` |
| `onDismiss` | the returned `Future` |

---
source: doc/components/CsSideNavigation.md
---

# CsSideNavigation

The list of pages of a service, with sections and groups, shown in the navigation drawer of the app layout.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/side-navigation/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsSideNavigation(
  header: const CsSideNavigationHeader(text: 'Service', href: '/'),
  activeHref: '/buckets',
  onFollow: (detail) {
    if (!detail.external) Navigator.of(context).pushNamed(detail.href);
  },
  items: const [
    CsSideNavigationLink(text: 'Dashboard', href: '/dashboard'),
    CsSideNavigationSection(
      text: 'Storage',
      items: [
        CsSideNavigationLink(text: 'Buckets', href: '/buckets'),
        CsSideNavigationLink(text: 'Access points', href: '/access-points'),
      ],
    ),
    CsSideNavigationDivider(),
    CsSideNavigationLink(text: 'Documentation', href: 'https://example.com/docs', external: true),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use as the primary navigation of a service with several pages, inside the app layout's navigation slot.
- Do not use for a table of contents within one page (use `CsAnchorNavigation`) or for global links across services (use `CsTopNavigation`).
- Keep one level of nesting.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<CsSideNavigationItem>` | `[]` | The items. See the item types below. |
| `header` | `CsSideNavigationHeader?` | `null` | `text`, `href` and an optional `logo` widget. |
| `activeHref` | `String?` | `null` | Every link with this href is highlighted. Groups holding it expand. |
| `itemsControl` | `Widget?` | `null` | A slot between the header and the items. |
| `onFollow` | `ValueChanged<CsSideNavigationFollowDetail>?` | `null` | A link, group link or the header was followed: `href`, `text`, `type`, `external`, `item`. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<CsSideNavigationChangeDetail>?` | `null` | A section or expandable link group was toggled: `item`, `expanded`, `expandableParents`. |
| `collapsed` | `bool` | `false` | Icon-only rail: only items with an icon remain, as round buttons with tooltips. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `CsStrings.navigation` | Accessible name. |

Item types (`sealed class CsSideNavigationItem`):

| Class | Cloudscape type | Fields |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CsSideNavigationLink` | `link` | `text`, `href`, `external`, `externalIconAriaLabel`, `info`, `icon`, `iconWidget` |
| `CsSideNavigationDivider` | `divider` | none |
| `CsSideNavigationSection` | `section` | `text`, `items`, `defaultExpanded` (true), `info` |
| `CsSideNavigationSectionGroup` | `section-group` | `title`, `items`, `info` |
| `CsSideNavigationLinkGroup` | `link-group` | `text`, `href`, `items`, `info`, `icon`, `iconWidget` |
| `CsSideNavigationExpandableLinkGroup` | `expandable-link-group` | `text`, `href`, `items`, `defaultExpanded`, `info`, `icon`, `iconWidget` |

## Examples

### Groups and info

```dart
CsSideNavigation(
  activeHref: '/instances/templates',
  onFollow: (detail) {},
  onChange: (detail) {},
  items: const [
    CsSideNavigationExpandableLinkGroup(
      text: 'Instances',
      href: '/instances',
      items: [
        CsSideNavigationLink(text: 'Launch templates', href: '/instances/templates'),
        CsSideNavigationLink(text: 'Spot requests', href: '/instances/spot'),
      ],
    ),
    CsSideNavigationLinkGroup(
      text: 'Distributions',
      href: '/distributions',
      items: [CsSideNavigationLink(text: 'Origins', href: '/distributions/origins')],
    ),
    CsSideNavigationSectionGroup(
      title: 'Settings',
      items: [CsSideNavigationLink(text: 'Preferences', href: '/preferences', info: Text('New'))],
    ),
  ],
)
```

### Icon-only rail

```dart
CsSideNavigation(
  collapsed: true,
  activeHref: '/buckets',
  onFollow: (detail) {},
  items: const [
    CsSideNavigationLink(text: 'Dashboard', href: '/dashboard', icon: CsIcons.gridView),
    CsSideNavigationLink(text: 'Buckets', href: '/buckets', icon: CsIcons.folder),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- The navigation is a labeled container. Links announce as links; the active one is marked selected (Cloudscape's `aria-current="page"`).
- Section headers and expandable carets are buttons with an expanded state. Tab reaches every link and caret; Enter and Space activate them.
- External links add "Opens in a new window" (or `externalIconAriaLabel`).
- In the collapsed rail each icon button is named by its text, which also shows in a tooltip.
- Collapsed content is removed from the tree, so it leaves the Tab order.

## Motion

Sections and groups expand and collapse from the top with a fade (`CsDurations.expandableContentEnter`, 180ms in, 135ms out). The caret turns 90 degrees (`CsDurations.rotate90`). Reduced motion makes both instant. Hover colors switch instantly.

## Mobile

The app layout shows the navigation in a drawer on phones. The list wraps long titles; on touch screens hit areas grow to 44px. Use `collapsed` for a narrow rail on tablets.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `items` (`type` unions) | `items` (sealed `CsSideNavigationItem` classes) |
| `header` (`text`, `href`, `logo`) | `header` (`logo` is a widget) |
| `activeHref` | `activeHref` |
| `itemsControl` | `itemsControl` |
| `onFollow` | `onFollow` (`CsSideNavigationFollowDetail`) |
| `onChange` | `onChange` (`CsSideNavigationChangeDetail`) |
| `collapsed` | `collapsed` |
| `info`, `icon` (ReactNode) | `info` (`Widget`), `icon` (`CsIconData`) or `iconWidget` |

source: doc/components/CsSkeleton.md

# CsSkeleton

Cloudscape's `Skeleton`: a placeholder shaped like the content that is loading, so the layout does not jump when the content arrives.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/skeleton/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsSkeleton(variant: CsSkeletonVariant.textHeadingM, width: 180)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use skeletons for content whose shape you know while it loads: a heading, a few lines, a chart area. For an unknown amount of work use `CsSpinner`; for a table or list use its own loading state (`loading` + `loadingText`).

## Parameters

### CsSkeleton

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `CsSkeletonVariant` | `dynamic` | Height of one line of the matching text step: `textBodyS`, `textBodyM`, `textHeadingXs` to `textHeadingXl`, `textDisplayL`; `dynamic` follows the surrounding text |
| `width` | `double?` | available width | Width of the bar; 160 where the width is unbounded |
| `height` | `double?` | | Block height; replaces the text line |
| `loading` | `bool` | `true` | With a `child`: shows the skeleton while true and cross-fades to the child when false |
| `child` | `Widget?` | | The content the skeleton stands in for |

### CsSkeletonLines

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lines` | `int` | `3` | Number of lines |
| `variant` | `CsSkeletonVariant` | `textBodyM` | Line height |
| `lastLineWidthFactor` | `double` | `0.6` | Width of the last line as a share of the width |
| `spacing` | `double` | `0` | Extra gap between lines |

## Examples

### A loading summary

```dart
const Column(
  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
  children: [
    CsSkeleton(variant: CsSkeletonVariant.textHeadingL, width: 220),
    SizedBox(height: 8),
    CsSkeletonLines(lines: 3),
    SizedBox(height: 16),
    CsSkeleton(height: 160),
  ],
)
```

### Swap to content when loaded

```dart
CsSkeleton(
  loading: false,
  variant: CsSkeletonVariant.textBodyM,
  width: 120,
  child: const Text('i-0abc123'),
)
```

## Accessibility

Skeletons are hidden from screen readers (`aria-hidden` in Cloudscape). Tell assistive technology that content is loading with the surrounding component's loading text or a `CsLiveRegion`, and announce when it has loaded.

## Motion

A soft wave (`color-background-skeleton-wave`) crosses the bar every 1.25s with ease-in-out, from start to end (mirrored in RTL). It runs only while the skeleton is on screen: it stops when the skeleton is replaced by its `child`, scrolled into an offstage route or disposed. Under reduced motion there is no wave and the bar stays still.

## Mobile

Skeletons fill the available width by default, so they reflow with the layout. Heights follow the type scale and do not grow with the text scale; the content that replaces them may be taller.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `variant="text-heading-m"` | `variant: CsSkeletonVariant.textHeadingM` |
| `width`, `height` (CSS strings) | `width`, `height` (logical pixels) |
| `display` | not applicable: use Flutter layout (`Row`, `Wrap`, `width`) |
| `tagOverride` | not applicable |

---
source: doc/components/CsSlider.md

# CsSlider

Picks a number from a range by dragging a handle along a track.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/slider/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Target utilization',
  child: CsSlider(
    min: 0,
    max: 100,
    step: 10,
    tickMarks: true,
    value: target,
    valueFormatter: (v) => '${v.round()}%',
    onChange: (v) => setState(() => target = v),
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use when the position in the range matters more than the exact number (a percentage, a relative capacity).
- Use `CsInput` with `type: CsInputType.number` when users need exact values, or pair the two.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min` / `max` | `double` | required | The range; `max` must be greater than `min`. |
| `value` | `double?` | middle of the range | The controlled value, shown at the nearest step. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<double>?` | `null` | Called with each new value while dragging, tapping or pressing keys. Null disables it. |
| `onChangeEnd` | `ValueChanged<double>?` | `null` | Called once when a drag, tap or key press ends (a Flutter addition). |
| `step` | `double?` | `null` | Granularity; null moves continuously (keyboard steps of 1). |
| `valueFormatter` | `String Function(double)?` | `null` | Formats the min, max and reference labels and the tooltip. |
| `referenceValues` | `List<double>` | `[]` | Labels between min and max; crowded, out-of-range and non-integer values are skipped. |
| `tickMarks` | `bool` | `false` | A tick at every step (needs `step`). |
| `hideFillLine` | `bool` | `false` | Hides the fill from the start to the handle. |
| `disabled` / `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Read-only stays focusable and shows a smaller handle. |
| `invalid` / `warning` | `bool` | `false` | Error or warning colors for the fill and handle. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name without a label. |
| `ariaDescription` | `String?` | `null` | Extra description read after the value. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsSliderI18nStrings` | English | `valueTextRange(previous, value, next)` for values the formatter leaves empty. |
| `haptic` | `CsHaptic` | `selection` | Fired at each step while dragging a stepped slider. |
| `focusNode` / `autofocus` | | | |

`CsSlider.snap(value, min:, max:, step:)` and `CsSlider.visibleReferenceValues(values, min, max, narrow:)` expose the rounding and label rules.

## Examples

### Commit on release

```dart
CsSlider(
  min: 1,
  max: 10,
  step: 1,
  tickMarks: true,
  value: instances,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => instances = v),
  onChangeEnd: (v) => saveDesiredCount(v.round()),
)
```

### Reference values and a warning

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Target utilization',
  warningText: target > 80 ? 'High targets leave little room for traffic spikes.' : null,
  child: CsSlider(
    min: 0,
    max: 100,
    referenceValues: const [25, 50, 75],
    value: target,
    warning: target > 80,
    valueFormatter: (v) => '${v.round()}%',
    onChange: (v) => setState(() => target = v),
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

- Announced as a slider with its label, the formatted value and the next and previous values; screen reader increase and decrease gestures move one step.
- Keyboard: arrows move one step (Right and Up increase; Left and Right mirror in RTL), Page Up and Page Down a tenth of the range, Home and End jump to the ends.
- Status is paired with the form field's error or warning text, not color alone.

## Motion

While focused or dragged the handle grows from 16px to 20px and shows its halo (`CsDurations.responsive`); hovering shows the halo. A tooltip with the formatted value shows over the handle while it is hovered, focused with the keyboard or dragged. Reduced motion makes the size change instant.

## Mobile

- Pressing the track jumps the handle there, then it follows the finger 1:1. The touch area is 44px tall around the 20px band.
- Stepped sliders fire a selection haptic at each step.
- On narrow screens fewer reference labels are kept (a quarter of the range apart), and under 465px only min and max show.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` / `onChange` | `value` / `onChange` (+ `onChangeEnd`) |
| `min` / `max` / `step` | `min` / `max` / `step` |
| `valueFormatter` | `valueFormatter` |
| `referenceValues` | `referenceValues` |
| `tickMarks` | `tickMarks` |
| `hideFillLine` | `hideFillLine` |
| `disabled` / `readOnly` | `disabled` / `readOnly` |
| `invalid` / `warning` | `invalid` / `warning` |
| `ariaLabel`, `ariaDescription` | `ariaLabel`, `ariaDescription` |
| `i18nStrings.valueTextRange` | `i18nStrings` (`CsSliderI18nStrings`) |
| `ariaLabelledby`, `ariaDescribedby`, `controlId`, `nativeInputAttributes`, `style` | web only |

---
source: doc/components/CsSpaceBetween.md

# CsSpaceBetween

Cloudscape's `SpaceBetween`: a vertical stack or a wrapping horizontal row with a token-sized gap between its children.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/space-between/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsSpaceBetween(
  direction: CsSpaceBetweenDirection.horizontal,
  size: CsSpacingSize.xs,
  children: [
    CsButton(text: 'Cancel', variant: CsButtonVariant.link, onPress: () {}),
    CsButton(text: 'Create', variant: CsButtonVariant.primary, onPress: () {}),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for consistent gaps between form fields (`l`), containers (`l`), buttons (`xs`) and text blocks. Use `CsColumnLayout` or `CsGrid` for columns.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | | `SizedBox.shrink()` children are skipped, like Cloudscape skips null |
| `size` | `CsSpacingSize` | `m` | `n`, `xxxs` (2) to `xxxl` (40) |
| `direction` | `CsSpaceBetweenDirection` | `vertical` | `horizontal` wraps onto new rows |
| `alignItems` | `CsSpaceBetweenAlign?` | | `start`, `center`, `end`; vertical stacks stretch by default |

## Examples

### Form fields

```dart
CsSpaceBetween(size: CsSpacingSize.l, children: [
  CsFormField(label: 'Name', child: CsInput(value: '', onChange: (_) {})),
  CsFormField(label: 'Description', child: CsInput(value: '', onChange: (_) {})),
])
```

## Accessibility

Layout only.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Horizontal rows wrap, so they never overflow at 390px.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `size`, `direction`, `alignItems` | same names |

source: doc/components/CsSpinner.md

# CsSpinner

Cloudscape's `Spinner`: shows that a short, unknown amount of work is in progress.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/spinner/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsSpinner()
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for waits of a few seconds where the length is unknown: loading a list, saving. For a measurable operation use `CsProgressBar`; for content that is loading in place use `CsSkeleton` or the component's `loading` state.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `CsSpinnerSize` | `normal` | `normal` 16, `big` 32, `large` 48 |
| `variant` | `CsSpinnerVariant` | `normal` | `normal` (current color), `disabled`, `inverted` |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` | `CsStrings.loading` | Pass `''` when nearby text already says what is loading |
| `dangerouslySetColor` | `Color?` | | |

## Examples

### With text

```dart
const Row(children: [CsSpinner(semanticLabel: ''), SizedBox(width: 4), CsBox(text: 'Loading instances')])
```

## Accessibility

Announced as a live region with "Loading" unless `semanticLabel` is empty.

## Motion

The ring turns every 0.7s while its halves grow and shrink every 1.5s, as in Cloudscape. Under reduced or disabled motion the halves stop pulsing and only the rotation remains, so loading never looks stuck. The animation stops when the spinner leaves the tree.

## Mobile

Same on every size.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `size`, `variant` | same names |

---
source: doc/components/CsSplitPanel.md

# CsSplitPanel

Cloudscape's `SplitPanel`: a secondary panel, usually details of the selected item, under or beside the content of an app layout.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/split-panel/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsAppLayout(
  content: const Text('Instances table'),
  splitPanel: const CsSplitPanel(header: 'i-0abc123', child: Text('Instance details')),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to show details of a selection without leaving the page. Put it in `CsAppLayout.splitPanel`; the layout owns its open state, position and size. Used on its own it renders as an open bottom panel that collapses into its header.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` |  | Panel content |
| `header` | `String?` |  | Title |
| `headerWidget` | `Widget?` |  |  |
| `headerActions` | `Widget?` |  |  |
| `headerDescription` | `String?` |  |  |
| `headerInfo` | `Widget?` |  |  |
| `headerBefore` | `Widget?` |  |  |
| `closeBehavior` | `CsSplitPanelCloseBehavior` | `collapse` | `collapse` keeps a bar; `hide` removes it and the layout shows a trigger |
| `hidePreferencesButton` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsSplitPanelI18nStrings` |  | Button labels and preferences copy |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  | Defaults to `header` |

## Examples

### Hidden when closed

```dart
CsAppLayout(
  splitPanelOpen: false,
  onSplitPanelToggle: (open) {},
  splitPanel: const CsSplitPanel(
    header: 'example-bucket',
    closeBehavior: CsSplitPanelCloseBehavior.hide,
    child: Text('Bucket details'),
  ),
  content: const Text('Buckets'),
)
```

## Accessibility

The panel is a named region with a level-2 heading. Open, close and preferences buttons are labelled; the resize handle is a focusable slider (arrows 10px, Page Up / Page Down 60px). The preferences dialog traps focus and closes with Escape.

## Motion

Resizing follows the pointer 1:1; the preferences dialog uses `CsDialogRoute`.

## Mobile

On phones the panel always docks at the bottom, the preferences button hides, and opening it covers the screen.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `header` | `header` / `headerWidget` |
| `children` | `child` |
| `headerActions / headerDescription / headerInfo / headerBefore` | same names |
| `closeBehavior` | `closeBehavior` |
| `hidePreferencesButton` | `hidePreferencesButton` |
| `i18nStrings` | `i18nStrings` |
| `ariaLabel` | `semanticLabel` |
| `(open, size, position)` | `CsAppLayout.splitPanelOpen`, `splitPanelSize`, `splitPanelPosition` |

# CsStatusIndicator

An icon and short text for the state of a resource or process, such as "Running", "Stopped" or "3 errors".

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/status-indicator/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';

const status = CsStatusIndicator(type: CsStatusType.success, text: 'Available');
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for the state of a resource (instance running, deployment in progress) in tables, key-value pairs and detail pages.
- Keep the text short: one to three words, or a count ("3 errors").
- Do not use it to categorize (use `CsBadge`) or for page-level messages (use an alert or flash message).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `CsStatusType` | `CsStatusType.success` | `error`, `warning`, `success`, `info`, `stopped`, `pending`, `inProgress`, `loading`, `notStarted`, `log`. Sets icon and color. |
| `text` | `String?` | `null` | The status text. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom content in place of `text`, such as a link. |
| `colorOverride` | `CsStatusColor?` | `null` | `red`, `grey`, `blue`, `green`, `yellow`: replaces the color, keeps the icon. |
| `wrapText` | `bool` | `true` | False keeps the text on one line with an ellipsis. |
| `iconAriaLabel` | `String?` | status name | Spoken before the text. Defaults to "Error", "Success" and so on; `''` speaks only the text. |
| `iconSize` | `CsIconSize` | `CsIconSize.normal` | Icon size; the loading spinner follows it. |
| `display` | `CsStatusDisplay` | `inlineBlock` | `inline` flows the icon with the text so wrapped lines start under the icon. |
| `animate` | `bool` | `false` | Fade in and shake an error icon once when first shown. |
| `embedded` | `bool` | `false` | Leaves out the status background (transparent in the default theme). |

Static helpers: `CsStatusIndicator.iconFor(type)`, `colorFor(colors, type, [override])`, `backgroundFor(colors, type, [override])`, `labelFor(strings, type)`.

## Examples

### Every type

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

Widget statuses() => const Column(
  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
  children: [
    CsStatusIndicator(type: CsStatusType.error, text: 'Failed'),
    CsStatusIndicator(type: CsStatusType.warning, text: 'Impaired'),
    CsStatusIndicator(type: CsStatusType.success, text: 'Running'),
    CsStatusIndicator(type: CsStatusType.info, text: 'Updated'),
    CsStatusIndicator(type: CsStatusType.stopped, text: 'Stopped'),
    CsStatusIndicator(type: CsStatusType.pending, text: 'Pending'),
    CsStatusIndicator(type: CsStatusType.inProgress, text: 'Stopping'),
    CsStatusIndicator(type: CsStatusType.loading, text: 'Deploying'),
    CsStatusIndicator(type: CsStatusType.notStarted, text: 'Not started'),
    CsStatusIndicator(type: CsStatusType.log, text: 'Log entry'),
  ],
);
```

### Truncated in a narrow cell

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

Widget cell() => const SizedBox(
  width: 140,
  child: CsStatusIndicator(type: CsStatusType.warning, text: 'Certificate expires soon', wrapText: false),
);
```

## Accessibility

The icon is announced before the text with the status name (`iconAriaLabel`), so the status never depends on color. The loading spinner is silent; the status name "Loading" is spoken instead.

## Motion

With `animate`, the indicator fades in over 165ms (`motion-duration-refresh-only-medium`) and an error icon shakes horizontally once. Reduced motion shows it at once.

## Mobile

The text wraps under itself by default and the icon stays on the first line. With 2x text the icon keeps its size and the text grows.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `type` | `type` (`'in-progress'` is `CsStatusType.inProgress`) |
| `children` | `text` or `child` |
| `iconAriaLabel` | `iconAriaLabel` |
| `colorOverride` | `colorOverride` |
| `wrapText` | `wrapText` |
| internal `__size`, `__display`, `__animate`, `__embedded` | `iconSize`, `display`, `animate`, `embedded` |
| `nativeAttributes` | not applicable (web only) |

# CsSteps

Shows the progress of a multi-step process, such as a deployment or a series of checks, with a status for each step.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/steps/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsSteps(
  ariaLabel: 'Launch progress',
  steps: [
    CsStepsStep(status: CsStatusType.success, header: 'Instance launched'),
    CsStepsStep(status: CsStatusType.loading, header: 'Running health checks', details: '2 of 3 checks complete'),
    CsStepsStep(status: CsStatusType.pending, header: 'Attach to load balancer'),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use to report the state of steps the system runs (provisioning, a pipeline, a timeline of events).
- Do not use for steps a person fills in; use `CsWizard`.
- Do not use for a single status; use `CsStatusIndicator`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | `List<CsStepsStep>` | required | The steps in order. |
| `orientation` | `CsStepsOrientation` | `vertical` | `vertical` stacks the steps; `horizontal` lays them out in equal columns. |
| `connectorLines` | `CsStepsConnectorLines` | `visible` | `none` hides the lines between steps. |
| `renderStep` | `CsStepsRenderedStep Function(CsStepsStep)?` | `null` | Builds each step's header, details and icon yourself. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name of the list. |
| `minHorizontalStepWidth` | `double` | `120` | Horizontal steps lay out vertically when a column would be narrower. `0` keeps them horizontal. |

`CsStepsStep`:

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `CsStatusType` | Status icon and header color (same set as `CsStatusIndicator`). |
| `header` / `headerWidget` | `String?` / `Widget?` | Summary of the step. One is required. |
| `details` / `detailsWidget` | `String?` / `Widget?` | More information under the header. |
| `annotation` / `annotationWidget` | `String?` / `Widget?` | Content before the icon, such as a timestamp. |
| `statusIconAriaLabel` | `String?` | Spoken name of the icon. Defaults to the status name. |
| `data` | `Object?` | Any value of yours, for `renderStep`. |

## Examples

### Horizontal

```dart
const CsSteps(
  orientation: CsStepsOrientation.horizontal,
  steps: [
    CsStepsStep(status: CsStatusType.success, header: 'Build'),
    CsStepsStep(status: CsStatusType.inProgress, header: 'Test'),
    CsStepsStep(status: CsStatusType.notStarted, header: 'Deploy'),
  ],
)
```

### Timeline with annotations

```dart
const CsSteps(
  steps: [
    CsStepsStep(status: CsStatusType.info, annotation: '09:58', header: 'Change set created'),
    CsStepsStep(status: CsStatusType.warning, annotation: '10:01', header: 'Drift detected', details: '1 resource differs'),
    CsStepsStep(status: CsStatusType.success, annotation: '10:05', header: 'Stack updated'),
  ],
)
```

### Custom steps

```dart
CsSteps(
  steps: const [
    CsStepsStep(status: CsStatusType.success, header: 'example-bucket', data: 'Versioning enabled'),
    CsStepsStep(status: CsStatusType.pending, header: 'example-logs', data: 'Waiting for policy'),
  ],
  renderStep: (step) => CsStepsRenderedStep(
    header: Text(step.header!, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w700)),
    details: Text('${step.data}'),
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The list is a container named by `ariaLabel`.
- Each step is one node that reads the status name (or `statusIconAriaLabel`) and then the header and details: "Error, Attach volume".
- Status is never color alone: every status has its own icon.

## Motion

The loading status shows a spinner while the step is loading; nothing else animates.

## Mobile

Vertical steps fit any width and wrap long headers. Horizontal steps switch to vertical when a column would be narrower than `minHorizontalStepWidth` (120px), which happens on phones with four or more steps. Annotations take at most half the width.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `steps` (`status`, `statusIconAriaLabel`, `header`, `details`, `annotation`) | `steps` (`CsStepsStep`, with string and widget forms) |
| `orientation` | `orientation` |
| `connectorLines` | `connectorLines` |
| `renderStep` (`header`, `details`, `icon`) | `renderStep` (`CsStepsRenderedStep`) |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `ariaLabelledby`, `ariaDescribedby` | not applicable; use `ariaLabel` |

source: doc/components/CsStrings.md

# CsStrings

Shared built-in copy (Close, Cancel, Loading, status names, month and weekday names, pagination text) in one place, provided by `CsLocale` and read with `context.csStrings`. Component-specific copy is passed per component as `i18nStrings`, as in Cloudscape.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/get-started/dev-guides/internationalization/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsLocale(
  strings: const CsStrings(close: 'Tutup', cancel: 'Batal', loading: 'Memuat'),
  child: const SizedBox(),
)
```

## Parameters

`CsStrings` has one `String` field per piece of copy, each defaulting to English, plus formatting helpers (`pageOf`, `monthYear`, `shortDate`, `fullDate`, `stepOf`). `firstDayOfWeek` sets where calendars start.

## Accessibility

Accessible names of icon-only controls come from these strings unless a component's `i18nStrings` or `ariaLabel` overrides them.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `I18nProvider` with messages | `CsLocale` for shared copy, `i18nStrings` per component |

# CsSupportPromptGroup

Suggested prompts a user can send to a generative AI assistant with one tap.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/support-prompt-group/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsSupportPromptGroup(
  ariaLabel: 'Suggested prompts',
  items: const [
    CsSupportPrompt(id: 'cost', text: 'Why did my bill go up this month?'),
    CsSupportPrompt(id: 'scale', text: 'How do I scale instance i-0abc123?'),
  ],
  onItemClick: (id) {},
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use at the start of a conversation or after a response, to suggest next questions.
- Keep prompts short and specific. Use 2 to 4 at a time.
- Do not use them for actions that change resources; use buttons.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<CsSupportPrompt>` | required | The prompts. An empty list renders nothing. |
| `onItemClick` | `ValueChanged<String>` | required | Called with the chosen prompt's `id`. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String` | required | Accessible name of the group. |
| `alignment` | `CsSupportPromptAlignment` | `vertical` | `vertical` stacks the prompts; `horizontal` flows them in wrapping rows. |

`CsSupportPrompt` fields: `id` (`String`, required), `text` (`String`, required), `textWidget` (`Widget?`, rich content instead of `text`), `icon` (`CsIconData?`), `iconWidget` (`Widget?`), `iconPosition` (`CsSupportPromptIconPosition.left` or `right`, default `left`), `iconVerticalAlignment` (`start`, `center` or `end`, default `start`), `ariaLabel` (`String?`).

Reach the state with a `GlobalKey<CsSupportPromptGroupState>` and call `focus(id)` to move focus to a prompt (Cloudscape `ref.focus`).

## Examples

### Horizontal with icons

```dart
CsSupportPromptGroup(
  ariaLabel: 'Suggested prompts',
  alignment: CsSupportPromptAlignment.horizontal,
  items: const [
    CsSupportPrompt(id: 'logs', text: 'Summarize error logs', icon: CsIcons.genAi),
    CsSupportPrompt(
      id: 'alarms',
      text: 'Explain this alarm',
      icon: CsIcons.external,
      iconPosition: CsSupportPromptIconPosition.right,
    ),
  ],
  onItemClick: (id) {},
)
```

## Accessibility

- The group is a single Tab stop. Arrow keys move between prompts and wrap around (left and right swap in RTL); Home and End (and Page Up and Page Down) jump to the first and last; Enter or Space sends the focused prompt. Tab leaves the group and Shift+Tab returns to the last focused prompt.
- Each prompt is a button; the group carries `ariaLabel`.

## Motion

Prompts get the standard press feedback; hover colors switch instantly.

## Mobile

Prompts wrap their text and, in `horizontal`, flow to new rows, so nothing overflows at 390px. The hit area of each prompt is at least 44px tall on touch screens.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `items` | `items` (`CsSupportPrompt`) |
| `items[].iconName` | `icon` |
| `items[].iconSvg` | `iconWidget` |
| `onItemClick` | `onItemClick` (the `id`; modifier keys are not passed) |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `alignment` | `alignment` |
| `ref.focus(id)` | `GlobalKey<CsSupportPromptGroupState>().currentState!.focus(id)` |

source: doc/components/CsTable.md

# CsTable

Cloudscape's `Table`: a collection of items in rows and columns, with sorting, selection, inline editing, expandable rows, resizable and sticky columns, and the header, filter, pagination and preferences slots of a collection.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/table/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsTable<Map<String, Object?>>(
  header: const CsHeader(title: 'Instances', counter: '(2)'),
  items: const [
    {'id': 'i-0abc123', 'state': 'Running'},
    {'id': 'i-0abc124', 'state': 'Stopped'},
  ],
  trackBy: (item) => item['id'],
  columnDefinitions: [
    CsTableColumn(id: 'id', header: 'Instance ID', isRowHeader: true, cell: (context, item) => Text('${item['id']}')),
    CsTableColumn(id: 'state', header: 'State', cell: (context, item) => Text('${item['state']}')),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a table to compare many items across the same attributes and to act on one or more of them. Use `CsCards` when each item needs a richer, visual summary, `CsKeyValuePairs` for the attributes of one item, and a list for a few items with one attribute each.

The table is controlled: it renders `items` in the order given and reports sorting, selection and expansion through callbacks. Use `CsCollection` to filter, sort and paginate a list in memory.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columnDefinitions` | `List<CsTableColumn<T>>` | required | The columns, see below |
| `items` | `List<T>` | required | Rows, in display order |
| `header` | `Widget?` |  | Usually a `CsHeader` with a counter and actions |
| `filter` | `Widget?` |  | Text or property filter, at the start of the tools row |
| `pagination` | `Widget?` |  | At the end of the tools row |
| `preferences` | `Widget?` |  | A `CsCollectionPreferences`, after the pagination with a divider |
| `footer` | `Widget?` |  | Under the rows |
| `empty` | `Widget?` |  | Shown when `items` is empty and not loading |
| `loading` / `loadingText` | `bool` / `String?` | `false` | Replaces the rows with a loading status |
| `trackBy` | `Object? Function(T)?` |  | Item identity for selection, expansion and edits |
| `variant` | `CsTableVariant` | `container` | `container`, `embedded`, `borderless`, `stacked`, `fullPage` |
| `selectionType` | `CsSelectionType?` |  | `single` (radios) or `multi` (checkboxes and select all) |
| `selectedItems` / `onSelectionChange` | `List<T>` / `ValueChanged<List<T>>?` | `[]` | Controlled selection; Shift extends a multi selection |
| `isItemDisabled` | `bool Function(T)?` |  | Disabled items cannot be selected |
| `sortingColumn` / `sortingDescending` | `CsSortingColumn<T>?` / `bool` | `null` / `false` | The current sort |
| `onSortingChange` | `ValueChanged<CsSortingState<T>>?` |  | Pressing a header: same column flips, another column sorts ascending |
| `sortingDisabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disables the sort buttons |
| `cellVerticalAlign` | `CsTableVerticalAlign` | `middle` | `middle` or `top` |
| `wrapLines` | `bool` | `false` | Wrap cell text instead of an ellipsis |
| `stripedRows` | `bool` | `false` | Shade every other row |
| `contentDensity` | `CsDensity` | `comfortable` | `compact` applies `CsDensityTokens.compactTable` |
| `resizableColumns` | `bool` | `false` | Drag handles between header cells; the last column fills |
| `onColumnWidthsChange` | `ValueChanged<List<double>>?` |  | All column widths after a resize, in definition order |
| `stickyColumns` | `CsStickyColumns` | `none` | `first` and `last` columns that stay while scrolling sideways |
| `columnDisplay` | `List<CsColumnDisplay>?` |  | Column order and visibility (from preferences) |
| `visibleColumns` | `List<String>?` |  | Deprecated in Cloudscape; ids of visible columns |
| `stickyHeader` | `bool` | `false` | Keeps header, tools and column headers in place (bounded height) |
| `stickyHeaderVerticalOffset` | `double` | `0` | Space above the stuck header |
| `onRowClick` | `ValueChanged<CsTableRowClickDetail<T>>?` |  | Row press (row index and item) |
| `onRowContextMenu` | `ValueChanged<CsTableRowContextMenuDetail<T>>?` |  | Secondary click or long press, with the position |
| `totalItemsCount` / `firstIndex` | `int?` |  | Counts for screen readers |
| `renderAriaLive` | `String Function(CsLiveAnnouncement)?` |  | Announced when the page of items changes |
| `submitEdit` | `FutureOr<void> Function(T, CsTableColumn<T>, Object?)?` |  | Saves an inline edit; throw to keep the editor open |
| `onEditCancel` | `VoidCallback?` |  | An inline edit was canceled |
| `enableKeyboardNavigation` | `bool?` | on with expandable rows | Arrow keys move focus between cells |
| `expandableRows` | `CsTableExpandableRows<T>?` |  | Nested rows, see below |
| `getLoadingStatus` | `CsTableLoadingStatus Function(T?)?` |  | Progressive loading for the list (`null`) and each expanded item |
| `renderLoaderPending` / `Loading` / `Error` | `Widget Function(T?)?` |  | Loader row content per status |
| `renderLoaderEmpty` | `Widget Function(T)?` |  | Shown under an expanded item without children |
| `ariaLabels` | `CsTableAriaLabels<T>?` |  | Selection, edit, expand and table labels |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsTableI18nStrings` | English | Fixed copy |
| `mobileLayout` | `CsTableMobileLayout` | `scroll` | Phones: `scroll` sideways or `cards` |
| `mobileStickyFirstColumn` | `bool` | `true` | With `scroll` on phones, stick the first column |
| `scrollController` | `ScrollController?` |  | Vertical scroll of lazily built rows |

`CsTableColumn<T>`: `id` (required), `header` or `headerWidget`, `cell(context, item)`, `width`, `minWidth` (default 120), `maxWidth`, `sortingField`, `sortingComparator`, `ariaLabel(CsTableLabelData)`, `counter(CsTableItemCounterData)`, `editConfig`, `isRowHeader`, `verticalAlign`, `cardLabel`.

`CsTableEditConfig<T>`: `editingCell(context, item, CsTableCellContext)`, `ariaLabel`, `errorIconAriaLabel`, `editIconAriaLabel`, `constraintText`, `validation(item, value)`, `disabledReason(item)`.

`CsTableExpandableRows<T>`: `getItemChildren`, `isItemExpandable`, `expandedItems`, `onExpandableItemToggle(item, expanded)`, `getItemsCount`, `totalItemsCount`, `getSelectedItemsCount`, `totalSelectedItemsCount`.

`CsTableState<T>` (through a `GlobalKey`): `scrollToTop()`, `cancelEdit()`.

## Examples

### Sorting and selection with a collection

```dart
ListenableBuilder(
  listenable: collection,
  builder: (context, _) => CsTable<Map<String, Object?>>(
    items: collection.items,
    columnDefinitions: columns,
    trackBy: collection.trackBy,
    sortingColumn: collection.sortingColumn,
    sortingDescending: collection.sortingDescending,
    onSortingChange: collection.setSorting,
    selectionType: CsSelectionType.multi,
    selectedItems: collection.selectedItems,
    onSelectionChange: collection.setSelectedItems,
    empty: collection.emptyState,
  ),
)
```

### Inline editing

```dart
CsTable<Map<String, Object?>>(
  items: items,
  submitEdit: (item, column, value) async => save(item, value),
  columnDefinitions: [
    CsTableColumn(
      id: 'name',
      header: 'Name',
      cell: (context, item) => Text('${item['name']}'),
      editConfig: CsTableEditConfig(
        ariaLabel: 'Name',
        validation: (item, value) => (value as String?)?.isEmpty ?? false ? 'Enter a name.' : null,
        editingCell: (context, item, ctx) => CsInput(
          value: ctx.currentValue as String? ?? '${item['name']}',
          autoFocus: true,
          onChange: ctx.setValue,
          onSubmit: (_) => ctx.submitValue(),
        ),
      ),
    ),
  ],
)
```

Pressing an editable cell opens the editor. Enter or the check button submits, Escape, the close button or a tap outside cancels. Validation runs as the value changes. After a save the cell shows a success icon and announces "Edit successful".

### Expandable rows

```dart
CsTable<Map<String, Object?>>(
  items: groups,
  columnDefinitions: columns,
  trackBy: (item) => item['id'],
  expandableRows: CsTableExpandableRows(
    getItemChildren: (item) => children[item['id']] ?? const [],
    isItemExpandable: (item) => children.containsKey(item['id']),
    expandedItems: expanded,
    onExpandableItemToggle: (item, open) => setState(() => open ? expanded.add(item) : expanded.remove(item)),
  ),
)
```

### Resizable, sticky, striped and compact

```dart
CsTable<Map<String, Object?>>(
  items: items,
  columnDefinitions: columns,
  resizableColumns: true,
  stickyColumns: const CsStickyColumns(first: 1, last: 1),
  stripedRows: true,
  contentDensity: CsDensity.compact,
  wrapLines: true,
)
```

### Sticky header in a bounded height

```dart
SizedBox(
  height: 480,
  child: CsTable<Map<String, Object?>>(items: items, columnDefinitions: columns, stickyHeader: true),
)
```

### Progressive loading

```dart
CsTable<Map<String, Object?>>(
  items: items,
  columnDefinitions: columns,
  getLoadingStatus: (item) => hasMore ? CsTableLoadingStatus.pending : CsTableLoadingStatus.finished,
  renderLoaderPending: (item) => CsButton(text: 'Load more', variant: CsButtonVariant.inlineLink, onPress: loadMore),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The table is a semantics container named by `ariaLabels.tableLabel`; `totalItemsCount` is its value.
- Sortable headers are buttons whose value is "ascending", "descending" or "not sorted"; `CsTableColumn.ariaLabel` overrides the name.
- Selection controls are checkboxes (multi, with a mixed select-all) or radios (single), labeled by `itemSelectionLabel` and `allItemsSelectionLabel`. Rows expose their selected state.
- Row-header columns (`isRowHeader`) mark their cells as headers.
- Resize handles are focusable: Left and Right arrows change the width by 10px; screen readers can increase or decrease it.
- Inline editors trap Tab inside the cell; Escape cancels. Submitting and success are announced.
- With expandable rows (or `enableKeyboardNavigation`) the arrow keys move focus between cells.
- `renderAriaLive` messages are announced when the page changes.

## Motion

Expand toggles turn over `CsDurations.rotate90`. Hover colors on editable cells switch at once. Reduced motion removes the rotation. Selecting a checkbox draws its mark with the checkbox's own animation.

## Mobile

At 688px and below:

- `mobileLayout: CsTableMobileLayout.scroll` (default): the table keeps its columns and scrolls sideways; the first column (and the selection column) sticks to the start edge with Cloudscape's sticky shadow. Sticky columns are released when fewer than 148px would remain to scroll.
- `mobileLayout: CsTableMobileLayout.cards`: each row becomes a `CsItemCard` with the row-header (or first) column as its title, a selection control in the corner and the other visible columns as label and value pairs. A "Select all" checkbox sits above multi-selection cards.

The tools row stacks the filter above pagination and preferences below 600px.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `columnDefinitions[].cell(item)` | `CsTableColumn.cell(context, item)` |
| `columnDefinitions[].header` | `header` (String) or `headerWidget` |
| `trackBy` (string or function) | `trackBy` (function) |
| `sortingColumn`, `sortingDescending`, `onSortingChange` | same; detail is `CsSortingState<T>` |
| `onSelectionChange` detail `selectedItems` | `ValueChanged<List<T>>` |
| `contentDensity: 'compact'` | `contentDensity: CsDensity.compact` |
| `variant: 'full-page'` | `CsTableVariant.fullPage` |
| `onRowClick` / `onRowContextMenu` | same, detail classes |
| `ref.scrollToTop()` / `ref.cancelEdit()` | `CsTableState.scrollToTop()` / `cancelEdit()` |
| `expandableRows.groupSelection`, `multiColumnSort`, `groupDefinitions`, `skeleton` | not supported yet |
| `editConfig.disableNativeForm` | not needed: call `ctx.submitValue` |
| `hasDynamicContent`, `analyticsMetadata` | web only, not ported |

---
source: doc/components/CsTableBody.md
---

# CsTableBody

Cloudscape's `TableBody` (`src/table-body`): the rows of a `CsTableRoot`. It tells each `CsTableRow` its position, so striping, row dividers and joined selection outlines match `CsTable`.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/table-body/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsTableBody(
  children: [
    CsTableRow(children: [CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('i-0abc123'))]),
    CsTableRow(children: [CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('i-0abc124'))]),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use one inside every `CsTableRoot`. For long lists, render only the rows in view and set `CsTableRoot.ariaRowcount`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | The body rows, usually `CsTableRow`s |

## Examples

### Selected rows join

```dart
const CsTableBody(
  children: [
    CsTableRow(selected: true, children: [CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('web-server-1'))]),
    CsTableRow(selected: true, children: [CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('web-server-2'))]),
    CsTableRow(children: [CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('batch-worker'))]),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

Rows keep their own semantics; the body adds none.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Scrolls sideways with the table.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `children` |
| `positionStyle` | not supported (use a scroll view or `Transform` around the root) |

---
source: doc/components/CsTableBodyCell.md
---

# CsTableBodyCell

Cloudscape's `TableBodyCell` (`src/table-body-cell`): a data cell, or the header of its row, styled as `CsTable`'s cells.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/table-body-cell/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsTableBodyCell(isRowHeader: true, child: Text('web-server-1'))
```

## When to use / when not to

Use one per column in a body `CsTableRow`. Put interactive content (a link, a button, a checkbox) inside it as needed.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | Cell content; text is body-m |
| `isRowHeader` | `bool` | `false` | Announces the cell as its row's header |
| `disablePaddings` | `bool` | `false` | Removes the cell padding |
| `colSpan` | `int` | `1` | Columns the cell covers |
| `wrapLines` | `bool?` | root's `wrapLines` | Wrap long text instead of truncating |
| `verticalAlign` | `CsTableVerticalAlign?` | root's `cellVerticalAlign` | `middle` or `top` |
| `editable` | `bool` | `false` | Inline-edit look: hover or focus fills `color-background-dropdown-item-hover` inside a `color-border-editable-cell-hover` border with an edit icon |
| `onEdit` | `VoidCallback?` |  | Called when an editable cell is activated |
| `editDisabledReason` | `String?` |  | Lock icon and the reason in a tooltip instead of editing |
| `editAriaLabel` | `String?` |  | Accessible name of the edit action |

## Examples

### Editable cell

```dart
editing
    ? CsTableBodyCell(child: CsInput(value: name, autoFocus: true, onChange: (v) => setState(() => name = v)))
    : CsTableBodyCell(
        editable: true,
        editAriaLabel: 'Edit name',
        onEdit: () => setState(() => editing = true),
        child: Text(name),
      )
```

### Spanning cell

```dart
const CsTableRow(
  children: [CsTableBodyCell(colSpan: 3, child: Text('No instances match the filter.'))],
)
```

## Accessibility

Row header cells are semantic headers. An editable cell is a button labelled `editAriaLabel`, with the disabled reason as its hint.

## Motion

None; the edit affordance appears instantly on hover and focus.

## Mobile

Text truncates to one line by default; set `wrapLines` for long values at 390px.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `child` |
| `isRowHeader` | `isRowHeader` |
| `disablePaddings` | `disablePaddings` |
| `colSpan` | `colSpan` |
| (from `Table`) | `wrapLines`, `verticalAlign`, `editable`, `onEdit`, `editDisabledReason`, `editAriaLabel` |

source: doc/components/CsTableHead.md

# CsTableHead

Cloudscape's `TableHead` (`src/table-head`): the header section of a `CsTableRoot`, holding one `CsTableRow` of `CsTableHeaderCell`s.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/table-head/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsTableHead(
  child: CsTableRow(
    children: [CsTableHeaderCell(child: Text('Name')), CsTableHeaderCell(child: Text('Type'))],
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use one as the first child of `CsTableRoot`, or as its `stickyHeader`. It only works inside a `CsTableRoot`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The header row, a `CsTableRow` of `CsTableHeaderCell`s |

## Examples

### As a sticky header

```dart
SizedBox(
  height: 240,
  child: CsTableRoot(
    stickyHeader: const CsTableHead(child: CsTableRow(children: [CsTableHeaderCell(child: Text('Name'))])),
    children: const [CsTableBody(children: [CsTableRow(children: [CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('example-bucket'))])])],
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

The header row is a semantics container; its cells are headers.

## Motion

None. As a sticky header it gains `shadow-sticky-embedded` once the body scrolls under it.

## Mobile

Scrolls sideways with the body.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `child` |
| (visuals) | `color-background-table-header` (container content in `borderless` and `embedded`), 1px `color-border-divider-default` below |

# CsTableHeaderCell

Cloudscape's `TableHeaderCell` (`src/table-header-cell`): a column header with the label, the sorting caret, the divider to the next column and an optional resize handle, styled as `CsTable`'s headers.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/table-header-cell/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsTableHeaderCell(
  sortingState: descending ? CsTableSortingState.descending : CsTableSortingState.ascending,
  onSort: () => setState(() => descending = !descending),
  child: const Text('Launch time'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use one per column in the `CsTableRow` of a `CsTableHead`. Leave `sortingState` null for columns that cannot sort.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | required | The column label |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` |  | Accessible name |
| `sortingState` | `CsTableSortingState?` | `null` | `sortable` (hollow caret), `ascending` or `descending` (filled caret, `color-text-interactive-active`); null for no sorting |
| `sortingDisabled` | `bool` | `false` | Shows the state, ignores presses, draws the caret disabled |
| `onSort` | `VoidCallback?` |  | Called when a sortable header is pressed; the app flips the direction |
| `disablePaddings` | `bool` | `false` | Removes the cell padding |
| `resizable` | `bool` | `false` | Adds a resize handle on the end edge |
| `onResize` | `ValueChanged<double>?` |  | New width while dragging or on arrow keys (10px a press); store it in a `CsTableGridColumn.fixed` |
| `onResizeEnd` | `VoidCallback?` |  | Called when a resize ends |
| `minWidth` | `double` | `120` | Narrowest width `onResize` reports |
| `editable` | `bool` | `false` | Edit icon after the label, for columns with editable cells |
| `wrapLines` | `bool?` | root's `wrapLines` | Wrap a long label |

## Examples

### Resizable column

```dart
CsTableRoot(
  columnLayout: CsTableColumnLayout.grid([CsTableGridColumn.fixed(nameWidth), const CsTableGridColumn(minWidth: 120)]),
  children: [
    CsTableHead(
      child: CsTableRow(
        children: [
          CsTableHeaderCell(
            resizable: true,
            onResize: (w) => setState(() => nameWidth = w),
            child: const Text('Name'),
          ),
          const CsTableHeaderCell(child: Text('Type')),
        ],
      ),
    ),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

A sortable header is a button whose value is the sort state ("sorted ascending", "sorted descending", "not sorted", from `CsTableRoot.i18nStrings`); Enter and Space sort. Other headers are semantic headers. The resize handle is focusable, adjustable with the arrow keys, and announces its width.

## Motion

Hover colors change instantly; the divider turns into a 2px `color-border-divider-active` line while the handle is hovered, focused or dragged.

## Mobile

The label truncates unless `wrapLines`; the resize handle is 16px wide and can be dragged by touch.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `child` |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `ariaSort` | `sortingState` |
| `disablePaddings` | `disablePaddings` |
| (from `Table` columns) | `onSort`, `sortingDisabled`, `resizable`, `onResize`, `editable`, `wrapLines` |
| `ariaLabelledby`, `ariaDescribedby` | not supported (web only) |

---
source: doc/components/CsTableRoot.md

# CsTableRoot

Cloudscape's `TableRoot` (`src/table-root`): the frame of a composable table. You build the head and rows from `CsTableHead`, `CsTableBody`, `CsTableRow`, `CsTableHeaderCell` and `CsTableBodyCell`; the root sizes the columns and draws the table the way `CsTable` does.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/table-root/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsTableRoot(
  ariaLabel: 'Instances',
  variant: CsTableVariant.container,
  children: [
    const CsTableHead(
      child: CsTableRow(
        children: [CsTableHeaderCell(child: Text('Name')), CsTableHeaderCell(child: Text('State'))],
      ),
    ),
    CsTableBody(
      children: [
        for (final name in ['web-server-1', 'web-server-2'])
          CsTableRow(
            children: [
              CsTableBodyCell(isRowHeader: true, child: Text(name)),
              const CsTableBodyCell(child: CsStatusIndicator(type: CsStatusType.success, text: 'Running')),
            ],
          ),
      ],
    ),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Reach for the parts when `CsTable`'s column definitions do not fit: rows built from different widgets, cells that span columns, summary rows, or a table whose state lives elsewhere. For a data table with selection, sorting, filtering, pagination, inline edit, expandable rows and the card layout on phones, use `CsTable`, which does all of it for you.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | A `CsTableHead` then a `CsTableBody` (only the body when `stickyHeader` is set) |
| `columnLayout` | `CsTableColumnLayout` | `CsTableColumnLayout.auto()` | `auto()`: columns share the width evenly, at least 120px each. `grid([...])`: per-column `CsTableGridColumn` |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` |  | Accessible name of the table |
| `ariaRowcount` | `int?` |  | Total rows including the header, when the body shows a subset |
| `stickyHeader` | `Widget?` |  | A `CsTableHead` pinned at the top while the body scrolls (needs a bounded height) |
| `stickyHeaderVerticalOffset` | `double` | `0` | Space above the sticky header |
| `variant` | `CsTableVariant` | `borderless` | Frame: `container`, `stacked` and `fullPage` draw `CsTable`'s rounded bordered container with 20px side padding; `borderless` and `embedded` none |
| `stripedRows` | `bool` | `false` | Shades every other body row (unless a row sets `shaded`) and uses the striped cell borders |
| `contentDensity` | `CsDensity` | `comfortable` | `compact` applies `CsDensityTokens.compactTable` |
| `wrapLines` | `bool` | `false` | Default for cells: wrap long text instead of truncating |
| `cellVerticalAlign` | `CsTableVerticalAlign` | `middle` | Default vertical alignment of body cells |
| `stickyColumns` | `CsStickyColumns` | `none` | Columns kept at the start and end while the table scrolls sideways |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsTablePartsI18nStrings` | English | Sort state, resizer and edit icon labels |

`CsTableGridColumn`: `CsTableGridColumn({flex = 1, minWidth, maxWidth})` for a flexible column, `CsTableGridColumn.fixed(size)` for a fixed one. A capped column (`maxWidth`) grows evenly instead of by weight, as in Cloudscape.

## Examples

### Grid columns, striped and compact

```dart
CsTableRoot(
  columnLayout: const CsTableColumnLayout.grid([
    CsTableGridColumn(minWidth: 180, flex: 2),
    CsTableGridColumn.fixed(140),
    CsTableGridColumn(minWidth: 100),
  ]),
  stripedRows: true,
  contentDensity: CsDensity.compact,
  children: const [
    CsTableBody(
      children: [
        CsTableRow(children: [CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('example-bucket')), CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('us-east-1')), CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('2 GiB'))]),
        CsTableRow(children: [CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('logs-bucket')), CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('eu-west-1')), CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('14 GiB'))]),
      ],
    ),
  ],
)
```

### Sticky header

```dart
SizedBox(
  height: 320,
  child: CsTableRoot(
    stickyHeader: const CsTableHead(
      child: CsTableRow(children: [CsTableHeaderCell(child: Text('Event')), CsTableHeaderCell(child: Text('Time'))]),
    ),
    children: [
      CsTableBody(
        children: [
          for (var i = 0; i < 40; i++)
            CsTableRow(children: [CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('Event $i')), const CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('12:00'))]),
        ],
      ),
    ],
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

The root is a labelled semantics container and a focus traversal group. Header cells are headers (sortable ones are buttons that announce their sort state), row header cells are headers, rows report `selected`. Cloudscape's `selected` row styling is visual only: put a `CsCheckbox` or `CsRadioButton` in a cell for an accessible selection control.

## Motion

None beyond the parts' hover and press states.

## Mobile

The columns keep their minimum widths; when they need more width than the screen the table scrolls sideways and `stickyColumns` stay at the edges (from 148px of free space, as in `CsTable`). There is no card layout; use `CsTable` with `mobileLayout: CsTableMobileLayout.cards` or `CsCards` for that.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `children` |
| `columnLayout: { type: 'auto' }` | `CsTableColumnLayout.auto()` (even shares, 120px minimum; Flutter has no HTML table content sizing) |
| `columnLayout: { type: 'grid', columns }` | `CsTableColumnLayout.grid([CsTableGridColumn ...])` |
| `size: number` / `size: { flex }` / `minWidth` / `maxWidth` | `CsTableGridColumn.fixed(size)` / `flex` / `minWidth` / `maxWidth` |
| `ariaLabel` / `ariaRowcount` | `ariaLabel` / `ariaRowcount` |
| `stickyHeader` / `stickyHeaderVerticalOffset` | `stickyHeader` / `stickyHeaderVerticalOffset` |
| `ariaLabelledby`, `ariaDescribedby` | not supported (web only) |
| (from `Table`) | `variant`, `stripedRows`, `contentDensity`, `wrapLines`, `cellVerticalAlign`, `stickyColumns` |

---
source: doc/components/CsTableRow.md
---

# CsTableRow

Cloudscape's `TableRow` (`src/table-row`): one row of cells in a `CsTableHead` or `CsTableBody`.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/table-row/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsTableRow(
  selected: true,
  onPress: () {},
  children: const [CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('web-server-1')), CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('t3.micro'))],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use one per row of a composable table. Give it one cell per column, or cells with `colSpan` that add up to the column count.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | required | Cells in column order |
| `selected` | `bool` | `false` | `color-background-item-selected` inside a 2px `color-border-item-selected` outline; adjacent selected rows join. Visual only |
| `shaded` | `bool?` | every other row with `stripedRows` | `color-background-cell-shaded` background |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` |  | Accessible name of the row |
| `onPress` | `VoidCallback?` |  | Makes the row tappable (`CsTable.onRowClick`) |

## Examples

### Shaded summary row

```dart
const CsTableRow(
  shaded: true,
  children: [CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('Total')), CsTableBodyCell(child: Text('16 GiB'))],
)
```

## Accessibility

A body row is a semantics container that reports `selected`. Pair `selected` with a checkbox or radio button in a cell, as Cloudscape recommends.

## Motion

None. Hover and press of a tappable row show the focus ring only when focused from the keyboard.

## Mobile

A tappable row is the full row height; it scrolls sideways with the table.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `selected` | `selected` |
| `shaded` | `shaded` |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `children` | `children` |
| `ariaRowindex`, `positionStyle`, `ariaLabelledby`, `ariaDescribedby` | not supported (web only) |
| (from `Table.onRowClick`) | `onPress` |

source: doc/components/CsTabs.md

# CsTabs

Cloudscape's `Tabs`: switches between panels of related content.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/tabs/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsTabs(
  tabs: const [
    CsTab(id: 'details', label: 'Details', content: Text('Instance details')),
    CsTab(id: 'monitoring', label: 'Monitoring', content: Text('Metrics')),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use tabs for peer views of the same resource. Do not use them for steps (use `CsWizard`) or for navigation between pages (use `CsSideNavigation`).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tabs` | `List<CsTab>` |  | `id`, `label`, `labelWidget`, `content`, `disabled`, `disabledReason`, `dismissible`, `dismissLabel`, `dismissDisabled`, `onDismiss`, `action` |
| `activeTabId` | `String?` |  | Controlled active tab; null lets the tabs manage it |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` |  | Id of the selected tab |
| `variant` | `CsTabsVariant` | `defaultVariant` | `defaultVariant`, `container`, `stacked` |
| `actions` | `Widget?` |  | Controls at the end of the tab row |
| `disableContentPaddings` | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `fitHeight` | `bool` | `false` | Fill the parent height; the panel scrolls |
| `keyboardActivationMode` | `CsTabsKeyboardActivation` | `automatic` | `automatic` or `manual` |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsTabsI18nStrings` |  | Scroll button labels |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  | Name of the tab list |
| `swipeable` | `bool` | `false` | Swipe the content to change tabs |
| `stackPosition` | `CsStackPosition` | `only` | For the `stacked` variant |

## Examples

### Controlled with a disabled and a dismissible tab

```dart
CsTabs(
  activeTabId: 'details',
  onChange: (id) {},
  tabs: [
    const CsTab(id: 'details', label: 'Details', content: Text('i-0abc123')),
    const CsTab(id: 'security', label: 'Security', disabled: true, disabledReason: 'No permission.'),
    CsTab(id: 'logs', label: 'Logs', dismissible: true, onDismiss: () {}, content: const Text('Log')),
  ],
)
```

### Container

```dart
const CsTabs(
  variant: CsTabsVariant.container,
  tabs: [CsTab(id: 'a', label: 'Origins', content: Text('example-bucket'))],
)
```

## Accessibility

Tabs expose `selected` and mutually exclusive semantics and use roving focus: Tab enters the active tab, Left/Right (mirrored in RTL), Home and End move between tabs, and in automatic mode select them. Disabled tabs with a reason stay focusable and show the reason in a tooltip.

## Motion

The 4px active indicator slides between tabs over `motion-duration-expressive`; the tab row scrolls a tab into view with the same timing. Reduced motion jumps.

## Mobile

The tab row scrolls horizontally and shows start and end arrow buttons when it overflows. Labels stay on one line. `swipeable` adds horizontal swipes on the content.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `tabs` | `tabs: [CsTab(...)]` |
| `activeTabId / onChange` | `activeTabId` / `onChange` (String) |
| `variant` | `variant` |
| `actions` | `actions` |
| `disableContentPaddings` | `disableContentPaddings` |
| `fitHeight` | `fitHeight` |
| `keyboardActivationMode` | `keyboardActivationMode` |
| `i18nStrings` | `i18nStrings` |
| `ariaLabel` | `semanticLabel` |
| `tab.href` | not supported (use `onChange`) |
| `contentRenderStrategy` | active only |
| `style` | not supported |

source: doc/components/CsTagEditor.md
