# CsTagEditor

Cloudscape's `TagEditor`: an attribute editor for resource tags with key and value suggestions, tag validation, a tag limit and undo for removing tags the resource already has.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/tag-editor/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsTagEditor(
  tags: tags,
  keysRequest: (key) async => ['environment', 'team', 'cost-center'],
  valuesRequest: (key, value) async => key == 'environment' ? ['production', 'staging'] : [],
  onChange: (change) => setState(() {
    tags = change.tags;
    valid = change.valid;
  }),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to add, edit and remove the key-value tags of a resource (an instance, a bucket, a distribution). For other repeated attributes use `CsAttributeEditor`. To only display tags use a key-value pairs list.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tags` | `List<CsTag>` | `[]` | The tags, including ones marked for removal |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<CsTagEditorChange>?` | | Gets the next `tags` and whether every tag is `valid` |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Shows a loading status in place of the editor |
| `tagLimit` | `int` | `50` | Tags marked for removal do not count |
| `allowedCharacterPattern` | `String?` | Unicode letters, digits, spaces and `_.:/=+@-` | Regular expression for allowed characters |
| `keysRequest` | `Future<List<String>> Function(String key)?` | | Key suggestions; called with `''` on focus, then as the user types |
| `valuesRequest` | `Future<List<String>> Function(String key, String value)?` | | Value suggestions for a key |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsTagEditorI18nStrings` | English | Every label, placeholder, suggestion and error message |

`CsTag`: `key`, `value` (`''`), `existing` (`false`; existing keys are read-only and removing marks them), `markedForRemoval` (`false`), `valueSuggestionOptions` (`List<String>?`), `copyWith`.

`CsTagEditorChange`: `tags`, `valid`. `CsTagEditor.getTagsDiff(initialTags, tags)` returns `CsTagsDiff(created: Map<String, String>, removed: List<String>)`.

`CsTagEditorState` (through a `GlobalKey`): `focus()` moves to the first key or value with an error.

## Examples

### Existing tags with undo

```dart
CsTagEditor(
  tags: const [
    CsTag(key: 'environment', value: 'production', existing: true),
    CsTag(key: 'team', value: 'payments', existing: true, markedForRemoval: true),
  ],
  onChange: (change) {},
)
```

### Limit and custom copy

```dart
CsTagEditor(
  tags: tags,
  tagLimit: 10,
  i18nStrings: CsTagEditorI18nStrings(
    addButton: 'Add tag',
    tagLimit: (available, limit) => '$available of $limit tags left.',
  ),
  onChange: (change) {},
)
```

### Sending the changes

```dart
final diff = CsTagEditor.getTagsDiff(initialTags, tags);
// diff.created: {'cost-center': 'cc-1001'}; diff.removed: ['team']
```

## Accessibility

Key and value fields are text fields named by their column headers; their suggestion lists are announced as expanded and move with Up and Down, Enter picks, Escape closes. Removing an existing tag replaces the value with an announced "This tag will be removed upon saving changes" and an Undo link, which takes focus; Undo returns focus to the row's remove button. Removing a new tag moves focus to the next key, the previous row, or the add button. Errors are announced with the form field's error icon label.

## Motion

None of its own; the suggestion dropdown uses `CsDropdown`'s open and close transition.

## Mobile

Rows follow `CsAttributeEditor`'s default two-field layout: key and value side by side from 465px of editor width, stacked below with the remove button on its own line. Suggestions always open as an anchored dropdown (not a bottom sheet) so the keyboard stays up while typing.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `tags`, `loading`, `tagLimit`, `allowedCharacterPattern`, `keysRequest`, `valuesRequest`, `i18nStrings` | same names (requests return `Future<List<String>>`) |
| `onChange` (`detail.tags`, `detail.valid`) | `onChange` (`CsTagEditorChange`) |
| `Tag.valueSuggestionOptions` (autosuggest options) | `CsTag.valueSuggestionOptions` (`List<String>`) |
| `getTagsDiff` | `CsTagEditor.getTagsDiff` |
| `ref.focus()` | `GlobalKey<CsTagEditorState>` + `focus()` |

---
source: doc/components/CsTextContent.md
---

# CsTextContent

Long-form text with Cloudscape's typography and spacing: headings, paragraphs, small print, inline code, code blocks, links and lists, for help panels and "How it works" sections.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/text-content/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';

const help = CsTextContent(
  blocks: [
    CsTextHeading('Price class', level: CsTextHeadingLevel.h3),
    CsTextParagraph(text: 'The price class sets which edge locations serve your content.'),
    CsTextList(items: [
      CsTextListItem(text: 'All edge locations'),
      CsTextListItem(text: 'North America and Europe only'),
    ]),
  ],
);
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for running text that mixes headings, paragraphs and lists, such as help panel content, empty-state explanations or a details page introduction.
- For a single styled line (a heading, a label, a value) use `CsBox`.
- Cloudscape styles raw HTML. Flutter has no HTML, so pass a list of blocks, or Markdown through `CsTextContent.markdown`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `blocks` | `List<CsTextBlock>` | required | The content, top to bottom. |

`CsTextContent.markdown(String source, {ValueChanged<String>? onFollowLink})` parses a Markdown subset: `#` to `#####` headings, paragraphs separated by blank lines, `-`/`*` and `1.` lists (indent two spaces to nest), fenced code blocks, paragraphs starting with `<small>`, and inline `**bold**`, `*italic*`, `` `code` `` and `[text](target)`. `parseCsMarkdown` and `parseCsInlineMarkdown` return the blocks and spans.

Blocks (`CsTextBlock`):

| Block | HTML | Look |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CsTextHeading(text, level: CsTextHeadingLevel.h1..h5)` | `h1` to `h5` | heading-xl to heading-xs, bold, heading color, 4px above and below |
| `CsTextParagraph(text:, spans:)` | `p` | body-m, 4px above and below |
| `CsTextSmall(text:, spans:)` | `small` | body-s in `color-text-small` |
| `CsTextPre(code)` | `pre` | monospace body-m, scrolls sideways |
| `CsTextList(items:, ordered:)` with `CsTextListItem(text:, spans:, nested:)` | `ul`, `ol` | 20px indent, `space-scaled-xs` above and below, `space-scaled-xxs` between items |
| `CsTextCustom(child)` | any element | any widget |

Inline spans (`CsTextSpan`): `CsTextRun(text, bold:, italic:)`, `CsTextCode(text)` (monospace body-s), `CsTextLink(text, onFollow:, external:)` (an underlined `CsLink`), `CsTextWidget(child)`.

## Examples

### Mixed inline content

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

Widget intro(VoidCallback openPricing) => CsTextContent(
  blocks: [
    CsTextParagraph(spans: [
      const CsTextRun('Use '),
      const CsTextCode('PriceClass_All'),
      const CsTextRun(' to serve from '),
      const CsTextRun('every', bold: true),
      const CsTextRun(' edge location. '),
      CsTextLink('Pricing', onFollow: openPricing, external: true),
    ]),
  ],
);
```

### Markdown

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

Widget steps(ValueChanged<String> open) => CsTextContent.markdown(
  '''
## Create a distribution

1. Choose an origin such as `example-bucket`
2. Pick a price class
3. Review and [create](create)

<small>Changes take a few minutes to deploy.</small>
''',
  onFollowLink: open,
);
```

## Accessibility

Headings are semantic headers. Links are focusable `CsLink`s (Tab reaches them, Enter follows) in the underlined primary variant. List markers are hidden from screen readers; each item is its own node.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Text wraps and scales with the platform text size. Code blocks keep their line breaks and scroll sideways instead of overflowing. Links sit in the line as a unit, so a long link moves to the next line rather than breaking.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` (HTML) | `blocks`, or `CsTextContent.markdown` |
| `h1`...`h5`, `p`, `small`, `code`, `pre`, `a`, `strong`, `em`, `ul`, `ol` | `CsTextHeading`, `CsTextParagraph`, `CsTextSmall`, `CsTextCode`, `CsTextPre`, `CsTextLink`, `CsTextRun(bold:/italic:)`, `CsTextList` |

source: doc/components/CsTextFieldState.md

# CsTextFieldState

A `State` mixin for controlled text fields: it owns a `TextEditingController` kept in sync with the widget's `value` and a `FocusNode` whose focus is mirrored in `focused`.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/input/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
class ArnField extends StatefulWidget {
  const ArnField({super.key, required this.value, required this.onChange, this.focusNode});

  final String value;
  final ValueChanged<String> onChange;
  final FocusNode? focusNode;

  @override
  State<ArnField> createState() => _ArnFieldState();
}

class _ArnFieldState extends State<ArnField> with CsTextFieldState<ArnField> {
  @override
  String get value => widget.value;

  @override
  FocusNode? get externalFocusNode => widget.focusNode;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return CsFieldBox(
      focused: focused,
      child: CsEditable(controller: controller, focusNode: focusNode, mono: true, onChanged: widget.onChange),
    );
  }
}
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use when building a custom controlled field from `CsFieldBox` and `CsEditable`, so it behaves like `CsInput`: the parent owns the value, and the caret stays where the user put it.
- Not needed for uncontrolled fields that own their own `TextEditingController`.

## Parameters

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String` (getter, required) | Return the widget's controlled value. |
| `externalFocusNode` | `FocusNode?` (getter) | Return the caller's focus node, if the widget takes one. Defaults to null, and the mixin creates and disposes its own. |
| `onFocusChange(bool hasFocus)` | method | Override to fire `onFocus` / `onBlur` callbacks. |
| `controller` | `TextEditingController` | Created in `initState` with `value`, disposed for you. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode` | The external node or the mixin's own. |
| `focused` | `bool` | Whether the field has focus; the mixin calls `setState` when it changes. |
| `syncValue()` | method | Writes `value` into the controller when it changed from outside. Called from `didUpdateWidget`. |

## Examples

### Focus callbacks

```dart
class _NoteFieldState extends State<NoteField> with CsTextFieldState<NoteField> {
  @override
  String get value => widget.value;

  @override
  void onFocusChange(bool hasFocus) => hasFocus ? widget.onFocus() : widget.onBlur();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => CsFieldBox(
    focused: focused,
    multiline: true,
    child: CsEditable(controller: controller, focusNode: focusNode, maxLines: null, onChanged: widget.onChange),
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

The mixin adds nothing to semantics; the field you build does (see `CsEditable`).

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Because the controller only takes a new value when it differs from what is typed, an IME composing region and the caret position survive rebuilds from the parent.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape pattern | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| controlled `value` + `onChange` on Input, Textarea, Autosuggest | `CsTextFieldState` |
| `onFocus` / `onBlur` | `onFocusChange` |

---
source: doc/components/CsTextFilter.md

# CsTextFilter

Cloudscape's `TextFilter`: a search input that filters a collection by text, with the match count next to it.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/text-filter/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsTextFilter(
  filteringText: 'web',
  filteringPlaceholder: 'Find instances',
  countText: '3 matches',
  onChange: (text) {},
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it above a table or card list when free-text search is enough. For structured filters by property use `CsPropertyFilter`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filteringText` | `String` | required | The text |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | Every edit |
| `onDelayedChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | | 400ms after the last edit (server filtering) |
| `filteringPlaceholder` | `String?` | | |
| `filteringAriaLabel` | `String?` | placeholder | |
| `filteringClearAriaLabel` | `String?` | "Clear" | |
| `countText` | `String?` | | Shown while there is text |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Pauses count announcements |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `focusNode`, `autoFocus` | | | |

## Examples

### Server filtering

```dart
CsTextFilter(
  filteringText: '',
  filteringPlaceholder: 'Find distributions',
  onChange: (text) {},
  onDelayedChange: (text) {},
)
```

## Accessibility

A search text field with a clear button. Changes to `countText` are announced (not while `loading`).

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

The filter fills the width (at most 648px) and the count stays on one line beside it.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `filteringText`, `filteringPlaceholder`, `filteringAriaLabel`, `filteringClearAriaLabel`, `countText`, `loading`, `disabled` | same names |
| `onChange`, `onDelayedChange` (`detail.filteringText`) | `onChange`, `onDelayedChange` (the text) |
| `controlId`, `ariaLabelledby`, `style` | not applicable |

# CsTextarea

A multi-line text field for free-form text such as a description, a note or a policy document.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/textarea/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Description',
  characterCountText: '${description.length}/200',
  child: CsTextarea(
    value: description,
    placeholder: 'Describe what this bucket stores',
    onChange: (v) => setState(() => description = v),
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use when the value can be longer than one line.
- Use `CsInput` for single-line values; it keeps forms compact and Enter submits.
- For code with syntax highlighting, use a code editor instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String` | required | The controlled text. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Called on every edit. |
| `onFocus` / `onBlur` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | |
| `onKeyEvent` | `FocusOnKeyEventCallback?` | `null` | Key events before the field handles them (Cloudscape `onKeyDown`), for example Cmd+Enter to submit. |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | `null` | May span several lines. |
| `rows` | `int` | `3` | Lines shown. |
| `maxRows` | `int?` | `null` | Grow with the content up to this many lines, then scroll. Null keeps the height at `rows`. |
| `disabled` / `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `invalid` / `warning` | `bool` | `false` | Status border with an 8px start edge. |
| `autoFocus` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `autoComplete` | `bool` | `true` | Platform suggestions. |
| `spellcheck` | `bool` | `true` | Spell checking and autocorrect. |
| `textCapitalization` | `TextCapitalization` | `sentences` | On-screen keyboard capitalization. |
| `inputFormatters` | `List<TextInputFormatter>?` | `null` | For example `LengthLimitingTextInputFormatter(200)`. |
| `mono` | `bool` | `false` | Monospace text for JSON or keys. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name without a visible label. |
| `ariaRequired` | `bool` | `false` | Adds a "Required" hint. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |

## Examples

### Character count with a limit

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Description',
  constraintText: 'Up to 200 characters.',
  characterCountText: '${description.length}/200',
  errorText: description.length > 200 ? 'The description is too long.' : null,
  child: CsTextarea(
    value: description,
    invalid: description.length > 200,
    onChange: (v) => setState(() => description = v),
  ),
)
```

### Grows with its content

```dart
CsTextarea(
  value: notes,
  rows: 2,
  maxRows: 8,
  ariaLabel: 'Notes',
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => notes = v),
)
```

### Submit with Cmd+Enter

```dart
CsTextarea(
  value: message,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => message = v),
  onKeyEvent: (node, event) {
    if (event is KeyDownEvent &&
        event.logicalKey == LogicalKeyboardKey.enter &&
        HardwareKeyboard.instance.isMetaPressed) {
      send();
      return KeyEventResult.handled;
    }
    return KeyEventResult.ignored;
  },
)
```

## Accessibility

Exposed as a multi-line text field with its label, enabled and read-only state. Enter inserts a line break; Tab leaves the field. Pair the character count with `CsFormField` so it is read with the field.

## Motion

None. Growth with `maxRows` follows the text instantly.

## Mobile

The on-screen keyboard shows a return key. With `maxRows` the field grows instead of scrolling inside a small box, which is easier with a finger; at 2x text each row grows with the text.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` / `onChange` | `value` / `onChange` |
| `rows` | `rows` (+ `maxRows` for growth) |
| `resize` | not supported: the height follows `rows` and `maxRows` |
| `placeholder` | `placeholder` |
| `disabled` / `readOnly` | `disabled` / `readOnly` |
| `invalid` / `warning` | `invalid` / `warning` |
| `autoFocus`, `autoComplete`, `spellcheck`, `disableBrowserAutocorrect`, `disableBrowserSpellcheck` | `autoFocus`, `autoComplete`, `spellcheck` |
| `onKeyDown` / `onKeyUp` | `onKeyEvent` |
| `onFocus` / `onBlur` | `onFocus` / `onBlur` |
| `ariaLabel`, `ariaRequired` | `ariaLabel`, `ariaRequired` |
| `name`, `controlId`, `ariaDescribedby`, `ariaLabelledby`, `nativeTextareaAttributes`, `style` | web only |

---
source: doc/components/CsThemeProvider.md
---

# CsThemeProvider

The root of a Cloudscape app: resolves light or dark mode and density, applies color overrides and typography, provides `context.cs`, and cross-fades mode changes. `CsTheme` forces a theme for a subtree, `CsDensityScope` switches density for a subtree.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/foundation/visual-foundation/visual-modes/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsThemeProvider(
  child: Builder(
    builder: (context) => MaterialApp(theme: csMaterialTheme(context.cs), home: const SizedBox()),
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Once, above `MaterialApp`. Use `CsTheme` or `CsDensityScope` for parts of the screen that need another mode or density, and `CsVisualContext` for Cloudscape's visual contexts.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `CsThemeMode` | `system` | `system`, `light`, `dark` |
| `density` | `CsDensity` | `comfortable` | `comfortable` or `compact` |
| `typography` | `CsTypography` | Open Sans | Font families |
| `tapTargetSize` | `CsTapTargetSize?` | platform default | `padded` (44px hit areas) on touch, `shrinkWrap` with a mouse |
| `disableMotion` | `bool` | `false` | Cloudscape's `disableMotion` |
| `lightColorOverrides`, `darkColorOverrides` | `Map<CsColor, Color>` | `{}` | Token overrides per mode (`applyTheme`) |
| `light`, `dark` | `CsThemeData?` | | Replace the generated themes |
| `animationDuration` | `Duration` | 250ms | Mode cross-fade |
| `child` | `Widget` | | |

## Examples

### Compact density for a table

```dart
CsDensityScope(density: CsDensity.compact, child: const CsBox(text: 'Compact content'))
```

### Force dark for one panel

```dart
CsTheme(data: CsThemeData.dark(), child: const CsBox(text: 'Always dark'))
```

## Accessibility

Follows the platform's light/dark setting by default; the platform reduce-motion setting turns motion off like `disableMotion`.

## Motion

Mode changes cross-fade every token over 250ms; instant when motion is off.

## Mobile

Touch platforms default to 44px hit areas.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape API | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `applyMode(Mode.Dark)` | `mode: CsThemeMode.dark` |
| `applyDensity(Density.Compact)` | `density: CsDensity.compact` |
| `disableMotion(true)` | `disableMotion: true` |
| `applyTheme({ theme: { tokens } })` | `lightColorOverrides` / `darkColorOverrides` |

---
source: doc/components/CsTiles.md
---

# CsTiles

A single choice shown as bordered cards, for options that need a description or an image to be compared.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/tiles/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Engine',
  stretch: true,
  child: CsTiles(
    value: engine,
    onChange: (v) => setState(() => engine = v),
    items: const [
      CsTilesItem(value: 'mysql', label: 'MySQL', description: 'Open-source relational database.'),
      CsTilesItem(value: 'postgres', label: 'PostgreSQL', description: 'Extensible relational database.'),
    ],
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for a few options (2 to 8) where each needs a sentence or an illustration.
- Use `CsRadioGroup` when a label is enough, and a select for long lists.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String?` | required | Value of the selected tile; null for none. |
| `items` | `List<CsTilesItem>` | required | The tiles. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Called with the newly selected value. |
| `columns` | `int?` | from item count | 1 to 4 columns on wide layouts. By default 1 for one item, 2 for 2, 4 or 8 items, otherwise 3. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Focusable, not changeable. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Group name outside a labelled form field. |
| `ariaRequired` | `bool` | `false` | Adds a "Required" hint. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | |

`CsTilesItem(value:, label:, labelWidget:, description:, descriptionWidget:, image:, disabled: false)`. The `image` is centered under the description and fades to 30% when disabled.

`CsTiles.defaultColumns(itemCount)` and `CsTiles.columnsAt(width, columns)` expose the column rules.

## Examples

### With images and four columns

```dart
CsTiles(
  value: size,
  columns: 4,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => size = v),
  items: const [
    CsTilesItem(value: 'small', label: 'Small', description: '2 vCPU, 4 GiB', image: CsIcon(CsIcons.file, size: CsIconSize.big)),
    CsTilesItem(value: 'medium', label: 'Medium', description: '4 vCPU, 16 GiB', image: CsIcon(CsIcons.folder, size: CsIconSize.big)),
    CsTilesItem(value: 'large', label: 'Large', description: '8 vCPU, 32 GiB', image: CsIcon(CsIcons.folderOpen, size: CsIconSize.big)),
    CsTilesItem(value: 'xlarge', label: 'X-Large', disabled: true),
  ],
)
```

## Accessibility

- Each tile is announced as a radio button in a mutually exclusive group, with its label and description; the whole tile is the touch target.
- The group is one Tab stop; arrow keys move to the next enabled tile and select it, wrapping. Keyboard focus draws the focus ring around the tile's radio, as Cloudscape does.

## Motion

Border and background change over `CsDurations.transitionQuick` (90ms) when a tile is selected; the radio ring grows in. Reduced motion makes both instant.

## Mobile

Columns follow the width the tiles get (Cloudscape's container breakpoints): one column under 465px, at most two under 688px, then `columns`. Tiles in a row share the tallest tile's height. The gap is half of `space-tile-gutter` (12px, 8px compact).

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value` / `onChange` | `value` / `onChange` |
| `items` (`value`, `label`, `description`, `image`, `disabled`) | `items` (`CsTilesItem`) |
| `columns` | `columns` |
| `readOnly` | `readOnly` |
| `ariaLabel`, `ariaRequired` | `ariaLabel`, `ariaRequired` |
| `name`, `items[].controlId`, `ariaControls` | web only |

source: doc/components/CsTimeInput.md

# CsTimeInput

A masked text field for typing a time of day as `hh:mm:ss`, `hh:mm` or `hh`.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/time-input/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsFormField(
  label: 'Backup window starts',
  constraintText: 'Use 24-hour format.',
  child: CsTimeInput(
    value: start, // '02:30:00'
    placeholder: 'hh:mm:ss',
    onChange: (v) => setState(() => start = v),
  ),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for a time without a date, such as a maintenance window.
- With a date, put it next to a `CsDatePicker`, or use `CsDateRangePicker`, which already has time inputs.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `String` | required | Time as typed, partial while typing, or `''`. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Text on every edit. |
| `onBlur` / `onFocus` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Blur first completes a partial time. |
| `onSubmit` | `ValueChanged<String>?` | `null` | Enter pressed; receives the completed time. |
| `format` | `CsTimeInputFormat` | `hhMmSs` | `hh`, `hhMm` or `hhMmSs`. `format.pattern` gives the placeholder text. |
| `use24Hour` | `bool` | `true` | False limits hours to 01-12 (no AM/PM part, as in Cloudscape). |
| `placeholder` | `String?` | `null` | Such as `hh:mm:ss`. |
| `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `warning`, `autoFocus` | `bool` | `false` | Field states. |
| `autoComplete` | `bool` | `true` | Platform autofill and suggestions. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name without a visible label. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |

## Examples

### Masking rules

Typing `7` gives `07:`; `25` becomes `23:` (24-hour) and `13` becomes `12:` with `use24Hour: false`. On blur or Enter, `10:1` becomes `10:01:00`.

### Hours and minutes

```dart
CsTimeInput(
  value: cutoff,
  format: CsTimeInputFormat.hhMm,
  placeholder: CsTimeInputFormat.hhMm.pattern,
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => cutoff = v),
)
```

## Accessibility

A text field labeled by its `CsFormField` or `ariaLabel`. Say the format in the constraint text.

## Motion

None beyond the field's focus ring.

## Mobile

Fills its parent's width with a 32px minimum height that grows with text.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `value`, `onChange` | `value`, `onChange` |
| `format` (`hh`, `hh:mm`, `hh:mm:ss`) | `format` (`CsTimeInputFormat.hh`, `.hhMm`, `.hhMmSs`) |
| `use24Hour` | `use24Hour` |
| `autoComplete` | `autoComplete` |
| `placeholder`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `warning`, `autoFocus` | same names |
| `onBlur`, `onFocus` | `onBlur`, `onFocus` |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `name`, `controlId`, `ariaDescribedby`, `ariaLabelledby`, `ariaRequired`, `disableBrowserAutocorrect`, `nativeInputAttributes` | not applicable |
| `ref.focus()` | `focusNode` |

---
source: doc/components/CsToggle.md
---

# CsToggle

An on/off switch for a setting that takes effect immediately.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/toggle/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsToggle(
  checked: monitoring,
  label: 'Detailed monitoring',
  description: 'Collects metrics every minute.',
  onChange: (v) => setState(() => monitoring = v),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use when flipping the control applies the change at once.
- Use `CsCheckbox` when the choice is submitted later with a form.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `bool` | required | The controlled state. |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | `null` | Called after a tap, key press or a drag that changes sides. Null disables it. |
| `label` / `child` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | Label; tapping it toggles too. |
| `description` / `descriptionWidget` | `String?` / `Widget?` | `null` | Body-s text under the label. |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Focusable, not changeable. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | "Switch" without a label | Accessible name. |
| `ariaRequired` | `bool` | `false` | Adds a "Required" hint. |
| `haptic` | `CsHaptic` | `selection` | Feedback when the state changes. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` | `null` | |
| `autofocus` | `bool` | `false` | |

## Examples

### Saving to a service

```dart
CsToggle(
  checked: protection,
  label: 'Termination protection',
  onChange: (v) async {
    setState(() => protection = v);
    await saveProtection(v);
  },
)
```

### Read-only

```dart
CsToggle(checked: true, readOnly: true, label: 'Encryption at rest', onChange: (_) {})
```

## Accessibility

Announced as a switch with its toggled state, label and description. Tab focuses it; Space or Enter toggles. Keyboard focus draws the 2px focus ring around the track. Without a label it is announced as "Switch" unless `ariaLabel` is set.

## Motion

- Tap: the handle springs to the other side, starting from wherever it is, and stretches by 4px early in its travel (Cloudscape's expressive tail). Track and handle colors follow its position.
- Press: the handle stretches while held.
- Drag: the handle follows the finger 1:1 from the touch point and resists past either end (`CsMotion.rubberband`). On release the side comes from the position plus the projected flick (`CsMotion.project`); a flick settles with `CsSprings.momentum`. If the parent does not accept the new value, the handle springs back.
- A selection haptic marks each change. Reduced motion moves the handle without animation.

## Mobile

The track keeps Cloudscape's 24x16 size; the row is padded to a 44px hit area on touch. The drag recognizer uses a 4px slop, because Flutter's 18px default is longer than the handle's 8px travel.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `checked` / `onChange` | `checked` / `onChange` |
| `children` | `label` / `child` |
| `description` | `description` / `descriptionWidget` |
| `disabled` / `readOnly` | `disabled` / `readOnly` |
| `ariaLabel`, `ariaRequired` | `ariaLabel`, `ariaRequired` |
| `name`, `controlId`, `ariaControls`, `nativeInputAttributes`, `style` | web only |

---
source: doc/components/CsToggleButton.md
---

# CsToggleButton

Cloudscape's `ToggleButton`: a button that stays pressed until pressed again.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/toggle-button/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsToggleButton(
  text: 'Favorite',
  icon: CsIcons.star,
  pressedIcon: CsIcons.starFilled,
  pressed: true,
  onChange: (pressed) {},
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it for a two-state action (bookmark, mute, show grid). For a setting that takes effect like a switch, use a toggle; for one of several modes, a segmented control.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pressed` | `bool` | required | On or off |
| `onChange` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` | | Next state; null disables |
| `text` | `String?` | | Button text |
| `variant` | `CsToggleButtonVariant` | `normal` | `normal` or `icon` |
| `icon`, `pressedIcon` | `CsIconData?` | | Icons for off and on |
| `iconWidget`, `pressedIconWidget` | `Widget?` | | Custom icons |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `disabledReason` | `String?` | | Tooltip; keeps it focusable |
| `loading`, `loadingText` | | | Spinner, presses ignored |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | | Required for the icon variant; shown as its tooltip |
| `focusNode`, `autofocus` | | | |

## Examples

### Icon toggle

```dart
CsToggleButton(
  variant: CsToggleButtonVariant.icon,
  icon: CsIcons.thumbsUp,
  pressedIcon: CsIcons.thumbsUpFilled,
  ariaLabel: 'Helpful',
  pressed: false,
  onChange: (pressed) {},
)
```

## Accessibility

Announced as a toggle button with its pressed state. Enter and Space toggle. A selection haptic plays on touch devices.

## Motion

Press feedback scales to 0.98 with a spring; colors switch instantly. Reduced motion removes the scale.

## Mobile

32px tall (28px compact) with a 44px touch target.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `pressed`, `variant`, `disabled`, `disabledReason`, `loading`, `loadingText`, `ariaLabel` | same names |
| `onChange` (`detail.pressed`) | `onChange` (bool) |
| `children` | `text` |
| `iconName`, `pressedIconName` | `icon`, `pressedIcon` |
| `iconSvg`/`iconUrl`, `pressedIconSvg`/`pressedIconUrl` | `iconWidget`, `pressedIconWidget` |
| `nativeButtonAttributes`, `ariaControls` | not applicable |

# CsToken

Cloudscape's `Token`: a compact, optionally dismissible representation of a chosen item, such as a selected option or an applied filter.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/token/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsToken(label: 'example-bucket', description: 'us-east-1', onDismiss: () {})
```

## When to use / when not to

Use a token for a single chosen item, alone or inline in text. For a list of tokens use `CsTokenGroup`; for a status use `CsBadge` or `CsStatusIndicator`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String?` | | Token text (or `labelWidget`) |
| `labelWidget` | `Widget?` | | Custom label |
| `labelTag` | `String?` | | Short text after the label |
| `description` | `String?` | | Small text (normal variant) |
| `tags` | `List<String>?` | | Small tags (normal variant) |
| `icon` | `CsIconData?` | | Leading icon; x-small when inline |
| `iconWidget` | `Widget?` | | Custom icon |
| `variant` | `CsTokenVariant` | `normal` | `normal` or `inline` (20px tall) |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | Disabled colors; dismiss does nothing |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Read-only colors; dismiss does nothing |
| `dismissLabel` | `String?` | "Remove <label>" | Dismiss button name |
| `onDismiss` | `VoidCallback?` | | Shows the dismiss button |
| `tooltipContent` | `String?` | | Tooltip on hover and focus |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | | Accessible name |

## Examples

### Inline

```dart
Wrap(spacing: 4, children: [
  CsToken(label: 'Running', variant: CsTokenVariant.inline, onDismiss: () {}),
  const CsToken(label: 'us-east-1a', variant: CsTokenVariant.inline, icon: CsIcons.locationPin),
])
```

### Read-only and disabled

```dart
Column(children: [
  CsToken(label: 'prod', readOnly: true, onDismiss: () {}),
  CsToken(label: 'archive', disabled: true, onDismiss: () {}),
])
```

## Accessibility

The token is a container with its label; the dismiss button is a separate button labelled by `dismissLabel`. Disabled and read-only tokens keep the button visible but inactive.

## Motion

None beyond the dismiss button's press feedback.

## Mobile

Labels wrap in normal tokens; inline tokens truncate with an ellipsis. The dismiss button's touch target is padded to 44px.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `label`, `labelTag`, `description`, `tags`, `variant`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `dismissLabel`, `onDismiss`, `tooltipContent`, `ariaLabel` | same names |
| `icon` (node) | `icon` / `iconWidget` |
| `label` (node) | `labelWidget` |
| `style` | not applicable (use theme tokens) |

# CsTokenGroup

Cloudscape's `TokenGroup`: a list of dismissible tokens with an optional limit and "Show more" toggle.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/token-group/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsTokenGroup(
  items: const [
    CsTokenGroupItem(label: 'example-bucket', description: 'us-east-1'),
    CsTokenGroupItem(label: 'logs-bucket', description: 'eu-west-1'),
  ],
  onDismiss: (index) {},
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use it to show and remove several chosen items, for example under a file upload or a custom multi-value field. `CsMultiselect` already shows its own tokens.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<CsTokenGroupItem>` | required | `label`, `labelTag`, `description`, `tags`, `icon`, `iconWidget`, `disabled`, `dismissLabel` |
| `onDismiss` | `ValueChanged<int>?` | | Index of the dismissed token; without it there is no dismiss button |
| `limit` | `int?` | | Tokens shown before "Show more (+N)" |
| `alignment` | `CsTokenGroupAlignment` | `horizontal` | `horizontal` (wrap) or `vertical` |
| `disableOuterPadding` | `bool` | `false` | Drops the 8px top padding |
| `readOnly` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsTokenGroupI18nStrings` | English | `limitShowMore`, `limitShowFewer` |
| `limitShowMoreAriaLabel`, `limitShowFewerAriaLabel` | `String?` | | |

## Examples

### Vertical with a limit

```dart
CsTokenGroup(
  alignment: CsTokenGroupAlignment.vertical,
  limit: 2,
  items: const [
    CsTokenGroupItem(label: 'report.csv', labelTag: '12 KB', icon: CsIcons.file),
    CsTokenGroupItem(label: 'chart.png', labelTag: '80 KB', icon: CsIcons.file),
    CsTokenGroupItem(label: 'notes.txt', labelTag: '1 KB', icon: CsIcons.file),
  ],
  onDismiss: (index) {},
)
```

## Accessibility

The group is a container; each dismiss button is labelled "Remove <label>" unless `dismissLabel` is set. The limit toggle announces its expanded state.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Horizontal tokens wrap to new lines at 390px.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `items`, `limit`, `alignment`, `disableOuterPadding`, `readOnly`, `i18nStrings`, `limitShowMoreAriaLabel`, `limitShowFewerAriaLabel` | same names |
| `onDismiss` (`detail.itemIndex`) | `onDismiss` (index) |

# CsTooltip

Cloudscape's `Tooltip`: a short text label for a control, shown on hover after a delay, at once on keyboard focus, and on long press with touch. Drawn as Cloudscape's popover container with its arrow.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/tooltip/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsTooltip(
  content: 'Copy ARN',
  child: CsButton(icon: CsIcons.copy, variant: CsButtonVariant.icon, semanticLabel: 'Copy ARN', onPress: () {}),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

Use tooltips for labels of icon-only controls and short clarifications. Never put essential information or interactive content in a tooltip: use `CsPopover` for that.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `String` | | Tooltip text |
| `child` | `Widget` | | The trigger |
| `side` | `CsSide` | `top` | Preferred side; flips when there is no room |
| `align` | `CsAlign` | `center` | |
| `delay` | `Duration` | 600ms | Hover delay; consecutive tooltips show at once |
| `closeDelay` | `Duration` | 0 | |
| `touchDuration` | `Duration` | 1500ms | How long a long-press tooltip stays |
| `disabled` | `bool` | `false` | |
| `showArrow` | `bool` | `true` | |
| `open`, `onOpenChange` | | | Control visibility from outside |

## Accessibility

The tooltip text is not a separate node; give the trigger its own label. Escape closes it.

## Motion

Fades and scales in from its trigger with Cloudscape's 115ms responsive timing; instant under reduced motion.

## Mobile

Shown on long press for `touchDuration`.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `content` | `content` |
| `position` | `side` |
| `trackRef`, `getTrack` | the `child` widget |

# CsTopNavigation

The global bar above the app layout with the product identity, a search field and utilities such as notifications, settings and the user menu.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/top-navigation/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsTopNavigation(
  identity: CsTopNavigationIdentity(href: '/', title: 'Cloud console', onFollow: () {}),
  utilities: [
    CsTopNavigationButton(
      icon: CsIcons.notification,
      ariaLabel: 'Notifications (2 unread)',
      badge: true,
      disableUtilityCollapse: true,
      onClick: () {},
    ),
    CsTopNavigationMenuDropdown(
      text: 'Account',
      description: 'user@example.com',
      icon: CsIcons.userProfile,
      items: const [
        CsTopNavigationMenuItem(id: 'profile', text: 'Profile'),
        CsTopNavigationMenuItem(id: 'signout', text: 'Sign out'),
      ],
      onItemClick: (item) {},
    ),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use once, at the very top of a console, above `CsAppLayout`.
- Do not put page actions here; they belong in the page header.
- Keep utilities to a few: notifications, settings, help and the user menu.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `identity` | `CsTopNavigationIdentity?` | `null` | `href`, `title`, `logo` (a widget, at most 32px tall), `logoWidth` (32), `onFollow`. |
| `search` | `Widget?` | `null` | A search field, such as `CsInput(type: CsInputType.search)`. At most 340px wide. |
| `utilities` | `List<CsTopNavigationUtility>` | `[]` | `CsTopNavigationButton` and `CsTopNavigationMenuDropdown` items. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsTopNavigationI18nStrings` | English | `searchIconAriaLabel`, `searchDismissIconAriaLabel`, `overflowMenuTriggerText` ("More"), `overflowMenuTitleText` ("All"), `overflowMenuBackIconAriaLabel`, `overflowMenuDismissIconAriaLabel`. |
| `visualContext` | `CsTopNavigationVisualContext` | `topNavigation` | `topNavigation` keeps the bar dark in both modes; `none` uses the page colors. |
| `safeAreaTop` | `bool` | `true` | Pads the content below the status bar and notch while the dark bar extends under them. Turn off when the bar is not at the top of the screen. |
| `child` | `Widget?` | `null` | Custom content. When set, `identity`, `search` and `utilities` are ignored. |

Shared utility fields: `text`, `title`, `icon`, `iconWidget`, `ariaLabel`, `badge`, `disableTextCollapse`, `disableUtilityCollapse`.

`CsTopNavigationButton`: `variant` (`link` or `primaryButton`), `href`, `external`, `externalIconAriaLabel`, `onClick`, `onFollow` (called when `href` is set).

`CsTopNavigationMenuDropdown`: `items` (`CsTopNavigationMenuItem`), `description`, `expandableGroups`, `onItemClick`, `onItemFollow` (items with `href`).

`CsTopNavigationMenuItem`: `id`, `text`, `href`, `external`, `externalIconAriaLabel`, `disabled`, `description`, `icon`, `items` (makes it a group).

## Examples

### With search and a primary button

```dart
CsTopNavigation(
  identity: const CsTopNavigationIdentity(
    href: '/',
    title: 'Cloud console',
    logo: SizedBox(width: 32, height: 32, child: Placeholder()),
  ),
  search: CsInput(value: '', type: CsInputType.search, placeholder: 'Search', onChange: (value) {}),
  utilities: [
    CsTopNavigationButton(
      text: 'Create resource',
      variant: CsTopNavigationButtonVariant.primaryButton,
      onClick: () {},
    ),
    CsTopNavigationButton(text: 'Docs', href: '/docs', external: true, onFollow: () {}),
  ],
)
```

### Responsive collapse

The bar measures its content and, as the width shrinks, steps through Cloudscape's states in order: utility texts hide (icons stay, unless `disableTextCollapse`), the search field becomes a search button that expands the field across the bar, utilities move one by one into a "More" menu (unless `disableUtilityCollapse`), and finally the title hides next to a logo. `CsTopNavigationResponsiveState.statesFor` exposes the state list.

## Accessibility

- The identity is a link named by the title. Icon-only utilities need `ariaLabel`; when text is hidden on narrow screens, `ariaLabel` or `text` names the control.
- Menu triggers announce their expanded state. Menus take focus; arrow keys move between items; Escape closes them and focus returns to the trigger.
- The overflow menu is a full-screen view with a focus trap. Escape goes back from a submenu, then closes; focus returns to "More".
- `badge` adds a dot to the icon; describe it in `ariaLabel` ("Notifications (2 unread)").

## Motion

Menu carets turn 180 degrees when open (`CsDurations.rotate180`). Menus scale from their trigger; the overflow menu fades in over `CsDurations.showPaced`. Reduced motion makes all of them instant.

## Mobile

The bar is 56px tall on wide screens, 48px from 465px and 40px below (plus a 1px bottom border). On phones menus open as bottom sheets and the overflow menu covers the screen. At extreme text sizes the utilities scale down rather than overflow.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `identity` (`title`, `logo`, `href`, `onFollow`) | `identity` (`logo` is a widget) |
| `search` | `search` |
| `utilities` (`type: 'button'`) | `CsTopNavigationButton` (`variant: 'primary-button'` is `primaryButton`) |
| `utilities` (`type: 'menu-dropdown'`) | `CsTopNavigationMenuDropdown` |
| `iconName`, `iconUrl` / `iconSvg` | `icon`, `iconWidget` |
| `badge`, `disableTextCollapse`, `disableUtilityCollapse` | same names |
| `i18nStrings` | `i18nStrings` |
| `visualContext` | `visualContext` |
| `children` | `child` |
| `target`, `rel`, `iconAlt` | not applicable (web only) |

---
source: doc/components/CsTreeView.md

# CsTreeView

Shows hierarchical items, such as folders and objects in a bucket or nested resources, that people can expand and collapse.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/tree-view/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
class Node {
  const Node(this.id, this.name, [this.children]);
  final String id;
  final String name;
  final List<Node>? children;
}

class BucketTree extends StatefulWidget {
  const BucketTree({super.key});

  @override
  State<BucketTree> createState() => _BucketTreeState();
}

class _BucketTreeState extends State<BucketTree> {
  final expanded = <String>{'logs'};

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return CsTreeView<Node>(
      ariaLabel: 'example-bucket',
      items: const [
        Node('logs', 'logs', [Node('jan', 'january.log'), Node('feb', 'february.log')]),
        Node('index', 'index.html'),
      ],
      expandedItems: expanded,
      getItemId: (node, index) => node.id,
      getItemChildren: (node, index) => node.children,
      onItemToggle: (detail) => setState(() {
        detail.expanded ? expanded.add(detail.id) : expanded.remove(detail.id);
      }),
      renderItem: (node, index) => CsTreeViewItem(
        icon: CsIcon(node.children == null ? CsIcons.file : CsIcons.folder),
        content: Text(node.name),
      ),
    );
  }
}
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for content with a real hierarchy that people browse: object prefixes, organizational units, nested stacks.
- Do not use for page navigation (use `CsSideNavigation`) or for tabular data with columns (use a table with expandable rows).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<T>` | required | The top-level items. |
| `renderItem` | `CsTreeViewItem Function(T, int)` | required | Maps an item to `content`, `icon`, `secondaryContent`, `actions` and `announcementLabel`. |
| `getItemId` | `String Function(T, int)` | required | A unique id per item. |
| `getItemChildren` | `List<T>? Function(T, int)` | required | The item's children; null or empty for a leaf. |
| `expandedItems` | `Set<String>` | `{}` | Ids of the expanded items. |
| `onItemToggle` | `ValueChanged<CsTreeViewItemToggleDetail<T>>?` | `null` | `id`, `item` and the requested `expanded` state. |
| `connectorLines` | `CsTreeViewConnectorLines` | `none` | `vertical` draws a line beside the children of each expanded item. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsTreeViewI18nStrings<T>` | English | `expandButtonLabel(item)`, `collapseButtonLabel(item)`; default "Expand" and "Collapse". |
| `renderItemToggleIcon` | `Widget Function(bool expanded)?` | `null` | Replaces the caret. |
| `ariaLabel` | `String?` | `null` | Accessible name of the tree. |

## Examples

### Connector lines, secondary content and actions

```dart
CsTreeView<String>(
  items: const ['logs/', 'index.html'],
  expandedItems: const {'logs/'},
  connectorLines: CsTreeViewConnectorLines.vertical,
  getItemId: (path, index) => path,
  getItemChildren: (path, index) => path == 'logs/' ? const ['logs/january.log'] : null,
  renderItem: (path, index) => CsTreeViewItem(
    icon: CsIcon(path.endsWith('/') ? CsIcons.folder : CsIcons.file),
    content: Text(path),
    secondaryContent: const Text('Last modified 2 hours ago'),
    actions: CsButton(
      variant: CsButtonVariant.inlineIcon,
      icon: CsIcons.download,
      semanticLabel: 'Download $path',
      onPress: () {},
    ),
  ),
)
```

## Accessibility

- The tree is a labeled container. Each row announces its `announcementLabel` (or content), its expanded state, and its level and position ("level 2, 1 of 3").
- One row is in the Tab order (roving focus). Up and Down move between visible rows, Home and End jump to the first and last, Right expands or moves to the first child, Left collapses or moves to the parent, Enter and Space toggle. Arrow directions flip in right-to-left layouts.
- Toggles are named by `expandButtonLabel` and `collapseButtonLabel`. Collapsing a branch that holds focus moves focus to its item.

## Motion

Children expand and collapse with Cloudscape's expandable motion and the caret turns 90 degrees (`CsDurations.rotate90`). Reduced motion makes both instant.

## Mobile

Rows wrap long content. On touch screens the toggle's hit area grows to 32px without changing the layout. Each level indents 24px (`CsSpace.treeViewIndentation`); keep trees shallow on phones.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `items` | `items` |
| `renderItem` (`content`, `icon`, `secondaryContent`, `actions`, `announcementLabel`) | `renderItem` (`CsTreeViewItem`) |
| `getItemId`, `getItemChildren` | same names |
| `expandedItems` | `expandedItems` (a `Set<String>`) |
| `onItemToggle` | `onItemToggle` (`CsTreeViewItemToggleDetail`) |
| `connectorLines` | `connectorLines` |
| `i18nStrings` | `i18nStrings` |
| `renderItemToggleIcon` | `renderItemToggleIcon` |
| `ariaLabel` | `ariaLabel` |
| `ariaLabelledby`, `ariaDescribedby` | not applicable; use `ariaLabel` |

---
source: doc/components/CsTruncatedText.md
---

# CsTruncatedText

Text that ends with an ellipsis when it does not fit and shows the full text in a tooltip on hover, keyboard focus or tap.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/truncated-text/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';

const path = CsTruncatedText('arn:aws:s3:::example-bucket/logs/2026/11/16/distribution-d111111abcdef8.gz');
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it for long identifiers, paths and names in narrow places: table cells, key-value pairs, cards, breadcrumbs.
- Use `maxLines` above 1 to clamp a description to a few lines.
- Do not truncate text people need to read in full to act (error messages, instructions): let it wrap.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `String` | required (positional) | The text. |
| `maxLines` | `int` | `1` | Lines before the ellipsis. |
| `tooltipText` | `String?` | `text` | Tooltip content when it should differ from the text. |
| `style` | `TextStyle?` | `null` | Merged over the surrounding text style. |
| `textAlign` | `TextAlign?` | `null` | Alignment of the text. |

## Examples

### In a narrow cell

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

Widget cell() => const SizedBox(
  width: 160,
  child: CsTruncatedText('distribution-d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.example'),
);
```

### Clamped description

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';

const description = CsTruncatedText(
  'Serves static assets for the storefront from example-bucket through every edge location, '
  'with logs delivered to logs-bucket.',
  maxLines: 2,
);
```

## Accessibility

Screen readers always read the full text. Only truncated text is interactive: it joins the Tab order, keyboard focus shows the tooltip with a focus ring drawn inside the text, and Escape hides it. Text that fits is plain text with no tooltip and no tab stop.

## Motion

The tooltip scales and fades in from the text (the shared popover motion of `CsAnchoredOverlay`); reduced motion leaves only the fade.

## Mobile

On touch screens a tap toggles the tooltip and a tap elsewhere closes it. Truncation is measured at the current width and text scale, so rotating the device or changing the text size updates it.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `children` | `text` |
| `tooltipText` | `tooltipText` |
| (single line only) | `maxLines` (extra) |

---
source: doc/components/CsTutorialPanel.md

# CsTutorialPanel

Lists the available tutorials and, while one runs, its tasks, steps and progress; place it in the help or tools panel under a `CsAnnotationContext`.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/tutorial-panel/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

Widget panel(List<CsTutorial> tutorials) => CsTutorialPanel(
  tutorials: tutorials,
  i18nStrings: const CsTutorialPanelI18nStrings(
    tutorialListDescription: 'Walkthroughs of common tasks in this console.',
  ),
);
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use it as the entry point to hands-on tutorials, in the tools panel or a drawer.
- It reads the running tutorial and current step from the nearest `CsAnnotationContext`; without one it only lists tutorials.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tutorials` | `List<CsTutorial>` | required | All tutorials. |
| `loading` | `bool` | `false` | Shows a spinner with `loadingText` instead of the list. |
| `onDownload` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Shows the "Download PDF version" link. |
| `onFeedbackClick` | `ValueChanged<CsTutorial>?` | `null` | Shows a "Feedback" link on the completion screen. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsTutorialPanelI18nStrings` | English | All copy (see below). |

`CsTutorialPanelI18nStrings` fields (defaults from Cloudscape): `loadingText`, `tutorialListTitle` ("Choose a tutorial"), `tutorialListDescription` (empty hides it), `tutorialListDownloadLinkText`, `labelTutorialListDownloadLink`, `tutorialCompletedText`, `learnMoreLinkText`, `labelLearnMoreLink`, `labelLearnMoreExternalIcon`, `startTutorialButtonText`, `restartTutorialButtonText`, `completionScreenTitle`, `feedbackLinkText`, `dismissTutorialButtonText`, `labelExitTutorial`, `taskTitle(taskIndex, title)`, `stepTitle(stepIndex, title)`, `labelTotalSteps(count)`, `labelTaskStatusPending`, `labelTaskStatusInProgress`, `labelTaskStatusSuccess`.

## Examples

### Loading

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';

const loadingPanel = CsTutorialPanel(tutorials: [], loading: true);
```

## Accessibility

Each tutorial is a group with an h3 title and an expand button that reports its state. In the detail view, each task has a status icon labeled "Success", "In progress" or "Pending" and an expandable step list labeled with the task title and step count. The back arrow is labeled `labelExitTutorial`. The completion screen is a live region, so finishing is announced.

## Motion

Tutorial details and step lists expand and collapse from the top over 180ms (`motion-duration-show-paced`); the step list caret rotates. Reduced motion switches instantly.

## Mobile

Everything stacks in one column and wraps; titles and buttons wrap at 2x text. Use it inside a scrolling panel or sheet.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `tutorials` | `tutorials` |
| `loading` | `loading` |
| `downloadUrl` | `onDownload` |
| `onFeedbackClick` (`detail.tutorial`) | `onFeedbackClick` (the tutorial) |
| `i18nStrings` | `i18nStrings` (`CsTutorialPanelI18nStrings`); `labelsTaskStatus` is split into three fields |

# CsVisualContext

Recolors a subtree the way Cloudscape's `awsui-context-*` classes do: the always-dark top navigation and high-contrast header, and the inside of flash messages and alerts.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/foundation/visual-foundation/visual-context/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
const CsVisualContext(
  context: CsVisualContextName.header,
  child: CsHeader(variant: CsHeaderVariant.h1, title: 'Amazon S3'),
)
```

## When to use / when not to

For custom dark headers and bars that should look like Cloudscape's. Components that need a context already apply it (`CsTopNavigation`, `CsFlashbar`, `CsAlert`, `CsContentLayout` with a high-contrast header).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `context` | `CsVisualContextName` | | `topNavigation`, `header`, `appLayoutToolbar`, `flashbar`, `flashbarWarning`, `alert`, `alertHeader` |
| `child` | `Widget` | | |

## Accessibility

Contexts keep Cloudscape's contrast: text tokens change together with backgrounds.

## Motion

None.

## Mobile

Same.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape | Flutter |
| --- | --- |
| `className="awsui-context-top-navigation"` | `CsVisualContext(context: CsVisualContextName.topNavigation)` |
| `awsui-context-content-header` | `CsVisualContextName.header` |

---
source: doc/components/CsWizard.md
---

# CsWizard

A multi-page form that walks people through a complex task, such as launching an instance, one step at a time.

Cloudscape reference: https://cloudscape.design/components/wizard/

## Import

```dart
import 'package:cloudscape_flutter/cloudscape_flutter.dart';
```

## Usage

```dart
CsWizard(
  submitButtonText: 'Launch instance',
  onCancel: () {},
  onSubmit: () {},
  steps: const [
    CsWizardStep(title: 'Choose an image', content: Text('Image settings')),
    CsWizardStep(title: 'Configure storage', isOptional: true, content: Text('Storage settings')),
    CsWizardStep(title: 'Review and launch', content: Text('Summary')),
  ],
)
```

## When to use / when not to

- Use for long or complex creation flows that are easier to finish in sections, with a review step at the end.
- Do not use for short forms that fit one page (use a form in a `CsContainer`), or to show progress of a system process (use `CsSteps`).
- Put each step's form in containers (`CsContainer` with `CsFormField`s), like a regular form page.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | `List<CsWizardStep>` | required | The steps. |
| `activeStepIndex` | `int?` | `null` | The current step, from 0. Null makes the wizard track the step itself. |
| `onNavigate` | `ValueChanged<CsWizardNavigateDetail>?` | `null` | `requestedStepIndex` and `reason` (`next`, `previous`, `step`, `skip`). Update `activeStepIndex` here when controlled. |
| `onCancel` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | Cancel button. Confirm with a modal if the person entered data. |
| `onSubmit` | `VoidCallback?` | `null` | The last step's primary button. |
| `isLoadingNextStep` | `bool` | `false` | Spins the primary button and locks navigation, for server-side validation. |
| `allowSkipTo` | `bool` | `false` | Shows "Skip to" over optional steps ahead and makes them reachable from the list. |
| `submitButtonText` | `String?` | `i18nStrings.submitButton` | Text of the last step's primary button. |
| `secondaryActions` | `Widget?` | `null` | Start-aligned actions, such as "Save draft". |
| `customPrimaryActions` | `Widget?` | `null` | Replaces Cancel, Skip to, Previous and Next or Submit. |
| `i18nStrings` | `CsWizardI18nStrings` | English | `stepNumberLabel(n)`, `collapsedStepsLabel(n, count)`, `skipToButtonLabel(step, n)`, `navigationAriaLabel`, `errorIconAriaLabel`, `cancelButton`, `previousButton`, `nextButton`, `submitButton`, `optional`, `nextButtonLoadingAnnouncement`, `submitButtonLoadingAnnouncement`. |

`CsWizardStep`: `title`, `content`, `info` (an info link), `description` / `descriptionWidget`, `errorText` / `errorWidget` (a page-level error alert), `isOptional`.

`CsWizardStepStatus.of(...)` exposes how the step list decides which steps are reachable.

## Examples

### Controlled with server-side validation

```dart
class LaunchWizard extends StatefulWidget {
  const LaunchWizard({super.key});

  @override
  State<LaunchWizard> createState() => _LaunchWizardState();
}

class _LaunchWizardState extends State<LaunchWizard> {
  int step = 0;
  bool validating = false;
  String? error;

  Future<void> _navigate(CsWizardNavigateDetail detail) async {
    if (detail.reason == CsWizardNavigationReason.next) {
      setState(() => validating = true);
      await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => validating = false);
    }
    setState(() {
      error = null;
      step = detail.requestedStepIndex;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return CsWizard(
      activeStepIndex: step,
      isLoadingNextStep: validating,
      allowSkipTo: true,
      onNavigate: _navigate,
      onCancel: () {},
      onSubmit: () {},
      submitButtonText: 'Launch instance',
      steps: [
        CsWizardStep(title: 'Choose an image', errorText: error, content: const Text('Image settings')),
        const CsWizardStep(title: 'Add tags', isOptional: true, content: Text('Tags')),
        const CsWizardStep(title: 'Review and launch', content: Text('Summary')),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

## Accessibility

- The step list is a labeled container ("Steps"). Each step is a button named "Step 2: Configure storage"; optional steps add "optional" as a hint. The active step is marked selected; unreachable steps are disabled and leave the Tab order.
- On every step change focus moves to the new heading and the title is announced.
- The error alert is a live region with an error icon named by `errorIconAriaLabel`.
- The loading primary button announces `nextButtonLoadingAnnouncement` or `submitButtonLoadingAnnouncement`.

## Motion

On phones the step list expands and collapses with Cloudscape's expandable motion and its caret turns 90 degrees. Reduced motion makes both instant.

## Mobile

Below 688px of width the step list collapses into a "Step 1 of 4" toggle above the heading, as Cloudscape's small-container layout; the actions wrap onto several lines when needed.

## Cloudscape React mapping

| Cloudscape prop | Flutter parameter |
| --- | --- |
| `steps` (`title`, `info`, `description`, `content`, `errorText`, `isOptional`) | `steps` (`CsWizardStep`) |
| `activeStepIndex` | `activeStepIndex` |
| `onNavigate` (`requestedStepIndex`, `reason`) | `onNavigate` (`CsWizardNavigateDetail`) |
| `onCancel`, `onSubmit` | `onCancel`, `onSubmit` |
| `isLoadingNextStep` | `isLoadingNextStep` |
| `allowSkipTo` | `allowSkipTo` |
| `submitButtonText` | `submitButtonText` |
| `secondaryActions`, `customPrimaryActions` | same names |
| `i18nStrings` | `i18nStrings` |
| `analyticsMetadata`, step `analyticsMetadata` | not applicable |
